spro/ /mkhas shing gab pa'i dbang phag chen po lngo gab chen sko shi so skastse'ajigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i gsung 'bum legs nyad nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

khu tsho—tho spra —rto‘5/wa ri ( rda༄kātsā2 kyiru bhepo /dh+ri rirnyingh+ru de— mu rke sgo — d+ngha tshotsho tsho ririri‘ phro tshosnatsho (—kroskeṣe — ༄ci dzecho— —redro 9 — hūṃ/ rngorngo ri posko sna rī༄ri 'u0skre mormo ritrīriri cidz+wardo trībyāridz+wasnori sna/’( ri9bhe //cu dzo/ / kho — r+ṣa /tsho‘sh+lau tsho/‘hūṃ tsho da d+ngha ne ḍa dze+erdogle )// sti tsho lhorte ci ri mo tsho ci trī ne /ci snye ༷ ri ne+e ri/khu ‘ 7 rkyu cho nya— — 6rdo — ste—dz+wa— rī / — —— 7 ༵/ ri pha(rī — d+nghastu / rloṭ+wāṃlkospyoglujushā//ṭ+wāṃ kā rī—du ྾ — —skuṭa — — — (rdzo —— shāXbye—— — tā — — kruji 7 wapro—sgyu—ra rtetsho — jirirīdhesnyeciririrmophyerwa/ kyi—riri snye— —tshotshotre(ḍosgo tre ——bye—chorna —rde wa 4 snye —sdo ri ri preme+erngu/ ne—— — rngo dz+wa—podze —tre pro riX ḍa —trī — nga — kausdu༈ṣi//((nyardorda ༄ 5 / tshotsho — tshorirdod+ngha —da— ci—r+sha—— wa~X —4 sheskrene+e— — —྅mi / )༷ kru yam̐ skrerihūṃ r+ha ༷ — — jir+sār+ṣa — ca dzo du

pod 3sngon 'gro 'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhig yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing / rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud dang /dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang‘‘gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i 1

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos’’zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par bstsal/gong gsal dgongs don lag star dngos 'bab byed ched/nga tshos rang skyong khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te/ ched gnyer las khungs btsugs shing / ched mkhas mi sna skong 'then dang ci nus sgos mthun rkyen bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng de'i byed nus 'don skul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung snga ba'i sgo nas las 'go brtsams/nga tsho'i thog ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo log sa cha'i gna' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad/brgyud pa ring zhing / rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang / nang gses rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang / rtsom rig lo rgyus/gso rig mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis gzhung / nang don rig pa sogs bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyab khongs phal mo che zin cing / dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i gna' gzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dugade phyir thog ma'i 'tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng /1993lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs kyi tshal du〈khra dge slong tshal rigang rigang 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 3khrims dar rgyas kyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs〉sogs snga gzhug tu deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jog legs po byung zhing /bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang gzengs bstod kyi dbugs dbyung thengs du mar gnang /nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed a yon lhan khang gis༄〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bstun zhing / rang skyong khul gyi srid dbang btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa spaṭa shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lta dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub 3

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ston la brtsi srang sgos/ mi rigs phul byang rig gnas dar spel sbyorngo/:ngerang /ste :nge ra dang / sgyugs mthun —la dang ga gnas brje res la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stang sa la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs gna' rtsom sngog 'don myur skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/ bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing / srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rig gnas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin chabyutshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang / ched las shes byar gcigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thog rgyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul g.yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang smros ma dgos/de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chags par byas te/ ma 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 2dze dngul gyi mthun rkyen cung 'byor ba'i gnas tshul 'og〈dpe tshogs〉de jus 'god dang / mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye ge'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te/mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rig gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myur skyob bya ru yod cing / mang po zhig da dung med brlag tu ma song bar 'tshol du yod pa dang de tsho'i rig gnas rin thang gi skor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/ legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i legs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khya mchog dang / phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang risi ༅ /rdo/deldan te/ ji skad du‘‘mkhas pa rnams med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min’’ces gsungs pa shin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing / khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi 5

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshogs la thugs gzhigs yang yang mdzad pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dag yod pa dang / legs skyes de dag dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa dag la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'jog gnang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing / nga tshos bskrun pa'i shes rig la rmang gzhi dang khungs lung yod cing / brgyud pa dang ldan par gyur/ mkhas pa de tsho dang rig gzhung de tsho bzhugs pas rang gi rigs rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i thun min rig gnas shig gi bdag por gyur yod la/ shes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rim 'phang mi dma' bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dag dang de dag gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dag ni mi rigs shig dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na gzi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug la/ 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dang 'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrag rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/ 'di ltar bsam na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 3rjes su yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro'i rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can pa dag la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gtsigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang‘‘mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang / skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste’’sogs kyis mtshon te mkhas pa dag phu dud bya ba'i yul gsum gyi gtso bo'i go gnas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing / khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsung chos dag ni bslab bya'i gnas shig dang / lugs gnyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyim rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsung chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas tebu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus 7

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gyar mang po'i khrod du'ang srog dang bsdos nas srang skyob byas norab :nge//)she lhardosgo /rwape reX/༅'dug da lta bsam na 'a goms la gas tsam du ma zad snying stobs rigs shig gi mtshon byed du'ang rung bar snyam/de dag gi dbang gis sa gnas 'dir yang lo rgyus su mkhas pa mi nyung ba tsam byon cing / da lta'i bar 'tshol du yod pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang tsam bzhugs la/ de tsho'i thun min rin thang gi cha nas bshad na'ang lo rgyus su mgo lo ga 'di mdo khams 'brel mtshams su chags yod pas/ mdo khams rig gnas ma lag che ba gnyis ka gcig 'dres su song ba'i nyams shig snang la/ bod brgyud nang bstan grub mtha'i dbang du btang na'ang snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge lugs pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba/mnyam med bka' brgyud pa sogs grub mtha' che gras phal mo che zhig yun ring mnyam gnas su chags pas/ dmangs khrod rig gnas tshun gyi rig gnas kun la sa cha gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i sger khyad cig lhag ger snang bar bsten/ rig gnas shul bzhag 'di rigs myur skyob thub pa byung na/ bod spyi'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dar rgyun nam brgyud pa gyes 'phel 'gro tshul dang /sa gnas thun min rig gnas grub stangs sogs zhib 'jug byed par don snying dang rin thang shin tu che bar gdon mi za la tha na 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 3bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi nang gses phyogs rer mtshon na de phyogs kyi stong cha gsab nus pa'i tshad du son pa'i rin thang yang yod par zhib 'jug mkhas dbang du ma smra/gang ltar da lta nga tshos〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'di nyid par du bskrun te mgo log gna' rtsom gyi spyi bab khyad chos dang ngo mtshar kun gyi spyan sngar bstar thub pa ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'bab byung ba'i bye brag gi mtshon dpe zhig yin la/mgo log rig gnas khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras chen po zhig yin cing / krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom bya ba'i grub 'bras kyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin pa dang / deng dus la dge ba'i mdzad bzang zhig dang / ma 'ongs par bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig ste/ lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba rlabs che ba zhig yin pa bsnyon du med la/ sa gnas thun min rig gnas thon khungs sngog 'don sgos khyad thon rig gnas dar spel byed cing / rang skyong khul gyi rig gnas brje res dang phyi phyogs dril sgrog la shugs snon byed par mtshon na don snying chen po tshab byed gzhan du med pa zhig yod par snyam zhing / dus mtshungs su〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid kyis rgya che'i klog pa po dang 'bre la yod zhib 'jug pa dag la'ang rig pa'i longs spyod gsar ba zhig stob nus pa'i yid ches nga tshor 9

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ yod/de sngon gyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te /cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen gsar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag gis don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing / kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis yod/'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myur skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che ba'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mu 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub pa la rag las yod/mjug mthar mgo log gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing / grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu//zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1 1la bris/10

pod 3rtsom pa po ngo sprod mgor bsdus/rdo grub chen kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi las a lcags 'bri yi rigs las mched pa gnubs lcags mo'i rgyud du/yab rtsod bral dus babs kyi sprul ba'i gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa rgis li gter ston zhes yongs su grags pa de dang / yum mtshan ldan ḍā ki'i rigs gyur bsod nams mtsho gnyis kyi sras sa bod rab byang bcu bzhi ba'i shing mo gling lor(spyi rabye ra lo1865)ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'bros sgang zhes grags pa'i ri zhol da lta'i mgo log pad ma rdzong gi rdzong grong gi nye 'dabs su sku bltams/ snga ma'i bag chags/ sad pas sku chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge dang brda sprod sogs gzigs pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen/ rdzogs sprul bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan ltar/ grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rdo grub kun bzang 11

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhan phan 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer gyi sku phreng gsum par ngos bzung ste rdo grub chen gyi gdan sar 'khod na'ang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po ches brtag pa mdzad tshe gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i yang srid du grub pas/ khri chen gung thang pa'i sku skyer yang grags so//rdza stod du phebs nas 'jam dbyangs ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam rol chen po rdza dpal dge sprul sku o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhe sa pas/lhag pa'i lhas rjes sa bzang zhing byin gyis brlabs te dgongs pa no༅ ༄ye shes kyi klong rdol/ dgung lo brgyad du son pa chu pho sprel lor dpal sprul rin po ches da lo rdo grub sprul skus spyod 'jug gi ba ka' khrid gnang dgos zhes phyogs kyi slob bu mang du bsdus tshe/nye gnas 'khor dang bcas pas sprul sku khong sku na chung drags pas re zhig 'khor de lta bu la bka' khrid mi 'ong zhes nan gyis zhus pa bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad par brten/ bka' nan bzlog ma nus par rdza rgyal dgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor la spyod 'jug chen mo'i bka' khrid gnang ba na/ 'khor slob kun gyi lus kyi spu long dbang med g.yo zhing / dad pa'i mchi ma sham sham 'bab pa'i tshod du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ dpal sprul rin po 12

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 3che'i zhal nas/ rdo grub byis pa lo brgyad pas chos 'khor 'di 'dra bskor nus pa'i tshul la dpag na/ da dung lung gi bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs ran mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa chen pos bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang yang 'thor/ snga phyir o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang / rdzogs sprul mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rgya rong nam sprul kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa nyag bla gter chen/ 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sogs dam pa mang du bsten nas/ 'dul ba dbu tshad phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i zab chos spyi dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs phur gsum/ snying thig gong 'og sogs snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' gter smin grol gyi dbang lung khrid gsam/ mdo smad rdi tsha ༄dgon gyi mgo log sprul sku 'gya ba a lags sogs las kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig chas gtso byas ri bo dge ldan pa ltar gyi gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs mdor na mdo sngags gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi lta grub kun la khengs pa dang skyo ngal med par thugs 'dris gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa ches cher rgyas/13

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rab tshes lcags 'brug spyi lo1880lor mgo log pad ma 'bum dpon shog brgyad kyis ched du phul ba'i bzhugs gnas rdo yul khri zhes bya bar dgon gnas gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling zhes bya ba gsar du bzhengs pa/ phyis ming zur shugs kyis 'gyur te gsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling du grags/de tsam nas dgon pa de'i g.yon ngos brdzi med bkra leb gong mar thang stong rgyal po'i lha khang du grags pa'i dben khrod cig tu sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad pas/ tshul khrims kyi dri bsung zhim pos khor yug dus kun 'gengs la/ lhag pa'i lha la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin bgro gleng byed cing / ma gza' dam gsum mir brdzus nas glegs bam skyel 'bul byed pa/ nyin lam du ma'i sar rab gnas kyi 'bru char 'beb pa sogs mngon shes dang brdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang / rtag tu sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kho nar dgyes pas don gyi gsang ba sus kyang dpogs par dka'/ gzhan yang gangs ri'i ljongs su bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog dang / bka' gter rnying rgyud/ bod kyi mkhas grub ris med kyi gsung 'bum glegs bam gsar bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi phrin las kyang rgya cher spel/mthar rab byung bco lnga ba'i zad pa me stag gi lor(1929)14

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 3gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus so//lung gis zin pa'i thugs sras mgar ba mkhan po 'jigs med 'od zer dang / ser shul mkhan po/ klu shul mkhan po/ mkhan po dam chos bcas mkhan chen bzhis gtso'i dhiḥphi dug tsha sogs yul gru kun nas slob ma mang du 'dus kyang / 'khor slob rgya cher bsdu ba sogs thun mong gi mnga' thang dang gzi byin gyi spros pa rtag tu bskyungs te bzhugs/gsung rtsom la〈rgyud ma hā yo ga'i tan+d+ra gsang ba'i snying bo de /bo na sh+laud rnanazlo 8k+kor nge0’ nga5 la zur myarkya/spo rdzar gyi nga/songs 'bel //ji/ 45rig /rdo nge /dro/rdo //༷/ ///kye —rigage don ran ten ma rid — lde ga〉dang / 〈mdo las byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs kyi rgyan rnam par bshad pa rgyal yum lus bzang mdzes byed legs bshad phreng ba〉sogs mdo sngags gzhung 'grel gyi skor dang / sgrub thabs skyed rdzogs kyi skor/ lo rgyus gtam tshogs kyi skor/ gsung mgur snyan ngag gi skor/ zhal gdams man ngag gi skor sogs gang la'ang thun mong min pa'i khyad chos rtsal du thon pa'i gsung chos pod chen bcu phrag lhag cig bzhugs pa las/gong smras〈gsang snying spyi don〉dang / 〈gzungs kyi rnam bshad〉〈gter gyi rnam bshad〉sogs la shes nas smra ba'i mkhas pa du mas bstod bsngags kyi me tog mang du 'thor/ gzungs kyi skor la rnam 15

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad 'di nyid kho na las gzhung logs su brtsams pa zhig bod na med par grags pas/ 〈gzungs rnam〉'di'i dpe zhig a mdo dge bshes 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi phyag brgyud nas kun gzigs bcu gsum pa chen po'i spyan sngar phul bas dgyes gzigs dang bsngags brjod yang yang gnang bar gsung la/ rdo grub khong rang nas kyang〈gsang snying〉dang〈gzungs rnam〉gnyis ka snying dmar rjen du bstan pa yin ces lan du mar gsung bar grags/ 〈gzungs rnam〉dang〈gter rnam〉gnyis dbyin ji sogs kyi yi ger bsgyur yod pa'ang nye lam thos so/ /gzhan yang khong gi gsung chos gang la'ang rtsom nyams dang rtsom stangs kyi cha nas thun mong la rjes bzlos su ma song ba'i khyad chos shig yod la/ snyan rtsom la'ang 'gyur bag dang ro nyams gzhan dang gzhan la yong dka' ba'i cha bklags pa tsam gyis lhag ger myong thub pa zhig yod pas/gsung mgur dang / gtam tshogs khrod kyi sgrung thang dag la rtsom /snye/de ri bcarig / nyams 'gyur dang rin thang ngo mtshar ba zhig yod par sngon dang da lta'i ngag rig smra ba kun zhal gcig tu gleng ngo / /zhes pa'ang lnga rig smra ba bde legs rab rgyas su 'bod pas khul gna' rtsom gzhung las khang gis bskul ngor zla tshes dge bar 'phral mar sbyar ba'o// //16

dkar chagasngon 'gro'i gtam/ (1)rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ (11)gsang snying spyi don rnam 'byed rin chen mdzod lde/ (1)sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ (207)sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ (321)'jam dpal bstod 'grel/ (359)rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ (435)mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ (505)bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ (1)
༄7/ /dpal gsang ba'i snying po'i rgyud kyi spyi don nyung ngu'i ngag gis rnam par 'byed pa rin chen mdzod kyi lde mig ces dran ba bzhugs so//

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo//don dam dbyings dang sgrib bral rig pa'i sku/ /mi phyed rdo rje grub pa'i gzi brjid sprin/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur mdzad rgyud ldi'i dbyangs/ /kun khyab 'a khor lo'i dbang phyug bla mar 'dud/ /gsang mchog rgyud sde'i snang bas gdul bya'i gling / /grub gnyis lang tsho rgyas pa'i pad tshal du/ /sgrub mdzad brgyud gsum bla ma'i nyin mor byed/ /yid mkha'i ngos la brtan par bzhugs gyur cigargyud don zab mo bdag 'dras dpag dka' yang / /skyes bu'i brjod pa'i rjes 'brangs brag cha ltar/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i legs bshad la brten nas/ /cha tsam gleng 'dir gzu bo'i blo yis nyon//'dir snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi bstan pa rgya mtsho'i nang mdzod/ /gsang sngags chu bo bzhi yi 'byung gnas/ rgyud lung man ngag thams cad kyi srog shing / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug gi snying po bcud du dril ba/ sems dang ye shes rang snang bden pa dbyer med du ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i spyi don gyi rnam bzhag cung zad brjed byang du 'god pa la gsum ste/ ston pas ji ltar gsungs tshul/ de las ji ltar brgyud tshul/ brgyud pa de ldan gyi rgyud don dngos bshad pa'o/ /2

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3dang po ni/ 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa bdag nyid srid pa'i 'ching ba mtha' dag las grol yang / sems can 'khor ba'i gzeb du chud cing rmongs pa'i mun nag stug pos non pa/ nges par 'byung ba'i phyogs yongs su mi shes pa rnams la thugs rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur te/ nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od kyis mi mtshon pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi snang ba rlabs po che 'gyed pa'i slad du skye rgu tshe lo brgya ba la babs pa'i dus su rigs thams cad las rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mtho ba shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i sras su skye ba'i pad+mo dbang 'byor gyi yon tan mtha' yas pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa bzung ste/ shākya thub pa'am shākya seng ge zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po sa gsum na mngon par gsal ba des/dang por gzhon nu'i rol rtsed dang / rig pa slob pa dang /btsan mo'i 'khor du bzhugs pa la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi spyod ༄pa'i tshul dang mthun pa'i thabs mkhas pa mang pos sems can yongs su smin par mdzad nas/ lo nyi shu rtsa dgu bzhes pa na rgyal po'i srid 'byor spangs te rab tu byung / klung ne rañja na'i 'gram du dka' thub mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskul nas btags pa'i lus der bzhag ste ye shes kyi lus 'og min du gshegs nas mngon byang lngas byang chub brnyes/3

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de nas ri rab kyi rtse dang / rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang / o rgyan dang /za hor rnams su gshegs nas 'khor dag pa rnams la 'di nyid la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mtha' yas pa bstan/ slar btags pa'i lus la zhug sa nas byang chub snying por gshegs pa sogs mdzad pa lhag ma rnams mthun snang du bstan/ de ltar sprul pa'i skus gsang sngags bstan pa dang / 'og min du longs skus gsang sngags bstan pa gnyis byad dang gzugs brnyan lta bu yin pas phyi ma'i gnas skabs spangs nas snga mar mdzad pa ni ma yin te/slob dpon nyi 'od seng ges rgya cher 'grel du bshad tshul lo/ /ston pas mi yul du byang chub brnyes pa'i mdzad pa bstan nas theg pa thun mong gi chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus su longs skus 'og min du rgyud gsungs pa'i phyogs ni sgeg pa rdo rjes spar khab tu bshad pa'i tshul lo/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po yang phyi ma dang mthun par bzhed de/ gang du rgyud gsungs pa'i 'og min de la dbang phyag chen po'i 'og min te longs sku'i zhing gi 'og min dang /༄de'i rjes mthun sprul sku'i 'og min gnyis yod cing / phyi ma la'ang phyed sprul longs skur grags pa rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams dang / gtsang ris lha gnas kyi 'og min gnyis gsungs so //bshad tshul de dag gang yang mi 'gal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 4

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3rnam 'phrul gyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes mkhas pa dag gsungs so/ /spar khab tu bshad tshul 'di la brten nas snga ma kha cig /mi yul du sprul skus thun mong gi theg pa tsam las ma hā yo ga'i rgyud ma gsungs par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ rtsa rgyud nyid las sprul sku'i mdzad pa 'dul ba bzhi'i nang tshan gsung gis 'dul ba'i skabs su/ bla na med pa'i theg pa dang zhes gsungs pa sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /'og min du gsung tshul ni le'u dang pos dngos bstan gtso bo yin pas longs sprul gyis gsung tshul gnyis ka rgyud nyid na gsal ba yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ brgyud gsum spyi'i rnam bzhag dang / so so'i ngos 'dzin phyes te bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bshad rgyud rgya mtsho las/ rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor pa/ /dgongs pa rig pa rna bar brgyud/ /ces pa ltar gsum ste/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i brda chad thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /de la rgyal ba dgongs brgyud ni gnyis te/ dper na nam mkha'i zla ba gcig pu la ri bong gi gzags yod pa nyid kyis cha zla ji snyed shar ba thams ༄༄mi skur cad ri bong gi rgyan dang ldan par snang ba bzhin du/ 'chad pa'i skyes bu rigs drug pas rgyud don mthar phyin par brnyes pa nyid kyis de las sprul pa'i gshegs pa gshegs ma dang / sems dpa' 5

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yab yum zhi khro'i 'khor thams cad rgyud don brnyes par 'jog nus te/ de ni gtso 'khor dgongs pa gcig gis brgyud pa yin no//ston pa dang rgyud tha dad pa'i lhan cig pa'i 'khor rnams la zab dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad pas ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med du gyur pa'ang dgongs brgyud kyi tshul gcig go/ /sems dpa' rig brgyud ces pa ni/ gzhan du rig 'dzin brda brgyud ces 'byung ba dang mthun te/ 'chad pa po dag pa'i sems dpa' sngags kyi ye shes las grub pa'i sku brnyes pas rgyud yongs su smin pa'i byang sems kyi 'khor la thugs rig pa'i ye shes kyi dgongs pa gtad nas sngags dang phyag rgya'i brda thabs bstan pa tsam gyis de'i mod la 'khor gyis rgyud don mtha' dag rtogs pa ste/'di yang dgongs pa don brgyud khyad par can yin yang / rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi brgyud tshul las gzhan du go ba'i ched du dgongs brgyud ces ma smos par rig pas brgyud pa zhes pa'i brda sbyar pa yin no/ /rnal 'byor rna brgyud ces pa'i rnal 'byor ni/dang po nas rig sngags kyi lhar bzhengs pa lta bu ma yin par tha mal pa'i rten bzang nas lam bsgoms te drod ci rigs thob pa ༄yan chad de/ 'di ni thun mong gdul bya'i snang tshod dbang btsan par bya'i/ gnas tshod ltar na 'di'i rnal 'byor pa la rgyal ba 6

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3dang sems dpa'ang yod de/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa snga ma snga ma'i zhal nas phyi ma phyi ma'i snyan du dbang rgyud man ngag rim bzhin brgyud pa ni rna brgyud do/ /sangs rgyas nang phan tshun la'ang slob pa'i rna brgyud 'dra ba med kyang snyan du brgyud tshul tsam yod pa mi 'gal bar kun mkhyen chen pos gsungs shing mdo rgyud du ma'i lung gis kyang grub pas/ rgyal ba la dgongs brgyud kho na dang sems dpa' la rig brgyud kho na zhes bshad mi rung ngo / /des na rnal 'byor pa la rna brgyud gtso/sems dpa' nas brgyud tshul thun min rig pa'i brgyud pa dang /sangs rgyas dngos kyis brgyud tshul thun min dgongs brgyud yin zhes bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ sems dpa' rig brgyud/ rnal 'byor rna brgyud do/ /dang po ni/ ston pa rigs drug pas rgyal tshab rigs lnga sogs dang / rigs lngas lhan cig pa'i 'khor la brgyud pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ mi ma yin la brgyud pa dang / mi dang mi min gnyis ka la brgyud pa gnyis/dang po ni/ rgyal sras rigs gsum sems dpas lha klu gnod sbyin gyi rig 'dzin grags ldan mchog skyong sogs gsum la bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba zhi bar gzims nas lo nyer brgyad 'das 7

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa na dam pa'i rigs can drwa ma lnga laṅka'i yul gyi grong brdal gyi mtsho gling ri ma la ya'i rtse mor rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dus te/ sangs rgyas la dmigs nas gdung dbyangs blangs pas dpal phyag na rdo rje mngon sum du byon nas rgyud bshad do/ /gsum pa la/ mi yul du rgyud 'di thog mar byung tshul dang / de las ji ltar brgyud tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ bshad ma thag pa ltar/ gsang bdag gis bka' bsdu mdzad pa'i tshe de'i byin rlabs kyis sa ho ra'i rgyal po dza ste in+t+ra bho ti la/ sku gsung thags rtags thim pa dang / rin ༄chen glegs bam babs pa dang / chos kyi bgro ba byed pa dang /kun gyis dam par bsgrags pa dang / mchod pa chen po byas pa dang / rin chen char du babs pa dang / sangs rgyas sa la lung bstan pa'o/ /zhes pa'i rmi ltas bdun byung zhing / de dang mthun par pho brang gi steng du rgyud sde'i glegs bam dang phyag na rdo rje'i sku khru gang ba dngos su babs te gsol ba btab pas sngon gsang sngags la sbyangs pa'i 'phro sad de rdor sems zhal mthong gi le'u rtogs nas de dang phyag rdor gyi sku la brten te zla ba drug bsgrubs pas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mjal zhing byin gyis brlabs pas glegs bam gyi don mtha' dag mkhyen par gyur to/ /gnyis pa ni/rgyal po des ku ku rā dza la bshad/ de nas rim bzhin in+t+ra bhu ti/8

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3seng ha rā dza/ u pa rā dza/ sras mo go ma dī wi'i bar du brgyud de/de rnams ni tshom bu dang bcas te rig 'ardzan gyi sa la gshegs pa sha stag go/ /go ma dī wis sgeg rdor dang sangs rgyas gsang ba la bshad/ sangs rgyas gsang bas slob dpon chen po pad+ma dang bi ma mi tra la gdams te 'phags yul du byung ba'i tshul lo/ /bod du ni/slob dpon pad+mas rje 'bangs 'dus pa la lta phreng gsungs pa sogs de las brgyud pa'ang yod par snang mod/ gong ma rnams la grags che ba ni/ bi ma las rma gnyags gnyis la gdams/ de gnyis nas brgyud pa'i chu bo gsum du gyes pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la gcig tu 'dres/ des gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho dang so ye shes dbang phyug la bshad/ de gnyis ka la nyang shes rab mchog gis zhus/ de nas nyang ye shes 'byung gnas/ zur bo che shākya 'byung gnas/ zur chung shes rab grags/ thugs sras ka ba bzhi/ sgro phug pa shākya seng ge'i bar du brgyud/ gnyags gnubs zar gsum de dag la gsang sngags kyi babs so gsum du grags/༄ rosgro phug pa la thugs zin gyi slob ma bcu gnyis gdugs rugs kyi slob ma grwa sa 'dzin pa stong sogs byung ste rgyud 'di'i phrin las phyogs med du brdal/ de'i slob brgyud gtsang nag 'od 'bar/mes ston mgon po/ /sro shes rab tshul khrims/ rta nag bdud 9

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'dul 'bum/ mda' shākya 'phel/ zur byams pa seng ge/ rje sgrol g.yung rnam gnyis/ sgrol chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'gos lo chen po gzhon nu dpal/ karma zhwa dmar bzhi ba chos kyi grags pa/ 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs/ rang grol nyi zla sangs rgyas/'khon jo sras tshe dbang nor rgyas/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur chen bkra shis kun dga'/ dar sdings rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po 'gyur med rdo rje/de la lo chen dharma shrīs gsan/ gter chen sku mched 'di gnyis thugs sras dang bcas pas rgyud 'di'i dbang dang / sgrub thabs/dkyil chog /rgyud 'grel/ mtha' dpyod sogs rin po che'i sgron me lta bu'i legs bshad mang du mdzad cing / 'chad nyan gyi rgyun btsugs pas bstan pa la bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab/ de nas rim par brgyud de mkhas grub dam pa dge rtse bsod nams bstan 'dzin nam 'jigs med ngo mtshar nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pad+ma bkra shis/ de la rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyis gsan/ des bdag cag gi bla ma 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi thugs sras kun mkhyen sprul pa'i sku o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang bo dang /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang pad+ma dam chos 'od zer dpal bzang po gnyis la bstsal cing / snga 10

yangar tha/thegakhung /steḥng /spyo 1docad :ngezud byengecad zugalngadzorngasno r+shasdo/ 21dzod/ rdosams rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rnam rgyal dang / phyi mas rnam 'dren rje btsun dam pa mi pham rnam rgyal rin po cher gdams pa nas kyang brgyud de/ mdor na kho bo 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa rgyud sde'i gnas la sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes shing /'khor lo'i lha la bsnyen pa las su rung ba/ rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa'i drod thob pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi phreng ba bar ma chad par brgyud pa las da lta'i bar du dbang gi chu bo ma skam/ bshad pa'i sgron me ma nub/ byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od ma yal bar byon pa yin no/ /lo rgyus 'di dag gi zhib cha ni gzhan las shes par bya'o//gsum pa la/ bshad bya 'chad byed 'chad tshul gsum gyi rnam bzhag mdo tsam brjod pa dang / rgyud don dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir gsang sngags bla med la/ ma hā/ a nu/ a ti yo ga'i rgyud sde gsum ste/ de gsum gyi khyad par la/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying bo'i don mthar thug pa ni 'od gsal gnyug ma'i de kho na nyid zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i mtshan nyid can nyag gcig yin zhing / don de la dang por 'jug pa'i sgo mi 'dra ba gsum ste/ sku gsum lam byed kyi bskyed chog rgyas pa dang /bskyed chog gi spros pa nye bar bsdus kyang dbyings dang ye shes lam byed kyi phyogs gnyis la rim gyis slob pa dang / bcos ma'i 11

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bskyed chog la mi ltos par rtsol med rang bzhag gi thabs kyis ye shes mngon du byed pa'o/ /de las dang po gtso bor ston pa dang /gnyis pa dang gsum pa gtsor ston pa rim bzhin ma hā sogs gsum du bzhag par khas blangs na re zhig 'chad bde zhing rog gi bzhed pa dang yang mthun no/ /ji skad brjod pa'i bskyed chog rgyas bsdus dang / dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus mi gcig la mtha' gcod pa gzhan yang mang ste mang bas 'jigs so/ /ma hā la yang bde 'dus sgrub pa lung gi bka' sgo las/ ma hā'i ma hā ni lha'i dkyil 'khor rim pas bskyed pa'o/ /ma hā'i a nu ni rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /ma hā'i a ti ni don dam ngo bo ma skyes pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rim 'jug gi spros pa che chung la ltos te gsum du phye ba las 'dir ni kun byed las/ ma hā rdo rje 'chang 'dod pas/ /thabs dang shes rab sgor zhugs nas / /rang rgyud dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhis sgrub par byed/ /ces pa ltar ston pas ma hā yo ga'i rgyud dang / de'i nang nas kyang chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par rtsal du bton nas ston pas ma hā'i a tir 'jog pa sgyu 'phrul mkhan po phal che ba'i bzhed pa ste dpe chang rang gnas kyi 'grel pa bi ma ༄las mdzad pa dang / bde 'dus gsang sngags bka'i lde mig la 12

mang ba/25snang /sterngardo /khro/ 1dozug :rdozud byengezud zugajordzutshog /ldo/ spubashāḥ// do/sogs pa'i khungs dang ldan pa'o/ /de yang rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse/ bstan pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs/ lung thams cad kyi spyi 'grel/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i zhe phugs/ 'bras bu thams cad kyi thug sa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gshegs shul/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi lam chen po ste che ba brgyad dang ldan pa dpal gsang ba'i snying bo yin te/ ma hā yo ga'i tan chen po sde bco brgyad las tragasang snying 'di ku ku rā dza'i dpal phreng ba dam pa'i 'grel ba ltar na kun gyi bsdus don lta bu'i rgyud dang / kun mkhyen bla ma'i bzhed pa ltar na spyi'i thugs rgyud yin no/ /de gang gis 'chad na/lung rigs man ngag gsum gyis te/ lung ni 'di nyid kyi bshad pa'i rgyud grol lam rim dang cig char ston pa ye shes snying bo dang rdo rje me long / thabs lam rim dang cig char ston pa rgya mtsho dang thal ba ste bzhi dang rgyud phyi ma sogs so/ /rtsa bshad gnyis kyi khyad par ni bzhed pa mang yang / rog bde gshegs chen po/ thog mar byung zhi nga bshad byar gyur pa'i rgyud rtsa rgyud/ rjes la byung zhing 'chad byed du gyur pa'i rgyud gzhan bshad rgyud ces gsungs pa ltar 'thad la/ rtsa bshad mi 'gal te/ rgyud phyi ma bzhin no/ /man ngag ni/ rab gsang sngags bla med kyi 'phags lam brnyes 13

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pas rgyud don mngon shes kyis 'chad nus pa dang / 'bring yi dam lhas mngon sum du byin gyis brlabs pas rgyud 'grel nus pa dang / tha ma rig 'dzin gong ma'i man ngag gi brgyud pa tshad ldan mnga' ba ci rigs kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel dang man ngag thor bu rnams te spar khab dang 'grel chung piṇ+ḍar+sha sogs dang / lam 'arim/ thugs thig /lta phreng la sogs pa'o/ /rigs pa ni rtog ge shes pa'i nga rgyal dang / gzu lum gyis rgyud kyi rdo rje'i gnas la bshad pa byed pa ni rang bzos bstan pa dkrugs pa yin zhing /'di las 'di bshad ces pa'i tshig spyi'i go yul skam po mang du yod kyang rgyud don las gzhan du bkri bar mi nus pa'i nges pa brtan po mi rnyed pas rtsa rgyud kyi don bshad rgyud rnams la brten nas grub thob so so'i man ngag gis ji ltar bkral ba bzhin du 'thad pa'am rgyu mtshan rnam par dag pas rang nyid nges shing gzhan la 'chad mkhas pa gces so/ /rgyud 'chad pa'i tshul la lha rje zur bo che/ rgyud rgyud kyis/ rgyud 'grel bas/ rgyud sgrub thabs kyis/ rgyud man ngag gis bshad pa ste bshad tshul bzhir bzhed pa dang / khog gzhung gsal sgron las/ spyi don gyis khog dbub/dkyus kyis sa bcad/ tshig gis 'bru gnon/ brgal lan gyis gtan la dbab pa ste bzhir bshad pa sogs rgyud gzhung spyi'i 171

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3'chad thabs dang / lta ba brgal brtag gis dang / spyod pa 'jug thabs kyis dang / dkyil 'khor don rtags kyis dang /dbang gdams ngag gis dang / dam tshig rnam grangs kyis dang /phrin las chog bsgrigs kyis dang / sgrub pa phyag bzhes kyis dang /ting nge 'dzin bskyed rdzogs kyis dang / mchod pa phyi nang gis dang / sngags sgra dag sdebs kyis dang / phyag rgya bskyed rim gyis bshad pa ste rgyud kyi dngos po so so'i bshad thabs gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang bdag sgro phug pas bzhed pa'i/ rang bzhin dngos po'i gnas tshul/ ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i snang tshul/thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs tshul/ brtse ba'i thugs rje skyes tshul/'gro don ji ltar mdzad tshul dang lngas 'chad pa sogs yod mod kyi/bla ma dam pa rnams sgyu 'phrul khog gzhung las/ rab la mtshan bstan 'bring la dbye/ /tha mar 'bru gnyer dgrol ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brang ste 'chad par mdzad pas 'dir yang de bzhin du bshad par bya'o/ /de la gsum/ mgo smos pas go ba'i gdul bya dbang po rab la rgyud kyi mtshan bstan pa/ cung zad phye ste bshad pas go ba'i dbang 'bring la spyi don rnam par dbye ba dang / rnam par spros pas go ba'i dbang po tha ma la 'bru re gnyer re'i sgo nas ba shad pa'o/ /15

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de yang gdul bya shes rab kyi 'jug pa myur ba'i dbang rnon rnams la mtshan don bshad pa tsam gyis rgyud kyi brjod bya'i gnad mtha' dag rtogs nus pas de'i ched du mtshan bstan pa yin yang de kho na'i ched du mtshan bstan pa min te/ dbang po 'bring tha gnyis la mgo smos pas go ba'i bag chags bzhag pa'i ched du'ang bstan dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang 'bring la spyi don bshad pas rgyud don gyi 'gangs gshog pa'i go ba skyed nus pas gtso bor de la bstan par bya ba yin yang / dbang po tha ma la'ang 'bru gnyer dgrol ba'i sngon du lus rnam bzhag la bslab pas dkyu sa mthong nas rta rgyug pa ltar gzhung gi tshig don bzung bde ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /mtshan la rnam grangs gsum gyi dang po rgyud dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang 'chad pa'i skyes ba gsam gyi mtshan than mong ra༄1 ra༄mi ra medu bstan pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ste/ de'i don yang bshad rgyud me long las/ chos rnams ma lus gnyis med pa'i/ /rang rig byang chub sems nyid do/ /tha dad med pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /zhes pas/ rdo rje ni mi phyed mi shigs pa ste shes rab stong pa nyid do/ /'di'i gong 'og tu stong pa nyid ces bshad pa rnams ni 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog pa'i cha la spros pa'i kun rtog dang bden dngos gnyis char 16

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3gyis stong pas stong pa kho na'i rnam pa can yin pa dang / man ngag dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas de la mnyam par bzhag pa nyid kyis stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag par 'gro bas der brjod de/ 'di la kun mkhyen bla ma dang gter bdag gling pa sogs ma yin dgag gi stong nyid ces gsungs te/ de ni thabs shes gnyis kyi nang nas shes rab kyi phyogs yin pas shes rab ces bya yi/ sems byung shes rab min no/ /sems dpa' ni sa twa'i sgra skabs 'dir brtan bsdus rtogs gsum la bshad de/ thabs rang rig pa byang chub kyi sems shes rab stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i zung 'jug rang bzhin rnam dag de thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i dus su gnas shing mtshan nyid gzhan du mi 'gyur bas brtan pa dang / de nyid kyi phyag rgyas brtan g.yo kun la btab pa'am/ brtan g.yo thams cad de'i cho 'phrul du shar bas mnyam pa nyid du gnas pas na bsdus pa dang / gnas lugs rdo rje lta bu'i don de nyid sgrib pa dang bral zhing tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs pa'i mthus ji bzhin par mngon du mdzad pa ni rtogs pa ste/ snga ma gnyis gzhi 'bras gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhes gnas tshul la ltos nas bzhag cing / phyi ma 'bras bu'i rdor sems zhes snang lugs dri bral gyi cha nas bzhag go/ /de nyid mtshan ma'i phyag rgyar snang ba 17

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang 'chad pa'i skyes bu mi bskyod pa la'ang rdo rje sems dpa' zhes grags te/ brtan bsdus rtogs gsum gcig tu gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dngos mi slob zung 'jug yin yang rdo rje brtan bsdus gnyis bsgrub gzhir bzung ste rtogs pa'i rdo rje lam byed la gnas pa'i bskyed rim gyi rdor sems dang / de yar ldan du song ba'i rdzogs rim pa'i rdor sems kyang cha 'dra tsam du bya dgos so/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ni/ rdo rje las/thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i don/ /sgyu 'phrul zhes ni bzhir bshad do/ /zhes pas/ rtog tshogs/ nges don/ drang don/ lha rtog dbyer med kyi sgyu drwa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ 'byung ba shes rab rigs kyi yum/ /zhes pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar 'byung ba lnga'i bcud 'dus pa'i thig le'i cha phra ba rnams phung khams kyi snang ba ris su ma chad par 'char ba'i gzhir gyur pas na sgyu ma dang /de las phung khams rags pa'i cha sna tshogs su shar ba ni 'phrul ba dang / de gnyis rten dang brten par 'brel ba la drwa ba zhes bya'o//gnyis pa ni/ de ltar snang ba sgyu ma ltar ris med du 'char ba'i gnad mthar thug ni shes rab stong pa nyid yin pas de la sgyu ma zhes bya zhing / de'i rang mdangs thabs rig pa rang byung gi ye shes su gsal ba la 'phrul ba dang / de gnyis ngo bo dbyer med du 18

〉khu〉 ba/thabangang /stethab /spyo mdozud :rdozud byebyezud zugalngadzospyad 'e// 21rngad/ rdosa'abrel ba la drwa ba zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de mtshon pa'i rtags kyi phyag rgyar snang ba lha yum rnams ni sgyu ma dang / yab rnams 'phrul pa/ yab yum kha sbyor bde ba'i skur bzhugs pa drwa ba'i don to/ /bzhi ba ni/ sgyu ma ni rtog tshogs/ de nyid rang rig rtogs pa'i thabs kyis lhar shar ba ni 'phrul pa/ lha rtog rang bzhin gnyis sa med par 'brel ba ni drwa ba'o/ /'di rnams kyang ༄gzhi dang 'bras bu'i dbang du byas par gsungs pas gzhi la sbyar na rtog tshogs dang / de'i snang gzhi sems nyid 'od gsal te/sgyu drwa snga ma gnyis tsam dang / 'bras bu la sbyar na rtog tshogs ni/'bras bu'i chos la gzhi'i chos kyi ming gis btags na ma gtogs med la/ nges don ni rtogs pa chos kyi sku dang / drang don ni gsang sngags thun min gyi gzugs sku dang / lha rtog dbyer med ni/phung khams thams cad ro mnyam rdo rje'i lhar dag pa'o/ /gtso bo'i dbang du byas na/ rdo rje sems dpa' lhag pa don dam gyi phyogs nas dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba kun rdzob kyi phyogs nas bshad pa 'dra la/ gzhi'i rdor sems sgyu drwa shes nas/ 'bras bu'i rdor sems sgyu drwa 'thob phyir du gzhi 'bras gnyis ka lam du byed pa'i lam rgyud la'ang mtshan de ltar 'dogs par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa che ba las mtshan du btags pa ni/ mtshan nyid 19

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang rgyud thams cad kyi lung gi spyi zhes pa ste/ de'i don yang rdo rje las/ so sor bstan pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ /'dir ston 'dis ston 'di phyir ston/ /don kun 'di la yongs rdzogs pas/ /lung gi spyi zhes bshad pa yin/ zhes gsungs te/ mtshan nyid theg pa'i gsung rab kyi brjod byar gyur pa mngon mtho dang / nges legs dang / thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa'i lam thams cad 'di'i lam stegs su bstan cing / gsang sngags phyi ba'i mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi lam dang / khyad par rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag gi brjod bya'i snying po zab gsal gnyis med kyi gnad gsang ma lus pa rgyud 'dir ston pa dang / sde snod dang rgyud sde gzhan thams cad 'dir bstan pa'i don de dag nyid las brtsams te gsungs pas 'di las 'phros pa dang / bstan pa de dag thams cad rgyud 'di'i dgongs don lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med la 'jug pa'i ched du dngos sam brgyud nas gzhol ba ste/ de dag gi phyir lung thams cad kyi spyi chings sa gyar pa yin no/ /'di ༄༄la lung dang mthun pa'i mtshan zhes kyang gsung ngo / /gsum pa don rang gi ngo bo las btags pa'am man ngag dang mthun pa'i mtshan ni/ gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa zhes glegs bam gyi klad du 'byung ba nyid de/ 'di la bi ma la'i 20

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3khu༄4 'aspel chung du/ /rang bzhin gsang ba zhes bya ste/ /che ba zhes bya lisnying po'i don/ /de kho na nyid mtshan nyid de/ /nges pas nges don mdor bstan pa/ /zhes mtshan gyi zur bzhi pos rgyud kyi rang bzhin dang / che ba dang / mtshan nyid dang / nges pa'i don rnams bstan par bshad do/ /'dir spyi'i don phyogs tsam brjod na/ mdo phal po che las stong gsum gyi 'jig rten 'di rgyu rkyen ches mang po dang ches sna tshogs las 'grub pa dper mdzad nas rgyu tshogs nyung ngu dang mdor bsdus pa tsam gyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi 'grub par gsungs pa ltar gdul bya rgya chen po la mos pa rnams la bstan pa'i theg chen pha rol tu phyin pa ltar na tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa'i bye brag dang / dus dang / slob tshul gyi thabs ma/khas mtha' yas pa zhig la ngal ba ma bsten par byang chub 'thob pa gnas med kyang / zab mo la mos pa'i gdul bya skal pa rab mchog ldan pa rnams la bstan pa'i gsang ba bla med kyi skabs 'dir ni dpal kha sbyor thig ler/ de phyir de rgyas ci zhig bya/ /mdor bsdus pas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar/ lam mdor bsdus kyis 'grub pa dang / de'ang snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la 'grub pa dang / bde blag nyid du 'grub pa dang / lam gzhan bsnan pa la mi ltos par 'di nyid kho nas 21

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'grub pa'i khyad par dang ldan la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / phyi rgyud sde gsum man chad du gsal bar ma bstan pa'i ye shes lam byed kyi gnad thun min cig yod pa de gtan la phab pa nyag gcig gi mtha yin zhing / de 'dra de la rgyud 'di las lhag pa bden gnyis ༄dbyer med kyi chos sku chen po'i rnal 'byor zhes gsungs te/'di'i brjod bya'i mthil ni de yin no/ /de'i phyir mtshan gyi zur 'di dag thams cad kyis kyang gtso bor de kho na bstan pa yin no zhes shes par bya'o/ /so sor bshad na gsang ba'i don ni spar khab tu rang bzhin sogs gsum dang / bi ma las mi bstan pa'i gsang ba bsnan te bzhir phye na'ang 'dir rgyud nyid las/ khong nas gab sbas don 'byin pa/ /zhes pa ltar gab sbas gnyis su 'du bar rje rong klong gnyis bzhed pa ltar bshad de/ gab pa'i gsang ba ni/ gnas lugs rang bzhin gyi rgyud dang / de la ltos pa'i lam 'bras rnams zab cing gting dpag dka' bas shin tu dbang rnon ma gtogs pa gzhan gyis rtogs mi nus pa'o/ /sbas pa'i gsang ba ni/ gsang ba bla med kyi lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad thun min rnams snod min la rnam pa thams cad du sba dgos pas der bzhag ste/ 'di gnyis rtogs dka' ba dang / rtogs su mi rung ba'i khyad par gyis dbye bar bshad do/ /snying po'i don ni/22

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3zhezhesnying po'i skad dod sa ra/ hri da ya/ gar+bha gsum las/ dang po'i steng nas bshad na/ gcig las mang po 'phro ba'i gzhi la 'jug pas sems nyid rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa las 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'phro zhing / de gtan la 'bebs pa'i rgyud 'di yang bstan pa thams cad kyi 'phro gzhir gyur pa'o/ /hri da ya las bshad na/ snying ltar gces spras su bya ba la 'jug ste/ theg pa'i sgo gang nas zhugs kyang mthar thug 'di las mi 'da' bas byang chu ba 'dod pa rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i gtso bor gyur pa ste snga ma/ la rgyu'i snying po dang / phyi ma la 'bras bu'i snying po zhes bshad do/ /gar+bha ni glegs bam gyi dbu na bzhugs pa gtso bo'i don te/ shun pa'i nang gi snying po lta bu bcud 'dus pa'i don la bya'o/ /de'ang gong 'og gi theg pa thams cad zhal bsdur yang /'di'i lam la byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas kyi gnad 'dus shing rdzogs pa las lhag pa'i lam gzhan med pas gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnad bcud du 'dril ba'o/ /de kho na nyid ni gsum ste/ ma bcos pa'i/ ma nor ba'i/ gzhan ma yin pa'i de kho na nyid do/ /dang po ni/ gdod nas rang bzhin dag pa'i ye shes glo bur ba'i kun rtog dang de'i bag chags kyi rnyogs pas bslad pa la sems can dang / de gtan log pa la sangs rgyas su btags shing /23

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsang sngags kyi thabs mkhas kyis gnyug ma'i rang bzhin rjen la phyungs te bsgoms pa kho nas chab rom chur zhu ba ltar bslad pa de rang log tu 'gro bas 'od gsal snying po'i lam la rgyu'i de kho na nyid ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lam des rang gnas kyi ye shes dri bral du byas pa kho nas sku dang ye shes kyi 'khor lo thams cad gsal bar rang 'byung ba ste 'bras bu'i de kho na nyid ces bya/gsum pa ni/ de ltar na shes bya gzhi dang / bsgrub bya 'bras bu gnyis ka gnyug ma mi shigs pa'i sems gcig pu las gud na med de/ de la rgyu 'bras ro gcig pa'i de kho na nyid ces kyang bya'o/ /nges pa'i don ni/ de ltar gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag mdzad pa de dag kyang gdul bya la drang ba'i don du bstan pa'i ldem dgongs lta bu ma yin te/ dbang rnon mchog gi gdul bya la rgyal ba nyid kyis ji ltar thugs su chud pa'i dgongs don mthar thug pa bstan pa'o/ /mtshan nang gsang ltar bshad pa phyogs mthong tsam ni/ nang ltar na snying ga'i mi shigs pa ni gdod nas rang la gnas kyang mtshon dka' bas gsang ba/ de nyid la gsang sngags kyi zab gnad thams cad 'dus pas snying po/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis ye shes kyi snang ba de nyid gsal bar sad pa de kho na nyid/ snying po'i thig le de gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi srog tu 24

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3nges pas na nges pa ste/ rgyud sde'i rdzogs rim rnams su rtsa 'khor gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba mang yang gsang ba sgyu 'phrul las snying ga'i 'khor lo gtso bor byed pas de ltar gsungs te bshad tshul gcig go/ /yang 'khor lo bzhi dang sbyar na/lte ba'i dbyings phyug lnga'i thig le ni gsang ba dang / snying ga'i ye shes snying po'i thig le ni snying po dang / mgrin pa'i rngam ma'i thig le ni de kho na nyid dang / spyi bo'i kun tu bzang po'i thig le la nges pa zhes bshad do/ /gsang ba ltar na/ rtsa gnas kyi thig le bde ba'i ye shes kyi ro dang bcas pa rang chas su yod kyang ma shes pas gsang ba/ thig le de la phung khams thams cad kyi bcud 'dus pas snying po/ thabs lam zab mos gnad du bsnun pas lhan skyes kyi rang zhal ji bzhin mthong ba de kho na nyid/ thig le de nyid gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum ka'i gnad srog tu nges pa la nges pa zhes bshad de bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag go/ /de ltar na rgyud 'di rgyud lung man ngag gsum gyi gnad bsdus yin pas rgyud dang mthun pa sogs mtshan gsum du byung zhing / rang gi ngo bo ma hā yo ga la ltos pa'i man ngag a ti yo ga'i rgyud du gnas pas glegs bam gyi klad du man ngag dang mthun pa'i mtshan 'ba' zhig smos zhes gsung ngo / /25

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gnyis pa la gnyis te/ don gyi rnam grangs rnam par dbye ba dang / tshig gi rnam grangs rnam par dbye ba'o/ /dang po la'ang /rgyud 'byung ba'i rgyu gleng gzhi/ rkyen gleng bslang / 'bras bu yongs su shes par bya ba rgyud don / rgyud kyi dgos 'brel/ 'khor la gdams shi nga bstan pa gtad pa ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ gang du ston 'khor tshogs pa de'i tshe rgyud 'byung bas phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan ni gleng gzhi'o/ /sgra bshad ni/ gleng gzhi'i skad dod dā na zhes pa sbyin pa la 'jug ste/ khungs ldan gyi lo rgyus ma rnyed pas yid mi ches pa rnams la nges pa sbyin pa'i phyir dang / rgyud don gleng ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye na thun mong ma yin pa dang / thun mong gi gleng gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni thabs lam dang sbyar ba ste/ de la'ang steng 'og gi sgo'i lam dang sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa bzhi dang / ston pa rtsa 'khor de'i dbus na sems mi shigs pa dwangs ma lnga'i thig le la brten te bzhugs pa dang / 'khor rtsa 'dab la rgyu ba'i las rlung gi bzhon pa can gyi rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang / bstan pa 'am chos bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes bsam mi khyab kyi dgongs pa ste mi shigs pa sad stobs kyis las rlung ye shes su sbyangs shing tshogs brgyad bde stong gi ros khyab pa 26

loḥji pe/thagapang /mijing /sde/ nyedozud :rdozud byengecad zugartse(rdotshod /sdo/ 1rngo/spredri// 2/ni ston pas 'khor la chos bstan pa dang / dus ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du bsdam pa dus med kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa'i dus so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje btsun mo'i pad+ma las bzhi'i dbyibs can ni gnas dang / thabs kyi rdo rje nor bu'i dbus na rtsa khams kyi bcud 'dus pa'i byang sems kyi thig le bzhugs pa ni ston pa dang / byed bcing gi thabs dang bcas pa'i yab yum gnyis kyi gsang ba'i rnam shes ni 'khor dang / thabs lam gyi sems lnga rdzogs pa'i mtha'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni chos dang /ston pa de'i mthus 'khor de dag chos de'i ngo bor skyes pa ni ston 'khor zhu 'chad byas pa'i don dang / dus sngar bzhin te/ de ltar phun sum tshogs pa lnga'o/ /'di dag rgyud kyi thog mar 'byung ba'i e waṃ mā yā zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi dang sbyar nas bshad rgyud kyis ji ltar 'grel ba sogs dgongs rgyan las shes shing le'u gnyis pa'i gsang dbang ston pa dang / dbang phyi ma gnyis ston pa'i rgyud tshig gi shugs kyis kyang rim bzhin steng sgo dang 'og sgo'i gleng gzhi thon par bshad rung bar mngon te/ nang gsang gi phun tshogs lnga ldan 'di dag gleng gzhir 'gyar tshal gyis shes pa'i phyir ༄ ༄te/ gleng bslang gi skabs su lhan cig pa'i 'khor rnams la ston pas 'bras dbang bskur nas de rnams nang gi mngon byang lngas 27

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byang chub pa na go phye ba'i 'khor gyi ched du/ e ma'o ye nas gsang ba'i chos sogs ched brjod zhus lan mdzad pa las 'phros te rgyud yongs rdzogs byang ba yin la/ de lta ba'i mngon byang lnga po'ang ri'i rig1snying ga dang gsang ba'i 'og min du 'tshang rgya tshul yin pa'i gnad kyis de la ltos pa'i phun sum tshogs pa lnga gleng gzhir song ba yin zhes dam pa snga ma dag bzhed do/ /gnyis pa la longs sku'i gleng gzhi'am rgyud 'byung ba khyad par can gyi gleng gzhi dang / de'i zhar byung gdul bya dgos ched du bstan pa khro bo'i gleng gzhi/ sprul sku 'gro ba 'dul ba'i gleng gzhi'am bstan pa spyi'i gleng gzhi ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ khog gzhung las/ ston gnas 'khor dang sdud pa dang / bstan pa dus kyis shes par bya/ /zhes phun sum tshogs pa drug tu bshad kyang /'dir sdud po phun tshogs 'khor la bsdus nas lngar bya'o/ /de la gnas ni/ spyan 'grel las/ don gyi/ rig pa'i/ gsang ba'i/'jig rten gnas kyi/ dbang phyug chen po'i 'og min dang lngar bshad pa'i ya gyal phyi ma ste 'dir bstan gyi dbang phyug chen po ni bla na med pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug ste longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o/ /de lta bu'i gnas de rang bzhin dang ngo bo gnyis kyi sgo nas bshad pa'i dang po la spyi'i rang bzhin ni/28

yang〉ming〉 tha/rdogasprang /steḥb /gra thergazud ṣ+ṭhasdezud byebyezug zugalngadzocad /sdo/ 1sprorngad/ do/'grel chang las/ mtha' dbas med pa'i chos kyi dbyings/ /de ni rang ra mi sanas kyi bla mar 'dod/ /ces pa ltar chos kyi dbyings yin la/cha shas so so'i rang bzhin ni/ 'og gzhi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin ye shes lnga dang / gru chad kyi bden bzhi dang / bar khyams kyi bden pa dbyer med la sogs pa'o/ /gnas kyi ngo bo ni/ rnam pa'i khyad par te 'grel chung las/ gzhal yas gzhi dang rgyu dang rgya//dbyibs dang glo 'bur rtse mo dang / /rgyan dang sgo khyud rta babs dang / /mtshan nyid gdan gyi rnam pa ste/ /bcu gcig dag gis dbye bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ston pa phun tshogs bshad pa la'ang rang bzhin dang ngo bo gnyis te/ de'ang dkyil 'khor gyi brda don ngo sprod la dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid bstan pa zhes brjod pa ltar dag pa'i rten dang brten pa'i ye shes kyi de nyid la rang bzhin dang / gzugs kyi rnam pa la ngo bo zhes btags pa yin pas rang bzhin chos sku'i phyogs nas dang / ngo bo gzugs sku'i phyogs nas bstan dgos so/ /de la ston pa'i rang bzhin ni 'grel chung las/ /byang chub mchog gi ngo bo dang / /chos rnams rol par longs spyod dang / /phyogs dus bde gshegs bdag po dang / /chos so cog dang dbyer med pa'o/ /zhes bzhir bshad cing / de'i dang po la'ang chos nyid de bzhin nyid sgrib 29

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byed kyi dri ma mtha' dag spangs pas mnyam par ma bzhag pa med pa'i tshul gyis mngon du mdzad pa de bzhin nyid du nar son pa'i rang bzhin dang / de'i dbang gis 'bras bu'i chos rgya mtsho lta bu rtsol med rang byung du brnyes pa yon tan ma btsal lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin ye shes re re'ang kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin yin pas tshad 'di tsam zhes bzung du med pas ye shes mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin gyi go 'phang la bzhugs kyang srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis gang dbang bsgyur yang gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i chos nyid las mi g.yo phyogs su'ang brjod du med pa'am/ yang na mnyam bzhag gi dgongs pa mtshan ma'i yul can gang gis kyang mtshon du med pa 'bras bu la mnga' mdzad kyang ngo bo bstan du med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ ye shes sgyu ma'i spyod yul tshad med pa la dbang bsgyur yang gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i chos nyid las mi g.yo ba ste/'di la mnyam pa nyid mngon du mdzad kyang spyod yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin zhes kyang bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba thams cad bsdu na rigs lngar 'du zhing lnga po'ang rigs drug pa la 'du bas rigs thams cad kyi bdag por bzhugs pa ste/gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin zhes kyang bya'o/ /bzhi 30

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3ba ni/ khams gsum dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i 'khor ba'i chos thams cad kyang lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med kyi don las phyi rol du gyur pa med cing bden gnyis de dag la rgyal ba drug pa'i dgongs pa rtag khyab tu bzhugs pa ste gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid chen por dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rang bzhin zhes kyang bya'o/ /gnyis pa ngo bo la'ang bzhi ste/ ston pa sku gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa'i don rtags/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i don rtags/ ye shes drug dang ldan pa'i don rtags/ rnam thar gsum dang ldan pa'i don rtags so/ /dang po la'ang chos sku'i bdag nyid yin pa'i don rtags su sku mdun dang rgyab med par phyogs thams cad du thal ler gzigs pa dang / longs sku'i bdag nyid yin pa'i don rtags su mtshan dpe'i yon tan mthar thug pa dang ldan pa dang / sprul sku'i bdag nyid yin pa'i don rtags su sku'i ba spu'i sgo re re las kyang sprul pa dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur spro ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ snying rje chen po dang / mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis mi gnas myang 'das la bzhugs pa'i brdar yab yum gnyis ka mtshungs par skyil krung du ba zhugs nas 'khril ba'o/ /gsam pa ni/ ye shes lnga rang byung gi ye shes dang drug brnyes pa'i ༄31

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rtags su phyag drug dang / des 'gro don mdzad pa'i rtags su rdo rje la sogs pa'i mtshan ma drug 'dzin pa'o/ /bzhi ba ni/ sku stong pa nyid/ gsung mtshan ma med pa dang / thugs smon pa med pa ste gsum po dbyer med pa'i rtags su mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum mnga' ba'o /'khor phun tshogs la lhan cig pa dang go phye ba'i 'khor gnyis/dang po la rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i/ rig pa khyad par can gyi/ dad pas gtam nyan pa'i 'khor ro/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po sogs rgyal ba rigs lnga ste/rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po zhes pa 'di la kun mkhyen chen pos rnam par snang mdzad yin pa'i sgrub byed mang du 'god par mdzad la/ zur pa ni glang chen rab 'bog gi rgyud dang / nyi 'od seng ge'i 'grel ba dang / rdo rje las rim sogs kyi khungs la brten nas mi bskyod par bzhed de/ gter bdag gling pa sku mched sogs kyang phyi ma'i rjes su 'brang ngo / /rigs lnga 'di dag thal ba las/ 'khor lo'i lte bar mi 'jigs steng / /bdag po kun bzang 'khor rnams la/ /kun 'byung sgyu 'phrul ston pa'i tshe/ /mi bskyod rgyal po mdun na gnas/ /zhes pa ltar rigs drug pa rgyud kyi ston par bzhengs pa la ltos te 'khor dang / spyir 'chad pa'i 32

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3skyes bu rigs lnga zhes grags pa ltar ston pa'ang yin pas ston 'khor gnyis ka'i gzhi mthan no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgya mtsho las/༄ de bzhin thugs kyi khyad par las/ /rang snang rgyal ba sems sogs dang / /zhes pa ltar ston pa'i thugs rig pa sngags kyi ye shes kyi khyad par las rang snang ba'i phyir rig pa khyad par can gyi 'khor zhes bya ste/ de la'ang rdo rje mthong ba dang / mthong bar bya ba sogs sems dpa' yab yum bcu drug dang / rdo rje reg pa dang / rtag par ma yin pa sogs 'joms byed khro bo yab yum brgyad de/ sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus la dbang yul sogs ngo bo tha dad med kyang ro mnyam rdo rje'i phung khams skye mched kyi ldog cha so so las gshegs pa gshegs ma dang sems dpa' yab yum sogs tha dad du sprul par shes pa'i ched du phung khams sogs kyi ming gis lha la btags pa'o/ /de dag ni ma 'ongs pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis gleng gzhi dang mthun par dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa'i dbang du mdzad nas rgyud tshig gis dngos su bstan pa'i 'khor rnams yin gyi/ rje sgro phug pa dang nye ston sogs kyi bzhed pa ltar ston pa las rgyud gzhan du gyur pa'i 'a phags pa slob pa yang mtha' yas pa zhig lhan cig pa'i 'khor la yod dgos te/ de lta ma yin na le'u gnyis par ston pas 'khor 33

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/la zab dbang bskur nas rtog pa'i dri ma bsal bar gsungs pa mi 'grigs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ khog gzhung las/ dad pas nyan pa'i lha chen rnams/ /zhes pa ltar/ phyi'i 'khor yug la gnas pa legs ldan ma hā dre wa la sogs pa'i lha chen po rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngags la mos pa'i dbang rnon skal ba dang ldan pa rnams te/ 'di dag 'og min du tshogs pa'i 'khor min yang rgyud kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya yin pas rdo rje sems dpa'i 'khor du smos so/ /bstan pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ gnyis med rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di nyid dang / dus phun tshogs ni/ gleng gzhi'i ston 'khor sogs tshogs pa'i dus so/ /gnyis pa la'ang phun sum tshogs pa lnga las gnas ni/ 'bar ba'i dur khrod chen po shin tu 'jigs pa'i rgyan chas kyis spras par ro/ /ston pa ni dgongs 'dus las/ shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi phyag rgya las/ /khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ /ces pa ltar/ phrin las phyag rgya'i khro bo ste/de la'ang drang srong khros pa'i dang / mi'u thung byis pa'i dang /dpal chen rngams brjid kyi cha byad gsum las phyi ma'o/ /'khor la gdul bya dang 'dul byed kyi 'khor gnyis kyi dang po ni/ ru tra 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ de'ang 'dir bstan gyi ru tra 'di gnas 34

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3zhesgomatshod la sprul pa yin par bshad kyang / snang tshod ltar na sngon sangs rgyas kyi rig sngags drag po bzlas shing / de lta bu'i sngags kyi lha bsgoms kyang lta ba zab mo'i gnad kyis ma zin cing dam tshig nyams pa'i chad pas ngan 'gro brgyud pa'i mthar las kyi srin po rig sngags kyi mthu can 'phags pa'i gnas lnga ma gtogs pa'i 'dod gzugs kyi khams thams cad sngags kyis dbang du bsdus shing 'jig rten phung bar byed pa/ gdug cing gtum pa'i 'khor mang po dang ldan par gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ khrag 'thung rigs bzhi'i tshogs dang / sras mo nyi shu ste/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad ni gdul bya dang 'dul byed kyi 'khor gnyis kar gtogs zhes gsung ngo / /bstan pa ni/ pho rgyud rnams la sgrol ba dang /mo rgyud la sbyor ba'i sgo nas rang gnas kyi ye shes mngon du bstan pas sbyor sgrol gnyis so/ /dus ni/ sngags kyi gdul bya gdug pa can 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa na'o/ /gsum pa la'ang lnga las/gnas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas sngon slob lam du smon lam gyis ji ltar bzung ba bzhin grub pa'i sprul sku'i zhing ste/ zhing 'di dang sbyar na gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya'i bdag nyid dang / spyir gling bzhi bye ba khrag khrig du ma dang ldan pa'i sprul sku'i zhing yang yod do/ /ston pa ni/ bstan pa 'di'i dbang du byas na shākya'i 35

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyal po ste/ gdul bya rigs drug la ltos te thub pa drug tu bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang / dmyal ba dang yi dwags kyi 'gro ba la gshin rje'i rgyal po dang / dud 'gro kha cig la ri dwags dbang po sogs rigs mthun gyi gzugs dang / mtshan dpes spras pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i gzugs dang / mchog gi sprul sku dngos kyis 'dul ba sogs mang du yod kyang mchog sprul nyid gtso bo dang rtsa ba'i sku yin pas rgyud kyi tshig zin gtso bo de yin no/ /'khor ni gtso bo'i dbang du byas na lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa zhes pa ltar lha mi gnyis/ de'i yang gtso bo 'khor rnam pa bzhi dang / spyir 'gro ba drug ka ci rigs su yod do/ /bstan pa ni/ 'dul ba bzhi ste/ sku/ gsung / thugs/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dul ba'o/ /de la dang po ni mdzad chen bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i sku ste/ gang gis chos ston pa'i rten no/ /lhag ma gsum ni/ cho 'phral gsum ༷༷) /blo/khro /zwato 1rngotho /re) 1111 zirabad+nghas sa ston tshul tsho / dang ra rdzu 'phrul sa 'a/ ra 'dun par mdzad/ de nas mngon shes kyis 'khor gyi sems la gzigs nas kun brjod par mdzad/ de'i 'og tu gdams ngag dang rjes bstan 'bogs par mdzad pa'i phyir ro snyam zhing go rim de bzhin mi 'byung ba ni snga ma bzhin dgongs so/ /dus ni rdzogs smin sbyang gsum grub nas sgron ma bkod pa'i dus so/ /de'ang le'u gnyis 36

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3zhed+kupa ltar lhan cig pa'i 'khor rnams 'bras dbang gis snang gsum gyi bag chags sam 'pho ba'i bag chags phra mo'i bdud bcom pa na de'i rtags snang phyi rol du khro bo'i gleng gzhir snang ba yin zhing /der ma zad sprul sku 'gro 'dul gyi gleng gzhi'ang le'u dang po'i sku gsung thugs sna tshogs par kun tu snang ba/ zhes dang / gnyis pa'i/ bstan phyir spro ba sna tshogs mdzad/ /ces pa las 'phros pas 'di gnyis zhar byung gi gleng gzhir 'gyur zhes bshad do/ /gnyis pa gleng bslang la/ ston 'khor zhu lan gyi sbyor bas rgyud don gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams par 'byung ma rag pa'o/ /de ni gleng bya rgyud don nyid gleng bar bskul ba'i sgo nas bstan pa 'byung ba'i rkyen byed pas na gleng bslang zhes bya'o/ /dbye na thun min dang thun mong ba gnyis las/ dang po la gsang dbang bskur ba dang / dbang gong ma gnyis bskur ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ston pa yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa las byung ba'i nyi zla byang chub kyi sems kyis lhan cig pa'i 'khor gyi rig 'dzin rnams la dbang bskur zhing / yab kyis thabs kyi cha bzung nas 'khor 'das brtan g.yo thams cad dag pa rab 'byams lha'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu sangs rgyas par ched du brjod cing / yum gyis shes rab kyi cha bzung nas brtan g.yo thams cad gdod nas rang 37

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin rnam par dag pa'i dbyings las mi gzhan par ched du brjod pas 'khor rnams kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i bden gnyis kyi rtogs pa cher 'bar ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems ye shes su bskyed pa'i ched du brjod pa e ma mtshar lnga gsungs te/ de'i tshe 'chad par 'gyur ba'i g.yo ldang / 'jig 'jug /gnas pa/smon pa ste sems bzhi sngon du 'gro bas dga' ba bcu drug lugs 'byung gi mtha'i lhan skyes sher dbang gi ngo bo nyid thob cing /slar mas brtan gyi dga' ba bcu drug gi mthar bde ba chen po'i dbang rdzogs te ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med du gyur pa'i mthar phyin byang chub kyi sems thob pa ni 'og tu dri zhus 'byung ba'i rkyen yin pas na gleng bslang ngo / /'dir ston pa kun tu bzang po khu rdul rlung gsum dag pa'i ye shes kyi sku can gyis 'khor la dkar dmar gyi thig le'i rdzas dbang bskur ba dang /'og min gyi rten can sa mthor bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin lus khu khrag dang sems 'khrig sred kyis dben pa phyag rgya la brten nas dbang gong ma gnyis nod pa mi 'gal ba'i tshul ni/ ston pa dbang 'byor gyi mthu'i pha rol tu byon pas 'khor gyi ched du nyi zla byin gyis rlabs pa mi khegs pa dang / dag pa'i 'khor la 'khrig sred kyi nyon mongs med kyang lhan skyes kyi bde ba don gnyer yod la /38

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3spyir btang 'og min gyi rten la khu khrag med kyang bla med kyi sngags spyod pa'i 'og min pa kha cig la khams drug ldan gyi rten khyad par can de 'dra 'byung ba dmigs bsal yin pa'am/ lo chen rin po che'i bzhed pa'i slob pa'i rten la khu rdul phra mo dag pa mi srid pas de'i phyogs nas bshad kyang rung bar sems te 'gal spong de ltar bya'o/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos grol ba'i thig le drangs nas bshad pa sogs ltar na rgyal sras mthar lam pa mi slob lam du sher dbang nas zhugs pas chog pa 'dra yang 'dir gsang dbang nas 'jug par bshad pa ni lugs gnyis kyi gsang dbang gi lam 'jog tshul mi 'dra bas yin nam/ yang na 'bras dbang bskur tshul 'di gsang dbang bskur tshul dang chos mthun pas gsang dbang du brjod pa tsam yin zhes 'chad pa gang bde dpyad dgos shing / dbang phyi ma gnyis la'ang dogs pa gcad rgyu yod de des shes nus so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar zab dbang la brten nas ston pa'i thugs kyi gsang ba ji lta ba bzhin mngon du byas pa na don de gsang ba bzhis chod nas 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i sems can rnams la rgyud bshad par/ e ma'o ye nas gsang ba'i chos/ /la sogs pa'i shugs kyis gsol ba btab pas srid pa'i 39

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sdug bsngal mtha' dag 'dzin pa phyin ci log gi rtsa ba can yin pa dang / de nyid kyi phyir 'bral rung glo bur ba kho na yin pa dang /gshis bcing grol gnyis su med pa nam mkha' ltar dag pas rgyud bstan pa don yod par mkhyen nas zhal 'dzum pa dang / smin ma/ g.yo ba sogs dgyes tshul drug gis ston par zhal gyis bzhes pa'o//gsum pa 'bras bu yongs shes rgyud don la/ rgyud gsum gyi rnam bzhag spyir bshad pa dang / lam gyi cha rkyen rgyud kyi dngos po bcu bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis te/ snga ma brjod bya gtso che ba'i dbang du bshad pa dang / phyi ma rjod byed gtso che ba'i dbang du bshad pa zhes kha cig las so/ /de'i dang po la/ gang rtogs par bya ba gzhi'am rgyu'i rgyud/ gang gis rtogs shing bgrod pa thabs sam lam gyi rgyud/ gang du mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i rgyud dang gsum du bshad de/ til la mar yod par shes na btag btsalge gi ngal ba la mi 'dzem par zhugs nas mar 'thob pa bzhin du rang rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi bsgrub gzhi mthar thug yod tshul dang /de'i khyad chos legs par shes na de nyid shin tu rnam dag 'bras bu'i gnas skabs dang rnam pa mthun par lam du byas nas yar ldan du 'khyer ba'i thabs mkhas kyi gnad la nges pa rnyed nas brtson pas sgrub nus shing / des mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'grub 40

zingar po/thagapa( /nyesprang /spyo 1dozud ṣ+ṭhasdecad cesacad zub:dzarngasno rtegi/ 21spred/ rdosapa'i phyir ro/ /tshul 'dis gzhi lam 'bras gsum rgyun gcig tu 'brel bas na rgyud ces gsungs te/ rgyud phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags la bshad de/ /thabs dang rgyu las 'bras bu'o/ /zhes gsangs pa'i phyir te/ thabs ni lam/ rgyu ni gzhi'i don to/ /༄'di gsum la glan nya tshal ba/ gnas pa gzhi/ 'jug pa lam/ smin pa 'bras bu zhes gsung / lo chen rin po che ni/ de ltar na lta ba chos can/ lam rgyud ma yin par thal/ lam rgyud la 'jug pa zhes pa'i mtshan nyid kyis khyab pa gang zhig /khyod 'jug pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags zur dang po khas/ phyi ma grub ste/ khyod the/sa pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhig /shes 'jug gi mtshan nyid gnyis mi gcig pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs kyang glan gyis de la/ ma khyab ste/mtshan nyid gsum gyi dang po de 'jug pa lam gyi rgyud yin yang shes 'jug gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ma yin pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhes lan btab na dpyad dgos so/ /lha rje dpyal/ 'bras bu'i rgyud la yon tan gyi smin pa mthar thug pa zhes gsungs te/ lam gyur gyi 'bras bu la ma khyab gsung /rang lugs/ chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa gzhi/shes 'jug gi byed rtsol dang bcas pa lam/ chos nyid mngon gyur bogs dbyung du med par son pa 'bras bu zhes bzhed do/ /41

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang po gzhi rgyud la/ gtso bo'i don gnas lugs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi dang / zhar byung 'khrul pa btags pa'i gzhi ste gnyis/dang po ni/ dgongs rgyan las/ 'ching grol med pa'i gnas lugs rang rig pa byang chub kyi sems bden pa dbyer med spyod yul dang bral bar ye nas gnas pa zhes gsungs te/ de la/rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams su brtan g.yo'i chos thams cad las sems kho na gtso bo yin par lan cig ma yin par gsungs shing /sems de la phra rags mang du yod pa las 'dir ni shin tu phra ba'i sems mthar thug sems kyi rdo rje dang / 'od gsal dang / rang bzhin lhan skyes la sogs pa'i ming gis btags pa ste/ rgyud 'dir sems dang ye shes rang snang ba zhes gsangs pa'i ye shes ༄kyang de kho na yin zhing / sems rags pa gzhan rnams la de gnyis kyi zlas drang ba'i sems zhes bya'o/ /de 'dra ba'i ye shes de ni sems gzhan rnams las nyon dang sdug bsngal gyi 'ching bas gzir bzhin pa na'ang ngo bo cung zad kyang ma spags pas bcing grol med pa zhes bya/ rgyud la ga sal bar nyams su myong ba na ye shes rang gi gnas lugs stong pa nyid rig pa las mtshan ma'i spros pas mi 'phrog pa'am snang srid thams cad rang snang nyag gcig tu rig pa'i ye shes kyi snang bar 'gyur bas rang rig pa zhes bya/42

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3gzhan du sems rags pa 'di nyid tshogs gnyis kyi lam bsgoms pa'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su nar son pa tsam las cher ma bshad kyang lugs 'dir sems de dag gi gnad gsang rdo rje'i ye thes 'di kho na byang chub chen po'i ye shes kyi snying por bzhed pas byang chub kyi sems zhes bya/ bden pa gnyis la spyir 'jog tshul mang yang 'dir ni gsang ba sgyu 'phrul ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs kyi bden gnyis sam lhag pa'i bden gnyis te/ lhag pa don dam bden pa ni/ dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i cha nas rang bzhin don dam/ rang gsal sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba'i cha nas ye shes don dam/ de nyid sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las te 'bras chos lnga'i gter du bzhugs pa 'bras bu'i don dam ste phyi ma la lngar phye bas don dam dkor bdun zhes grags so/ /mdor na 'od gsal gyi mi rtog pa'i cha dang / gsal ba'i cha dang /des 'bras chos kyi rten byed pa'i cha las so sor phye bar zad do/ /lhag pa kun rdzob ni/ de'i rtsal snang zhes bshad kyang / bde ga shegs zar chung ba/ chos thams cad rig pa'i cho 'phral du snang ༄༄mizurag rngurwari zurar zurazir ba ma hā/ rag pa' rtsal du snang ba a nu/ rag pa nyad rang snang ba a ti'i lugs zhes gsungs pa ltar na cho 'phrul zhes brjod na legs pa 'dra ste/ don dam de'i cho 'phrul snod bcud thams cad 43

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dag pa'i 'khor lo rab 'byams su shar ba'o/ /'di dang 'bras bu'i don dam gnyis 'byed dka' zhes zer ba yod kyang 'char gzhi dang shar chos kyi khyad che'o/ /bden gnyis de dag ngo bo gcig tu gnas pa'i zung 'jug ni lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med ces bya'o/ /de 'dra ba'i bden gnyis zung 'jug de blos bcos pa tsam min pa'i yin tshul rjen par mthong ba ni yul dang yul can du snang ba'i spros pa rags pa can gyi sems la med pas sems kyi spyod yul las 'das pa'am spyod yul dang bral ba zhes bya'o/ /blo'i spyod yul dang bral bar bstan pa 'di 'dra rnams kyis 'khrul gzhi byas nas don dam bden pa shes bya min zhes smra bar ni mi bya ste/ de ltar smra na he ru ka galpo las/ shes bya'i nang nas dam par ni/ /gyur phyir nges pa'i tshig yin no/ /zhes dang //zhal lung du mdo'i don bsdus drangs par/ chos rnams thams cad byang chub sems/ /ji bzhin ngang du ye gnas pa/ /shes par bya ba'i rgyud don yin/ /zhes dang / rig 'dzin gong ma thams cad kyis gzhi shes pa dang 'bras bu thob pa ste lam rgyud kyis bya ba gnyis byed par gsungs pa sogs dang dngos su 'gal zhing rigs pa'i gnod pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang ji skad brjod pa'i ye shes de sems kyi gnyug ma'i rang bzhin las ngo 44

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3bo gzhan du mi 'gyur bar bzhugs pas na ye nas gnas pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /snang gsum 'pho ba'i bag chags las skyes pa'i sems rags pa ni 'bras bu'i sa na med cing de'i dbang gis de dag stong gzhir byas pa'i stong nyid kyang de na med pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid kyi skur 'gro rgyu'i de kho na nyid ni gnyug ma'i ye shes 'di'i dbyings la bzhag dgos pas 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo sde rnams su gang la dgongs te bde gshegs snying po bstan pa'i dgongs gzhi mthar thug kyang 'di nyid yin zhing / 'on kyang de la dgongs te gsungs pa'i mdo sde de dag gnyug sems ston pa'i sde snod ni min zhes bshad na bskyang bde yang / 'dir ni rgyal ba klong chen pa sogs mchog gzigs gong ma mang po mdo de dag gis bstan pa'i gshegs snying dang / 'dir bstan gnyug sems don gcig pas de dag gi dgongs gzhir ma zad brjod bya yang 'di kho na yin zhes bzhed la/ de lta na mdo sngags khyad med du mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ 'di la smin gling lo chen rin po che sogs ni rig pa 'gyur med sbyang gzhir 'dod pa la khyad med kyang de nyid lhan skyes mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'dod pa sngags kyi khyad chos yin zhes bzhed do/ /don 'di dka' ba'i gnad yin pas kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gzhung la brten nas 45

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpyad pa'i sgo tsam smos na/ bla med kyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnyug sems dang 'khor lo tha ma nas bstan pa'i gshegs snying gnyis ming mi 'dra yang don gcig la/ don de 'gro ba thams cad la khyab par bzhugs kyang gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i sems kyis bsgribs nas ma mthong ba yin pas/ de mngon du byed pa la 'khrul pa'i sems 'di sbyang dgos par bzhed pa la'ang mdo sngags khyad par med mod kyi/ sbyang tshul mi 'dra ste mdo sder ma zad rnal 'byor rgyud man chad du'ang sems rags pa 'di nyid kho na'i steng nas zab cing rgya che'i lam bsgoms te rim gyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings su sbyangs nas/ mthar gshegs snying dngos la reg par ston pa sha stag yin la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba'i thabs kyis bde gshegs snying po'i 'od gsal de sku gsum du sad pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa sngon du btang bas da lta nas kun rtog 'khrul pa'i sems 'di thad kar gcod pa'i thabs mkhas kyi 'phrul gsang zab mos gnyug sems mngon du phyung ste de nyid yar ldan du khyer nas 'bras bu la bde myar du sbyor byed la pha zurig mjug zurang ra mi'akhar dang bcas pa na bla mad kya rgyud las gzhan du bstan pa med cing / lam sgrub tshul snga ma'i skabs su mi mkho ba'i rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam bzhag dang / gnyug sems bde ba chen po'i ldog 46

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3zhem〉pa nas bstan pa sogs kyang mdo sde'i phyogs na med do/ /de ltar bshad na theg pa gong 'og gi rnam bzhag thams cad kyang pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar ma 'dzings ma 'khruṭa par gnas par 'gyur ro/ /bde gshegs snying po'i mdo mnyan du rung ba la dbang thob dgos par thal bar yang mi 'gyur te/ dbang bskur ba ni gtso bor bla med kyi lam la slob pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ dper na lugs gzhan du'ang bla med kyi skabs su 'bad pa du mas lhan skyes kyi bde ba bsgrubs pa'i don po bde ba des stong nyid sgom pa yin yang / stong nyid mnyan pa la dbang nod mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /mdo sde'i phyogs nas de 'dra'i gshegs snying bstan pa de da lta nas lam du bya ba'i ched min na dgos pa ci yod ce na/ 'di'i skyon spong byede tshul rgyud bla ma'i/ /sprin dang rmi lam sgyu bzhin de dang der/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs rgyu mtshan lnga gsungs pa la sogasapa'i steng nas shes dgos te/ de la'ang zhib cha dgos shing / rgyud bya'i 'ash+laul par( gshegaspo sking la rtag pa'i chos ltad ces gsungs pa sogs dang / de bas kyang ches bshad dka' ba 'ba' zhig yod pa'i 'gal spong sogs kun mkhyen chen po'i gzhung rnams khog bsgrigs nas shes par bya'i/ 'dir ma spros so/ /rnam pa gcig tu na/ 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo dang rgyud bla ma 47

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sogs la brten nas sngags kyi 'od gsal gtan la phab pa rnams/mdo bstan bcos de dag rang rang gi dgongs gzhi mthar thug dang sbyar ba'i steng nas bshad na 'di ltar 'gyur zhes zab mo'i mdo sde rnams kyi dgongs don mthar thug gsang sngags bla med la gzhol tshul bstan pa tsam du dgongs pa blang na'ang 'gal ba cher ma mthong ste/ rang lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyis zhib tu dpyad par bya'o/ /ye shes de 'khor 'das gnyis kyi gzhir 'gyur tshul ni/sems can rnams 'gro ba lngar 'khor ba na phung po snga ma sa chu la thim pa sogs kyi rim pas 'od gsal gyi dbyings de nyid du sdud cing / slar yang de nyid gzhom med kyi rlung dang bcas pa las snang ba gsum dang kun rtog gi rlung sems rim gyis mched de bar srid dang skye ba 'grub la/ skye ba blangs nas kyang las nyon gyis phyi ma'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po phyi snod dang bcas pa 'du byed cing /ji ltar 'du byas pa bzhin du 'grub ste/ de ltar zo chan gyi 'khor ༄ lo ltar 'khor ba ni bla med kyi rgyud gsar rnying phal cher nas gsungs la/ da lta gson lus la gnas dus kyang gzung 'dzin rags pa'i rlung sems kyi cha thams cad nyi 'od dang de'i drod bzhin du ye shes kyi rlung sems kyis khyab nas gnas pas yul snang 48
