gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3thams cad la yang 'od gsal ye shes kyi snang ba'i cha re med mi srid la/ de dag las ye shes kyi rlung sems rnams ni gnyug ma'i cha dang / rags pa'i cha rnams de'i cho 'phrul du byung ba dang / de srog tu yod pa'i dbang gis rang rang gi bya ba la 'jug pa yin zhing / ye shes 'khrul pa'i rlung sems sa mched pa na de'i dbang ༄gis ye shes kyi snang ba'ang 'khrul snang du song ba yin pas snang sems thams cad kyang rtsa ba'i gzhi sems nyid 'od gsal kho nar 'dod pa ni gsang sngags snga 'gyur nas bshad pa ste/ 'od gsal gyi ye shes lus la gnas pa dang shar ba mi gcig cing 'char ba'i thabs kyang gcig tu ma nges pas/ 'chi dus su shar ba sogs nam mkha' rkyen gsum dang bral ba lta bu'i stong sang gi rnam pa can dang / dhū ti'i rtsa 'khor gyi nang kho nar 'char ba sogs yin yang 'od gsal gang yin thams cad de ltar ma nges te/ 'di tsam zhig snang ba lhar sgrub sogs skabs du mar mkho bas smos kyi rgyas par rdzogs chen gyi skor las 'byung bas ma bkod do/ /de ni kun nyon 'khor ba'i chos kyi gzhi byed lugs yin la/ rnam byang phyogs kyi gzhi byed lugs gzhan yang yod mod de/ gtso bo ni gong du byang chub sems kyi don bshad par brjod zin to/ /'di dag gi skabs su ye shes rang snang zhes bshad pa ni ye shes nyid 49

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las gzhan du ma gyur pa'i snang ba ste/ ye shes kyi rang dbang gi 'char tshul ltar bzhag pa dag pa'i snang ba dang / sems rang snang zhes pa ni ye shes de sems kyis dkrugs pa'i dbang gis snang sems rang rgyud par 'char ba ma dag pa'i dngos snang rnams te/de dag kyang sems rang gis btags pa tsa ma gyi snang char zad kyi/ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med pas rang snang zhes bya'o/ /phyi ma'i gnas lus sogs ni ye shes kyi cha dang sems kyi char gyur pa gang yang min pas rang snang dngos ma yin yang / sems ye shes su bskyed pa'i le'ur/ nyid las gzhan zhes bya ba'i chos/btsal yang rgyal bas mi brnyes so/ /zhes sogs snang srid dag mnyam du bstan pa rnams kyi dgongs don gtan la dbab pa'i phyir 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang snang gi phyogs su bsdus nas bstan pa yin no / /gnyis pa ni/ gzhi la 'khrul pa med kyang / 'khrul pa la gzhi yod ces rog bde gshegs chen po gsungs pa ltar/ gnyug ma'i rang bzhin la 'khrul pa med kyang / de'i cho 'phrul 'khrul par shar te/ gnas lugs kyi rang zhal 'gebs shing sgrib par byed pa'i zhen snang ni phyin ci log tu sgro btags nas 'khor ba phra rags kyi rten du gyur bas 'khrul pa btags pa'i gzhi zhes bya/50

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3de yang gzhung spyi skad dang bstun na snang sems la phyin ci log tu snang zhing snang ba ltar zhen pas na zhen snang zhes sbyor dgos par mngon yang / 'di'i bka' srol du 'das pa snang yang 'khor bar zhe na pa zhes gsungs te/ de ltar na snang ba ltar ma rtogs par gzhan du zhen pa zhes bshad par bya'o/ /gang ltar yang don du gnyis med la gnyis su 'dzin pa la 'jog par bshad de/ rang bzhin med pa'i chos nyid las gzhan du ma gyur pa'i dngos po rnams la phyi rol du gyur pa'i snang ba rang rgyud pa'am rang dbang ba dang rang mtshan par zhen pa'o/ /de'ang gnas lugs kyi don las gzhan du gol ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo rmongs pa ma rig pa yin zhing /de la lhan skyes dang kun btags gnyis te/ de gnyis kyang 'dir grub mtha' ngan pas btags ma btags la ma bzhag par ngo bo'i dbyings la rmongs tsam gyi ma rtogs pa'i ma rig pa dang / snang sems rang rgyud du zhen pa'i log rtog gi ma rig pa gnyis la bshad pa'i/ gtso bo phyi ma ste/ 'dir bstan zhen snang ni de'o/ /sangs rgyas su 'grub pa'i bsgrub gzhi'i dbang du byas nas ngo bo'i gzhi dang / sems can du gol ba'i 'khor rtsa'i dbang du byas nas btags pa'i gzhi bstan par sems te/ snga ma ma bstan na 'di'i 'grub mtha'i snying po chos thams cad ye sangs rgyas par 51

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gtan la dbab tu med la/ /phyi ma ma bstan na de la ltos pa'i sbyang bya'i gtso bo ngos mi zin pas dngos dang zhar byung gi tshul du gnyis smos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyed byed shes rab rnam pa gsum gyis bskyed bya thun mong dang mchog gi sems lnga skyes sam skyes pa ste/ rim gsum las/ ngo bo shes rab rnam gsum gyis/ /sems lnga skyes par bstan pa yin/ /zhes so/ /'dir thun mong gi sems lnga ni/lha mi'i theg pa dang / nyan rang / byang sems/ phyi rgyud sde gsum gyi lam rnams re re zhing sems lnga re brtsi ba yin la/ mchog gi sems lnga ni/ ma hā yo ga'i rang lam nyid la brtsi ba ste/ lam de dang de la 'jug 'dod kyi sems dang por ldang ba g.yo ldang /lam de rnyed na ci ma rung snyam du 'dun pa'i shugs cher song ba smon pa/ smon pa bzhin 'jug pa 'jug pa/ zhugs nas nyams len gyi rgyun la gnas pa gnas pa/ mthar 'dod don grub pa mthar phyin pa'i sems te/ 'di rnams re re'i mthar byang chub kyi sems zhes sbyar snang ba mchog gi sems lnga'i dbang du byas pa'am/yang na nyan rang gi theg pa'i sems lnga'ang de dag rang gi byang chub la ltos nas de ltar brjod pa'am sgra 'jug pa la bshad du yod pas ma khyab pa gang bde'i steng nas bsnyad par bya'o/ /52

lke tha/thagaspyang /stesprang /khro/ 1rgacad :ngezud byengecad zugartsejordospyad /sdo/ :spro/sprerwa// na/de'ang nyan thos kyi sde snod nas de'i lam rnams sems lngar bsdus te bstan pa sogs min gyi/ rgyud sde 'di'i gzhung las nyan thos kyi lam rnams sems lngar bsdus nas bstan pa sogs yin no/ /ci ltar na thabs sam lam gyi rgyud du 'gyur zhe na/ thob bya 'bras rgyud mngon du byed pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen yin pas thabs dang /gang gis gang du bgrod pa'i shul yin pas lam mo/ /de la gtso phal gyi sgo nas dbye na/ nye ba'i lam bla med sgyu drwa'i lam 'di nyid dang / ring ba'i lam thun mong gi theg pa bzhi dang phyi rgyud sde gsum gyi lam rnams te/ de'ang 'di'i dngos kyi gdul byas lam 'di bor nas de dag la 'jug na mchog gi dngos grub las ches ring du 'gyur ba dang / theg pa gzhan gyi rigs can gyis rang lam sgrub na'ang dman lam sngon song lta ci/ dang po nas phar phyin dang phyi rgyud kyi lam nas zhugs kyang lam 'di pa la ltos na rdzogs byang dus ring mo zhig na 'grub pas ring lam zhes bya yi/khog gzhung las/ thun mong lam stegs tsam nyid du/ /pha rol phyin bcu rgyu 'bras spyod/ /ces pa ltar 'di'i lam la dbang po dang bsam pa'i snod sbyong ba'i ched du than mong gi rtogs rigs la ༄slo/ba pa tsam ni nye ring thun mong gi lam du 'gyur ro/ /khyad par gyi lam de la dbye na/ thabs kyis nges pa'i lam 53

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang / shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba'i lam gnyis te/ bshad rgyud rgya mtsho las/ grol lam thabs su rnam par bstan/ /zhes so/ /de gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ spyir thabs lam zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi thabs ni grol lam gyi nang du'ang yod de/ tshogs spyod bzhin no/ /grol lam gyi skabs su bshad pa'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyang thabs lam la dgos te/ de dang bral na lam gyi snying po stor ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang gang zag gcig gi lam la thabs grol gnyis ka 'jog pa'ang ma yin te/ thabs lam pa dang grol lam pa zhes gang zag tha dad kyi lam cha tshang gnyis su bzhed do/ /des na lam gyi gzhung shing rdzogs rim la ltos nas rtsom pa dang por lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs kyi man ngag la brten pa dang /sems rang babs kyi steng du 'jog pa'i bzhag thabs tsam la brten pa'i khyad par du bshad kyang rung mod de/ 'dir dgongs rgyan ltar gtso bor shes rab gsum gyi sgo nas rang rgyud kyi 'ching ba chos nyid du grol bar byed pa grol lam dang / gtso bor thabs kyi khyad par brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas 'bras bu myur du 'grub par byed pa thabs lam du bya ste nye ston chos seng sogs kyi bzhed pa'o/ /de'ang lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med kyi bzhugs tshul rtogs nas goms par byed pa ni 'di 54

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3zhetranyid kyi lam spyi'i khog yin la/ gtso bor de tsam gyi steng nas lam bgrod pa ni grol lam dang / de'i steng du man ngag gi thabs zur pa bsnan nas de la'ang gtso bor brten te lam bgrod pa la thabs lam du bzhag pa yin pas/ mtshan nyid gsum gyi khog rgyas par grol lam gyi skabs su bstan zhing / thabs lam 'chad dus thabs lam rang gi sgos chos tsam las cher ma bshad pa'ang de'i rgyu mtshan la thug ste/ thabs lam la mtshan nyid gsum med pa ni gtan min no/ /dper na phar phyin drug sngags lam la yang tshang mod kyi/sngags kyi theg pa phar phyin theg pa ma yin zhing / phyin drug gi spyod pa'i skor la phar phyin theg pa'i gzhung rnams rgyas la/ sngags su gsang sngags rang gi khyad chos rnams gtso bor ston pa dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar thabs grol so sor gtso bor gang byed kyi lam la khyab che chung bshad pa 'dis mtshon don dang gleng gzhi sogs kyi skabs su grol lam ltar bshad pa rnams la thun mong ltar ram spyi ltar bshad pa zhes 'byung ba'i go don yang shes par mngon no/ /lam myur bul gyi dbang du byas na/ grol lam ni rin po che kau stu bha dang lhan cig bzhag pa'i rdo'i khams rim gyis gser du 'gyur ba lta bu dang / thabs lam ni mak+ṣi ka'i sbyor bas lcags khams yud tsam gyis gser du sgyur ba lta bur bshad la/ grol 55

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lam rim gyis pa thabs lam rim gyis pa las bul yang / grol lam cig car ba ni thabs lam cig char ba las kyang myur zhes gsung srol yang snang ngo / /de la thun mong sngon dang khyad par rjes su bshad pa'i dbang du btang ste grol lam dang por dang /'chad bde ba la bsams nas thabs lam dang por 'chad pa gang yang rung zhes gsungs pa las 'dir dgongs rgyan ltar/ thabs lam sngon la bshad par bya ste/ thabs lam nyid la'ang thabs dang thabs byung gi rnal 'byor gnyis yod pa'i go rim dang bstun na thabs sngon la 'ong zhing thabs byung grol lam gyi sgrom nas shes pa'i yang phyir ro/ /de la gnyis/ steng sgo 'ju 'dul dang / 'og sgo khams gsum rol pa'i lam mo/ /dhū ti'i nang du khams bzhu btul gyi las kyis ye shes 'char bar byed pas na 'ju 'dul gyi lam dang /rgyud kyi le'u bzhi par yul sku/ dbang po gsung / rnam shes thags su gsungs shing lus snang ba 'dod khams/ ngag phyed snang ༄ mi 'igazugs khams/ yid snang gzugs med khams su bshad pa gtso bo pad+ma'i reg bya dang rdo rje'i dbang po dang bde ba'i rnam shes gsum sbyar ba'i sngags kyi rol rtsed yin pas na khams gsum rol pa zhes bya ste/ snga ma rang lus dang phyi ma gzhan lus la brten 56

〉 gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3po〉pa'o/ /'ju 'dul gyi lam la gtso bor byed pas kyang bogs 'don du khams gsum rol pa la slob dgos shing / khams gsum rol pa gtso bor byed pas kyang sngon du 'ju 'dul gyis rtsa thig rlung gsum las rung nges par 'gro dgos kyang / gtso bor gang byed la ltos nas gang zag gnyis kyi lam du bzhag kyang chog ste snga sna bhezhin no/ /dang po steng sgo'i rnal 'byor la gnyis bshad de/ thun mong ba dang / khyad par ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bshad rgyud rgya mtsho las/'khor lo gsum gnyis srog shing gsum/ /me rlung 'gro bas nam mkha'i ba/ /bzho bas steng du rnam par grags/ /zhes gsungs te/'khor lo gsum phrag gnyis ni/ spyi bo bde chen gyi/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi/ snying ga chos kyi/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ste rtsa ba'i 'khor lo bzhi dang / de 'og sor bzhi gzhal bar lte ba'i gtum mo las yar 'bar ba rgyud gzhan du tshangs pa'i me zhes grags pa'i me dkyil dang / de'i 'og na me de spor byed kyi thur sel gyi rlung ste rkyen gyi 'khor lo gnyis so/ /srog shing gsum ni/ dbu rkyang ro gsum mo/ /lhag ma'i don ni/ 'khor lo bzhi'i lte bar dmigs pas gnad du bsnun pa las ro rkyang gi rgyu ba 'gag cing rlung dkyil gyis me sbar/ dhū ti'i lam drang bo nas song ste 57

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nam mkha'i ba zhes pa spyi bo'i haṃ yig bskul te mu tig lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems babs pa las yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi nyams su myong zhing / khyad par du lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i dus su gdal khyab spros pa med pa'i dbyings la spyod pa'o / /gnyis pa la/ lus las ye shes skye ba'i gnad dang / de shes nas gnad du bsnun tshul gnyis las dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i rang gnas kyi ye shes de da lta rdo rje'i lus la ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul ni/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar dwangs ma chen po lnga'i dbus na stong gsal bde ba chen po'i ngo bo dang / snang ba thams cad kyi 'char gzhir bzhugs te/ rdo rje me long las/ lus can snying la gang gnas pa/ /rang byung zag med ye shes gzugs/ /mi shigs thig le bde chen po/ /nam mkha' lta bu kun khyab pa/ /mi gnas chos sku'i rang bzhin yin/ zhes dang / dpe chung rang gnas las/ mi shigs ye shes thig le ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i bdag /gcig dang du ma rnam spangs pa/ /sna tshogs snang la mtshon du med/ /ces so/ /de las cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i nus pa rim gyis sad pa na dang por de nyid dang rjes sa mthan pa dag pa'i snang ba skul ba'i byed las no༅ ༄can gyi dkar dmar rlung gsum gyi cha phra mo gzhan dag 'byung ba 58

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3ni nye ba'i dwangs chen te/ dwangs ma gzhan thams cad kyi zungs sam gnad du gyur pa'o/ /de dag thog med na sa brgyud de 'ongs pa'i log pa'i zhen snang gi chas dkrugs pa las ma dag pa'i snang ba ngan pa skyed pa'i rtsa khams rlung gsum snyigs ma'i cha gtso bo rnams 'byung zhing / de dang mnyam du rang snang gi yul rnams kyang chu shin tu mnyen pa dgun gyi grang reg gi rkyen gyis rdo ltar sra ba'i khams su 'gyur ba ltar tha mal pa'i rnam par shar nas slar la zhen snang rgyas par byed de/ de ltar 'khrul pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin no/ /de'ang cung zad zhib tu bshad na/ lugs 'dir snying ga'i gnad gtso bor byed de/ de la dgongs rgyan ltar rtsa 'dab brgyad dam rtsa chen bzhi las/ mdun chos nyid kyi rtsa la nye ba'i dwangs ma oṃ dang snyigs ma su tri/ g.yas ye shes kyi rtsa la dwangs ma hūṃ dang snyigs ma a dri/ g.yon yon tan gyi rtsa la dwangs ma āḥdang snyigs ma pre du'i yi ge rnams gnas te/ yi ge gsum po dwangs ma'i nang phyogs dhū ti dang nye ba na dang / sa bon drug po rtsa 'dab kyi gab bam mthar gnas so/ /nye ba'i dwangs ma de dag ni dbus kyi dwangs ma lnga'i yon tan las byung ste/ oṃ yig sha'am rtsa'i dwangs ma shel sbug can gyi yo na tan las byung / lus la rtsa'i dwangs cha dang de'i yon tan rnams skyed cing skyes zin gyi 59

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyun gsos nas rgyas par byed do/ /āḥyig mi shigs pa'i dmar cha'i yon tan las byung / khrag gi dwangs cha dang yon tan skyed cing gso/ hūm̐ yig mi shigs pa'i rlung gi yon tan gyi dbang las byung / dbugs kyi dwangs cha dang yon tan skyed cing gso'o/ /oṃ du 'jog pa ni thig le de la dag pa'i gzugs snang sna tshogs skyed pa'i nus pa shas cher yod pa'i sgo nas yin te/ oṃ sku rdo rje'i sa bon yin pas so/ /des mtshon te sgra tshig gi snang ba ris med skyed pa'i sgo nas āḥdang / ting nge 'dzin bzang po skyed pa'i sgo nas hūm̐ du 'jog pa'ang shes par bya la/ da lta sku sgrub byed kyi las bsags pa rnams oṃ gyi steng du sog pa dang / gsung sgrub byed rnams āḥl sog pa dang / thugs sgrub byed hūm̐ la sogs par yang bshad do/ /de bzhin du su tri gnyis la rtsa'i snyigs ma skyed pa dang /lha min dang dud 'gro'i snang zhen skyed pa'i nus pa gnyis yod cing /da lta 'gro ba de gnyis su skye ba'i las bsags pa rnams kyis kyang de gnyis kyi nus pa gsos 'debs pa dang / pre du gnyis kyis khrag gi snyigs ma la bya ba 'jug cing / yi dwags dang dmyal ba'i snang zhen skyed pa sogs dang / a nis dbugs kyi snyigs ma la bya ba 'jug cing / lha mi gnyis kyi snang zhen skyed pa sogs kyang shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi snying po sems mi 60

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3shigs pa'i steng na snang ba ris su ma chad pa spro ba'i nus pa yod pa de da lta 'gro ba rigs drug gang rung gi sa bon gyis kha lo drangs te 'khrul snang rang dga' ba'i yo lang chen por shar ba 'di dag pa rab 'byams kyi snang bar go 'phos nas don dam dkor bdun gyi gnas lugs la 'jug pa'i ched du lta ba dang bskyed rim sngon du btang ste/ kun tu bzang po'i thig le'am snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i sems 'dzin rtse gcig tu sbyangs pas thig le de 'bar zhing las su rung nas sems mi shigs pa 'od gsal bsam mi khyab kyi dgongs pa kun rtog gi rnyogs pa dang bral bar 'char la/de'i tshe sngar bskyed rim la sbyangs pa dang / dwangs ma lnga'i sems 'dzin gyi khog tu ye shes kyi snang ba thun min 'char ba'i rtsa dar skud lta bu'am shel sbug can la gnad du bsnun pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis mi shigs pa'i steng gi dag pa'i snang ba 'char ba'i nus pa gsal bar sad de me long dwangs pa la gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i tshul du sku dang zhing gi snang ba tshad med pa mthong ste/ de'i mthus dang po byung ba'i rim pa ltar yi ge gsum gyi gzi brjid dang nus pa cher sbar/ de dag sbar ba'i dbang gis mar me gsos na rang 'od mched nas 'ong ba ltar stod smad kyi lus kun gyi dwangs ma rnams stobs su gyur cing 'bar nas rtsa khams bde bas rgyas par 'gyur 61

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/la/ shin tu phra ba dang rags pa'i phyogs sam dwangs ma ye shes dang ma dag snyigs ma'i phyogs kyi rtsa rlung thig le ni gcig rgyas pa na cig shos zhum 'gro ba chos nyid yin pas yi ge gsum ji ltar 'bar ba de ltar sa bon drug po'i nus pa chung du 'gro ste/ 'di la rdzogs rim pa'i rigs drug sreg sbyang yang zer ro/ /'di ltar mi shigs gnyug ma'i dwangs chen bskul stobs kyis rtsa 'dab kyi dwangs ma sbar ba ni ci tsam sbar ba de'i tshod du de rnams mi shigs pa'i dbang du 'du bas/ rim gyis dwangs ma gzhan rnams rtsa ba'i yi ge gsum dang / de gsum yang dwangs ma lnga ldan la zhugs nas mchog gi dwangs ma'i nus pa lhag par gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar zhe na/ dwangs ma lnga las sas bde ba brtan par byed/ chus bde ba sdud cing mnyen/ mes bde ba smin/ rlung gis bde ba rgyas/nam mkhas mkha' mnyam rdzogs pa chen por byed ces gsungs te/mdor na bde chen gyi nyam/sa myong 'thug cing rgya che ba dang brtan por 'jug pa'i don te/ de'i stobs kyis stong gzugs kyi snang ba'ang je gsal dang rgya je cher 'gro zhing brtan par 'gyur ro/ /dwangs ma'i gnad skul tshul thun mong ma yin pa de 'dra 'ong ba la ni dang por bskyed rim sgom pa'i dus nas cir snang thams cad dkyil 'khor dang / de'ang ye shes rang snang zhes mi shigs pa'i 62

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3sems las phar mched pa'i cho 'phrul 'ba' zhig tu blta ba dang /de'i ched du lta ba'i skabs su de ltar ngo 'phrod cing thag chod kyi sa/deng rnyed pa zhig srog tu bzung dgos so/ /skabs 'di'i stong sazugs sgrub tshul dang dus 'khor nas rlung bcu dbu mar bcings pa'i rtags snang bshad pa gnyis 'od gsal gyi snang ba tsam du 'dra yang / 'di ni mi shigs pa'i rlung rang mal du sad pa'i snang ba yin pas mi 'dra ste/ rdzogs chen thod rgal ba'i 'char snang dang 'di gnyis rig gdangs kyi cha la rtsal 'don byed mi byed dang / sems 'dzin rtsol ba yod med las phyogs mtshungs so/ /de yang snang ba de dag rlung bcu dbu mar zhugs pa'i rtags su shar ba yin min dpyad par zad kyi/ de dag 'char ba la rlung bcu dbu mar 'jug mi dgos zhes bshad pa ni min no/ /gter chen sku mched sogs kyis rdzogs rim pa'i lha sku mthong ba dang /thob pa gnyis su bshad pa'i mthong ba tsam dang / 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa las rung rnyed pa tsam la kun tu bzang po'i thig le sa/cig pu bsgoms pas kyang chog mod kyi/ lha sku de thob pa dang /rtolgas pa'i 'od gsal lam 'thag po'i 'od gsal phal phyin rig rag 'char ba la lte ba'i a thung la dmigs pa kun tu bzang mo'i man ngag dang / mgrin pa'i rngam ma la dmigs pa sbyor ba dag pa dang /63

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/spyi bo'i haṃ yig la dmigs pa khyab brdal chen po'i man ngag rnams kyang grogs su nges par gces te/ gtum mo'i gnad la dngos su dmigs nas ci tsam bsgoms pa de tsam du 'bar 'dzags shugs che la/ 'bar 'dzags kyis mi shigs pa tshim stobs che rim bzhin ye shes 'bar ba dang / de'i rang snang gi lha sku gsal brtan khyad zhugs par 'gyur zhing / 'khrul pa btags pa'i gzhi'i srog mkhar gyi sa bon drug po'i grib tshabs che ba'i phyir ro/ /'di rdor bzlas kyis rtsa mdud 'grol ba ma bshad kyang / lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar gyi dbu ma'i lam du 'bar 'dzags kyi bde ba cher 'phel te sems bde bas bsdus pa na rtsa 'dab kyi rlung rnams kyang lam der 'drong ste/ rlung sems 'jug pa gcig pas so/ /de ltar rlung 'drong stobs kyis dhū ti'i rtsa mdud rang zhig tu 'gro bas gnad legs par tshang ngo / /de dag ni steng sgo'i man ngag gi gzhung rnams khog bsgrigs nas go don cung zad bshad pa ste/ 'khor lo bzhi'i man ngag sgom pa'i lag len dngos ni rgyud 'grel phyogs bcu mun sel dang / sems nyid ngal bso'i don khrid/ gsang bdag zhal lung sogs su gsal bar bzhugs te/ de dag la'ang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bag tsam yod pas zhib tu shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud kyi le'u bcu gcig par/ lha mo klu mo 64

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3tratrad+kurigs ngan mo/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa brtag cing btsal ba dang / 'gugs shing rnyed nas 'dod pa'i bstan bcos las bshad pa'i kun spyod kyis rjes chags rtsom pa rnams ni bsnyen pa dang / yab yum lhar bskyed pa lha'i 'du shes/ mkha' gsang rdo rje dang pad+mar rlob pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan skyes kyi ye shes bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te gsum ldan gyis brdab zhes bsnol mar skul ba sogs nye bsnyen/ phyag rgya bzhis snyoms par zhugs te rjes chags kyi rlung bskyod pas gtum mo sbar ba'i 'od kyis zla ba bzhus pa'i yas babs kyi 'gros kyis 'ongs pa las 'khor lo bzhir dga' bzhi rim gyis myong ba'i mthar nor bu'i rtser 'dzags med du bzung bas lhan skyes kyi dga' ba rdzogs par thob pa sgrub pa/ nyi zla rdo rje'i lces blangs te bzlog pa'i sbyor bas gyen du drangs te rtsa 'khor gyi gnas so sor dga' ba'i cha shas rim gyis gang ba'i mthar bde chen 'khor lo'i haṃ yig la brtan pa las byung ba'i lhan skyes mthar phyin pa ni sgrub chen te/ lam dus dang / sgrub dus dang / sbyor dus kyi bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i 'jog tshul gsum gyi nang tshan phyi ma'o/ /'di nyid kyi rgyud phyi ma las ni/ rnal 'byor rnal 'byor mar 'brel ba/ /bsnyen pa zhes 65

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byar bstan pa yin/ /bo la kak+ko la sbyor ba/ /nye bar bsnyen par brjod pa ste/ /rtsa gnyis mngon par 'brel ba ni/ /sgrub pa yin par bstan pa'o/ /lhan cig skyes gnyis 'brel ba ni/ /sgrub pa chen por brjod pa'o/ /zhes bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i 'jog tshul khyad par can gzhan gsungs so/ /de dag la g.yo ldang la sogs pa'i sems lnga 'jog tshul yang yod de 'grel pa las shes so/ /pho nya'i lam gyi gnad che shos gcig ni/ thal ba las/ spangs nas rdo rje dbyings phyug rtsa/ /dgug dang bsdam pa ma shes na/ /rdo rje'i bskal pa mtha' yas par/ /chos sku thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ltar/ rtsa bcing ba'i gnad nyid yin te phyag rgya brtag pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di yin no/ /'grel pa rnams su thabs des rtog tshogs sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'char bar gsungs pa'i don ni dam pa 'gas rtog pa'i ngos nas tha dad kyang ye shes kyi ngos nas gcig tu song ba yin zhes bshad pa ltar rtog tshogs thams cad bde ba chen po'i ro gcig gis myos te so sor 'dzin pa'i 'du shes kyi g.ya' dang bral ba ste/ phung khams bde ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsdam pa zhes bya'o/ /'di la sogs pa'i gong 'og du mar ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched la rtog tshogs zhes/ bshad pa ni rtog pa tha mal snang zhen gyi rnam rtog la byas nas/66

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3'di la dang / 'dis rtog pa zhes pa'i snga ma la bshad kyang rung mod/ le'u gsum par/ gnas dang sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa/ /log rtog nyid las gzhan du ci yang med/ /ces pa ltar/ ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad log rtog gi rnam 'phrul yin pa'i sgo nas bshad na 'thad dam snyam mo/ /gong du brjod pa ltar thabs lam cig char ba la ltos nas kyang dbang gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i lam go rim nges shing gnyis par rang lus la brten pa'i thabs kyis gsal bar mtshon pa'i don de nyid gsum par gzhan lus la brten nas sgom par zad pas ye shes kyi sku sgrub tshul sogs snga ma las gzhan du mi bsam mo /gnyis pa grol lam la'ang / lam myar bul la ltos nas cig zurang /re) hāX/ nor spre(1 :re/char ba dang / ram d+nghas pa lam gnyis las/ dang /'grel pa las/ dbang po yang rab kha cig dbyer med chig chod du rtogs goms mtha ra phyin par byed pa yod de cig char ba zhes bya zhing / zhes pa ltar ro/ /de la rim cig char brtsi ba'i gzhi ni mtshan nyid gsum yin la/ mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che sogs kyis bzhed pas/ de gsum dus mnyam kho nar rdzogs pa'i cig char ba 'di bzhag chog na'ang / cig char pa thams cad de ltar ma nges kyi/ rtogs pa shin tu myur ba la cig char ba zhes brjod pa 67

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ste/ de ni gang zag yin la/ cig char ba'i lam ni de'i rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin sogs so/ /de'ang 'di'i lam la sbyang ba'i thog mar rtogs pa bzhi la sogs pa'i gtan tshigs kyi sna rtse re bkod pa tsam gyis 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa bcos min du rnyed nas/snang srid thams cad ye shes rang snang ba'i dkyil 'khor nyag gcig tu 'char zhing / de'i don la mnyam par bzhag pas rkyen thub kyi rtogs pa 'phel 'grib med par brtan pa 'phral la thob nas rig 'dzin gyi sa la mig 'phrul bzhin du 'gro ba zhig go/ /rtogs pa de ltar myur ba ni rgyud dang dbang po dang dge rtsa rlabs che ba'i gang zag gi khyad par 'ga' zhig sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lam 'di la sngon smon lam rlabs po che btab pa la sogs pa'i rgyu las byung ste/ de yang tshe sngon sgyu drwa'i lam la ma bslab pa yin zhing /tshe 'dir lam bgrod tshul dang sgyu 'phral gyi lam 'di nyid la ltos rwa15//bye ()sgo /nyeskyerdo ri'i 'ag tsho 425ta ga char ba na yang / snga ma yan chad du 'ag ma' lam la rim gyis sbyangs pa yang mi 'gal lo/ /brgyud pa'i bka' srol la de 'dra ba de la sbyangs rno cig char ba zhes grags shing / theg gsum rigs nges ltar sems can gyi rigs dang dbang po sna tshogs yin pas dbang rno cig char ba'ang yod ces gsang bdag sgro phug pa chen po gsung ngo / /des rim gyis pa la sbyangs pa dang 68

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3rang bzhin gyi dbang rnon gnyis su 'byed tshul yang go sla'o/ /de la mtshan nyid gsum ni slob dpon chen po 'i man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba las/ de la mtshan nyid gsum gyis don mthar phyin par 'gyur te/ rtogs pa rnam pa bzhi'i tshul rig pa ni shes pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /yang nas yang du goms par byed pa ni 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /goms pa'i mthus mngon du gyur pa ni 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba/ rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting nge 'dzin/ mngon du gyur pa'i mtshan nyid 'bras bu ste/ nyams len gyi sbyor ba'i 'jug yul shes par byed pa'am/ bsgom bya'i dbang du mdzad nas lta ba dang /nyams len gyi sbyor bas 'jug pa'am sgom byed kyi dbang du mdzad nas ting nge 'dzin dang / bsgom pa'i don mngon du gyur pa'i dbang du mdzad nas 'bras bu bzhag go/ /phyi ma 'di la rtogs bya mtha' dag mngon du gyur pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu dang / ci rigs tsam mngon du gyar pa lam gyar gyi 'bras bu gnyis las/ra pa tsho'irig rig mi //bye/ //ste/snga ma 'bras rgyud dang gcag la/ lam rgyud skabs — mtshan da gsum pa ni phyi ma'o/ /sems can sangs rgyas kyi khyad sngar bshad pa'i zhen snang dag ma dag yin la/ zhen snang gcod byed kyi gtso bo lta ba yin zhing / de nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis yang yang gsos 69

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ btab cing bskyed bsring bas rig 'dzin gyi 'bras bu 'grub pa'i phyir rgyu rkyen 'bras bu gsum du yang bzhag go/ /theg chen thun mong gi gzhung du sems bskyed rdzogs byang gi sa bon lta bu dang /lta ba sogs spyod pa gzhan rnams de'i grogs su gsungs kyang /'di dang rnam gzhag tha dad yin zhing / 'dir thun min gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed kyang lta ba'i phyogs nas 'jog thab pas phyogs ༄'dzol ba yang med do/ /dang po rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid la/gzhal bya/ 'jal byed/ grub mtha' ste gsum las/ dang po ni /zhen snang ngam snang zhen gyi tshogs pa la bshad kyang / de'i dgongs pa btsal na log rtog 'khrul pa'i dmigs yul chos can du byas nas gdod nas rnam dag gi ngo bor 'jal ba'am gtan la 'bebs pa yin pas/ de 'dra'i chos can dang bsgrub bya'i chos kyi tshogs don de la byed par mngon te/ gsang bdag zhal lung las/zhen snang gtan la phab pas chos nyid phebs par 'gyur te sbrul 'khrul gyi shes pa la dpyad pas thag khrar rtogs pa bzhin no/ /zhes dpe 'jog tshul 'di la legs par brtag na shes nus so/ /gnyis pa 'jal byed ni/ gtan tshigs te/ skabs don rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la lam rim las/ de nyid dngos lnga tshul dang tshig /zhes pa ltar gsum ste/70

ho〉 ba/thagajib /stesprang /khro/ 1rgacad ṣ+ṭhasdezug byengezud zugartse(rdothad /ldo/ 151jid/ do/sngon byung dngos lnga'i dang / rjes 'jug tshul lnga'i dang / tshig lnga'i gtan tshigs so/ /dang po ni/ sngon byung du ston pa sku lngas 'khor lnga la gsung lnga'i sgo nas chos nyid kyi don mngon sum du bstan pa ste/ ston pa chos kyi skus 'khor ye shes rgya mtsho la skye med don gyi gsung gis/ longs skus smin pa rgya mtsho la dgongs pa brdas/ sprul skus mos pa rgya mtsho la brjod pa tshig gis/ rdo rje'i skus dbyer med rdo rje'i 'khor la rdo rjes/ mngon byang gis rgyal ba rgya mtsho la rig pa byin rlabs kyi gsung gis brda sprod pa'o/ /'di la sngon gyi sgyu 'phrul mkhan po rnams sprul sku ma gtogs pa'i sku bzhi'i 'khor la zhen snang med pas gsang de dag sngon byang nyid ༄༄me ༄shil ltos na gtan tshigs min yang rjes 'jug rtogs pa'i gtan tshigs sgrub byed kyi yan lag yin pas gtan tshigs su btags kasung / gzhan dag sku bzhi'i 'khor la'ang zhen snang phra ba ci rigs gcad rgyu yod pas gtan tshigs dngos yin gsung / lo chen dharma shrī ni/ mthar lam na'ang shes sgrib phra mo yod pas phyi ma ltar 'thad gsung / de dang bstun na/ mthar lam pa rnams longs sku'i lhan cig pa'i 'khor du song ba nyid kyis chos sku sogs gsum po'i yang 'khor du song ba dang / chos sku dang rjes mthun gyi rtogs pa thob pa la ye shes rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang / rdo rje dang 71

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mngon byang gi sku dang cha 'dra ba'i rtogs pa thob pa la rdo rje'i 'khor dang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'khor zhes ldog chas phye nas brjod pa yin nam snyam ste/ slob lam na ye shes chos sku mngon sum du mthong ba med cing / chos longs sprul gsum tshogs don nyid de gsum ngo bo dbyer med pa dang ldog pa tha dad pa'i cha nas rdo rje dang mngon byang gi sku so sor bzhag pa tsam las med pas ston pa tha dad du bshad mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje'i gsung sogs kyi go don yang / ston pa sku gsum dbyer med sogs kyi dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pa nyid kyis 'khor rnams rgyud don gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin pa la brda sprod pa'i tha snyad spyar ba ste/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud dang 'dra'o/ /rang gi go tshod la/ grol lam gyi skabs 'dir rang gzhan gyi lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs rnams sngon du ma btang bar gtan tshigs tsam la brten nas rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa gsar du 'dren par bzhed de/ de ltar 'dren nus pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ lam 'di gdul bya shes rab ches lhag par rno ba'i dbang du mdzad pas grol lam shes rab kyi lam pa zhes bya la/ de 'dra ba des gtan tshigs tsam la brten nas zhen snang gi spros pa gcod nus shing /de bcad stobs kyis gnyug ma'i bzhugs tshul rjen par mthong 72

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3d+kunus pa'i gnad kyis yin te/ der ma zad shin tu dbang rnon 'ga' zhig rdo rje slob dpon gyis dgongs pa gtad pa tsam dang /brda thabs tsam dang / tshig mgo smos tsam gyis zhen snang bcad de rang gnas kyi ye shes gsal bar mtshon nus pa'ang 'di ltar yod ces dbang rnon shes rab kyis grol tshul 'dir bstan 'a di la rnam grangs kyi sgo nas nges pa skyed pa'i ched du dngos tshul tshig gsum gyi dbye ba 'di dag mdzad pa 'dra'o/ /bla ma thams cad mar+ṣa pa'i gsung rgyun las kyang / rtsa rlung thig le'i byed bcing la mi ltos par gtan tshigs kho nas lam gyi 'od gsal la sbyor ba ni rgyud 'di'i khyad chos chen po yin pas 'dir gtan tshigs srog tu bzung dgos zhes gsung ngo / /de'i phyir sngon byung dngos lnga nas dpyad du yod pas go ba'i gtan tshigs kyi bar gyis ye shes mtshon tshul thams cad shes rab kyis grol lugs su mtshungs pas 'dra ba las btags te dngos lnga sogs la'ang gtan tshigs zhes brjod do/ /de ltar byas na gong du smos pa'i bzhed pa gnyis po lga/nga la'ang 'thad mi 'thad kyi cha gnyis re 'byed rgyu yod par rtogs so/ /tshul 'di ni grol lam gyi dka' ba'i gnad cig tu snang ngo / /gnyis pa tshul lnga ni/ dbang rnon yang rab rnams la snang 73

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/grags kyi dngos po thams cad kyis sngon byung sku lnga'i gsung gi tshul dang mthun par rgyud don ngo sprod pa ste/ de'ang ston pa chos sku/longs sku/ mngon byang / rdo rje/ sprul pa'i sku rnams kyi gsung dang tshul mthun pa'i gtan tshigs rim pa bzhin/ skye med don gyi gtan tshigs skye med mtshon pa nam mkha' lta bu dang / dgongs pa brda'i gtan tshigs sgrib pa ngos 'dzin pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu dang / rang rig mngon gsal gyi gtan tshigs rtog med rang gsal nyi ma'i snying po lta bu dang / dbyer med rdo rje'i gtan tshigs grags stong dbyer med brag cha lta bu dang / brjod pa tshig gi gtan tshigs kun yid 'jug pa tshangs dbyangs lta bu'o/ /'di ni rgyal ba gong ma rnams snang ba thams cad bla ma dang dpe char shar ba zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pa ste/ de'ang yul snang gi brda la brten nas skye med kyi rtogs pa shar na chos sku'i gsung gi tshul du song ba dang / brda des rang rgyud kyi sgrib pa ngos zin pa na longs sku'i dang / gsal mdangs 'gags med kyi rig pa ngos zin pa na mngon byang gi dang / snang dus nyid nas stong pa'i ngo bor shes pa na rdo rje'i dang / rgyal ba'i tshangs dbyangs gcig nyid gdul bya'i dbang gis skad rigs dang tshig don sna tshogs su 'char ba ltar dngos po gcig nyid gsang sngags kyi dgongs pa sna 74

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3thalanam〉pharotshogs shes pa'i sgor mthong ba na sprul sku'i gsung gi tshul du song ba yin no/ /gsum pa tshig lnga ni/ tshul lnga po de dag tshig tu brjod pa ste/skye med rang snang du ston pa'i tshig rnams chos sku'i tshig dang /ldem dgongs brda'i tshig rnams longs sku'i dang / dbyer med rdo rje lta bur ston pa'i tshig rnams rdo rje'i dang / ye shes rang snang du ston pa'i tshig dang yi ge rnams mngon byang gi dang / bkri drang brgyud pa'i tshig rnams sprul sku'i tshig go/ /de rnams bsdu na lam rim las/ de lta mod kyi bsdu na gnyis/ /bzhi rjes mi dpyod gcig rjes dpyod/ /ces pa ltar/ dpyad du med pas go ba sku ba'i'i gtan tshigs zhes gdul bya dbang rnon dpyad pa'i ngal ba la cher mi ltos par rgyud don go ba'i dbang du byas pa dang /dpyad du yod pas go ba sprul sku'i gtan tshigs zhes dbang rtul dpyad pa gtso bor byas pa la brten nas rgyud don go ba'i dbang du byas pa gnyis so/ /'di las dpags na tshig lnga'i nang gi skye med rang snang du ston pa'i tshig la rnam par spros te ma bshad par/chos thams cad skye ba med pa'o/ /zhes pa lta bu'i ngag gis don bcar phog tu ston pa zhig dgos sam snyam la/ sku gzhan gsum gyi gtan tshigs la'ang rigs pa de ba sgre bar bya 'o/ /de ltar na 75

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbang rnon mchog gis rgyud don go ba gtan tshigs rgyas par bstan pa la mi ltos mod/ 'on kyang de dag rgyu mtshan med bzhin du rgyud don rtogs pa min pas gtan tshigs kyi dod thub dgos par nges shing / gtan tshigs bstan pa'i yul gyi gtso bo yang gong ma la ltos te dbang rtul zhes brjod kyang spyir shin tu dbang rnon yin te/ rgyud 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gtso bo'i gdul bya yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi rtse mor gyur pa'i rgyud 'di dbang rtul la dgongs te gsungs pa'i rgyud yin zhes smra mi rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /sprul sku'i gtan tshigs de la gnyis te/ tshig don mthun pa'i dang / mi mthun pa'i gtan tshigs so/ /dang po ni/bsgrub bya'i don dang btan tshigs gnyis sgra mi 'gal bar sbyar nas gtan la 'bebs pa'o/ /sgra mi 'gal ba zhes pa'i tshig zur 'di sbyar dgos par sems te/ 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs mtshan nyid pa yin min la byed na tshig don mi mthan pa'i gtan tshigs ༄bzhag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /de la gnyis/ tshad ma bka' gzhung dang / sgra mthun don spags kyi gtan tshigs so/ /dang po ni/ rgyud gzhung gis dngos bstan ltar 'chad pa ste/ de la'ang rtogs pa bzhi'i/ dag pa gsum gyi/ mnyam pa bzhi'i/ bdag nyid chen po'i gtan tshigs dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rgyud kyi le'u 76

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3bcu gcig par/ rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul/ /byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum pa/ /rab tu rtogs pa rnam bzhi yis/ /thams cad mngon rdzogs rgyal po che/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la tha mal pa'i gnas dang longs spyod la sogs pa snang ba sna tshogs dang /de rnams la bzang ngan dang spang blang sogs su zhen tshul sna tshogs can gyi sems ni kun nyon 'khor ba'i phyogs dang / de dag brgal ba'i pha rol ye shes kyi snang ba rnams ni rnam byang myang 'das kyi phyogs te/ de dag gang yang sems kyi gnyug ma'i gnas lugs kyi khams sam dbyings la ma grub ste/ dbyings de gcig pu snang ba de dag thams cad kyi rgyu'am snang gzhi yin zhing /dbyings de'i ngos nas 'khor ba'i snang sems grub na dbyings 'khor ba'i phyogs su chad pas snang sems de dag sbyang du mi rung la/rnam byang gi snang ba de'i ngos nas grub na dbyings de rnam byang gi phyogs su lhung bas 'khor ba'i snang gzhir mi rung ngo / /snang sems rang rgyud pa'am rang dbang bar grub na snang gzhi mthar thug gi khams la med pa mi 'thad pas/ grub tshul de khegs dgos te/ de'i phyir spyan 'grel las mtha' bzhi'i skye 'gog dang gcig du bral gyi rigs pa rgyas par bshad do/ /de ltar na dbyings kyi bzhugs tshul mthar thug la gnyis snang gi spros pa phra 77

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ rab tsam yang med par bzhed de/ 'di yang ma yin dgag gi stong nyid las brtsams te dpyad pa'o/ /tshul de ltar rtogs pa ni rgyu gcig par rtogs pa ste/ mdor bsdus nas sbyor bar 'god tshe/rang bzhin skye med/ rol ba 'gags med/ ngo bo dbyer med/mtshan nyid blo bral bzhi bsgrub byar bzung nas rgyu gcig pa sogs bzhi po gtan tshigs su 'god par gsungs pa dang sbyar na/'khor 'das kyi snang ba gnyis chos can/ dbyings kyi rang bzhin la skye ba med de/ khyod gnyis ka'i snang gzhi mthar thag dbyings ༄gcig po de las med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ste/ gsang bdag dgongs rgyan du bkod tshul ni der shes par bya'o/ /de ltar snang cha dbyings kyi ngos nas ma grub kyang / dbyings la ye shes 'bral mi srid cing / ye shes la snang cha lhun grub tu yod de/ thag khra med na sbrul du 'khrul pa'i gzhi med pa bzhin sems kyi gnyug ma'i gnas tshul la snang ba gtan med na 'khrul snang gtan med pas khyab ces sgyu 'phrul la mkhas pa rnams gsungs te rdo rje'i tshig go/ /de'ang gong smos ltar rtsa ba'i dbyings gang du yang phyogs lhung med pa'i gnad kyis ris med kyi snang ba sgyu ma lta bur rang shar te/ris med kyi don ni/ bye brag mtha' yas pa dang / chu lta bu'i 78

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3dngos po gcig kyang las dang rig sngags dang bsam gtan la sogs pa'i rkyen las cir yang snang ba ste/ mdor na phyogs rer ma chad pa'o/ /rgyud 'dir dngos po thams cad ming tsam du zad par yang yang gsungs te/ snang ba ris med kyi rgyu mtshan dpyis phyin pa yin la/ de yang dbyings la snang ba ma grub pa'i rgyu mtshan der thug go/ /ye shes kyi snang ba la phyogs ris med kyang sems kyis phyogs ris su zhenapar ma zad/ rdzogs rim pas stong gzugs mthong tshe ris med kun khyab kyi 'char tshul rtsal ma rdzogs pa'ang rtog sgrib glo bur ba de'i shan zhugs pa yin gyi/ snang ba rang gi gnyug ma'i 'dug tshul mthar thug gi cha ma yin te/ glo bur bas bslad pa med na rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes las mi gzhan pa'i rang snang bkod pa'i 'khor lo rnam pa thams cad pa/chos kyi dbyings ltar tshad yongs su ma chad pa kho na'o/ /de 'dra ba de la dag pa rab 'byams kyi snang ba zhes bya zhing / de nyid yongs su dag pa'i lha'i ngo bo nyid kyang yin te/ dag pa'i rten dang brten pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid yin par yongs su grags so/ /'di la yig 'bru'i tshul dang snang ba lhar sgrub pa zhes bya ste/ rtags sbyor bkod na/ dgongs rgyan las 'byung ba ltar/ sems nyid skye med kyi gdangs chos can/ rol pa 79

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gags med lha'i sku gsung thugs su rang snang ba yin te/ mtshon du med pa'i yi ge a nyid mtshon byed yi ge du mar ma 'gags par snang bas mtshon nas rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa yin te/ dbyings la spros pa med pa ni a yig la yi ge mang po med pa dang 'dra/'on kyang snang ba sna tshogs dbyings de'i cho 'phrul du shar ba ni a de gnas lnga'i byed rtsol tha dad kyis bsgyur bas dbyangs gsal gyi tshogs 'byung ba dang 'dra/ rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings de las shar ba la mthar gtugs na dag pa'i lha las gzhan med pa ni dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge la a'i gdangs kyis ma khyab pa med pa dang 'dra'o/ /grol lam cig char ba'i thad na rgya mtsho las/ sku gsung thugs su snang ba yis/ /ma lus gsung gi rgyan du rtogs/ /zhes pa ltar lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med yi ge a u ma gsum oṃ yig la gcig tu 'dus pas mtshon nas rtogs par byed pa la yig 'bru'i tshul du gsungs pa'ang yod do/ /dper na ras dkar po btsod kyis kha bsgyur na dmar po yin pa ltar gang dang ji ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul gyi phyogs nas bltas na lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med kyi rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyag gcig tu 'char bas snang spyod thams cad tshul de gnyis kyis sangs rgyas su byin gyis brlabs pa zhes bshad 80

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3na lta phreng dang mthun la/ skabs 'di'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtan tshigs la'ang sbyar rung bar mngon no/ /sbyor ba ni/ lhag pa'i bden gnyis chos can/ ngo bo dbyer med yin te/ khyod gnyis rang bzhin dang rol par gtan la phab pa'i byin rlabs sam shugs las de ltar thon pa'i phyir zhes bkod na go bde'am snyam mo/ /yang na/ 'di ltar snang ba 'i dngos po chos can/ lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med dam zung 'jug gi rang bzhin du ye nas sangs rgyas pa yin te/ rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bra'i tshul du //tsā //spri///// /spriX/ /trere/ zirang 1111 /༷bye(tshogs pa gnyis — tsho bas sam rten rlabs las ltar ma sang ba phyir/ zhe sa brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar chos thams cad bden pa dbyer med du sangs rgyas pa de shes pa gang gis gsal bar 'grub ce na/ de ni sgrin po'i blo can rnams kyis ring du brtag kyang lha mi'i spyod yul tha dad ltar sems kyi spyod yul ma yin pas mngon sum du blta bar mi nus kyi/ sems las 'das pa'i ye shes rang gsal g.yo med kyi dgongs pa shar ba na gdod gzhon nu ma'i bde ba ltar nyams su myong bzhin brjod mi shes shing / yid ches yod kyang phyogs 'dzin dang ma 'dres pa'i tshul du rang nyid kyis mthong bar 'gyur zhes ston pa la/ bden pa dbyer med chos can/ blo'i spyod yul las 'das pa yin te/ rang rig mngon sum gyis yul 81

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/med rang gsal du rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ste/ mngon sum pa'i gtan tshigs so/ /dbyings dang ye shes dang sems zhes smos pa rnams su sngar bshad pa rnams dran par bya'i/ gzhung spyi skad dang bsre bar mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud nyid las/ snod bcud rgyud rnams dag rtogs shing / /zhes gsungs te/ 'di la snang ba phyi nang gi chos rnams chos can/ ye nas sangs rgyas pa yin te/ dag pa gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / snod bcud rgyud gsum chos can/ye nas sangs rgyas pa yin te/ rim bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa yum lnga dang yab lnga dang ye shes lngar dag pa'i phyir/ zhes 'god pa gnyis don 'dra'o/ /de'ang da lta phyi nang gi dngos po'i bye brag ji snyed pa de snyed du tha mal pa'i snang zhen rgyas shing / de ji ltar rgyas pa ltar dag pa'i gnas tshul las gol bar 'gyar ba bzhin du///rngo| /jiX/ raring shā/de/ /rdoXrdolha /rdo ༷/de/da gas pa dag thams cad gdod nas rnam dag ra sa pa'i lta ba ci tsam rtsal sbyangs pa de tsam du log pa'i zhen snang gcod tshabs che la/ zhen snang gi dmigs pa mtha' yas kyang 'dir snod bcud rgyud gsum du bsdus nas bstan te/ phung po gcig la mtshon na/ gzugs phung tsam yang tshor ba sogs phung po thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gnas pa ro mnyam rdo rje'i gzugs 82

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3phung dang / de'i cha shas res kyang brtan g.yo mtha' dag khyab pa rtag khyab chen po'i gzags phung ni dag pa'i gzags phung gi don //re/ ri ri chibasi yin nga / don de dag kyang rang snang ris med ces pa'i don mthar thug yin la/ sems can gyi gzugs phung yang rang snang ris med du gdod nas dag par bshad zin te/ tshul de lta bus snod kyi 'jig rten sogs gsum po rnam par dag pa ni dag pa rnam pa gsum gyi don yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhung las/ mnyam gnyis lhag pa'i mnyam gnyis kyis/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad chos can/ ye nas sangs rgyas pa yin te/ mnyam pa bzhis mnyam par gnas pa'i phyir/ bzhi po ni/ phyi nang gi dngos po rnams sems la dag ma dag tu snang ba'i tshul gnyis su byung ba la bzang ngan dang blang dor du bden par blta zhing rlom pa ltar med de/ chos de rnams kyi gnas lugs la rnam grangs yin min gyi don dam gnyis yod kyang yul can gyi khyad par la ltos nas phye ba ma gtogs skye med mtha' bral du mnyam zhing / yang log gi kun rdzob gnyis po gang gi dbang du byas kyang bden stong sgyu ma lta bur mnyam ste/ de gnyis ni mdo sngags thun mong gi srid zhi mnyam nyid 'jog lugs so/ /'di dag 'og ma kha drang ba'i ched tsam 83

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/min gyi/ lam 'di'i rnal 'byor pas tshul de dag gis kyang 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du blta dgos pa yin te/ 'di gnyis la thun mong gi mnyam pa zhes grags pas shes pa'i phyir ro/ /stong nyid med dgag dang ma yin dgag gi rnam gzhag ci tsam byas kyang glo bur ba'i sems kyis sgro btags pa'i dgag sgrub kyi tshul la brten nas byas pa kho na ste/ sems las 'das pa'i lhag pa don dam gyi ngos nas bltas na ni dgag pa gnyis ka'i tha snyad dang bral ba yin la/ de bzhin du da lta rags pa'i sems kyis ma dag pa'i snang zhen bkag nas bsgoms pas dag par shar yang de 'dra'i dag ma dag gnyis la glo bur ba'i sems kyi snang ba yin min khyad med cing / dag par snang ba de ma dag pa'i dngos po'i gnas tshul du sgrub mi nus pas nyi tshe bar zad la/ lhag pa kun rdzob kyi bden pa dngos kyi steng nas gzhal na ni gser gling du sa rdo phal pa mi rnyed pa ltar spong len med par de 'dra'i las snang dang bcos ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyi snang ba thams cad ye shes rang snang gi 'khor lo 'ba' zhig tu mnyam ste lhag pa'i mnyam pa gnyis so/ /rang byung ye shes 'khor lo tha ma nas bstan par 'chad tshe lhag pa'i mnyam pa'am thunabyumong ma yin pa'i mnyam pa zhes 'dod rung mi rung dpyad rgyu che yang / de ltar bstan pa'i mdo rnams 84

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3dmigs bsal du byas nas/ mdo phyogs spyir btang la ltos te thun min du 'jog pa'am/ yang na bde gshegs snying po don dam dkor bdun gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa dang / de la brten nas snang srid dag mnyam du blta ba mdo sde'i phyogs la med pas de'i cha nas thun min du bzhag ces bya ste/ phyi ma drag par sems so/ /le'u bcu gcig pa'i dgongs rgyan sogs dang bstun nas gong ltar bshad kyi/ go bde ba ni chos thams cad don dam par ma skyes pa dang / kun rdzob tu sgyu mar mnyam pa gnyis thun mong ba dang / don dam par dkor bdun dang / kun rdzob sku dang ye shes su mnyam pa gnyis lhag pa zhes gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ro//bzhi pa ni/ lam rnam bkod dang bstun na le'u dgu pa'i/rang byung ye shes gnas med snang / /zhes pa drang rung ba 'dra yang dpyad dgos/ don ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams chos can/snang lugs du mar snang yang yin lugs la de ltar ma grub ste/sems nyid skye med rang byung gi ye shes gcig gi bdag nyid du ye nas gnas pa'i phyir/ zhes bya ste/ 'di pha mes kyi lo rgyus bsnyad pas rigs brgyud gang yin shes pa'i dpes mtshon par gsungs pas/ mdor na chos thams cad sems nyid 'od gsal gyi gdung rigs su bstan pa yin no/ /de'ang dag mnyam gyi lta ba'i gnad 85

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/spyir gtan la 'bebs pa rtogs pa bzhi dang / dag tshul bye brag tu phye nas ston pa dag pa gsum dang / mnyam tshul bye brag tu phye ba mnyam pa bzhi/ dag mnyam gyi gnad thams cad mthar thug rang byung ye shes su la zlo ba bdag nyid chen po zhes bshad na/nyang ṭika dang / smin lo chen po'i dgongs par yang 'grigs so//gnyis pa sgra mthun don spags la/ nyon mongs rang spyi'i/mtha' dang bral ba'i/ rnam par dbye ba'i/ mtshon pa dpe'i gtan tshigs dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs dug lnga chos can/spang byar yang dag par ma grub ste/ rang spyi'i mtshan nyid gnyis char du ngo bo nyid kyis stong ba'i phyir/ zhes pa ste/ dug lnga la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid gnyis 'jog pa 'og ma dang mthun yang / 'jog lugs mi mthan te/ 'og ma'i lugs la/ de dag spyi'i mtshan nyid ༄sems rab tu ma zhi ba'i rnam pa/ so so'i mtshan nyid/ gti mug kun tu rmongs pa/ zhe sdang kun nas mnar sems pa/ nga rgyal khengs pa/ 'dod chags yul la sred pa/ phrag dog gzhan gyi phun tshogs mi bzod pa'i rnam pa yin zhing / 'dir nyon mongs spyi'i mtshan nyid rig pa spros bral dang / so so'i mtshan nyid rig pa sgyu ma'i rtsal tha dad du snang bar 'dod pas 'phags zhes gsungs te/phyi ma'i mtshan nyid ni don ldog la mi byed kyi/ rang bzhin nam de 86

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3nyid la bya zhing / nyon mongs pa'i de nyid rig pa ye shes yin lugs la sngar gzhi rgyud kyi skabs su bshad pa dran par bya'o/ /bshad tshul snga ma yang 'dir mi bzhed pa min yang / nyon mongs lam byed kyi skabs don gtso bo phyi ma yin la/ de 'og ma dang mi mthun pa'i 'phags chos yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs chos can/ khyod la mtha'i spros pa ci yang ma grub ste/ yang dag par gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i phyir/ zhes pa ste/ thun mong du stong nyid la yod med rtag chad sogs kyi mtha' lgang yang med pa dang sgra mthun yang / 'dir sems dang ye shes phye nas mtha'i rtog pa gang yang ye shes kyi dbyings la mi rgyu bar ston pas spags so/ /gsum pa ni/ bum pa chos can/ rang bzhin med de/ dbyibs dang kha dog sogs chos du ma dang ldan pas brtag na dben pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ste/ thun mong ba ltar na/'byung chen rags par snang ba rnams snang ba ltar bden par grub nga/ cha shas phye na mi rnyed pa'i rigs pas 'gog pa dang sgra mthun yang / 'dir rgyu mtshan des chos de dag hūm̐ gyi de nyid 'od gsal gyi dbyings su bstim par byed pas 'phags so/ /bzhi pa ni/sems nyid chos can/ ngo bo nyid cir yang ma grub ste/ gzung du med pa'i phyir te/ nam mkha' bzhin/ zhes pa lta bar gzhung spyi'i ༄87

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpe don sbyor tshul dang sgra mthun yang / 'dir nam mkha'i brda thabs kyis chos nyid mtshon pa tsam las rtags kyi tshul gsum sgrub pa'i ched ma yin pas spags zhes zer ram dpyad rgyu cung zad snang ngo / /gnyis pa tshig don mi mthun pa'i gtan tshigs ni/ sems can tha mal pa la dngos su snang ba'i dngos po 'di dag nyid lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med du gdod nas sangs rgyas kyang de ltar mi shes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ lhag pa'i bden gnyis kyi gnad gsang mthar gtug na sems nyid kyi dbyings ci yang ma yin pa ste cir yang ma grub pa la thug cing / snang ba'i dngos po ni sna tshogs cir yang 'char ba mig 'phrul gyi grong khyer lta bur yod pas des mgo rmongs nas dbyings kyi bzhugs tshul las phyin ci log tu 'khrul pa yin zhing / lta ba ngo sprod tshe snang phyogs cir yang 'char ba nyid dbyings ci yang ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan du bkod pa rmad du byung ba'i thabs mkhas kyis du ma dang ro gcig phyogs rer zhen pa'i mdud pa 'grol ba la yin min gyi phyogs 'dzin gzhig pa zhes lam rnam bkod las gsungs te/ de lta bu'i gtan tshigs ni/sems nyid chos can/ yang dag par ci yang ma yin te/ snang tshul du ma 'gags par rang snang bas ci yang yin pa'i phyir/88

lo〉lke tha/thagasprang /stesprang /spyo 1docad :sdezud byebyecad zugalngadzocad /sdo/ 21rngad/ 8/rtags grub ste/ ci ltar brtags shing bsam pa ltar 'gyur bas na chos kun gyi ngo bor chos nyid rang snang ba'i phyir/ zhes bshad do/ / sgra mthan don spags dang tshig don mi mthan pa'i mthan mi mthan no༅ norab ra༄mi rigazibartsi ba'i gzhi mi gcig ste/ snga ma ni theg pa 'og ma'i bshad tshul dang sgra mthun pa dang / phyi ma rtags chos gnyis kyi tshig don mi mthun pa la bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma 'di'i mi mthun pa'i ma/tshams ni ci yang ma yin pa dang yin pa gnyis tsam mo/ /de'ang rtogs pa bzhi sogs rgyud gzhung gi dngos bstan bzhi po'i khongs su lta ba ngo sprod tshul gtan la phab pa des theg pa 'og ma'i gsung rab rnams su rang spyi dang mtha' bral gyi tha snyad sogs gsungs pa'i mthar thug gi dgongs gzhi sbas te ma bstan pa rnams gsal bar bkrol nas sde snod gzhan rnams 'dir gzhol bar ston pa la sgra mthun don spags dang / yang bzhi po der mi mkhas pa la ches 'gal ba ltar snang ba'ang phan tshun grogs su khyer nas gol sgrib kyi g.yang sar mi 'chug pa'i gnad kyi gzer bu ngo mtshar can yod pa zur du phyung ste ngo sprod pa la mi mthun pa'i gtan tshigs byung bar bdag cag smra'o/ /gsum pa grub mtha' ni/ de ltar gtan la phab pa las cir 'gyur zhe na/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid kyi lta ba dngos rnyed par 89

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gyur te/ de'i ngo bo ni lam rim las/ rgya mtsho dwangs pa'i gzugs brnyan ltar/ /sgra rten yid la byed min par/ /rang rig mngon sum dmigs bral ba/ /rang gsal gsum bral mi bsgul bar/ /nges par gdengs su gang byas pa/ /thos bsam brtan pa'i lta mthar phyin/ /zhes pa ltar/ gnas lugs lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med rang rig mngon sum gyis yul med rang gsal du rjen par rtogs pa ste/ mngon sum 'di dang rtogs pa bzhi'i skabs kyi mngon sum pa don 'dra'o/ /gsal bar bshad na 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa dngos su rnyed nas de'i char gyar pa'i shes rab /spre11 //)pe rig ༅skyes pa ste ga gzhung las/ lhun grub shes spron ma nyid/ /rang bzhin gsal ba spyan gyi mchog /ces so/ /'di la rang rig mngon sum zhes bshad pa ni/ rang gnas kyi ye shes go yul du ma lus par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin la/ lam gyi 'od gsal mngon sum du shar na chos nyid kyi dbyings mngon sum du mthong bas ma khyab pas rje sgrol g.yung rnam gnyis 'dir chos nyid don spyi'i sgo nas mthong bar bzhed pa dang yang mi 'gal te/ ji srid gnyis snang phra mos kyang bar ma chod pa'i tshul gyis 'od gsal gyi dbyings la 'jug mi nus pa de srid du chos nyid rjen par mthong ba ma yin zhing / des mthong tshod tsam de rnam 90

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3khugapar mi rtog pa'i dbyings mtshan nyid yongs sa rdzogs pa'ang ma ༄yin no/ /'dir 'od gsal rjen par rtogs pa'i grol lam rim gyis pa yod na slar stong pa chen po'i rnal 'byor la nyams lnga mthar chags kyi sgo nas 'jug dgos pa mi 'gal lam zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ 'od gsal sprin sbubs kyi nyi ma lta bu yud tsam rer rtogs kyang da dung rnam rtog gi gzhan dbang can yin pas brtan pa rim gyis 'thob dgos pa'i phyir te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/rang ngo 'phrod kyang goms 'dris ma byas na/ /rnam rtog dgras 'khyer g.yul ngo'i bu chung 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'od gsal gyi dgongs pa dngos la ma reg kyang lhag pa'i bden gnyis la bsam byung gi nges pa rnyed na shes pa'i mtshan nyid phal ba tsam du 'dod dgos so/ /shes pa'i mtshan nyid bshad zin te/ ma hā yo ga'i rgyud la gsum du 'byed skabs/ gsang 'dus sogs pha rgyud rnams su gsal stong rlung gi rdzogs rim dang / bde mchog sogs ma rgyud du bde stong thig le'i rdzogs rim dang / gsang snying sogs gnyis med rgyud las 'od gsal ye shes chen po'i rdzogs rim gtso bor ston zhes 'byung ba'i rdzogs rim phyi ma yang grol lam la byed par mngon zhing / sngar bshad pa ltar thabs lam du rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skye gnas 'phel gsum thams cad 91 ji

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shas cher rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor gyis byed pa'i dod phal cher lam 'dir lta ba lam byed kyi steng nas 'gro bar snang ba dang thabs lam la'ang med du mi rung bas rgyas par bshad do/ /gnyis pa rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid la/ lam rim las/srid pa rim par smin tshul gyis/ /'jug pa'i yan lag lnga ru bzhag /gang dag dngos kun rang rig phyir/ /shi ba don dam bden pa ste/ /skye ba bar ma kun rdzob yin/ skyes pa'i rim gsum gnyis med don/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tha mal pa'i skye 'chi bar do gsum gyi snang zhen sbyangs nas 'chi ba'i 'od gsal chos skur lam du 'khyer ba don dam stong pa chen po'i rnal 'byor/bar do'i rlung sems longs skur 'khyer ba kun rdzob snying rje sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor/ skye srid rags pa 'khor bcas sprul skur sbyong byed kyi rnal 'byor rim pa gsam ste ting nge 'dzin lnga'o/ /phyi ma'i rim pa ༄ gsum ni dri za mngal du zhugs pa nas phyir btsas pa'i bar dang mthun pa phyag rgya gcig pa dang / btsas nas bu tsha 'khor 'dabs rgyas pa'i bar dang mthun pa phyag rgya spros bcas/ nar son nas bcad ris dang khe drag sgrub pa dang mthun pa tshom bu tshogs sgrub rnams te/ de ltar rim drug las bshad do/ /phyag rgya gcig pa la'ang / rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed dang sbyar na/ bar 92

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3do'i rlung sems pha ma'i khu rdul gyi dbus su dang por zhugs pa ltar gsung yig 'bru/ mer nur ltar 'khrang gi gnas skabs ltar thugs phyag mtshan dang / gor nya rus sbal nas lus rdzogs te bcos pa ltar sku rdzogs pa zhes he ru ka gaspo drangs nas lo chen gyis gsungs so/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye sgo gzhan yang bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa gnyi sa te/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud phyi ma las/ lha yi rnam pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /zla ba rdo rje la sogs rim/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes su bshad/ /rang bzhin grub pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa zhes byar brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'khor ba'i skye 'chi bar do gsum dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sku gsum ste gzhi 'bras de gnyis char dang rnam pa mthun par byas nas rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du sgom pa'i dag rdzogs smin gsum gyi gnad tshang ba'i bcos ma'i rnal 'byor ni bskyed rim dang / skye 'chi bar do sku gsum du dngos su sgyur ba'i lam gyi rigs su gnas pa'i ma bcos pa'i rnal 'byor ni rdzogs rim yin la/ de'i phyir gong ma kha cig kun btags bskyed rim dang / yongs grub rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor zhes gsungs pa yang dgongs pa zab bo/ /yang gnyis te/ ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa ma thob kyang mos mno tsam gyis thun re'i nang du srung 'khor nas go bgo lus srung bar 9 3

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyi sgrub thabs tshang ba re nyams su len pa mos sgom dang / stong chen sogs lnga po snga ma la g.yo thob goms brtan mthar phyin gyi nyams lnga rdzogs pa na gdod phyi ma phyi ma la 'jug pa'i tshul gyis mthar chags su slob pa nges rdzogs te lam rim las de ltar bshad do/ /mos sgom du bshad pa'i tshal 'di nyid than bzhir sgom pa'i rabye ra༅sbyor bas bskyed rim mthar phyin pa'ang yod mod kyi/ bka' srol 'di las cher mi 'byung la/ thun rer sgrub thabs kyi yan lag tshang bar sgom pa la mos nges gnyis su phye ba'i mos sgom gyis khyab pa ni 'dir yang mi bzhed de/ nges rdzogs kyi tshogs sgrub skabs su yang de ltar sgom par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mos sgom 'di la bskyed rim gyis khyab cing / /der thun re'i nang du tshang bar sgom rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni rgya spros man chad kyi bzhi po tsam yin yang /sems brtan pa'i mtshan ma ma mthong ba'i sgrub pa po mang pos tshogs sgrub byed pa'ang mos sgom du bzhag dgos pas spyir mos sgom gyi lnga ka yod do/ /nges rdzogs la bskyed rdzogs kyi cha gnyis dang / de la slob tshul yang gang zag gi khyad par gyis mi 'dra ba gnyis yod par gsungs te/ dang po nas bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel du slob tshul dang / bskyed rim mthar phyin nas rdzogs rim la 'jug pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thog mar stong pa chen po'i rnal 94

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3tra tra'abyor nog pas g.yo ba'i nyams ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu dang /thob pa'i nyams rong khung dog po'i 'bab chu lta bu goms pa'i nyams byang thang gi dal 'bab lta bu/ brtan pa'i nyams mtsho chung ser bus bskyod pa lta bu/ mthar phyin gyi nyams rgya mtsho rlabs dang bra la ba lta bu ste nyams lnga rdzogs rdzogs su bsgoms pa'i khog nas rdzogs rim pa'i 'od gsal gyi nyams myong la 'dris cha thon pa na snying rje sgyu ma bcos nas sgom/ de rdzogs rim ma bcos pa'i snying rje sgyu mar song ste nyams lnga rdzogs pa na phyag rgya gcig pa phra rags la dmigs pa'i bskyed rim la sbyangs pas rkyen byas te rdzogs rim gyi lha sku rgya gcig mthong la/ de la gsal brtan gyi nus pa rnyed pa dang / phyag rgya spros bcas kyi rnal 'byor yang dang por bskyed rim dang rim gyis rdzogs rim du go 'pho zhing / spros bcas mthar phyin nas tshogs sgrub kyi spyod pa'i nye rgyus mtshams sbyar bas 'phags lam 'grub pa ste/ 'di'i rgya gcig gi bskyed rim lta bu ni rdzogs rim thob la ma nyams pa'i rgyud kyi bcos ma'i rnal 'byor yin pas/ rdzogs pa'i bskyed pa dang / bskyed pa'i rdzogs pa zhes gsungs pa lta bur 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang por bskyed rim gyi stong chen brtan pa thob thob tu sgom/ de nas snying rje sgyu ma de ltar sgom/ de lta bu'i 95

stuXrngad/ 3 rdogrub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rim pas spros bcas kyi bskyed rim mthar son pa na tshogs sgrub kyis 'dod gzugs gang rung gi rig 'dzin bsgrubs te mkha' spyod kyi zhing sogs nyul zhing dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu rdzogs rim la brten nas lam lnga mthar dbyung ba ste/de ltar gnyis yod kyang grol lam rim gyis pa gtso bo rnams kyi sgom tshul dngos snga ma yin par gsungs so/ /de ltar spyi'i rnam bzhag la dpyad pa'i sa bon tsam smos nas ting 'dzin lnga so so'i ngos 'dzin zur tsam brjod na/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs cir yang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong nyid kyi dbyings su mnyam par 'jog cing chos sku'i ngo bor blta ba stong pa chen po'i rnal 'byor/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje longs sku'i rang bzhin du shes nas sgom pa snying rje sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i rang sems a dkar por bsgoms nas yi ge spro bsdu la dmigs pa phra ba yig 'bru dang / de las bskyed chog rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis rtsa ba'i lha yab yum zung gcig byin rlabs kyi lha gsum dang dbu rgyan gyi lha lnga thags ka'i ye shes sems dpa' rwa/|/ dmi miste yan lag lha dgu dang bcas par sgom pa rags pa lha sku la bslab pa ste phyag rgya gcig pa phra rags kyi rnal 'byor/ gnyal 96

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3sangs rgyas grags kyi bzhed pa ltar/ rigs tha dad kyi gtso bo gcig tu gyur pas rab tu phye ba dkyil 'khor dang / rigs tha mi dad kyi gtso bo so sos byed pas rab tu phye ba tshom bur bshad de/de 'dra'i dkyil 'khor dang tshom bu spro ba gnyis dang grangs dang zhal phyag spro ba ste phyag rgya spros ba cas kyi dbye ba bzhi/ de la dkyil 'khor spro ba ni/ zhi dkyil 'bring po lha zhe gnyis ma/ rgyas pa de'i steng du rigs chung gi sems dpa' yab yum bzhi bcu bsnan pas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa/ bsdus pa rigs lnga dang sgo ba yab yum ba co brgyad/ khro dkyil 'bring po yongs grags nga brgyad la khro bcu yab yum bsnan pas don brgyad/ rgyas pa de la rigs chung bsnan pas brgya dang bco brgyad/ bsdus pa lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa rnams so// tshom bu ni/ mi bskyod pa yab yum rdo rje'i rigs chang zang bzhi//steste she11 ༄༄r+sha /rjes/thur+sharasgo ba yab yum tsho bsne brgyad pa dang / sku gsung thugs — rags gsum gyi gtso bo rigs chung dang bcas pa la khro bo bcu las steng 'og gi khro bo spangs pa'i yab yum zung brgyad bsnan pas zhe drug ma dang / rigs lnga rigs chung khro bcu yab yum ste bdun cu pa rnams rim bzhin tshom bu gcig gsum lnga pa'o/ /khro bo'i skabs su/gnas yul sgo skyong dbang mo rnams yod mnyam la/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi gtso 'khor bcu dang khro bcu yab yum bsnan pa'i don brgyad ma 97

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang / bud+dha dang pad+ma'i gtso 'khor yang bsnan pa'i go brgyad ma dang / rigs lhag ma gnyis kyang bsnan pa'i bco brgyad pa rnams snga ma bzhin no/ /grangs ni/ le'u brgyad pa ltar sangs rgyas stong dang / nyi khri bzhi stong dang / bsam yas lhun grub tu spro ba dang gsum/ de'i rigs pa khro bo la'ang sbyar bas lha grangs stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang / bdun khri drug stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu pa dang / bsam yas lhun grub ste spro ba gsum mo/ /bsam yas lhun grub spro ba la 'phags lam pa dgos zhes gsungs pa yod kyang de tshun chad la de ltar dngos su spro mi nus pa yin gyi sgom mi nus pa min no/ /zhal phyag ni/ zhi ba rgyas pa thub drug dang yum rnams ma gtogs thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug pa dang / 'bring po rgyal ba rigs drug tsam zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ bsdus pa thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ khro bo la gtso bo dbu phyag grangs med dang dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa/ 'khor gyi ma mo rnams kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa sogs rgyud nas bshad kyang brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes su rgyas pa la rigs lnga dang / 'bring po la gtso bo tsam zhal gsum phyag drug pa dang / bsdus pa thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar ting nge 'dzin bzhi po so sor sgrub cing rtsal thon nas/ slar de rnams thun re'i nang du tshang bar bsgoms 98

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3te bogs 'don pa'am khyad par du 'gro bar byed pa ni tshom bu tshog sa sgrub yin te/ 'di la gsum/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas gzhi bzung ba/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis gzhung bsrang ba/ 'bras bu rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i dus bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag dbang bar chad med cing yid du 'ong ba'i sar g.yos sbyor byed pa dang / sgrub gzhung srong ba dang / gsang spyod la 'jug pa'i khang pa rim gsum brtsigs pa gnas phun tshogs dang / gza' skar sbyor byed tshes grangs sogs legs pa'i dus phun tshogs/ 'tsho ba zas/ rkyen zlog sman/ sgrub pa rdzas/ mchod pa rdzas kyi yo byad rnams tshang bar 'du byas pa yo byad phun tshogs/ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs/ /zhes sogs ltar rang bzhin brgyad ldan gyi slob dpon dang / ston pa mchod brtson rtogs pa gsal/ /sogs yon tan drug ldan gyi 'khor te ston 'khor de gnyis sgrub pa po phun tshogs zhes gciganetu bsdu ste/ de lta bu'i 'dus pa chung 'bring chen po ji ltar tshogs pa dang / bsnyen sgrub rnam pa bzhi'i srol du tshud pa sgrub pa'i thabs phun sum tshogs pa ste lnga'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sgrub dus kyi bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i dang po bsnyen pa la'ang sngon du bya ba'i dang / bya ba las kyi bsnyen pa gnyis las/dang po ni/ sngar spros bcas man chad kyi ting 'dzin bzhi mthar 99

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ phyin par bslabs pa de nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa chog /sta gon/bshags skong / mtshams gcod/ dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan bkod pa rnams sngon du btang ste/ gral tshul gyi phyag nas rtags gdab par bya/ de nas ting 'dzin gsum dang / dkyil 'khor dang / las rim gyi ting nge 'dzin lnga po bsgom la dzab kha phye nas gsal ba gsum ldan gyis dzab bzla/ dkyil 'khor phye ba de rang la bsnyim zhing tshogs mchod sogs byed pa nub dang po'i bsnyen pa ste bsnyen pa'i yan lag /las rim de dang mthan pas dzab kyi tshe ༄'od zer dkar po'i spro bsdus dngos grub kyi snod rung du bya ba la ci tsam sgrub pa'i dus kyi phyed tshun chad brtson pa nye bsnyen gyi yan lag /phyed phyi mar 'od zer dmar po'i spro bsdus dngos grub dbang du bya ba bsgrub pa'i yan lag /dngos grub kyi mtshan ma yid ches pa byung ba na 'od zer mthing khas dngos grub bsdu zhing lha dang rdzas dang yum gyi mkha' rnams las dngos grub blang ba sgrub chen gyi yan lag go/ /rgyud nyid las tshogs sgrub ston pa na zhen med kyi ngang nas 'dod yon gyi yo byad lnga la longs spyod tshul 'a ba' zhig rtsal du bton nas gsungs pas tshogs sgrub kyi don po ni bde chen gyi ye shes rgyas pa'i sgo nas de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa 'bar zhing brtan pa la byed dgos te/ de'i mthus ting nge 'dzin 100

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3snga ma bzhi'i rgyun yang shin tu khyad zhugs par 'gyur bas bogs 'don du 'gro lugs dang / dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gnyis ka de yin no/ /spyir bde ba dang / khyad par zhu bde lam byed la rdzogs rim gyis ma khyab pa ni grags che bas ma phye'o/ /'grel pa rnams su dngos grub blang ba'i skabs ma gtogs par a li ka li'i yo byad la spyod tshul gsal bar ma smos kyang / med pa min te/ sgrub thabs kyi mchod pa'i nang du/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor bas/ /zhes sogs 'byung ba las shes pa'i phyir ro//gsum pa ni/ brtson 'grus drag pos bsgrubs pas zla drug la sogs pa'i dus nges pa can na phra yang sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa'i rig 'dzin gyi lus 'dod gzugs gang rung gi lha dang rjes su mthun pa 'thob ste/ 'dod gzugs kyi rig 'dzin gnyis gang 'thob ni las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i khyad par gyis yin zhes gsang ngo / /'di lta ba'i rig 'dzin ni than mong gi dngos rigang rig mi norang grub chen po'o/ /lam rim las zhi ba'i tshogs sgrub kyis rab zla ba drug dang / tha mas lo gcig zla ba bzhi na dang / khro bos rab zla ba gnyis dang / tha mas drug na 'grub pa sogs kyi khyad gsungs pa la dzab 'thor 'dril gyi khyad du bzhed pa'ang yod mod kyi/phal cher snar ston gyi bzhed pa ltar khro bo bar chad 'dul ba dang /101

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/drag cing myur ba'i phrin las kyi lhar bzhengs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin byas na bde zhing / dngos grub kyi pho nya'i dbang gis kyang khyad cung zad zhugs sam snyam mo/ /ma hā yo ga'i rgyud gzhan las tshogs spyod kyi mthar thun mong gi grub pa chen po sgrub pa la da dung sbyin sreg dang 'khrul 'khor sogs bar du brgyud dgos par gsungs shing / 'dir de dag la mi ltos par tshogs sgrub kyi dus nyid du rig 'dzin 'grub par gsungs pa ni/ snga ma bskyed rim cung zad brtan pa dang / phyi ma cher brtan pa'i dbang du byas par bzhed pa yod kyang phra mo'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa'i tshogs spyod pas kyang snga ma ltar byed par bshad pas sgrub lugs kyi khyad lta bus 'byed dgos sam brtag par bya'o/ /phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin gong 'og 'di dag thams cad du lta ba'i skabs su bshad pa'i rang snang ris med kyi go don srog tu dran par bya ste/ slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyi gzhung las bskyed rim gyis yul dus tshad can 'joms par gsungs pa'ang 'di dang tshul mtshungs la/ rang snang ris med kyi dkyil 'khor la grangs tshad dang zhal phyag sogs gcig tu nges pa med kyang sgrub thabs su nges pa ltar ma bstan na don de la rnam pa gsal ba dang nga rgyal brtan pa sogs kyi ting nge 'dzin skyed mi nus pas de ltar 102

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3bstan ces bde gshegs 'dus pa las gsungs so/ /de 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin lnga ni bskyed rim kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin la/rdzogs rim gyi ting nge 'dzin lnga ni/ dang por chos dang chos min gyi bya ba gzhan btang ste/ lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas 'dug la/ sems kyi gnad bzhag thabs gnyis gang rung la gnas par bya ste/bzhag thabs gnyis ni/ blo che ba shes rab kyi dang / blo chung gdams ngag gi stobs kyis 'jog pa gnyis te/ dang po la'ang spros bral gyi chos nyid la sems 'jog go snyam pa dran tsam gyis rig pa yul med du sal ler 'jog pa rig pa spyi blugs su dang / sngar gtan la phabs pa'i lta ba dran par byas nas de'i ngang la rgasal ba so ma shor tsam du 'jog pa mthong ba'i rdzas la 'jog pa sa/nyis yod cing / phyi ma ni nang du rang sems kyi ngo bo la bltas pa na cir yang mi mthong zhing de'i ngang la ma bcos par 'jog pa ste/ gsum ka sems de nyid la 'jog par khyad med kyang 'jog byed kyi thabs sam sgo mi 'dra ba las dbye'o/ /gang ltar yang rtse gcig tu dang / bar ma chad par bslab pas gzung 'dzin rags pa dang bral ba'i 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu mngon du gyur nas stong gzags zhes stong pa 'od gsal gyi char gyar pa'i gzags rig nor skur 103

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/snang ngam stong pa 'od gsal gyi gzugs brnyan lta bu'i snang ba sgyu ma'i grong khyer ltar dbyibs dang kha dog gi rnam pa can mtha' klas pa 'char te/ goms pa yun bsring bas 'od gsal je 'thug tu 'gro zhing / ci tsam 'thug pa'i rim pa ltar stong gzugs de dag je dwangs je gsal dang cher mched par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i 'od gsal de la 'khrul pa'i kun rtog gis stong pas stong pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ste/ 'di tshe stong gzags shar ba de la ༄gtso bor mi byed par 'od gsal rang gi bzhugs tshul mi rtog pa'i dbyings la bsre ba rtsal 'don byed par mngon no/ /de byang bar goms pa na 'od gsal rgya bskyed de snang ba de rnams la bsris nas rtse gcig tu bzhag pas ris med kyi snang ba sngar las kyang cher mched cing / de thams cad thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs med kyi snying rje'am mi dmigs pa'i bde ba'i yo lang 'ba' zhig tu 'char bar 'gyur te/ de brtan pa'i tshe stong gzugs la las rung gi yon tan khyad par can thob pas/ rkyen cung zad tsam gyis rdzogs rim pa'i lha sku rgya gcig tu sgyur nus pa yin no/ /mnyam bzhag tu de ltar rtsal 'byongs pas de las langs pa na'ang 'gro ba thams cad stong gzugs bzhin du bde chen snying rje'i rol pa sgyu ma lta bur 'char te snying rje sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas bskyed 104

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3rdzogs zung 'brel byed tshe kun bzang yab yum lta bu'i bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / gang ltar yang 'phen pa'i rkyen la brten nas stong gzugs de thams cad lha sku phyag rgya gcig pa'i rnam par sad pa ni rgyu gcig gi rnal 'byor te/ stong gzugs kyi lha sku ji snyed shar yang kun bzang yab yum lta bu gcig gi rnam pa can du mtshungs pas de ltar brjod kyi/ stong gzugs kyi sku gcig las mi 'char ba ni min pa 'dra'o/ /bka' srol 'di las rgya gcig gi mgo brtsams pa nas zung 'jug gi lha sku yin zhes 'byung ba ni ting nge 'dzin dang po'i stong pa dang gnyis pa'i snying rje zung 'jug tu song ba tsam la dgongs kyi/ zung 'jug gi sku dngos min no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dang tshom ba'i 'khor lo spro ba'i bskyed rim gyi ༄rkyen cung zad las stong gzugs kyi lha gtso 'khor dang tshom bu'i rnam pa mtha' yas pa dang / de dag re re la'ang grangs spro ba'i skabs ltar grangs med pa/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su 'char ba nas bzung mthar phyin pa'i bar ni phyag rgya spros bcas te/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin snga ma bzhi'o / /phyag rgya spro ba'i bskyed rim gyi skabs 'dir/ phung khams sogs rtog tshogs thams cad lhar sbyong ba'i ched du sangs rgyas zhe gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa dang / phung sogs kyi cha re re yang 105

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnam dag gi yon tan thams cad par sgrub pa'i ched du lha de dag re re zhing yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad tshang bar sgom pa dang / de ltar dag pa gcig kyang dag pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid du 'gyur ba'i tshul de'ang rtog tshogs thams cad mi shigs pa'i srog dang ldan pa rgyu mtshan du bzung ba'i steng nas sgom pa'i ched du lus la bkod pa'i lha thams cad so sor ye shes sems dpa' dang ldan par dmigs pa sogs yin pas/ lha rtog dbyer med du shes pa ni bskyed rdzogs kyi lam gnad gces shos shig tu snang ngo / /de dag sgom pa'i rjes thob kyi skabs rnams su'ang mnyam bzhag gi rnal 'byor gang yin des snang spyod thams cad rgyas btab nas rnal 'byor de dang mi mthun pa'i rnam rtog sdom pa'ang gnad gcig ste 'di ni la dor ba spyod pa'i thad na gsal lo//de bzhin du nyin mo ting nge 'dzin gang la slob pa de nyid mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor du 'khyer tshul yang rgyud 'grel las stong chen gyi skabs su sad pa'i dus kyi 'od gsal dang mtshan mo'i gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal gnyis sbrel te nyams su len pa dang / snying rje sgyu ma'i skabs su nyin snang dang rmi lam gyi snang ba thams cad sgyu mar mthong zhes 'byung bas rnal 'byor dang po gnyis kyis gnyid dang rmi lam sbyong tshul gsal bar bstan cing / tshul des rmi lam 106

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3trashe gyi snying rje sgyu ma phyag rgya gcig spros su bsgyur nas sgom pa'ang go nus la/ sngar lam rim drangs par/ 'chi ba don dam bden pa ste/sogs kyis 'chi ba dang stong chen bsre ba dang / bar do snying rje sgyu ma dang bsre ba sogs kyang legs par thon pas bsre ba'i man ngag ces pa'i ming ma btags kyang don tshang ba yin no/ /'on kyang 'dir rmi lam dang bar do'i phyag rgya gcig spros sad pa dang skye ba sbyong byed kyang yin pas gzhan dang mi 'dra'o/ /de'ang lta ba'i skabs su gtan tshigs rnams la brten nas sems dang ye shes thun mong gi snang ba rags pa rnams la ye shes kyi rang snang kho na'i phyogs bzung ste bltas pas grub mtha' 'od gsal mngon sum du sad pa ni ye shes kyi snang ba thun min dngos su skul ba'i sgo dang po yin te/ 'dir ye shes kyi snang ba thun min ni stong gzugs la bya'o/ /de 'dra'i snang ba de ting nge 'dzin dang por mthong nas/gnyis par ji ltar mthong ba de la dbang gyur bsgrub/ gsum pa nas lha skur bsgyur te rtsal sbyang bas gnas lugs ngo bo nyid kyi ka/zhi'i steng na shin tu phra ba'i snang ba rnam pa thams cad pa spro ba'i nus pa yod pa de ye shes kyi rlung gis bskul nas gsal bar sad cing / gzhi'i yon tan dang shes 'jug gi lam ma bu 'phrod de gcig grogs gcig gis byas nas ye shes rang snang gi rten dang 107

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brten pa'i dkyil 'khor dngos gnas pa sgrub pa'i nus pa bde blag tu rdzogs par 'gyur ba ni sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lam gnad chen po ste/ thabs grol gnyis ka'i skabs su rtogs dka'i mdud pa 'di las 'grol dka' ba med pas rtsal ci yod phyung nas sems pa gces so/ /rgya spros mthar phyin na sa rnal 'byor pa'i 'byor pa dang dbang po'i rim pa bzhin du 'dus pa che 'bring chung ngu ci rigs kyi tshogs sgrub bam yang na stong gzugs kyi lha mo 'ba' zhig la brten nas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba bsgrubs te zag med kyi lam la sbyor ba ni tshogs sgrub kyi ting nge 'dzin dang bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /tshogs sgrub kyi skabs su'ang rgya spros kyi ting nge 'dzin phul du byang ba yod mod kyi/ ting nge 'dzin lngar phye ba'i bzhi pa ni ma yin ༄zhing / des stong chen sogs gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o/ /le'u dgu pa rtsa 'grel gyi tshig zin la 'bras bu rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i dus bstan pa 'byung ba ni rdzogs rim gyi tshogs sgrub 'di nyid kyi dbang du mdzad pa yin no/ /der tshogs sgrub kyi dus su lha tshom bu gcig pa dang gsum pa sogs gang bsgom gyi khyad par las 'bras bu dman mchog gi khyad 'a jug par bshad pa ni rgya gcig dang tshogs sgrub kyi bar du spros bcas bor ba'i thod rgal ba yod par 108

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3bshad pas de lta bu la sbyar dgos sam dpyad do/ /shes 'jug gi mtshan nyid de dag la tshogs sbyor gyi lam gnyis kyi rnam bzhag bya ba'i tshul ni/ sdom ṭika snye mar bskyed rim pa'i tshogs sgrub kyis 'dod gzugs kyi rig 'dzin grub pa'i bar rnams tshogs lam dang / rdzogs rim la zhugs pa nas sbyor lam du 'jog par bshad pa sngar brjod pa'i rim gnyis la slob tshul phyi ma dang 'grigs shing / yongs grags kyi bshad sgros dang yang mthun pas bzung bde mod/ bskyed rdzogs sbrag nas sgom pa'i phyogs la rnam bzhag gzhan dgos pas sgyu 'phrul rang gi bshad sgros su/ tshogs lam gyi rnal 'byor bzhi dang / sbyor lam tshogs sgrub ces grags che ba ltar dgos so/ /sngags bla med kyi tshogs lam la bsgom stobs kyis rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa las byung ba'i rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor du ma zhig yod par yid bzhin mdzod rtsa 'grel sogs mang po las ches gsal bar gsungs pa'ang phyogs 'di la 'thad do/ /de'ang ji srid bcos shing brtags pa'i rnal 'byor la ltos pa de srid du tshogs lam pa yin la/ rang bzhin grub pa'i rnal 'byor ram ma bcos pa'i rnal 'byor 'ba' zhig tu song ba na sbyor lam par 'jog ste/ tshogs lam du 'jog pa bcos ma'i rnal 'byor gyi cha nas yin kyang / tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi ma bcos 109

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i rnal 'byor rnams tshogs lam du 'jog pa mi 'gal lo/ /'dis rdzogs rim la dang por 'jug pa'i sngon du bskyed rim mthar phyin pa ma song ba'i gnad kyis rdzogs rim pa'i rgya spros grub pa'i 'og tu'ang bskyed rim la brten nas spro bsdu'i rtsal sbyang dgos pas rnal 'byor snga ma bzhi ka tshogs lam du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/ /rgya spros las bsam yas lhun grub spro ba'i thad 'dir zhib cha cung zad dgos so/ /de ltar byas na bskyed rdzogs sbrag ma'i lugs 'dir so skye'i sa'i rdzogs rim gyi yon tan phal cher tshogs lam nyid du rdzogs par 'dod dgos shing / sbyor lam la drod sogs bzhi'i dbye ba byas pa'ang ma mthong bas bla med kyi rgyud sde'i lam gyi 'gros gzhan dang mi 'dra ba ches che ba zhig 'ong bar go ste/ da dung mkhas pa rnams kyis zhib tu brtags dpyad mdzad par zhu'o/ /rgya gcig man chad tshogs lam dang / spros bcas nas sbyor lam dang lo tshod bstun par 'dod pa sogs kyang yod de 'dir ma brjod do/ /gsum pa lam gyur gyi 'bras bu ni/ lam dang gang zag gnyis las/ lam la mthong sgom mthar lam gsum dang / de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag la/ rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun gyis grub/ /ces pa ltar rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'o/ /dang po rnam smin rig 110

ra〉 tha/thagasprang /stesprang /spyo mdocad :ngecad byebyezud zugartse(rdotshog /sdo/ 1sdo/jid/ 2/'dzin ni/ rnam smin gyi lus rten rags pa dang ma bral ba/sems yi dam gyi lha skur smin pa/ lus rgya dang bral ma thag phyag chen rig 'dzin la sbyor nges pa ste chos gsum ldan gyi mthong lam pa 'o/ /de thob pa na mngon shes la brten nas gling bzhi'i 'jig rten tsam du 'gro ba'i don spyod nus pa sogs yon tan gzhan mang po yang 'thob bo/ /'di la rnam smin gyi lus rgyas bcings pa'i cha nas dang / sems lha skur rnam par smin pa'i cha nas rnam smin rig 'dzin zhes sgra bshad tshul gnyis yod gsung ngo / /tshe dbang rig 'dzin ni/ lus zag med du gyur pa/ 'khor sgyur dang 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i gtso bo'i cha byad can gyi mthong lam pa ste/rdzogs rim gyi lag rjes su gyur pa'i dbang shes nyi shu rtsa lnga dang /spyir grags pa'i mngon shes drug gis gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgyar sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ /'dir zag med ces pa'i zag pa ni bzhi ste/ zhen pa phyin ci log gi sgro 'dogs nyon mongs pa'i dang / lus rang dbang med par 'dor ba lus kyi dang / khams bde mi bde rang dbang med par 'byung ba khams kyi dang / las kyis rang dbang med par lus len pa skye gnas kyi zag pa ste dang po rtsa ba dang lhag ma gsum yan lag go/ /de la rig 'dzin de gnyis ka'ang don gyi 'od gsal mtshan nyid pa thob pa dang / rtsa 111
