pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i zag pa zad pa'i spangs rtogs kyi cha la khyad med kyang dbang po rno rtul gyi dbang gis rags lus ye shes kyi mes sbyang nus ma nus sam yan lag gi zag pa gsum zad ma zad kyi khyad par las phye bar lam chung las/ nus pa thob dang ma thob pa'i mthong lam gnyis su 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes pa drang nas bshad do/ /des na gang zag gcig gis rig 'dzin 'di gnyis ka bgrod pa ni mi srid de/ mthong lam lan gnyis sa 'thob pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /༄phyag chen rig 'dzin ni/ rtsa ba'i lus rten yi dam gyi lha'i rnam pa can mtshan dpes brgyan pa dang / sprul pa'i lus rngon pa dang smad 'tshong sogs sna tshogs pa'i gzugs su ston cing / tshe dbang las kyang gsal brtan dag gsum gyis khyad par 'phags pa'i mngon shes kyis longs sku'i zhing dang mnyam par 'gro ba'i don byed pa ste/ 'di la sgom lam sa dgu'i dbye bas de snyed dang /dgu po de la rigs lnga'i gnas skabs kyis lngar mdzad pa'ang yod do/ /lhun grub rig 'dzin ni/ mthar lam pa zhes sa bcu pa'i khyad par lam la gnas pa/ sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs sku dang rjes su mthun pa'i lus can/ rtogs pa dang phrin las kyang sanganu/ rgyas nyid dang phyogs mtshungs pa'o/ /rig 'dzin phyi ma gnyis su lhan cig gnas pa dang bag la nyal gyi dri ma phra mo spong bar 112

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3gsungs pa'i dri ma rnams ni shes sgrib kho na yin te/ nyon sgrib kun brtags lhan skyes ma phye bar mthong lam nas spong bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /slob lam du rig 'dzin gcig las ma bgrod par sangs rgyas thob pa sogs kyang yod de/ shin tu blo che ba 'ga' zhig tshe dbang nas rgya chen dang lhun grub gnyis bor nas dang /rgya chen tsam bor nas dang / rgya chen nas lhun grub bor te 'tshang rgya ba'i thod rgal ba bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gi dka' ba'i gnas la dpyod pa'i sgo cung zad btod na/ 'di dang dus 'khor ba'i lugs gnyis la spyir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par che yang stong gzugs kyi phyag rgya la brten nas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba sgrub pa dang / des phung khams rags pa spyod tshul la dgongs pa mthun par rgyal ba g.yung sogs bzhed la/ de ltar kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'ang bzhed de/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje las/ sa dang sa yi yon tan rnams/ /rtsa rnams kyi ni skye 'bri las/ /rlung dang bde chen las 'dod de/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed 'phel dang 'grib/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phel 'grib/ /rnam bzhi'am gsum mam lnga 'khor lo/ /gnyis gnyis kyi ni gcig ma rdzogs/ /sa bcu thams cad ye ces sa/ /bzhi pas steng dang 'og tu grags/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas yid bzhin mdzod kyi/ /'khor lo bzhi yi rlung sems 113

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las rung tshe/ /lam bzhi'i yon tan rim bzhin 'char ba ste// /dbu ma'i rtsa mdud gnyis gnyis grol ba las/ /sa bcu'i yon tan nang nas 'char bar bzhed/ /ces pa rtsa 'grel du 'byung ba rnams 'gyur med kyi bde bas rags lus za tshul bshad pa rnams dang rags bshad zhib bshad kyi khyad par ma gtogs dgongs pa gcig ces mkhas grub gong ma 'gas gsungs so/ /de ltar byas na 'dir 'gyur te/ phyag rgya gcig spros su stong gzugs kyi sku thob nas de 'dra ba'i phyag rgya'i stobs kyis bde chen 'dren pa'i ched du tshogs spyod byed pa yin zhing / nam mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba skad cig dang po thob pa nas lus kyi bem po'i cha dag pa'i mgo rtsom pa yin pas rags lus dwangs mar song ba'i tshe dbang rig 'dzin du 'jog chog go/ /dbang rtul ni phyag rgya chen mo grub nas de la tshogs kyi spyod pas rjes chags brtsams kyang mchog bde 'dren mi nus pas 'phags lam thob kyang snyigs ma'i lus dag ma dag gnyis su byang bar 'dod dgos so/ /'di pas mi 'gyar hāX/ rmorngo/ )sgo rir byejerdo1dre/ /bye//ba ba ba —ba nas — la 'tshang rgya bas khyab kyang / tsho nga gzugs kyi sku mtshan nyid pa thob pa tsam la de 'dra'i nges pa med par bzhed de/ rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi bshad pas shes so/ /rnam smin pas bar dor rgya chen 'grub lugs ni/ de'i 'chi dus 114

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3kyi shin tu phra ba'i rlung de don gyi 'od gsal mtshan nyid pas lga/ser sbyangs ltar dag cing dri med kyi khams su sbyangs pa dang /sngar nas snying rje sgyu ma sogs kyis rmi lam dang srid pa bar do'i snang zhen sku dang ye shes su sbyangs stobs kyis thob pa'i stong gzugs kyi sku la gsal brtan rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel gyis 'od gsal las ldang ba na zung 'jug sgyu ma'i sku mtshan dpes brgyan par bzhengs pa la tshegs med par mngon te/ tshe dbang las rgya chen du 'phos tshe rags lus lha'i skur 'grub pa la'ang sgrub tshul zar pa med do/ /tshe dbang dang des thob pa'i rgya chen lta bar stong shā//phyo ri bcakazugs sku yang gsal brtan dag gsum phul du byung ba yod mod kyi/ stong gzugs mnyam bzhag kho na dang 'brel bas stong ga/zugs kyi rten la 'tshang rgya zhes mi bya'i/ bar dor rgya chen thob na sgyu lus kyi rten dang / tshe 'dir thob na rags lus dwangs mar gyur pa'i rten la 'tshang rgya zhes bya'o/ /sgom lam bar nas bor te mthong lam nas mi slob lam du 'gro ba'i lam thod rgal ba ni 'dir yang mi 'dod kyi/ phyag chen dang lhun grub bor te tshe dbang nas 'tshang rgya ba yod par bshad pa sogs ni rdo rje'i lus thams cad pa'i cha byad can sogs rig 'dzin gyi lus rten mi 'dra ba gsum gyi steng nas thod rgal brtsis te/ shin tu dbang rnon kha 115

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/cig 'gyur med kyi bde ba'i skad cig ma thams cad dkyus thog gcig la rdzogs pa lta bur 'dod dam gang yin dpyad par bya'o/ /zhar byung kun mkhyen chos rje'i bzhed pa'ang bstan par bya ste/rnam smin rig 'dzin ni sems yi dam gyi phyag rgyar smin pa'i mos spyod pa dang / tshe dbang mthong lam pa/ rgya chen tsam ni 'phags lam gyi rtogs pa dang por thob pa nas dang / khyad par bsgom lam pa/ lhun grub mi slob lam pa ste sems kyi rtogs pa la ltos nas bzhag pa dang / rnam smin gyi lus rten khyad par can sogs rig 'dzin gyi lus la ltos nas 'jog pa'i tshul gnyis te/ tshe rgya gnyis lus dwangs mar gyur pa dang / sems 'phags lam thob pa'i cha nas rim bzhin 'jog pas ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad du gsungs pa dang / gnyis pa tshe dbang / gsum pa phyag chen zhes pa mi 'gal tshul yang de'i steng nas go sla'o/ /rnam smin pa 'a/ 'dir chos mchog thob nas tshe dbang la sbyor ba dang / chos mchog ma thob par shi nas bar dor phyag chen gyi sku 'thob pa gnyis te/ snga mas rig 'dzin bzhi ka 'thob cing / phyi ma la gsum las mi 'thob bo/ /de ltar gnyis yod pa bzhin du de das gis thob pa'i mthong lam gnyis kyang khyad che bas/ nus pa thob dang ma thob pa'i/ /sogs kyi lung don yang gnas so/ /phyi ma 116

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3'dis thob pa'i mthong lam ni sems la ltos te rgya chen rig 'dzin du rung yang lus la ltos te rig 'dzin bzhi'i gang yang min no/ /chos mchog ma thob par shi na bar dor rgya chen 'grub pa'i rnam smin pa ni rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa cher byang ba dgos kyi/ bskyed rim brtan pa tsam min par sems te/ rnam smin rig 'dzin la mthong lam pa'i sgra sbyor ba'ang rdzogs rim gyi lhag mthong rnyed pa yan chad cig ltas gzhan la 'grigs dka' bas/ bskyed rim pa'i rnam smin 'jog na phal ba tsam du 'dod par bya'o/ /lam rim las/ /lus kyi rgya mdud grol gyur nas/ /phyag rgya'i sku nyid gsal gyur pa/ /rnam par smin zhes de la brjod/ /ces sogs bshad pa rnams kyis kyang rnam smin rig 'dzin shi nas bar dor phyag chen la sbyor ba zhig ston yang / rnam smin rig 'dzin yin na ma shi bar du phyag chen mi 'grub pas khyab ces bstan par mi bzhed do/ /tshe 'dir chos mchog thob ma thob ces pa ni tshogs spyod byas ma byas la rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa bzhed do/ /chos mchog nas tshe dbang rig 'dzin la sbyor tshal mi 'gyar ba'i rabye no༅bde ba'i steng nas 'gro ba kun mkhyen gyi bzhed par yang gnas pa ni sngar bshad zin la/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i ma mtha'i mtshams la mos spyod mthon po nas 'jog pa sogs bzhed pa mi 'dra ba 117

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yod kyang / bde ba de'i skad cig dang po thob pa dang 'phags lam gyi dang po brnyes pa dus mnyam pa'i phyogs de kun mkhyen gyi dgongs par gnas te/ de'i rgyu mtshan dang lugs 'di kho na bzhin du ma byas na lung rigs kyi gnod byed yod tshul sogs ma spros la/ nges don shing rta chen po sogs las 'gyur med kyi bde ba'i skad cig rnams kyis dhū ti'i rtsa mdud 'jig par bshad pa'i don ni rtsa mdud dang de 'jog tshul gzhan nas bshad pa dang mi 'dra bar rtsa 'od du dengs pa la byed de/ de'i tshul yang ma spros so//spyir sgyu 'phrul mkhan po snga rabs pa kha cig /rnam smin rig 'dzin lus 'di dang bral nas phyag chen rig 'dzin du ma slebs pa'i skad cig de la 'jog par 'dod/ /de la nye ston chos seng gis/ mi 'dor 'god pa gzhan gyi'o/ /zhes pa'i lung dang 'gal ba la sogs pa'i skyon brjod mdzad kyang / 'chi ba'i snga rol du mthong lam thob pa la rnam smin par 'jog pa rnams las 'di nyid zur lugs gzhir bzhag la'ang bzang bar sems te/ snga ma ltar na de 'dra'i rnam smin pa des slar mi 'gyar ba'i bde ba thob nas ༄rgya chen tshe 'dir 'grub pa'ang med par sgrub mi nus la/ de yod na ni rags lus 'di rgya chen du 'khyer ba med pas rnam smin dang des thob pa'i rgya chen sogs lhag med myang 'das dang / tshe 118

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3dbang dang des thob pa'i rgya chen sogs de las ldog pas lhag bcas myang 'das su zur lugs pa rang gis bshad pa dang 'gal zhing / stong gzugs ye shes kyi sku sngon nas grub cing don gyi 'od gsal thob nas nyon sgrib zad par spangs pa'i 'phags pa las kyis 'chi ba'i gzhan dbang du 'gro ba sogs kyang khas len bzang bar ma mthong la/ lugs phyi ma 'di ltar na/ sbyor lam tshogs sgrub pa la phyag rgya chen mo'i stobs kyis mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba grub nas mthong lam par 'gyur ba dang / de ma grub kyang 'chi ba'i stobs kyis 'thug po'i 'od gsal gnyis snang gi spros pas mi shigs pa thob ste mthong lam par 'gyur ba gnyis las snga mas thob pa'i mthong lam pa de tshe dbang dang / gnyis pa rnam smin rig 'dzin zhes bshad par 'gyur te/ de ltar byas tshe mthong lam pa phyi ma de rnam shes lu sa las bsdus zin pas lus dang bral ba zhes gong du smos pa ltar yin yang bar do la ma sleb bar du rnam smin gyi lus la gnas shing lus las phyir mthon pas rgya chen la sgrib pa'i snyigs ma'i lus dang ma bral ba zhes kyang brjod pa dang /sngar nas sems lha skur smin pa dang / gdon mi za bar bar do'i rten la rgya chen 'thob pa ste sngar smos pa'i chos gsum tshang bar ldan la/ zag pa gsum ma zad pa'i don ni lus rten snga ma'i 119

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'byung ba snyigs ma'i cha rnams ma dag par lus pa tsam la bya yi/da dung khams bde mi bde sogs dbang med du 'byung ba mi dgos te/ rnam smin rig 'dzin tshe 'dir thob par 'dod pa rnams kyi ltar na'ang / de skye gnas kyi zag pa ma zad kyang bar dor rgya chen du sbyor bar nges par dbang med du skye ba mi len pas khyab par bzhed pa bzhin no/ /'dis mthong lam brnyes kyang tha mal pa'i rnam smin gyi lus rgya'i sbubs las ma 'phags pas sgra bshad kyang mi 'jug go/ /ci ste rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi 'jog tshul de ltar byed na ni/ lam rim las/ lha yi rnal 'byor gsal rdzogs smin/ /lus kyi drwa bas bsgribs gyur pa/ /zhes lus kyis bsgribs par bshad pa dang 'gal te/ 'chi ba'i 'od gsal la gnas pa yin na phung khams rags pa'i drwa bas ma bsgribs par 'dod rigs pa'i phyir dang / dpag tshad gling khams yul la spyod/ /ces mngon shes kyi yul don bshad pas kyang gnod cing / smin pas phrin las rdzogs byed pas/ /mi 'dor 'god pa gzhan gyi'o/ /zhes phrin las bzhis gzhan don spyod pa mi 'dor bar bshad pa'ang 'gog rigs par thal lo zhe na/ mi skyon te/ dang po ni 'od gsal la bsgribs pa'i don min zhing phung po phra rags kyi 'brel ba gtan chad pa na gegs byas pa'i don dngos mi gnas 120

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3kyang rnam smin gyi lus snga ma las ma phyung bar du sgyu ma'i skur mngon du mi 'gyur ba la des sku de bsgribs par tha snyad byas pa yin par/yid kyis lha yi gzugs bzung zhing / /lus kyi rgya mdud grol gyur nas/ /phyag rgya'i sku nyid gsal gyur pa/ /zhes dang / rgya mig rgya sa ji lta bar/ /phyag rgya thob la ma rag pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyis shes shing / gnyis pa mngon shes kyi nus pa thob tshul tsam la sbyar bas chog pa dang / gsum pa sems lha'i skur smin pas gzhan phan phrin las kyi nus pa cher lhag pa'i sgo nas rnam smin pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes de zab gsal gnyis med dang srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis 'gog pa'i rnal 'byor du 'gro lugs ston pa tsam yin pa'i phyir te/ phyi ma 'di gnad shin tu che'o/ /'di lta bu'i tshul gyis bshad na zar lugs dang kun mkhyen ༄chos rje'i bzhed pa gnyis kyang rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi mtshan gzhi ngos 'dzin la mi mthun pa tsam dang / rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas kun mkhyen gyi dgongs pa blangs pa dang bsgrigs tshe phyag rgya gcig spros pas tshe 'dir tshe dbang rig 'dzin mi 'thob pa'i rgyu mtshan tshogs spyod ma byas pa dang / byas kyang dgos pa ma grub pa la bzhed pa'i khyad par yang yod de/ de tsam ma gtogs gnad kyi 'gangs gcig par snang la/ tshe 'dir mthong lam thob cing 121

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /bar dor rgya chen 'grub pa'i rnam smin rig 'dzin khas len pa ltar na gnad mi mthun pa'i khyad par chen po yod do/ /de la zur lugs pa rnams ni rig 'dzin bzhi po 'di mtshan nyid gsum las 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid du gsungs pas so skye'i sar bzhag tu mi btub par dgongs te rnam smin rig 'dzin yang 'phags lam pa kho nar 'jog gi gnyug sems lha'i skur rdzogs pa tsam gyis 'jog mi nus par bzhed la/ kun mkhyen ni rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub ces pa phal cher gtso bor lus kyi dngos grub khyad par can gyi steng nas 'jog pa rgyud sde gong 'og kun tu grags che zhing /sems lha skur smin pa zhes rdzogs rim gyi lha sku thob pa nas rnam smin gyi lus gnas ma gyur yang mchog gi dngos grub kyi phyogs su gtogs pa'i rig 'dzin gyi sku brnyes pa yin pas rig 'dzin bzhi'i dang por 'thad snyam du dgongs nas mos spyod kyi sar gnas dang rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi gzhi mthan zhal gyis bzhes pa ༄yin zhes bshad na so so'i lugs la nges pa phrig tsam rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /sems lha skur smin pa zhes pa'i sku 'dir res sems kyi phyogs dang / res lus kyi phyogs su bshad kyang 'gal ba med par shes par bya ste cung zad go sla'o/ /gsum pa gang du mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i rgyud ni/ gnas 122

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3lugs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi'i steng gi sbyang bya slo bur gyi dri ma rnams lam gyis bsal bas gzhi ji lta ba bzhin mngon du gyur pa mthar thug pa'i go 'phang ste/ khog gzhung las/ grub pa mthar phyin 'bras bur brjod/ /ces pa ltar bla na med pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba rnams kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pas na 'bras bu dang / nam yang rgyun mi 'chad pas na rgyud ces bshad do/ /theg chen pha rol du phyin pa'i sde snod nas kyang byang chub chen po'i 'bras bu rgyas par bstan mod de/ de dang sngags bla med nas bshad pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis smon lam dang tshogs gnyis spyod pas bsgrubs pa dang / rang bzhin gzhi rgyud kyi gnas tshod ji lta ba bzhin mngon du mdzad pa'i khyad che zhing / gsang sngags thun min gyi lam la ma brten par de'i thun min gyi 'bras bu 'grub pa mi 'thad pas mthar lam lhun grub rig 'dzin tsam la sangs rgyas su btags pa yin gyi/ sngags lam gyi sangs rgyas dngos ni de'i phyi nas 'thob dgos so zhes dpal ldan zur pa'i srol 'dzin chen po rnams bzhed la/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po yang mdo phyogs nas bshad pa'i sangs rgyas dang rgyud 'di'i lhun grub rig 'dzin gcig par bzhed kyang / lhun grub mthar thug gi sa la mdzad pas dgongs pa mi gcig ste/ lugs phyi ma ltar na/ chos thams 123

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par byang chub pa'i sangs rgyas mdo phyogs nas kyang shin tu rgya cher gsungs la/ de ltar mngon par byang chub pa ni glo bur ba'i sems kyis bsgrub gzhi byas pa la mi srid pas bla med kyi lam la nges par brten dgos te/ de'i phyir theg pa gnyis kyi thob bya'i sangs rgyas gcig yin kyang mdo lam rkyang bas 'thob mi nus zhes pa ste/ yi ges 'jigs pas rgya ma bskyed do/ /'bras bu'i chos la dbye na/ spyir grags pa'i stobs bcu mi 'jigs sogs dang / bla med kho na la grags pa'i kha sbyor yan lag bdun sogs mang du yod kyang rgyud gzhung 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na 'bras chos nyer lnga ste/ dang po sku lnga ni/ dbyings la rig pa phyogs med du grol ba chos sku dang / de las ma g.yos bzhin du byang sems 'phags pa rnams la theg pa mchog gi chos kyi longs spyod rdzogs par ston pa longs sku/ gdul bya dag ma dag than mong gi snang ngor bzo dang skye ba mchog gi gzags su ston pa nodangami 11she/ //rngo| //bye/ riring sprul sku/ gsum dbyer phyed pa rdo rje sku/ sku gsum snang cha ma 'dres pa mngon byang gi sku'o/ /gsung lnga ni/ bsam brjod dang bral ba'i dbyings la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes nyid brjod pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa'i cha nas chos sku skye 124

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3med don gyi gsung / mthong ba tsam gyis 'khor rnams gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la 'jug pa'i cha nas longs sku'i sku de dgongs pa brda'i gsung / skad cig rer yang gdul bya so so'i skad du chos tshad med pa ston pa sprul sku brjod pa tshig gi gsung / ci tsam gsung yang gzhom med ye shes kyi rang sgra las gzhan du mi 'gyar ba dbyer med rdo rje'i gsang / ye shes gcig risi mi rig ༅nyid sgra dbyangs kyi rnam pa thams cad du 'char ba mngon byang rig pa byin rlabs kyi gsung ste phyi ma gnyis po'i khyad ni/ du ma gcig tu 'du ba dang / gcig nyid du mar 'char ba'i ldog cha nas so/ /dgongs rgyud kho na la sbyar na sngar sngon byung dngos lnga'i thad du bshad pa ltar yang rung mod de/ le'u bdun pa rtsa 'grel gyi dngos bstan ni bshad ma thag pa nyid do/ /thugs lnga ni/ chos dbyings ye shes chos sku rnam par mi rtog pa'i thugs/ mnyam nyid ye shes longs sku mnyam pa chen po'i thugs/ bya grub ye shes sprul sku 'gro ba 'dul ba'i thugs/ sor rtog ye shes mi phyed rdo rje'i thugs/ me long ye shes mngon byang cir yang gsal ba'i thugs so/ /yon tan lnga ni/ rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams/ rgya tshad bral ba'i gzhal yas khang / gsal zhing dag pa'i 'od zer/ khyad par 'phags pa'i gdan khri/ dgyes dgur spyod pa'i longs spyod rnams 125

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/so/ /phrin las lnga ni/ tshe 'di phyi'i sdug bsngal rgyur bcas zhi ba dang / legs tshogs rgyas pa dang / sa gsum gyi gdul bya dbang du mdzad pa dang / shin tu gdul dka' rnams drag pos tshad bcad pa dang / de dag thams cad dus dang gdul ba'i dbang bzhin rtsol med du 'byung ba lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las so/ /rten sku/ brten pa ye shes/ mdzad pa phrin las kyi rnam bzhag rnams kyang de dag tu 'dus so/ /don gnyis pa lam gyi cha rkyen rgyud kyi dngos po bcu bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang chen rgyud sde'i rnam grangs ji snyed cig bstan pa thams cad ston pa rang nyid lam gang nas gshegs pa de nyid nas gdu la bya mchog rnams 'khrid pa'i ched kho na yin pas rgyud kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo lam rgyud yin la/de nyid lam gyi khog dbab tshal spyir bstan pa dang / de'i cha rkyen ༄ ༄du dgos pa'i rgyud don gyi dngos po bye brag tu phye nas bstan pa gnyis kyis gsal bar bshad pa las/ dang po thabs grol gyi lam sngar brjod pa rnams yin zhing / phyi ma la'ang / dkyil 'khor/sgrub pa/ dbang / dam tshig phrin las te gzhi lnga dang / sngags/phyag rgya/ ting 'dzin/ mchod pa dang yan lag bzhi ste shes bya'am mkhas bya'i rgyud don gyi dngos po dgur lo tsā ba chen po rong zom 126

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3gsungs la/ spar khab las gzhi lnga po de'i steng du lta spyod gnyis bsnan nas dngos po bdun du bshad kyang / 'dir de kho na nyid lta ba/ la dor ba spyod pa/ bkod pa dkyil 'khor/ rim par bgrod pa dbang / mi 'da' ba dam tshig rol pa phrin las/ don du gnyer ba sgrub pa/ mi g.yo ba ting nge 'dzin/ gnas sa stobs ༄pa mchod pa/ 'ching zlos sngags dang phyag rgya ste bcur 'chad par mdzad de/ de'ang lam gyi khog sngar bshad pa de la dbang dang dam tshig sogs kha bskang nas dang / ting nge 'dzin dang spyod pa sogs gsal bar phye ba'i tshul gyis 'chad par shes par bya'o/ /'di dag la nyams su len byed lam gyi rim pa bshad pa dang /blang bya rgyud kyi dngos po bshad pa zhes kyang 'byung ngo / /de la dang po ni/ sgyu phrul drwa ba'i lam gong 'og thams cad la lta ba khyab byed du 'jug pas lam gyi rim pa la ltos nas lta ba'i grangs dgur dbye ste/ lam rim las/ mnyam nyid ngang la mi skrag pas/ /mngon byas nges pa'i shes rab dang / /rnam pa kun ldan stong chen mthong / rang rig ye shes snying rjes gzigs/ /phyag rgya gcig sku 'bras bur blta/ /thams cad gsal ba'i lta ba dang / /bar chad med pa'i tshogs chen mthong / /dbang bsgyur mnyam nyid mi g.yo ba//ye shes kun mkhyen lta ba dgu/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang rgyud kyi 1 27

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dngos po rnams la lta ba khyab byed dam zin byed du 'jug pa la ltos nas lta ba'i grangs dgu dang / tshogs drug gi spyod yul thams cad lta ba'i rgyas 'debs pa la ltos nas drug dang /dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i rtogs tshul la ltos nas gsum du dbye ba sogs yod cing / gtan la 'beb tshul rgyas par sngar bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir spyod pa la mnyam rjes gnyis ka yod kyang 'dir spyi ming phyogs gcig la btags nas mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa'i grogs sa gyar pa'i sgo gsam gyi spyod pa rjes thob kyis ra mer༅ ra༄mibasdus pa gtso bor gyur pa ste/ de la spyibyudang / khyad par gnyis/dang po ni/ las dang po pa'i dus su dge sbyong gzhon nu ltar bag dang ldan par spyod pa zhes lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad sogs las byol ba dang / mthun rkyen/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /don sems pa dang sgom pa ste/ /spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid ni/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med//ces pa'i chos spyod bcu la mang du gnas pa dang / de nas cung zad goms pa na rtogs pa rkyen thub tu rtsal sbyong ba ro snyom smyon pa'i brtul zhugs dang / shin tu goms nas rkyen bzang ngan gang 128

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3gis kyang rtogs pa bri gang med pa na rang babs su gzhan phan byed pa rgyal po sa 'dzin gyi spyod pa lta bu ste spyir bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ grol lam bag yod dang / thabs lam brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa gnyis/ dang po la rim gyis pa dang cig char ba'i spyod pa gnyis/ dang po la'ang bdun te dang po dad brtson gyi spyod pa zhes shes pa'i mtshan nyid tshol dus kyi spyod pa/ 'di la gzhi dam tshig gis bzung ba/ rgyud thos pas dgrol ba/ sgo kun nas bsdur ba/ phul du mkhas pas dbyung ba/ thag lta bas bcad pa/ nyams su ting nge 'dzin gyis blang ba/ la spyod pas dor ba/ rim pa dbang gis bgrod pa/ don man ngag gis sgrub pa/ mdo don gcig tu bsdu ba la bslab pa ste bslab pa'i mtha' bcu'o/ /de'ang lta ba thog mar 'tshol dus nas lam yongs rdzogs dmigs 'og tu bcug nas skabs don la gtso bor byed pa yin pas de ltar gsungs kyi/ skabs don gtso bo'i dbang du btang na rgyud thos pas dgrol ba sog/sa bzhi po nyid do/ /gnyis pa shes rab dang mthan pa zhes stong chen gyi dus su than mtshams kyi bya ba dmi me nodang thams cad mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyi rtsal sbyong du 'khyer ba dang /gsum pa thabs dang mthun pa zhes snying rje sgyu ma'i skabs su snang spyod ye shes sgyu ma'i yo lang du blta ba dang / bzhi pa phyag rgya 129

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gcig pa'i dus su phyogs gcig pa dang / /lnga pa spros bcas kyi tshe spros bcas kyi spyod pa zhes mnyam bzhag tu gang bsgom gyi lha'i ting nge 'dzin des snang ba thams cad la rgyas btab ste log rtog 'khrul pa'i snang ba zil gyis gnon pa dang / drug pa tshogs kyi spyod pa zhes tshogs sgrub kyi dus dag mnyam bde ba chen po'i rna'/ 'byor khor yug tu skyong ba dang / bdun pa zag med rig 'dzin thob nas rdzu 'phral gyi spyod pa zhes nus mthu thogs pa med pa'i phrin /spri) rirab 1(1 /chen /rdo| /jenge /re) rterdor+shalas —sa gzhan don rlabs d+nghad sneng rang rgyud — tsho gas pa gong du spor ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rjes thob tu yang snang sems gang shar thams cad la brten nas lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med kyi dgongs pa'i rtsal phyogs med du sbyong ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni /skrag pa dang dogs pa dang ngo tsha ba la sogs pa'i rnam rtog thams cad bshig nas sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang bud med la sogs pa'i yul thamyo/sa cad la bde ba chen po'i man ngag gi gdeng dang ldan pas ci dgar longs spyod pa'o/ /phyi ma 'dir yul gang la spyod kyang rang bzhin dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin las skad cig kyang mi g.yo ba gnad du bzung dgos pas bla na med pa'i bag yod kyi spyod pa yin yang chags yul dang skyug bro ba'i gnas sogs gang la'ang 'dzem pa spangs pa 'di lta bu grol lam gyi dus su rtsal 130

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3'don mi byed pas brtul zhugs kyi dang bag yod kyi spyod pa zhes so sor sbyar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ bkod pa lha'i 'khor lo rdzogs par snang ba la bshad de thugs thig las so/ /de la chos don las rang bzhin dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor gsum dang / rgyud phyi ma las sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gsum dang / 'grel chung las dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis su bshad pa sogs yod kyang brgyud pa'i bka' srol du rgyas pa las/'dis ni rang bzhin dkyil 'khor dang / /gzugs brnyan lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan gsum/ /ting 'dzin lhag pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /byang chub sems dang tshogs mchog bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dkyil 'khor bdun du 'chad par mdzad de/ /de la dang po rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /khog gzhung las gsum du gsungs te/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ye nas rnam par dag pa'i dbyings rang bzhin nyid kyi dang / rtog tshogs thams cad kyi snang gzhi ye nas lha'i dkyil 'khor du gnas pa rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dang / rtogs pa mngon du gyur te 'og min du sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa rang bzhin 'bras bu mthar phyin gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /gnyis pa gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ don dam pa'i gzugs brnyan kun rdzob lha'i dkyil 131

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'khor rtog pa phra rags kyi rnam par shar ba'o/ /gsum pa lhag pa gzugs brnyan ni/ dgos pa la ltos nas dbang gi dang / rab gnas kyi dang / sgrub pa'i dang / phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor dang bzhi ste gang yang rdul tshon sogs las dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs su bzhengs pa'o/ /de'ang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i las rim mang pos lhag pas na lhag pa gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /las rim ni/ rdo rje las rim las/ sa gzhi mnyam dang tshad thig dang / /tshon dang bri dang rnam pa dang / /rab gnas sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor du/ /'jug dang zhugs pa'i yon tan no/ /zhes pa ltar/ sa brtag bslang / dbang du bya ba/ sbyang ba/ byin gyis rlob pa/ srung ba/ sa gzung ba dang bdun sa gzhi mnyam pa zhes gcig tu bgrang ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang byed kyi tshad nges pa can du bya ba dang / thig gi rgyu/ grogs/ tshad/grangs/ rab gnas/ gdab thabs/ nyes spang dang bdun la thig chog ces gcig tu byas pa dang / rgyu/ grangs/ rab gnas/'gyed lugs/ nyes spang ste tshon gyi cho ga lnga dang/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang rung du 'bri ba dang lha'i mtshan ma sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan ci rigs kyi rnam pa dgod pa dang /bum pa dang slob ma dkyil 'khor gsum rab tu gnas pa dang /132

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3d+ku'achad par 'gyur ba'i sbyin sreg dang / bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing slob ma gzhug pa dang / zhugs pa'i yon tan rnams te/ de dag kyang slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i ched du yin na lam mos sgom gyi tshul gyis grangs dus mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa gang rung rdzogs pa dang / tshogs sgrub kyi ched yin na nges rdzogs kyi spros bcas man chad brtan pa'i slob dpon gyis bya ba yin no/ /bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ dngos snang thams cad mi dmigs pa'i dbyings su bsdus te rig pa ma bcos pa'i ngang la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /lnga pa lhag pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ mtshan bcas lha sku sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/ bskyed chog gi bya ba mang pos lhag pas lhag pa zhes bya'o/ /de la'ang /thugs rje zhi ba'i dang / bdud 'dul khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin gnyis yod/ 'di dag gi las rim yang zur tsam brjod na/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gral tshul gyi phyag dang / rgyud sbyang ba/ mtshams bcad pa/bshags pa bya ba/ dam bca' ba/ byin dbab pa/ mchod pa byin brlab ste las bdun no/ /gnyis pa ni/ khyad par gyi sems bskyed pas mtshams sbyar nas bskyed chog dngos la 'jug ste/'di ni lhag ting gi sgom don gtso bo yin pas cung zad bshad 133

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/par bya ste/ de la gsum/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ las rim gyi ting nge 'dzin no/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin nyid stong pa chen po dang / kun snang snying rje sgyu ma dang / rgyu'i ting 'dzin rtsa ba'i a dang de las a sogs yi ge phra mo'i spro bsdu la dmigs pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa la rten dang / brten pa sgom pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang / gzhal yas khang dang / gdan bskyed pa rnams te sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /gnyis pa la/ dang por bskyed tshul/ bskyed pa'i lha'i rnam pa/dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab pa'o/ dang po ni/ spyir lugs gsum las rgyud 'grel nyi seng ma ltar na/ thog mar sems bskyed de/ yud tsam gyis kun tu bzang por bsgoms nas 'og gi phyogs su ye shes kyi sa gzhi nas bzung gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed/ de las nyi zla'i gdan la sems skyil gyis 'dug par mos la byang chab kyi sems ye shes sa bskyed pa'i don gyi stong nyid ye rig mi dmi phoshes/ de'i ngang las rang sems a'i ngo bor bsgoms nas spro bsdus a las zla ba la mtshan gyi sa bon a li nyis 'gyur dang /ā ring las nyi ma la dpe byad kyi sa bon ka li nyis rim du 'god pa me long ye shes/ de dag 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu 'dril ba mnyam nyid ye shes/ 'od kyi gong bu de las hūṃ du gyur nas de'i rgyu 134ji

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3mthun pa'i 'bras bu rdo rjer byin gyis rlob pa sor rtog ye shes/de yongs su gyur pa las kun tu bzang po'i skur bskyed pa bya grub ye shes te cho ga lnga'o/ /de nas yum bskyed de byang chub sems sprin las lha so so'i sku bskyed pa rang rang gi sngags kyis phyir phyung nas dkyil 'khor du 'god par mdzad do/ /bi ma la'i lha sku sgom pa'i man ngag ltar na gong du bshad pa'i rgyu'i yi ge las yi ge zhe gnyis spros te so so'i don la bkod nas rgyu'i a nyid de rnams la bsngim zhing spro bsdu bya ba yig 'bru'i cho ga yi ge rnams zhu ba rdo rje dang 'khor lo sogs phyag mtshan zhe gnyis su gyur pa las spro bsdu bya ba phyag mtshan gyi cho ga phyag mtshan rnams yongs su gyur pa las dang so so'i bskyed sngags brjod pa las rgyal ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi skur bskyed pa sku rdzogs pa'i cho ga ste rdo rje gsum gyi cho gas bskyed pa da lta'i phyag bzhes su ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin no/ /drwa ba che chung gi lugs ni srasabyuganyis kyi cho gas bskyed pa ste/ de la bdag sras ni cho ga gsum gyis lha zhe gnyis bskyed pa'o/ /gzhan sras ni/gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bdag nyid 'khor ba'i lus 'dzin pa zhig shar sgor thon nas gsol ba btab pas lha rnams kyi sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi 'od zer 'phros te bdag gi lus rtog sbyangs pas 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa la slar yang rdo rje gsum gyi 135

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'od zer bstims pas ye ge gsum dang de yang hūṃ du bsgyur/ de nyid zla ba'i steng du bzhag pa rlung dkyil gyis btegs nas lha tshogs rnams la bskor ba lan gsum byas te gtso bo'i thugs kar thim/ yab yum rol pa'i rjes chags kyis byang sems su zhu ba sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum mkhar babs pa'i rkyen gyis gtso bo yab yum 'od du zhu/ 'a khor rnams kyang bde ba chen por zhu ste dbas kyi thig ler thim pas 'od kyi gong ba gcig tu gyar/ de rig mi nini me rig minyid kyang hūṃ s+t+waṃ du gyur pa las cho ga gsum gyis rdor sems yab yum bskyed/ snyoms par zhugs nas yum mkhar spro ba gsum gyi dang pos thig gdab/ gnyis pas gzhal yas khang gdan bcas su rlob/ gsum pas sa bon gyi yi ge bskyed cing de dag rang rang gi sngags kyis lhar bskyed nas mdun mkhar bton/ yi ge gsum gyis sku brtas par bya/ spro bsdus sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrub ste mi bskyod pa gtso bo la bstim/ gzhan rnams rang rang gi gnas su dgod par bya'o/ /'di ltar bskyed pa'i khungs ni/ rgya mtsho las/ rang byung dngos dang mi 'gal zhing / /'bras bu nyid la lam shes pas/ /ma lus dkyil 'khor thig le rnams/ /bdag gi sras su bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / /gang gis gang la gsol btab pas/ /thugs rjes byin brlabs sbyangs byas nas/ /thugs/ 136

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3zhugs 'dres nas dbyer med pa/ /sras gyur dgongs pa gcig la gnas/ zhes dang / lam dang 'bras bu'i khyad par las/ /rtog pa'i ye shes 'od las byung / /byin rlabs 'bras bu dngos 'brel bas/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sras tshogs bsgom/ zhes so/ /de'ang bdag sngon gyi sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir bdag gi sras su de bzhi na gshegs pa bya ba dang / rigs mi nub cing lhun gyis grub par bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras su bdag bya ba zhes chen po rnams gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /de'i don yang sems kyi gnyug ma'i gnas tshul ni sangs rgyas yin la/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gang bsgom kyang de nyid gzhir bzung ste sgom pa las ma 'das shing / de ltar bsgoms pas gnyug ma las gnyis med gnyis ltar snang ba'i glo bur gyi phung po'i cha rnams sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du bstims nas slar shin tu rnam dag gi phung khams kyi cha las mi bskyod pa sogs rgyal ba sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rang 'char ba ni lam rim pa gnyis ka'i khog sdom yin la/ de ltar 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas lam du gang byed gzhir gnas gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kyi gdung rigs las bskyed dgos pa dang / dri bcas gnas lugs kyi gzhi de 'bras bu lam byed kyi gdung sras su bzung bas byang chub kyi 'bras 137

pong/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bu 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di'i phyir bdag gi sras su sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi sras su bdag byed pa yin te rgya mtsho'i lung don yang 'dis shes so/ /dam pa rgyan las sras gnyis kyi cho ga khro bo'i bskyed chog tu sbyar nas bshad pa'ang khog 'di nyid yin te yi ges 'jigs nas ma bkod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ bzhugs tshul/ lha gnas/ phyag mtshan/ sku mdog zhi tshul/ 'od zer sogs te le'u drug pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ byin rlabs dang dbang bskur gyi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin le'u bdun pa rtsa 'grel las 'byang ba bzhin no/ /gsam pa la'ang / ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan riring rig midrang zhing bstims nas mchod pa 'bul ba dang / bshags pa bya ba dang / dngos grub gsol ba/ dam bca' ba/ dzab bzla ba ste lnga'o/ /gsam pa rjes rim la'ang / tshogs kyi mchod sbyin/ brtan ma ༄skyong ba/ bsdu ldang / go bgo lus bsrung / spyod lam rgyud gyi rnal 'byor dang lnga'o/ /rje rong zom ni/ snang srid thams cad gdod nas dag pa lha'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la spyir dmigs nas sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dang / rang gis mngon par 'dod pa'i dkyil 'khor gang yin la bye brag tu dmigs nas sgom pa lhag ting gi dkyil 'khor du bzhed de/ 'dis ni lhag pa zhes pa gtso bor 138

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3ram khyad par du zhes pa'i steng nas 'chad par mngon no/ /drug pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ rtsa rlung thig le ste/ rdo rje'i lus la rtsa dbu rkyang ro gsum dang / dbu ma las gyes pa'i spyi bo bde chen/ mgrin pa longs spyod/ snying ga chos/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rnams dang / lte 'og me dang / gshang kha rlung gi 'khor lo rnams dang / rlung rtsa ba lnga dang / yan lag gi rlung lnga dang / de dag gi 'pho ba bcu drug la sogs pa'i rnam bzhag sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho dang / gsang ba'i snying po khro bo stobs kyi rgyud dang /dbang gi galpo la sogs pa las gsungs par bshad la/ rgyud 'di'i sgos chos su che long tsam 'byang ba ni/ snying ga'i 'khor ///nye rig ///nye ///nyelor chos nyid d+ngha rtsa gsum/ ye shes d+ngha rtsa gcig /rang rgyud — rtsa gsum/ yon tan gyi rtsa gcig rnams 'od bzhi dbyibs bzhir bcas pa dang / de dag gi dbus na dwangs ma lnga'i thig le dang /lte ba dang / mgrin par gtum mo dang / spyi bo na bdud rtsi'i thig le/ dbyings phyug lnga'i thig le sogs kyi ming can yod tshul thal rgyud dang dbang gi gaspo dang gsang thig sogs las gsungs pa rnams so/ /bdun pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ khog gzhung las/skal ldan mi'i/ 'byor ldan yo byad kyi/ dgyes ldan lha'i tshogs gsum tshig zin dang / sogs sgras bstan pa tshogs chen po ste 139

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhir bshad do/ /dang po ni/ rnal 'byor mchog dang ldan pa'i skye bo pho mo tshogs shing 'dus pa ste/ bshad rgyud rdo rje las/ skye bo mdza' ba kun tshogs pa/ /rnal 'byor 'dus pa'i tshogs zhes bya/zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ khyad par gyi yo byad lnga la sogs pa tshogs pa ste/ de nyid las/ rnal 'byor yo byad tshang bas ni/ /bde ba longs spyod tshogs su bshad/ /ces so/ /gsum pa ni/ de las/lha dang dam can kun 'dus pa/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs su bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ tshogs 'di dngos ni ye shes lha'i dkyil 'khor sprul pa phyag brnyan dang bcas pa yin la/ btags pa ba dngos grub kyi rten du de dag gi gzugs brnyan bkod pa dang / sems kyis brtags nas bsgom pa'ang yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/bdag dang tshogs kyi longs spyod thams cad ye shes kyi rol par shes nas spyad pas bsod nams dang / spyod bzhin du mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pas ye shes kyi tshogs gong nas gong du rdzogs pa ste/ de nyid las/ thams cad spyod la mi 'dzin pa/ /tshogs gnyis rgyun du rdzogs byed pas/ /tshogs chen por ni nges par bshad/ /ces so/ /tshogs dkyil zhes pa'i tshogs kyi rnam grangs de ltar yod kyang tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dngos ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang par rten gyi dkyil 'khor tshal bzhin du bris te/༄140

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3der lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshogs sgrub kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams lha'i chas su zhugs te gtso bo'i lha gnas su rdo rje slob dpon yab yum dang 'khor gyi lha gnas su 'khor gyi rnal 'byor pho mo brang sprad du 'dug pa'am 'dug par mos pa gang rung la bya ste/ de la'ang rnal 'byor pa so sos lha so sor nga rgyal bzhag nas sgrub pa dang / rnal 'byor pa re re zhing gtso bo'i nga rgyal la gnas te sgrub pa'i tshul gnyis yod par gsungs so/ /de la rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor dang po gnyis ni lhag pa don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyi ma gcig ni de bsgrubs gzhi mthar thug tu bzung ste 'bra sa bu lam byed kyi dmigs pa yin la/ gzugs brnyan ni lhag pa kun rdzob kyi dkyil 'khor dang / lhag pa gzugs brnyan ni gang du zhugs na kun rdzob ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor der zhugs par 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / ting nge 'dzin ni stong phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa'i rnal 'byor dang / lhag ting ni snang phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa'i rnal 'byor dang / byang sems ni rang bzhin ma bcos pa'i dkyil 'khor la dngos sa ༄'jug pa'i phyir gnad du bsnun pa'i yul dang / tshogs dkyil ni dngos grub mchog gi don du sgrub pa po ya gyal nyung ngu'i nus pa la mang po tshogs pa'i nus pas stongs gdab pa'am gtso bor bde 1stu11

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/chen gyi kun spyod gcig pa'i grogs mang po la brten nas ye shes phyogs med du rgyas par byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa dbang ni/ thugs thig las/ rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhis yan lag bsnyad/ /drug la gnas pa'i thob bya de/ /ngo bo nyid ces rnam par bshad/ /ces pas/ rgyu gnyis dang rkyen bzhi tshogs pa la brten nas go 'phang gi chos rgyud la 'jog pa'i las kyis ye shes dngos sa skyes pa'am skye nges kyi nus pa ci rigs thob pa'o/ /༄ de la dbye na/ rtsa rgyud du phan nus zab mo'i dbang gsum gsungs pa bshad rgyud rdo rje las lngar phye nas gsungs te/ dang po sa bon 'jog pa ste/ /gnyis pa nus pa skyed pa yin/ /gsum pa nyams myong skyed pa'o/ /bzhi pas de nyid brtan par byed/ /lnga pas brtan pa nyams lon pas/ /mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir 'grub/ /ces so/ /rgyud phyi ma las/ slob dpon gsang ba shes rab dang / /de ma thag pa bzhi pa ste/ /zhes phan nus gnyis slob dpon gyi dbang zhes gcig tu bgrangs nas bzhir gsungs te/ slob dpon gyi dbang gtso bo dang gzhan rnams de'i 'khor yin pa la dgongs nas so/ /de la phan dbang ni bcu ste/ snying po lnga dang dbubyurgyan dang / /bum pa cod pan phreng ba dang / /go cha rgyal mtshan 142

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3gdugs phyag rgya/ /bza' btung dbang rnams rim bzhin bskur/ /zhes brgyud kyi dngos bstan zhi ba'i phan dbang yin la/ khro bo la ni/ gdan dang lha dbang phyag mtshan dang / /chas bcu sgrub rdzas bco lnga ste/ /zhes nyer brgyad du bshad do/ /phan dbang bcu po de dag phal cher 'jig rten na rgyal po chen po'i bu rgyal sar dbang bskur ba na steng du gdugs dang g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan bsgreng / bum chus spyi bo nas blugs dbu rgyan dang cod pan sogs byin nas byed pa dang tshul mthun par bzhag pa dper na dus 'khor nas byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun zhes gsungs pa lta bur mngon nam snyam yang snga ma rnams kyis bshad pa ma mthong bas kha tshon mi chod do/ /nus dbang ni/ nyan sgom gnyis/ 'chad phrin gnyis/ rdo rje rgyal po'i dbang dang lnga ste/ phyi ma gsum po 'di las gzhan rnams slob dpon gyi dbang ma yin yang dbang bzhi'i ya gyal gyi slob dpon dbang yin par brjod zin la/ gsum po'i yang rdo rje rgyal po'i dbang gtso bo dang 'chad phrin de'i 'khor du bshad de/ des na rdo rje rgyal po'i dbang gi 'khor la slob dpon gyi dbang yin min gnyis yod do/ /zab dbang gsum ni gsang sher tshig dbang gsum ste/ sher dbang la 'dir ye shes rang gnas dang / dbang bzhi pa la 143

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbyer med bde ba chen po'i dbang zhes kyang gsungs so/ /dbang de dag thams cad la rgyu gnyis dang rkyen bzhi re yod pa'i dang po rgyu gnyis las/ mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu ni/ slob bu'i rgyud la dang po nas dbang so so'i rjes su mthun pa'i chos re yod pa de yin te/phan dbang dang sbyar na/ gong du smos pa'i go rim ltar nang gi bdud rtsi lnga dang / rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang / rtsa gnas thig les gang ba dang / rtsa ro rkyang gnyis dang / dhū ti'i nang na thig le so gnyis gnas pa dang / lus rtsa'i drwa bas khebs pa dang / pho mo'i dbang po dang / spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor dang / rtog tshogs lha'i ngo bor gnas pa dang / longs spyod 'khor lo'i thig le rnams su thal ba las gsungs shing / nus dbang gi mtshungs ldan ni rim bzhin/ rna ba'i 'dom rtsa'i sgra nyan byed kyi thig le dang / snying ga'i dran byed kyi dang / lag pa'i skyod byed kyi dang / lce'i smra byed kyi dang / yan lag lnga'i skyod byed reg shes kyi thig le rnams dang /zab dbang gsum gyi ni/ snying ka gtso bor gyur pa'i lus gnas bde ba'i rten gyi thig le dang / 'od gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang / bden pa dbyer med kyi ye shes gdod nas rang chas su bzhugs pa rnams go rim bzhin no/ /lhan cig byed pa'i rgyu ni/dbang rdzas rab gnas dang ldan pa ste/ dbu rgyan dang phreng ba 144

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3rin 'byung gi/ cod pan mtha' yas dang rdor sems kyi/ go cha don grub kyi/ rgyal mtshan dang gdugs mi bskyod pa'i/ phyag rgya ni kun mkhyen chen po'i rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan la bzhed kyang 'dir dkyil 'khor ba'i sku gzugs te lha rang rang gi/ bum chu rigs lnga ka'am/ bza' btung rnam snang gi/ snying po lnga ni kun mkhyen bdud rtsi lnga la bzhed kyang 'dir rigs lnga'i sa bon te gang ltar yang rigs lnga so sor rab gnas can no/ /de dag kyang sngon rab gnas byas pa tsam gyis mi chog gi/ dus der gang la dbang bskur ba de'i ched du rab gnas byas pa dgos so/ /dbang rdzas gang du 'god pa'i mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor yang lhan cig byed rgyur 'jog pa'am yang na bdag rkyen gyi phyogs su bzhag par bya ste brtag go/ /de bzhin du nus dbang gi dbang rdzas kyang / glegs bam rin 'byung gi dang / phreng ba yi dam gang yin gyi dang / rgya gram don grub kyi dang / 'khor lo dung sogs mtha' yas kyi dang / rdor dril rigs lnga spyi 'dus kyi rab gnas can rnams dang /gsang dbang la rdo rje slob dpon gyi lhan skyes kyi bde bas lhag par gnas pa'i bdud rtsi dang / gong ma gnyis la byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyag rgya ma'o/ /rkyen bzhi'i dang po rgya'i rkyen ni khog gzhung las/ dad dang riphyo145

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brtson 'grus gsum ldan dang / /brtul zhugs gsum ldan slob ma la/ /zhes pa ltar dbang gi snod du rung ba'i slob ma ste/ phan dbang gi snod dad pa can dang / nus dbang las nyan sgom gyi snod bdag don nus pa'i dang / 'chad phrin gyi gzhan don nus pa'i dang / rdo rje rgyal po'i gnyis ka'i don nus pa'i brtson 'grus can gsum dang / gsang dbang gi spyod pa'i dang / sher dbang gi rig pa'i dang / dbang bzhi pa'i snod mnyam pa'i brtul zhags can te gsum rnams so/ /'dir bstan dad pa can ni sngags kyi theg pa la yid ches pa ste/ de'i rten du tshe 'di'am snga mar theg chen spyi'i lam la blo sbyang ba'ang dgos so/ /nus dbang gi snod la de'i steng du rgyud nyan sgom sogs la dngos su 'jug pa'i brtson 'grus sam spro shugs lhag pa dang / zab dbang la de gnyis ka'i steng du brtul zhugs gsum dang yang ldan pa snod du dgos zhes pa yin gyi/ phan dbang ma gtogs pa'i snod la dad pa can gyi dgos pa sogs min no/ /brtul zhugs gsum ni rim bzhin/ bde ba chen po'i lam la mos pa brtan pas bdud rtsi lnga la gtsang dme'i rtog pa zil gyis mnan nas dngos su spyod nus pa dang / chags rtog rang dga' ba zil gyis mnan nas rig ma'i bde ba lam du byed nus pa dang / de'i sgo nas bden gnyis 146

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3dbyer med mnyam pa chen po'i don la dngos su 'jug nus pa ste gsum la byed ces gsungs te/ gtso bor dngos dbang gi snod la dgongs so/ /gnyis pa bdag po'i rkyen ni/ le'u dgu par/ shin tu phra ba'i dam tshig mchog /ces pa'i skabs ltar bsnyen pa tshad du 'khyol ba sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon te de las gzhan gyis dbang skur lo byas kyang slob ma'i rgyud smin mi nus shing bdag nyid rnam par sun 'byin par gsungs so/ /gsum pa dmigs rkyen ni/ dbang rdzas dang sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gsum tshogs pa'i nus pa khyad par can te/ de la ting nge 'dzin ni/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i gnas lngar snying po lnga bkod pa rigs lngar bskyed de byin gyis brlabs pas khams lnga rigs lngar dag par dang / dbu rgyan gyis tshogs brgyad ye shes lngar dag par dang / bum pas rigs lnga'i chu rgyun gyis nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dag nas ye shes lnga'i dbang thob par dang /cod pan gyis yon tan rdzogs shing gdug pa 'dul ba dang / /phreng bas gzungs ting sogs 'bras chos rdzogs pa dang / go chas rgol bas mi tshugs par dang / rgyal mtshan gyis log lta can zil gyis gnon par dang / gdugs kyis nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung las skyob par dang / phyag rgyas rtog pa lha'i ngo bor dag pa dang /147

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bza' btung gis 'dod yon ye shes su rol pa'i mthu thob par bsam pa rnams phan dbang gi dgongs pa yin la/ der ma zad dkyil 'khor pa'i lha rnams kyang de ltar dgongs pa mdzad par dmigs dgos te/ phan dbang lhag pa gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor las thob par bshad pa'i go don yang de'i steng nas shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir te/ de la dgongs nas phan dbang gi mtshams sbyor du yang slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor bskor zhing bstod nas dbang bskur ba'i don du dgongs shing byin gyis rlob par gsol ba 'debs tshul 'byung ba yin no/ /nus dbang gi ting nge 'dzin ni/ slob bu'i mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu rnam sa kyi gnas su dbang rdzas rab gnas la bshad pa'i rigs gang yin gyi tshom ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal spro bsnyims nas slob ma rigs bzhi'i ༄gtso bo dang kun tu bzang por byin gyis rlob pa'o/ /zab dbang gsum las/ gsang dbang la nyi zla byang chub kyi sems rdo rje sems dpa'i sku phra mo til gong phye ba lta bur gyur pa snying ga'i 'khor lo la bsnyims pas de nas gnas pa'i rigs drug gi sa bon gnyid dang bcas pa sbyangs nas sems nyid 'od gsal gyi dkyil 'khor du bsgyur ba dang / sher dbang la phyag rgya'i thabs kyis mtshon pa'i dpe'i ye shes rtogs pa dang / dbang bzhi bar mas 148

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3brtan gyi dga' ba'i mtha'i lhan skyes la brten nas bden gnyis zung 'jug gi dkyil 'khor ma thar thug ngo sprod pa'i dgongs pa'o//sgyu 'phrul thal ba las dbang bzhi pa bskur dus dga' bzhi mtshan dpe dang mngon shes drug ldan du ngo sprod tshul gsungs shing / de 'dra de bla ma bsu skyel sogs dang rnam gnas yid byed kyis mtshan dpe dang mngon shes sgrub pa'i phyogs dang thun mong ma yin par kun mkhyen chen po bzhed de/ mdor na sngar thabs grol du bshad pa'i ye shes kyang sku dang mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i thugs gnyis ngo bo gcig tu gyar pa'i zang 'jug gi go 'a phang ngo sprod par gsal la/:she rtse(rdo ra me ༷/rteshi /re/ ྅rngodza :re/ :de/ ltar sprod byed — dga' ba da ༄sa gleng bslang thad dang bsgrigs na mas brtan la byed dgos par mngon te/ de'i steng nas ngo sprod tshul ni/ da lta dbang dus su skyes pa'i dga' bzhi 'di dag gi rgyun goms pa las yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi gnas skabs bcu drug dang / rten gyi dbye ba sum cu rtsa gnyis ye shes kyi ro nyams brgyad cu mtshan dpe'i rgyu tshogs kyi nus pa thams cad pa las byung ba'i mas brtan gyi ye shes mtshan dpe dang mngon shes kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur ba yin zhes mtshon par byed pa ste/ da dung rdo rje las rim las/ pha rol phyin dang sa mtshan nyid/ /mtshungs phyir rdzogs par bshad pa yin/ /149

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhes sogs ltar mang du spro bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa de ma thag rkyen ni/ dbang de dag go rim 'chol bar bskur du med kyi/ snga ma snga mas go phye nas gdod phyi ma phyi ma bskur dgos pas zab dbang gi de ma thag rkyen nus dbang dang /nus dbang gi de ma thag rkyen phan dbang yin pa sogs te/dkyil 'khor du ma bcug pa la dbang bskur mi rung ba 'di'i yang lugs yin pas phan dbang dang po'i de ma thag rkyen dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la bzhag dgos pa sogs kyang 'dod chog gam snyam mo//de ltar na dbang bskur yul khams drug ldan gyi rten can min na mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu ma tshang / dbang rdzas ma tshogs pa'am tshogs kyang lhag gnas ma byas na lhan cig byed rgyu ma tshang / sngon du slob bu'i rgyud sbyangs shing smin pa ma song na rgyu'i rkyen dang / slob dpon gyis sngon du bsnyen pa sogs ma song na dkyil 'khor gyi las la mi dbang bas bdag po dang / yul rten de dag 'dzom yang slob dpon gyis rdzas sngags ting 'dzin tshang bar 'du ma byas pa dang / byas kyang slob bus de la yid gtad nas mos pa ma bsgom na dmigs rkyen dang dmigs rkyen du 'gro ba'i yan lag dang /dbang gi go rim 'khrugs shing bar du 'ga' zhig chad na de ma thag rkyen ma tshang bar 'gyur la/ shing rta 'phang lo nyams pa ltar 150

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3rgyu tshogs kyi yan lag ma tshang na dgos pa byed mi nus pas thams cad tshang ba gces so/ /de ltar tshang ba las lag rjes kyi khyad par gang dang gang 'byung ba ni/ phan dbang gis spyir gsang sngags kyi rigs su nges par byed cing phyi dkyil drang don gyi bskyed rim tsam mnyan pa la dbang ba dang / nyan sgom gyi dbang gis nang lus la lha tshogs rgyas par bkod pa'i snang byed kyi bskyed rim sogs nyan sgom la dbang bar byed/ nus dbang lhag ma gsum gyis slob dpon gyi go 'phang sbyin par mtshungs kyang 'chad phrin gnyis kyis rgyud 'chad pa dang / las phra mo sgrub pa tsam la dbang bar byed la/de tsam gyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdo rje slob dpon du gyar pa ༄min zhing / rdo rje rgyal po'i dbang gis dkyil 'khor kyi las rab 'byams la dbang bar byed pas mi 'dra'o/ /gsang dbang gis steng sgo'i rdzogs rim mam rang lus la gnad du bsnun pa la dang /sher dbang gis 'og sgo'i lam mam gzhan lus pho nya'i rnal 'byor la dbang bsgrub par gsungs te/ grol lam dang sbyar na/ gsang dbang gi lam rdzogs rim pa'i stong chen sogs ting nge 'dzin dang po bzhi dang / sher dbang gi lam tshogs sgrub nas 'jog pa 'dra zhing / gang ltar yang dbang bzhi pas gsang sher gyi lam du thob pa'i ye shes de dag 'gyur med kyi bde bar song ba'i sgo nas shin 151

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tu brtan par byed de/ dbang bzhi'i lam gyi rtogs pa 'di dag thog mar skye ba la go rim gyi nges pa yod kyang / gsang dbang gi lam pa dang bum dbang gi lam pa 'gal ba sogs mi bzhed dam snyam du sems mod kyi zab mo'i gnas la kha tshon mi chod pas gzur gnas mkhas pa rnams kyis zhib tu dpyad par bya'o/ /dbang de rnams ma smin pa smin byed kyi dbang du bskur na rgyu'i dbang zhes bya la/ smin zin gyi nus pa gong 'phel du bya ba'i phyir dang / rtsa ltung byung nas sngags sdom slar gso ba'i ched du bla ma las nod pa'am rang nyid len pa ni lam gyi dbang dang / mthar lam pas rigs bdag drug pa dngos las nod pa ni 'bras bu'i dbang zhes bya'o/ /lnga pa dam tshig ni/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis khrims su bcas shing sngags pa rnams kyis bsrang byar gyar pa'i bslab gzhi khyad zurar zuragarir thorang nor sa pa dzerangapar can las ma 'da' ba' sams pa sa ran dang bcas pa sta/rgyud phyi ma las/ gang zhig nan tan las mi 'gong / /rmi lam du yang dam tshig brjod/ /dam bca' ba ni sdom par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rdo rje gsum gyi brtul zhugs la gnas pa'i cha nas dam tshig dang / rgyud mi mthun phyogs las sdom pa'i cha nas sdom pa'ang yin no/ /de srung ba la dang por bla ma las sngags sdom thob 152

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3pa med du mi rung zhing / de la thob pa'i dus mtshams shes nas thob blo skye ba gal che ste/ dus mtshams ni sngon gyi sgyu 'phrul mkhan po rnams dbang gi snga rol du dang por thun mong gi sdom bzung dang / de nas khyad par gyi sdom bzung lan gsum re brjod pa'i mtha' la skye bar bzhed kyang / lugs 'dir rdo rje las rim las/ /rang bzhin 'bra gsum sku gsung thags/ /gzi byin ldan par byin ༄༄mi zur ri sna rag sa sna mchog dzor brlabs la/ /dam tshag rdom pa mchag cas bshad/ /cas pa ltar dkyil 'khor du 'ju ga pa'i skabs sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig byin pa nyid sdom bzung du bzhed pas de'i mthar skye ba yin no/ /de la dam pa kha cig ni/ sdom bzung gi dus su sngags sdom thob kyang sngags sdom mtha' dag der bzung ba ni ma yin te/ da dung dbang so so'i ngo skal gyi sdom pa mi 'dra ba mang po bzung dgos pa'i phyir zhes gsungs la/ kha cig ni/ sngags sdom la ris mi 'dra ba mang po med kyi gcig tu zad la/ de khas blang gis bzung ba'i mthar thob kyang dbang bskur dang ma 'brel ba'i khas blang gi brjod pa lan gsum tsam gyis 'thob pa min zhing / khas blang gis thob pa'i 'og tu dbang rnams bskur bas sdom rgyun gong 'phel du 'gro ba yin zhes gsung ngo / /thun mong byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni lus dbul gsum gyi skabs su skye bar bshad kyang 153

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rdzedam tshig gsum bkod dang bstun na rung tsam snang yang 'di'i skor du de ltar bshad pa ma mthong ngo / /spyir dam tshig gi rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang bsdu na rtsa ba dang yan lag gnyis su 'du la/ de'ang rgyud gzhung 'di nyid las grags pa ltar na/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig lnga dang / yan lag gi dam tshig bcu'o/ /dang po ni/ le'u bcu dgu pa las/ bla med mi spang bla ma bkur/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad/ /yang dag lam du zhugs la byams/ /gsang ba'i don phyir smra mi bya/ /'di ni rtsa ba lnga rnams te/ /sgrub dang srung ba'i dam tshig mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bla med mi spang ba/ bla ma bkur ba/ sngags rgya rgyun mi gcod pa/ mched la byams pa/ gsang ba mi smra ba ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rang bzhin gyi sems bskyed pa'am byang chub chen por 'bras bu lam byed kyi tshul du sems bskyed pa mi spong ba ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin byang chub tu rtogs pa'i lta ba gzhir bzung ste ting nge 'dzin gyis rgyun du goms par byed pa las mi 'da' ba'o/ /de la sems nyid spros bral gyi ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa don dam sems bskyed dang /cir snang sems nyid kyi rnam rol rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyag gcig tu shes pa kun rdzob sems bskyed gnyis yod de/ rim 154

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3bzhin zab pa dang rgya che ba'i sems gnyis so/ /sems de gnyis mthar phyin par gdul byas myur du 'grub pa'i ched du sangs rgyas rnams kyis shin tu rnam dag gi bden gnyis zung 'jug lha'i rnam par byin gyis brlabs pa la de ltar shes nas bsgom na bla med byang chub kyi sems gnyis ka der 'du bar sngon gyi mkhas grub dag gis gsungs te/ 'dir kun rdzob byang sems gtso bor sgom pa'i tshe yang snang ba rang rgyud pa ma yin par lhag pa kun rdzob ces ye shes sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor du sgom pas don dam sems bskyed kyi snying po can yin la/ don dam sems bskyed la mnyam par 'jog pa na yang tha mal pa'i dngos snang gi rang bzhin stong par sgom pa dang mi 'dra bar dag pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad don dam 'od gsal gyi thig le gcig tu bsdus nas sgom pa yin pas kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi snying po can te/ tshul de lta bus byang chub kyi sems gnyis skad cig tsam yang ya bral du ma song ba'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis rlabs po che bsdu ba la bslab par bya'o/ /gsang ba bla na med 'dir bcas mtshams thun mong ma yin pa 'di lta bu yod pa la dgongs nas/ bde gshegs nyid kyi yul la zhugs/ /'jigs med kun tu bzang por sbyor/ /zhes dam tshig bsrung na sangs rgyas nyid dang spyod yul gcig pa dang kun tu bzang po'i — 155

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyal srid lag mthil na gnas pa lta bur gsungs pa yin te/'dul sdom 'dus pa'i che ba dang / spyod sgo yangs pa'i che ba bshad pa rnams kyang gnad 'di la gtug dgos par dam bsgrags kyi skabs las shes shing / rtsa ba'i dam tshig lhag ma bzhi yang 'di'i ched du bcas par snang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ bkur ba'i yul la bde 'dus zhi rgyud las/ rgyud 'grol dbang bskur de nyid bstan/ /zhes pa ltar/ dbang bskur ba/ rgyud 'chad pa/snying po'i don gyi man ngag ston pa ste/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi bka' drin nod pa'i bla ma gang yin yang sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par bltas nas dngos po thams cad kyis mchod pa la brtson pa'o/ /bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam tshul ni/sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la zhugs nas dgongs pa gcig gis slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlob par rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis zhal gyis bzhes pa yin te/'di nyid las/ dbang phyug longs spyod lngas mchod na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod pa yin/ /nye ba'i dkyil 'khor smos ci dgos/ /nyes pa thams cad dag par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mang ngo / /de la dgongs nas sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las kyang / bla med mdzad pa'i slob dpon ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs 156

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3mchod pas/ /de yis bsod nams ma byas ci/ /dka' thub ma bsten ci zhig yod/ /ces sogs sngags kyi theg pas 'gro ba rnams la tshogs myur du rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs 'di dang mnyam pa gzhan med par yang yang gsungs te/ mchod pas bsnyen bkur tshul la/ rnyed bkur gnyis dang rim gro sogs sgo mang po yod do/ /gtso bo'i dbang du btang na de ltar yin kyang /spyir bla ma bkur zhes pa'i bla ma la gsang sngags ston pa las gzhan yang yod pa mi 'gal te/ dper na gang zhig smad pas sngags kyi rtsa ltung 'byung ba'i chos la gsang sngags kyi chos shig mi dgos par/ rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'i/ /chos la smod pa drug pa yin/ /zhes bshad pa bzhin no/ /des na dam tshig gsal bkra las 'dir bstan bla ma'i dbye ba dang de dag bkur ba'i tshul drug tu bshad de/ 'gro ba mang po'i 'dren par gyur cing rang gis kyang bka' drin cung zad thob pa spyi'i bla ma ste yul khams skyong ba'i rgyal po lta bur bkur ba dang / de bzhin du rab byung gi mkhan po lta bu chos sgor 'dren pa'i ste khu bo dang / dam tshig 'bogs shing dbang bskur ba dam tshig dbang gi ste pha dang /ltung ba phyir bcos kyi yul du gyur pa nyams chag skong ba'i ste ma dang / gzhung don gsal bar bkrol nas ston pa shes rgyud 'grol 157

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i ste mig dang / zab don snying po'i man ngag 'bogs pa man ngag lung gi slob dpon te snying las lhag pa'i tshul du bltas nas bkur ba rnams te/ 'dir dpe don la 'dra chos brtsi lugs kyi gsung sgros kyang yod de go sla bas ma smos so/ /yang na rgyud las dngos bstan gyi bla ma phyi ma rnams yin yang / bla mar gyur pa gcig la brnyas na de'i rgyu mthun 'phel nas gzhan la'ang srung dka' bas spyi'i slob dpon sogs kyang zhar byung du bstan zhes bshad par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gong du brjod pa'i bla med byang chub kyi sems de yang sngags dang phyag rgya'i yan lag dang bral na mda' sgro med bsnun yang tshabs chung ba bzhin du dngos grub sgrub pa'i rtsal shugs cher mi 'byung bas bla med mi spang zhes pa'i tshis/ zur gyi bla med bsgrub bya dang sngags rgya sgrub byed du dkon mchog 'grel las gsungs te/ de'i phyir 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sngags gsum dang phyag rgya bzhi po sgom bzlas 'ching gsum gyi sgo nas nyams su blang ba la brtson dgos so/ /de'ang brtson pas nyams su blang na dngos grub 'byung ba tsam du ma zad kyi ma brtson na bcas 'gal gyi ltung ba bskyed pa yin la/ de skyed pa'i mtshams kyang dam tshig gsal bkra'i tshig ris las dpag na/ bla med mi spang nyin rer dus gsum du ma dran pa dang sngags rgya ra ba bzhi'i 158

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3dus mtshams yol ba nas 'jog ste/ tshogs gtor yang lo las 'das par chag na de bzhin no/ /bsrung na yon tan 'thob par ma zad 'das pa las ltung ba 'byung ba'i tshul 'di bla ma bkur ba sogs lhag ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ yul la spyi ring nye 'dres kyi spun bzhi las/ spyi'i mched ni sems can thams cad de/ bde gshegs snying po'i gdung gcig pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur ba rgyu mtshan du bzung nas byams shing gus par bya bar gsal bkra las bshad de/sems can la brten pa'i sdig ltung mtha' dag sdom pa'i thabs chen po'o/ /ring ba'i mched ni chos 'di pa rnams te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su slob pa'i 'khor yin no snyam du dang / nye ba'i mched ni sngags kyi theg pa rnams te/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul la gnas pa'o snyam du dang / nang 'dres pa'i mched la bla ma gcig pa pha gcig gi spun ni gsal bkra las dngos su bshad la/des dkyil 'khor gcig pa ma gcig gi spun yang mtshon zhes mkhas pa dag gsung ste/ de gnyis ni snying po byang chub kyi bar du dam tshig gi srog rtsa gcig gi sprel ba'i 'du shes kyis lhag par yang sgo gsum gyis byams par bya'o/ /de dag gang la byams pa las 'das kyang dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes par 'gyur mod kyi/159

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skabs 'dir bstan gyi mched dngos ni theg chen pa kho nar rong zom chen po bzhed la/ yang dag lam du zhugs pa zhes gsungs pa dang le'u bcu gsum par phar phyin theg pa ba la yang dag nyid ma rtogs pa zhes gsungs pa'i shugs kyis yang dag rtogs pa'i lam gsang sngags su go nus pa bsgrigs na theg chen gsang sngags pa 'ba' zhig yin pa 'dra'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gsang zhes pa bshad gzhir bzung / gang gsang ba ni gsang ba'i don zhes pas bstan/gang la gsang ba ni phyir zhes pas bstan te/ snod kyi mtshan nyid las phyir gyur pa'o/ /ji ltar gsang ba ni/ smra mi bya zhes pas bstan to/ /de dag phye na/ yul ni dam tshig phra rgyas las/ dam nyams dam las log pa dang / /dam med dkyil 'khor ma mthong dang / /'dres dang ma 'dres thams cad la/ /zhes so/ /gang gsang ba la/ spyir gsang bzhi dang / bar gsang bzhi dang /gsang bar 'os pa dang gnyer gtad pa gnyis te bcur bshad pa'i dang po ni/ lta ba zab mo dang spyod pa brlang po gnyis ni blo dman dang ma 'dres pa la gsang / yi dam gyi lha sngags dang grub rtags ni 'dres dang ma 'dres thams cad la gsang bar gsungs te/ dus nam yang de ltar gsang dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa'i gnas/ dus/ grogs/ rdzas rnams te sgrub pa ji srid du 160

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3gsang ngo / /gsang bar 'os pa ni bla ma dang mched la pha rol ma dad par 'gyur ba'am 'gyur du dogs pa'i kun spyod sogs dang /gsang bar gnyer gtad pa ni/ bla ma dang mched kyis 'di gzhan la ma smra zhes bsgo ba rnams so/ /sgrub rdzas snod min gyi mig la mi bstan pa'ang dam tshig chen po yin mod de/ skabs 'di'i dngos bstan ni gsang don rna bar mi smra ba nyid do/ /sngags kyi dngos grub mi 'grub pa'i rgyu'i nang na snod min la gsang ba ston pa dang /bla ma smod pa las thu ba gang yang med par dgongs te 'di nyid kyi dbang gi skabs su yang / sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'di/ / dam nyams ma 'dres med pa la/ /nam yang smra bar ma byed cig /theg pa chen po ston byed pa/ /nga la brnyas dang smad mi rung / /zhes 'bur dod du gsungs so/ /de dag kyang bsdu na gnyis pa dang bzhi pa lnga pa rnams srung ba'i dam tshig dang po dang gsum pa sgrub pa'i dam tshig go/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig tu bsdu na/gnyis pa dang bzhi pa sku'i/ gsum pa gsung gi/ dang po lnga pa thugs kyi dam tshig tu byed pa grags che la/ dang po gsung gi dam tshig tu bsdu ba'i lugs kyang yod do/ /de ltar rtsa ba lnga po'i yan lag tu gyar pa'i dam tshig ni bcu ste/༄mi spang ba lnga dang / mi dor ba lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ gti mug 161

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/chags dang zhe sdang dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog mi spang ngo / /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don la gsal bkra las/ /mi spang dam tshig bshad bya ba/ /yang dag dug lnga log dug lnga/ zhes gnyis su bshad pa'i dang po yang dag dug lnga ni/ bla med mi spong ba'i grogs sam yan lag tu dug lnga dang cha 'dra ba'i thabs kyi khyad par lnga dang mi 'bral bar bya ba ste/ lnga ni/ lta ba la phyogs ris dang spyod pa la blang dor gyis 'byed pa med pa gti mug dang / de ma rtogs pa la dmigs med kyi snying rje 'byung ba 'dod chags/kha cig tu chos nyid mnyam pa nyid las 'bral mi phod pa 'dod chags su bshad pa'ang yod/ rang byung ye shes kyis log rtog 'joms pa zhe sdang / mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba gshongs su mi 'bebs pa'am 'phang mi smod pa nga rgyal/ gnyis 'dzin gyi zhen rtog mnyam nyid kyi dgongs klong du mi shong ba phrag dog rnams te/mdor na bla med byang sems ni snang phyogs dang stong phyogs kyi lha sgom pa yin zhing / de la bar du gcod pa ni spong len phyogs ris kyi zhen snang yin pas de mnyam pa chen po'i thabs mkhas kyis sdom pa la lngar phye ba 'dra la/ de ltar byas na bla med mi spong ni bslab bya'i yul dang / 'di lnga ni slob tshul thabs kyi khyad par du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa log pa'i dug lnga ni/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga dngos 162

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3te/ de rnams dang du blang ba la mang du bshad kyang snying po bsdu na/rdo rje las/ nyon mongs rnams ni sgyu 'dra ngo bos stong / /ngang gis mi rtag rang bzhin shes pas grol/ /zhes rang bzhin shes pa'i sgo nas dang du blang bar gsungs pa dang / rig 'dzin gong mas snum gyi don du til mi spong ba lta bur gsungs pas nyon mongs thol gyis skyes pa na 'jig rten phal pa ltar de'i gzhan dbang du mi gtong / theg dman pa ltar de la dgrar mi lta bar sgra mthun don spags las nyon mongs rang spyi'i gtan tshigs kyi thad du bshad pa ltar shes pas nyon mongs de nyid kyi bcud blangs pas rang rkya mi thub par lan tshwa chur zhugs pa bzhin ye shes kyi dbyings su rang grol ba ste nyon mongs pa'i bcud ni 'od gsal gyi ye shes yin par sngar bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri sha chen/ /dag pa'i snod cha mi dor ro/ /zhes gsangs te/ de'i don ni sman mchod las/rigang rig mibyang chub sems ni rdo rje ste/ /sha chen mchod pa rin po che/ /pad+ma me tog yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje'i chu ste las kyi mchog /zas mchog tshe yi dri chen po/ /zhes so so'i rigs kyi ngos 'dzin dang bcas bshad pa'i grub pa bzhi ldan gyi bdud rtsi chen po lnga dag mnyam rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis dang du blang bar bya ste/ de la grub pa 163

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhi ni/ rdzas de rnams rang bzhin rnam dag gi dbyings las ngo bo gzhan du ma gyur pas chos nyid rang bzhin gyis grub pa/sngags kyi ye shes 'char ba'i rten khyad par can khams drug ldan gyi lus las byung ba'i bcud len gyi rdzas khyad par can yin pas chos can rang gi ngo bos grub pa/ dam tshig can gyi sngags pas rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin du sbyangs rtogs spar gsum byas te dngos grub kyi rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pas nus pa'i mthus grub pa/ de lta bu'i rdzas lnga la dme bar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mnyam pa'i dam tshig la gus pa dang dag mnyam gyi dgongs pas zil gyis mnan te dang du len pa la dag mnyam chen po'i lam gyis mngon par byang chub pa'i sangs rgyas dang de'i sras rnams spyod yul gcig par dgongs nas lhag par byin gyis rlob pa byin gyis rlabs kyis grub pa dang bzhi yin te/ rim pa bzhin/ thal rgyud las/ dngos po ma lus sems nyid phyir/ /mtshan nyid bral ba chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes dang / rang bzhin bde ba'i ye shes lnga/ /byed pa med par rang snang ba'o/ /zhes dang / shes rab ting 'dzin thabs dag gi/ /nus mthu nges par 'byung ba yin/ /zhes dang / 'di lta'i lam la gang gnas pa/ /phyogs dus kun nas byin gyis rlobs/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar dang du blangs pas gong 164

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3du smos pa'i rim pa bzhin/ tsha ba/ mdze nad/ grang ba/ gag pa/dug nad de nad lnga sel ba dang / de bzhin du mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang / mthu che ba dang / bkrag gso ba dang / skad snyan pa dang / tshe ring ba ste yon tan lnga 'byung ba sogs kyang gsungs so/ /de ltar na dus rtag tu lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor zab mo la gnas shing / nang 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs dug lnga dang / phyi 'jig rten na shin tu smad par grags pa'i rdzas lnga sogs kyang de nyid rtsal sbyong gi grogs su 'khyer ba la ci nus su slob pa ni gsang ba sgyu 'phrul pa'i dam tshig gi kun spyod nges pa'o zhes shes par bya'o/ /dam tshig bco lnga po de las rgyas par phye na sum brgya drug cur 'gyur tshul yang yod de gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshig de dag ma nyams par bsrung ba dang / brgya la nyams na phyir 'chos pa gnyis kyis dam tshig dag par 'gyur te/ de la srung ba'i thabs ni/ rgyud nyid las/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams gyar na/ /sgrub pa thams cad log par 'gyar/ /zhes zi tsho rig zur〉tsho me pa 'tsho ra mizurang mjug zurarasags dam chag nyams pa la ma nga dang ma ma nga ga nyas dmags bka' bstsal ba rnams yang yang bsam nas 'jigs pa dang / rgyal ba'i rigs mchog 'dzin pa de/ /zhes sogs bsrung ba'i phan 165

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yon bstan pa rnams bsam nas don gnyer dang spro ba bskyed la srung 'dod drag po mang du sbyang / de ltar bsams kyang 'jigs skrag dang spro ba cher mi 'byung na rtsa ba las 'bras yid ches kyi dad pa chung ba dang kun byang gi skyon yon ma mthong bas yin phyir dad pa mang du bsgom/ dran shes bag yod dang ngo tsha khrel yod sogs srung thabs kyi yan lag gzhan rnams kyang so so'i man ngag bzhin du bslab/ phyir bcos ni rtsa ba'i rgyud bsdus pa 'dir/ nyams na skong bas rdzogs pa dang / /zhes dang / rgyud phyi ma las/ don yod rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dam tshig slong bar 'dod pa yin/ /zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs kyang rnal 'byor spyi khrus sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /drug pa phrin las ni/ thugs thig las/ phyi rol tshad med nyid las bzhi/ /zhes pas byams sogs tshad med bzhi'i rgyu las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas gtso bor gzhan don dngos su sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas kyi mdzad spyod do/ /gsang bdag zhal lung du/ bdag gzhan don sgrub phrin las te/ /zhes khog gzhung las gsungs pa drangs nas phan gdags pa dang / tshar gcod pa gang rung gi sgo nas bdag gzhan gyi don sgrub pa'i bya ba zhes bshad do/ /de la dbye na/166

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3bsgrub bya'i las kyi sgo nas zhi sogs bzhi ste/ de re re la yang mtha' yas pa dbyer yod kyang / thugs thig las zhi ba la nad dang gdon bgegs dgra zhi ba'i las gsum dang / rgyas pa la gso ba dang 'phel bar bya ba gnyis kyi snga ma la na ba gso ba nas/shi ba/ lo tog sri'u gso ba ste bzhi/ phyi ma la tshe/ rigs brgyud/longs spyod/ bsod nams spel ba ste bzhi/ dbang la gzungs ma sogs dgug pa dang / yul khams sogs dbang du bya ba ste gnyis/mngon spyod la bskrad pa dang / mnan pa dang / smyo bar byed pa dang / bskams pa dang / rmongs par byed pa dang / rengs par byed pa rnams bshad la/ mngon spyod kyi gtso bo bsad pa ni rgyud nyid du gsungs so/ /bya thabs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ me dang / rdzas dang / lu gu rgyud dang / mchod rten dang / phyag rgya'i sgo nas bya ba rnams khog gzhung las bshad de/ de las snga ma gsum ni rgyud nyid kyi le'u nyi shu par 'byung ste/ de rnams re re la'ang las bzhis dbye bas bzhi bzhir 'gyar ro/ /rgyud nyid du bstan tshod ༄kyi las bzhi ni/ pha rol khros pa zhi ba dang / tshe bsod sogs rgyas pa dang / dmigs bya 'gug pa dang / bsgral 'os bsad pa ste bzhi po 'di tsam mo/ me'i las ni sbyin sreg dang / rdzas kyi las ni phur gdab dang / lu gu rgyud ni bro'i las so/ /167

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sbyin sreg la'ang phyi nang gsang ba gsum yod kyang re zhig dang po'i dbang du byas na sbyin sreg rtsa ba las/ gnas rdzas thabs kyi rnam pa dang / /gzungs dang gtso sems bsgrub bya dang / /phur bu lha dus las rim dang / /lhag ma bcu gcig shes par bya/ zhes don bcu gcig tu bshad de/ sdom tshig 'di dag rtog pa spro ba'i sa bon tsam du smos kyi yi ges ngal bas rgyas par ma phyes la/ sbyin sreg gi sgo nas las dang dngos grub myur du 'byin pa'i gnad che ba ni/ le'u dgu par/ zhal du gyur pa'i me bos la/ /zhes me la dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i zhal du gsungs pa 'di yin te/ dper na khams zas kyis kha'i sgo nas brgyud de zin pa'i 'byung ba chen po rnams tshim zhing rgyas par byed pa bzhin du me lha tshim pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor ba rnams tshim zhing mnyes par 'gyur bas na de ltar gsungs te mdor na me lha'o/ /de'i sgo nas rang gi lhag pa'i lha rnams tshim par bya ba'i tshul la bzhi ste/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par byas la der lha rnams spyan drangs te mchod pa dang / 'bar ba'i dbus su dam tshig pa bskyed de ye shes pa gzhug pa dang / me lha shar lho'i mtshams su dpang po'i tshul du gzhag nas me'i dbus su dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang / me lha'i lto bar bskyed pa rnams las 'dir phyi ma'o/ /dmigs bya'i rdzas gzugs la brten pa'i 168

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3las ni/ dmigs bya gang yin de'i bdud rtsi lnga ste zag rdzas sam nya sha bu ram sbrang rtsi til te rdzas lnga dang gzhan yang mi la rkang rjes kyi sa dang mi ma yin la gnas rten gyi sa la sogs la rgyu byas pa'i ling ga gnas yig can las gang yin gyi brub khung du bcug nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs so sor 'jog de nas las dang mthun pa'i 'dug stangs dang sngags kyi ring thung drag zhan/dbyangs kyi 'gyur stangs sogs dang ldan pas/ skabs su gang babs kyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed/ lha las la gzud cing sprul pa spros la bsgrub bya gang yin bkug ste ling ga la bsnyim/ rgyu dang dbyibs dang kha dog dang grangs nges par byas pa'i phur bu gang yin las de dang de'i rigs kyi tī la yar byas nas phur bskul dang / ga ta ya'i sngags mjug tu spu gri btags te/ zhi ba la yan lag lnga snying ga dang drug rgyas pa la yan lag bzhi/ dbang la dbang po lnga/ drag po la gnas gsum du gdab/skabs 'dir ni mngon par 'dod pa'i yul la rin po che'i phur bu'i rgyas btab nas rgyas par bya ba sogs kyang yod pas phur gdab dkyus dang mi 'dra'o/ /phur gdab kyi 'og tu ral gris bcad/ mtshon char gyis gtub nas zhal bstab sogs bya'o/ /bro'i las ni/ ling ro dbas sa spungs pa'i mthar sgrub pa po ༄ ༄169

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnams las dbyibs dang mthun pa'i bror bcas la/ snod bcud thams cad las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rten dang brten par bzhengs pa'i nga rgyal gyis lag g.yas steng du byas te bsnol bas zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi la rim pa bzhin mdzub gung srin lag mthe'u chung rnams lu gu rgyud du sbrel zhing tshig dang sngags kyis bskul te bro brdung bas lha rnams kyi 'od zer las mthun gyi kha dog can bsgrub bya la thim pas las gang yin grub par bsam la spu gri brjod cing phyag rgya sprugs te bshig nas mnan par bya ba'o/ /mchod rten gyi las ni/ rang nyid zhi ba la rnam snang sogs las gang yin gyi lhar bskyed nas rigs so so'i sngags kyis mchod rten dkar po zlum po sogs las gang yin de'i dbyibs mdog tu btab pa'i bum par las mthun gyi lha bskyed/ de'i 'od kyis bsgrub bya bkug nas mchod rten gyi 'og tu gnas pa la 'od des reg pas ci ltar 'dod pa'i las grub par bsam pa ste sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa las gsungs shing / spyan 'grel las/ mchod rten 'byung ba gang la 'debs kyang / zhes me dang rlung sogs la 'debs kyang rung bar bshad do/ /phyag rgya'i las ni/ sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa la brten nas rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya bca' ba dang bsam pas zhi ba dang / rtse lngas rgyas pa/ dgu pas dbang / bcu gcig pas mngon spyod sgrub 170

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3par spyan 'grel las bshad pa phyag rgya bca' ba'i sgo nas sgrub tshul dang / rgyas pa las/ rdo rje lan gsum gsor ba yis/ /lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo/ /dam can rnal 'byor dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes sogs phyag rgya bsgyur ba'i sgo nas phrin las sgrub tshul gsungs pa rnams so/ /de dag gang la'ang nang gi sems rnam pa gnyis dang /phyi'i grogs 'dzoms pa mchog tu bsngags te/ de la sems gnyis ni don gyi sems dang / stongs kyi sems so/ /dang po ni/ bden pa dbyer med spyod yul dang bral ba rtogs shing goms nas sgyu ma'i mdzad spyod la byan tshud pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de la stongs 'debs pa'am grogs byed pa'i las so so'i kun slong gi sems te/ zhi ba la dwangs pa/ rgyas pa la dga' ba/ dbang la chags pa/drag po la khros pa zhes le'u nyi shu pa las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /gnyis pa grogs ni/ don gyi sems de'ang phyag rgya khyad par can gyi grogs dang tshogs na lhag par 'bar bar 'gyur zhing / de'ang las de la khyad par du bsngags pa'i phyag rgya rnyed na stongs kyi sems rno la ngar btags bzhin byed pas le'u nyi shu pa'i/ /ljon pa dang ni lcag phran tshal/ /sogs kyi nges don 'grel chung las/chosi mi 13ji cho rig /༷rngo/ /༷/shem rmas pa dang pu dra mang 'a la dang / /skya rgyud da dang bkra shis gsang ba/ /zhes bshad de/ spyir bde chen gyi rnal 'byor 171

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las rung ma thob kyang zhi sogs kyi las rnams mi 'a grub pa ma yin mod/ 'on kyang de yod na phrin las rlabs che ba dang myur du dang tshegs med du 'grub pa sogs kyi stobs shin tu mi mnyam pa yin no / /bdun pa sgrub pa ni/ dngos grub la dngos su sbyor ba'i thabs khyad par can te/ de la bsgrub bya'i dngos grub kyi sgo nas dbye na thun mong gi dngos grub tsam dang / mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa gnyis te/ rgyud phyi ma las/ 'jig rten pa yi dngos grub ni/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sbyor bas 'thob/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub ni/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sbyor bas so/ /zhes thun mong gi dngos grub bskyed rim dang / mchog gi dngos grub rdzogs rim gyis 'grub par gsungs shing / rdzogs rim gyi gzhir bskyed rim yang dgos pas mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa la bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka dgos par don gyis bstan to/ /lha'i khya da par gyis dbye na/ lha chen po sogs 'jig rten pa'i dang / rdo rje sems dpa' sogs 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub pa gnyis de'i phyi ma la'ang gtso bor las tshogs kyi ched du bsngags pa'i lha'i dang / mchog sgrub kyi ched du gtso bor bsngags pa'i lha'i sgrub pa gnyis sogs yod do/ /bye brag gsang ba sgyu 'phrul 172

sbra'i zhe ba/bzhing /steng /spyo lnga zug :rdocad byengecad zugajordzutshasdo 'e// casayid/ do/pa'i lugs la dngos grub kyi sgrub pa mang du gsungs te/ khog gzhung las/ ro langs tshe dang pra sgrub dang / /lha chen po dang rgyal po bzhi/ /gdug pa klu 'dul rgyal blon gyi/ /chung ma dbang du bya ba gnyis/ /yul khams ce spyang rkang mgyogs bskrad/ /mi snang gzugs sgrub lha klu mo/ /rgyal blon dmag dpon zhang blon sgrub/ /tshe 'di'i ched phyir 'jig rten pa'o/ /zhes than mong gi dngos ༄grub sna tshogs sgrub lugs dang / yi ge sgyu 'phrul tshogs sgrub dang / /rdo rje sems dang sman sgrub dang / /rigs lnga sgrub dang yum lnga sems/ /byin dbab sgrub pa rnams gnyis so/ /zhes mchog sgrub kyi rnam grangs gsungs te/ lung phyi ma'i rnam gnyis so/ /zhes pa ni byin dbab dang sgrub pa gnyis po nyid de/ rigs lnga dang yum lnga dang sems ma rnams re re zhing dbab pa dang sgrub pa gnyis re yod do/ /sgrub lugs kyi khyad par de rnams ni bshad rgyud rgyas pa las kha bskangs nas bshad pa ste/ rgyas pa'i le'u gang gis sgrub lugs gang bstan pa'i rnam bzhag zhib par ni 'grel pa rnams su gsal lo/ /rtsa rgyud nyid las mdo tsam gsungs pa ni/ thun mong gi sgrub pa la le'u bcu gnyis par/ 'dzul lam nam mkhar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / chos kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dkon mchog 'grel dang sbyar ba las 'thon zhing /173

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gtso bor le'u lnga pa las yi ge sgyu 'phrul gyi las tshogs gsungs pa rnams yin te/ dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba la sogs pa yon tan 'byung ba'i dngos grub drug 'og min gyi bar gyi nam mkha' la rdo rje'i skas 'byung ba la sogs pa 'byung ba'i dngos grub lnga/ dgug pa dang bskrad pa sogs las phran tshegs kyi dngos grub brgyad sgrub pa ste bcu dgu'o/ /rtsa rgyud las 'di ltar gsungs pa rnams bshad rgyud du las tshogs rgyas par bshad pa rnams kyis so sor 'grel tshul yang yod de gzhan du shes so/ /'di dang sngags kyi dngos grub spyi'i go ba la'ang phan pas yi ge'i las tshogs bslu med du 'grub pa'i tshul zur tsam brjod na/ sems can gyi las kyi mthu dang rnal 'byor pa'i nus pa'i yul bsam gyis mi khyab ces yongs su grags pa ltar/ yi ge sgyu 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin grub pa rnams la yi ge'i sprin las dngos grub kyi don thams cad 'byung ba lha rnams la yid bzhin gyi sprin las rin po che'i char 'bab pa lta bu dang / de ltar dngos grub kyi don byed pa'i nus pa phul du byang //1) 13 ge//dres //rware risi mib can yi dag kyang rnal 'byor pa yid tsam gyi rgyu mtshan can yin pa yid bzhin gyi sprin gzugs can de dag klu'i rgyal po'i sems dang lha rnams kyi las gzugs can ma yin pa'i rtsa ba can du zad pa bzhin te/ de ltar yang rgyud nyid las/ rtsa ba med pa'i 174
