gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3sems nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /sems nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin te/ /yi ge yid bzhin rin chen sprin/ /zhes gsungs/ de'ang chos thams cad gdod nas rang snang ris med kyi lhar sangs rgyas shing / de yang ming tshig yi ges btags pa'i rnam 'phrul nyag gcig tu gnas la/ dag pa'i lha dang de'i mdzad pa sgrub pa'i yi ge de la sngags kyi yi ge zhes bya ste/ tshul 'dis chos thams cad rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du 'du zhing /de'ang yi ge 'khor lo la 'du bar rtogs nas yi ge sgyu 'phrul sgom pa yin la/ sgom pa de rdzogs pa'i tshe 'khrul pa'i zhen snang zil gyis non te/ snang srid ma lus pa ris med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba ji ltar bsam pa de ltar 'char ba'i yid bzhin gyi yi ge'i cho 'phrul tsam du mthong ba stobs su gyur pa snang ba byung bas mun pa zil gyis mnan nas dngos po'i rang gzugs gsal bar dmigs pa lta bu dang / de'i dbang gis brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnams bye ma las gser dang sol ba las ljon shing sogs rnal 'byor pa'i 'dod pa bzhin du byin gyis rlob pa gser 'gyur rtsis lcags sgyur ba lta bu dang / gnas lus longs spyod sogs ngan reng gi rnam par snang ba'i cha thams cad yi ge'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'dul nus pa dug bcud len gyi sman gyis thebs pa lta bu ste/ le'u lnga pa'i 175

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhung de nyid las/ de nyid ye shes rang snang ba'i/ /ming tshig gzugs sogs yid bzhin gyi/ /mun la snang byung ji bzhin du/ /'gyar ba gser 'gyar sman gyi tshul/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni rig 1)sgo skuramirong klong 'grel pa gnyis dang 'gro phyogs bstun nas bshad do/ /yi ge'i sgyu 'phrul 'di gtso bor sgom pa'i dus kyang rje rong klong ni/dang por yi ge rnams las dkyil 'khor ba bskyed de gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du a dkar po phra mo brtan pa thob thob sgom/ de nas a grangs med pa'i spro bsdu dang de goms pa na yi ge gzhan spro bsdu'i dmigs pa la bslab/ de la'ang drod thob pa na las sna tshogs la sbyor bar bzhed/ zur lugs la snying rje sgyu ma dang phyag rgya gcig pa rags pa lha sku la bslab pa'i bar der sgom par bzhed do/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las thun mong gi dngos grub de snyed gsungs pa rnams kyi gtso bo ni rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub yin te/bcu gcig pa'i/ mkha' 'gro gsal 'bar che la sogs/ /zhes pa'ang dngos grub de'i khyad par yin la/ bcu gnyis par yo byad lnga la spyad pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa rnams kyang shas cher tshogs sgrub kyi dus su yo byad lnga la spyad pa'i lag rjes rig 'dzin grub pa'i dus su 'thob tshul yin pas thun mong gi sgrub pa'i rgyal po ni tshogs sgrub pa yin no/ /sgrub pa de rnams gang yang phyag rgya spros 176

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3bcas kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs nas gdod bya bar/ sngags dang phyag rgya rab brtan na/ /zhes pa'i rgyud tshig gis bsgrubs nas zur pa rnams 'chad par mdzad de/ rgya spros rdzogs pa la'ang tshogs spyod byas ma byas gnyis las rig 'dzin ma gtogs pa'i dngos grub phal cher ma byas pas kyang sgrub nus la/ rig 'dzin ni tshogs spyod med par sgrub tu med de sngar bshad zin to/ /'di ltar bshad pa thams cad bskyed rim pa kho na'i dbang du byas la/ rdzogs rim pa la'ang ting 'dzin lnga'i skabs su thun mong gi sgrub pa ci rigs byed pa yod mod kyi/ spyir mchog sgrub gtso che ste/ de yang gong du bstan pa bzhin no/ /sgrub pa dang phrin las gnyis la khyad par ci yod ce na/ las phra mo gcig la mtshon na bsnyen pa rdzogs nas las de dngos su 'grub pa'i nus pa skyed pa'i ched du las de'i sngags dang ting nge 'dzin sgrub pa ni sgrub pa dang /de la nus pa rnyed nas grub pa las la sbyar ba zhes las dngos su sgrub pa ni phrin las te/ gsung rgyun 'gar sgrub pa rang don dang /phrin las gzhan don gtso che zhes 'byung ba'ang de dang phyogs 'dra'am snyam zhing / phrin las la phra mo las bzhi'i skor ma gtogs dngos grub chen po'i rigs rnams ma bshad do/ /brgyad pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ le'u lnga pa dang / dngos rnams 177

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nyid na dngos med par/ /rtogs pa'i dbang sgyur ting 'dzin yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtogs bya'i don la dbang du gyar pa'am //byere ///bye rig ༅ ///golas su rung ba sems rtse gcig pa ste/ ma ga dang thun mong dngos grub chen po thams cad zab pa dang rgya che ba'i bden pa gnyis la de 'dra'i ting nge 'dzin brtan pa las 'byung la/ phra mo'i dngos grub rnams kyang lha sngags la yid rtse gcig tu gtad nas sgom pa med par mi 'grub cing de ltar sgom pa'ang ting nge 'dzin gyi phyogs yin no/ /de'i phyir rgyud nyid las/ gang gis glang chen myos 'dra'i sems/ /mnyam par bzhag pas btul nas su/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dngos grub 'dod pas glang po che myo sa pa bzhin du spros na mi 'phro zhing / bsdus na mi 'du ba dang /'dod pa'i yul la mi 'jug cing mi 'dod pa'i yul la 'jug pa sogs g.yo ba'i skyon gyi gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i yid 'di ting nge 'dzin sgrub pa'i man ngag gi gnad kyis bzung ste 'dul ba gces so/ /de la lam rim las/ skyes bu seng ge bzhin rgyu bas/ zhes dang / khams dang ting 'dzin rkyen bsdus la/ /zhes pa ltar/dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su/ khams dang mthun pa'i zas sogs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi cha rkyen du bla ma'am mched dgongs nyams can dang ting nge 'dzin gyi man ngag gi glegs bam 178

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3sogs bsdus la/ lha rje zur chung ba'i mdzub tshugs kyi bsam gtan las/ dad pas phul btags/ brtson 'grus kyi gzhu bdungs pa/ 'khor ba dpyis 'byin pa/ sems rus kyi thang gcod pa / bla ma lha ltar bkur ba/ man ngag snying ltar 'tsho ba/dam tshig so mtshams kyi mkhar ltar srung ba/ 'du 'dzi dug ltar spong ba/ gnas grogs ltar bsten pa/ byang chub kyi 'bras bu sgrub pa'i mi chen pos spro ba bsrings te bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos bcu ldan gyis bsgom par bya'o/ /sgom tshul dngos ni lam nges rdzogs kyi dbang du byas na/ thog mar stong chen gyi rnal 'byor sngar bshad pa bzhin byas la de'i dus su sgom pa'i skyon bying ba'am rgod pa byung na de ma thag ngos bzung ste gnyen po'i man ngag gis 'chos shing / skyon de dag zhi ba na rang babs su bzhag nas bsgoms pas rim gyis nyams lnga rdzogs par 'gyur la/ de'ang bskyed rim kho na'i nges rdzogs pa yin na dus der zhi gnas dang / rim gnyis stobs gcig tu nges rdzogs byed na dang por bskyed rim gyi stong chen la zhi gnas thob ste/ de'i 'og tu rdzogs rim gyi stong pa chen po'i ye shes skye la/ de skyes pa na sems g.yo byed kyi las rlung rang sar zhi bas 'od gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin la rlung med pa'i mar me'i rtse mo ltar g.yo med du 179

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gnas shing / de nyid mar me dang rang 'od kyi tshul du shes rab kyi snang ba rnon po dang mi 'bral la/ de dag kyang sems kyi gnyug ma'i cha yin pas ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab gzhan las ches phul du byung ba yin te/ mdor na rdzogs rim pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin grub pa yin no/ /de lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis ༄rlung sems legs par btul ba'i 'og tu snying rje sgyu ma sogs kyang nyams lnga rdzogs su sgom yang mthar phyin gyi nyams la sleb par sgom pa'i don yin gyi/ re re zhing g.yo ba'i nyams ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bur re yod par mi sems so/ /'di'i thad du lha sku sgom thabs kyi man ngag rnams kyang dran par bya ste/ de'ang mdo tsam bkod na/ skabs 'dir tha mal gyi snang zhen gcod pa'i snang phyogs kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can zhig skyed dgos shing / de la yul can gyi sems gsal ngar dang ldan pa tsam gyis mi chog gi/lha sku'i dmigs pa gsal zhing nga rgyal brtan pa zhig dgos te/de med na dag ma dag gi snang zhen go bzlog mi nus pa'i phyir ro//lha'i nga rgyal brtan pa'ang rten dang brten pa'i rnam pa gsal ba gzhir bzung ste bslabs pa las 'byung ba dang / rnam pa gsal ba la'ang thun mong dang khyad par gyi slob lugs gnyis yod par bi ma las lha sku sgom pa las bshad de/ thun mong ba ltar na/180

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3bde ba'i stan la lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas 'dug la/ mdun du bris sku tshad ldan bkram ste/ de'i gzugs brnyan la sems gtad nas mi ga rengs rengs su bltas pas yid ngor gsal zhing 'dris pa na de nyid la sems rtse gcig tu bzung /de'ang dang por lha sku mdun du sgom/ de la goms pa dang bdag nyid lhar sgom pa dang lam rnam bkod las ci rigs su bshad de/bdag lhar sgom tshul ni khyad par ba'i skabs bzhin byas pas chog pa 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par ba ltar na/ lam rim sogs las rim cig char gyi sgom tshul gnyis bshad pa'i dang po ni/ cho ga gsum bskyed dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab sogs byas nas sems 'dzin la bslab pa ste/ de'ang dmigs pa gsal ba'i yan lag tu lha sku sgom pa las dang po dbu yi gtsug tor gsal/ de nas zhal gyi mdangs la bslab/ de nas thugs kyi dpal be'u la/ zhes sogs ltar spyi'i rnam pa ma shor ba'i ngang nas sku'i cha so sor gsal btab la sgom/ brtan pa'i yan lag tu lha grangs dang sku'i tshad ma nges pa la slob par lha sku sgom pa de nyid las bshad pa ni/lha 'i ting nge 'dzin 'byongs pa'i 'og tu rtsal sbyang tshul yin gyi dang po nas de ltar byar mi rung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ lam rim las/181

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yang na phyag rgya chen po ste/ /chu las nya ldang ji bzhin du/ /zhes pa ltar lha sku skad cig dran rdzogs su wal gyis bskyed nas gzhan du ma yengs par de nyid la sems 'jog pa ste/ lha sku'i gsal snang skye myar bul gyi blo rim gcig tu ma nges pas de ltar phye'o/ /grol ra midzodami tsa mi zudang zurig tsa ra /)pe/ rwa palam cag char ba' skabs su zha lhag gnyas snga phya da par ba pa zhig kyang khas len dgos par mngon zhing / thabs lam pa la rdzogs rim gyi sngon du rim pa dang po'i zhi lhag gnyis ka thob pa dang / zhi gnas tsam thob pa'ang 'jog chog gam da dung mkhas pa rnams kyis gzu lum mi bya bar zhib tu dpyad dgos so/ /dgu ba mchod pa ni/ 'dir bstan gyi dbang du byas na/dkyil 'khor ba rnams tshim zhing mnyes par byed pa'i thabs kyis rab tu phye ba ste/ de la dbye na/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las phyag rgya dang lhag pa ting 'dzin sogs ci rigs shig gsungs pa la bshad rgyud dang yan lag gi rgyud kyis kha bskangs nas sgrub thabs rnams su bcu bzhir gsungs te/ de la mchod rdzas byin rlob dang / 'bul tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ mchod rdzas la tha mal pa'i rnam rtog ma bsal bar bla med kyi dkyil 'khor dgyes pa skyed pa'i rdo rje'i longs spyod du mi 'gyur la/ de lta na de la brten nas nyams chag skong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i tshogs rdzogs pa'i dgos pa'ang 182

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3sgrub mi nus pas mchod pa la byin rlabs thog mar 'gro ste/ de'i tshul ni/ phyag rgya bzhi pa'i bsam gtan ltar/ rang nyid las kyi rdo rje sems dpar bskyed de/ thugs ka nas rdzas so so'i sa bon spros te 'phro 'du dang sngags kyi rkyen gyis mchod rdzas thogs pa'i lha mo nam mkha' gang bar rlob pa thun mong phyi mchod rlob tshul dang /sman gyi snod gzhal yas khang lte ba rtsibs bzhi dang bcas pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sa bon zung lnga bkod/ cho ga gsum gyis rigs lnga yab yum du bskyed/ rjes chags kyi sbyor bas thams cad zhu ste snod ka pā lar bcud ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la oṃ dang / kha gcod kyi rdo rje rgya gram la rta mgrin gsang ba'i yum bzhi dang bcas pa bskyed/ mtheb srin gyis rdo rje bzang ba bdud rtsi la ༄reg ste bdud rtsi dgug pa'i sngags bzla zhing oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis 'khor 'das kyi bdud rtsi bkug pa dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la thim par bsams nas bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ 'di ni sman mchod kyi ched du ma zad/ ji skad du/ rnal 'byor ba la gtor byas na/ /rtog sgrib nyams chag dag par 'gyur/ /mchod pa'i rdzas la gtor byas pas/ /thams cad bdud rtsi nyid du 'gyur//mi mthun phyogs la gtor byas pas/ /drag po gtum po'ang 'jig par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar dgos pa gzhan yang mang ngo de 183

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin du gtor ma la oṃ bkod de 'phro 'du dang gtor sngags kyis 'dod yon gyi lha mo drug re re zhing grangs med par spros te spel ba dang / rak+tar las 'phro 'du dang sngags kyis rak+ta'i rgya mtshor rlob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las las kyi rdo rje sems dpa' zhig spros te shar sgor gnas pa ni mchod pa byed pa po yin la/ des mchod pa ci zhig byed pa la bcu bzhi ste/ de'ang sgyu 'phrul zhi ba dang sbyar na/ dang po phyag ni/ phyag 'tshal ba'i yul rten gnyis su mi dmigs par rtogs pa don gyi phyag dang /lha rnams kyi yon tan dran nas gus pas 'dud pa brda'i phyag gnyis zung 'brel du 'tshal zhing / lha tshogs rnams kyis lan gnang bar bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa phyag rgya ni 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar ro/ /gsum pa kun bzang ni/ chos thams cad rig pa rang snang du mnyam pa la bzang ngan dang blang dor ma grub pas mchod par ma gyur pa'i dngos po rdul tsam yang med de spyod yul yongs su dag pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'o/ /'di dang 'og ma rnams kyi sngags rgya sogs sgrub thabs ltar ro/ /bzhi pa zhabs bsil ni/ bsil chab thogs pa'i lha mos lan gsum du phul bas phyag dang zhabs dang zhal bsil bar bsam pa'o/ /lnga pa bzhi bsnol ni/ rdo rje spos ma sogs lha mo dpag med spros te/ shangs 184

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3la bdug spos/ dbu la me tog spyan la mar me/ thugs kar byugs pa rnams kyis mchod de/ mthar lha mo rnams kyang gnas de dang der thim pa dang / skyes lan gyi tshul du lha rnams kyi gnas de dag las lha mo bzhi slar byung nas las sems kyi shangs sogs gnas bzhir thim pas dngos grub thob par bsam pa ste/ de ltar skyes dang skyes lan gyi tshul gnyis bsnol mar byed pas na bzhi bsnol zhes brjod gsungs so/ /drug pa sman mchod ni/ bdud rtsi'i che ba brjod pa sngon du btang ste/ mtheb srin nyi zla kha sbyor gyi phyag rgyas gtor bas bdud rtsi'i zegs ma nam mkha' la sprin ltar chags pa las ra sa ya na'i char babs pas lha rnams gzi brjid bskyed cing / de nas rang gi lce la hūṃ dang sman la 'bru gsum bkod la mtheb srin gyis blangs nas lcer bzhag pas gnas gsum du chags te 'phro 'dus sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam pa'o/ /bdun pa gtor ma ni/ gtor ma 'dod yon gyi lha mo drug gi rnam par phul bas gzugs rdo rje ma dang me long spyan la dang / sgra rdo rje ma dang rgyud mangs snyan la sogs dbang po so so la thim nas mnyes par bsam pa'o/ /brgyad pa bdud rtsi gsang nan ni/ gsang nan nam rtsang nan zhes pa skyems kyi brda rnying ste/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gtor mar lan gsum sbreng pas dang 185

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pos lha rnams dgyes pa bskyed/ gnyis pas nyan thos rnams 'gog pa las bslang / gsum pas rgyal ba rnams gzhan don la bskul ba'o/ /dgu pa lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa ni/ sprul pa dang bsgyur ba gnyis las 'dir phyi ma ltar byed de/ bdag nyid las kyi sems dpa'i thugs ka nas rgyu yig spros pas sa gzhi dang khang khyim sogs dag pa'i zhing dang gzhal med khang du byin gyis rlob pa dang / tshul de bzhin du trī las rgyan dang nags tshal/hrīḥlas glu dbyangs/ a las khrus rdzing / oṃ las zhal zas/ me las gos dang / hūṃ las bro gar sogs re re'ang mtha' yas pa spros te mchod pa'o/ /bcu pa bsgral mchod ni/ rgyud nyid las/blo ngan 'jig rten snying re rje/ /zhes pa ltar 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang du song ba'i sems can rnams la snying rje bskyed de rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i ram̐ yig las ye shes kyi me 'bar bas bsgral bya'i snying nang gi sa bon drug bag chags dang bcas pa bsreg nas rnam shes 'od gsal gyi dgongs dbyings sa bstim pa'o/ /༄bcu gcig pa sbyor mchod ni/ lha tshogs rnams rjes chags kyis snyom par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i 'od zer spro bsdus rgyal ba thams cad mchod cing gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam la a nu rā ga'i sngags kyis nga rgyal bzung ba'o/ /bcu gnyis pa 'dod yon ro 186

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3mnyam ni/ snang srid thams cad 'dod yon gyi lha mor dag pas lha la lha dang chos nyid la chos nyid rol pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa'o//bcu gsum pa rol mo ye shes ni/ mchod pa'i yo byad ji snyed pa sems nyid kyi rol par sdud pa ste/ de rnams bsgrigs na/ dang po kun bzang gis 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi rnam pa yin min gyi rnam dbye med par ye shes kyi rang snang kho nar bltas te mchod pa dang / de nas dgus dag pa'i 'dod yon gyi bye brag so sor sprul te mchod pa dang / phyi ma 'dis de dag thams cad ye shes kyi dbyings su ro gcig par bsdus nas mdor na snang spyod ma lus pa dgyes mnyam chen po'i ye shes rtsal 'bar ba'i grogs su 'khyer ba nyid mchod pa'i lam gyi gnad yin pas/ rol mo ye shes kyi mthar ma hā pū dza badz+ra zhes sogs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i rdo rjer nga rgyal bzung ba gsungs te mchod pa ra ma zad bla med kyi rgyud las 'dod yon lam khyer gyi thabs mkhas ji snyed bstan pa rnams kyi gnad gzer yang 'di nyid do/ /bcu ba zhi pa glu ye shes ni/ dkyil 'khor lha rnams la che ba'i yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa'i glu chos nyid kyi rang sgra'i dbyangs su grags par mos la bstod pa glu drug blang ba'o/ /khro bo la'ang phal cher de dang 'dra ba las/ dgu pa'i gnas su rak+ta tshar gsum ste lha 187

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshogs rnams mnyes par bya ba'i phyir dang / zhing bcu sogs gdug can rnams brlag pa'i phyir dang / khams gsum gyi 'dul dka'i 'gro ba rnams thugs rjes sgrol ba'i phyir go rim bzhin du rak+ta'i dwangs ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsir dang / khu ba bsgral byar dang / rtsigs ma dug gsum sha rus kyi rnam par byas te 'bul ba'i ched du rak+ta lan gsum sbrong ba'o/ /spro na tshogs mchod kyi cho ga'i tshul yang gnas su stobs pa mchod pa'i skabs 'dir bshad par bya'o/ /bcu pa sngags rgya la gnyis las/ dang po sngags ni/ thabs she sa kyi yi ge a li ka li tshogs pa'am rkyang pa ci rigs la bzhag pa'i grub pa bzhi ldan gyi ngag gtso bor gyur pa ste/ thugs thig las/ yi ge 'dus pa grub pa bzhi/ /mthu chen red pa gang yin pa/ /zhes so/ /grub pa bzhi'i grangs 'dren ni sngar bshad pa bzhin te/yi ge'i rang bzhin mtha bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos dbyings sa ri bca riri byiganas pa dang / sgyu ma tsam du ming tshig yi ge la brten nas phan gnod kyi bya ba sna tshogs 'byung ba ba lang rdzi'i bar la grags pa dang / sngags pas sangs rgyas byang sems sogs mthu ldan rnams kyis sngags tshig tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas bzlas pas ngag la nus pa phul byung skye ba dang / des sngags kyi 188

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3lha'i thugs rgyud 'khul nas sgo gsum byin gyis rlob pa rnams so/ /spyir ni sngags la ngag kho nas ma khyab cing / gsang bdag zhal lung las/ thabs shes kyi bdag nyid de'i sgo yig 'brur snang bas gsang ste ngag tu brjod pa dang bcas shing shes skyob kyi las kyis log rtog gi gnyen por 'gyur ba ni gsang sngags/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi bdag nyid dngos po'i don rig par byed pa'i las kyis ma rtogs pa'i gnyen por gyur pa ni rig sngags/ dran pa dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid chos kyi tshig don mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i las kyis dran nyams kyi gnyen por gyur pa ni gzungs sngags te/'di gsum gyi rtags kyang / dang po lha pho'i dbyibs dang / phyi ma gnyis lha mo'i gzugs su bzhugs zhes 'byung ngo / /zhes pa ltar gsum du dbye ba sogs yod kyang / rtsa rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa'i sngags kyi rnam grangs ni/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i dang / lha bskyed pa'i dang / las kyi rim pa'i sngags te gsum las/ dang po ni/ pho brang gi sa bon dang / rkyen gyi sngags gnyis rim bzhin r+ghaṃ zhes pa dang bi shwa/ bi shud+dha zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa la zhi khro'i sngags gnyis las/ dang po la'ang / rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i dang / bskyed pa rkyen gyi dang / bzlas pa las kyi sngags so/ /dang po ni/ gang zhig yongs su gyur pa las lhar 189

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bskyed pa'i sa bon gyi sngags la lha sku'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i sngags zhes brjod pa yin pas gzhan du phreng ba'i sngags la rtsa ba'i sngags su bshad pa sogs dang mi 'dra'o/ /de la'ang / le'u bzhi pa las gsungs pa'i yi ge sgyu 'phrul dang / bdun pa las gsungs pa'i hūṃ s+t+waṃ sogs rigs kyi sa bon du grags pa gnyis dang / phyi ma la'ang ming yig dang po yin min gnyis yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/gang zhig brjod pa'i rkyen gyis phyag mtshan rdo rje sogs las lha 'i skur 'gyur ba'i rkyen gyi sngags te/ 'di la sgrub thabs su/ hūṃ sogs sa bon dang badz+ra sgrika sogs gnyis char tshogs pa 'byung yang / 'grel pa las badz+ra sgrika sogs tsam las ma bshad pas bskyed sngags dang bskyed sngags rkyang pa gnyis las gsum du phye ba'i bskyed sngags la rkyang pa kho na 'jog dgos sam snyam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ sa bon dang bskyed sngags sbrel ba ste/ 'di ni dzab kyi las la 'jug che bas las sngags zhes btags sam brtag go/ /gnyis pa la'ang gsum las/ rtsa sngags ni/ hūṃ ha he phaṭa bh+yo rnams khrag 'thung gnas yul sgo dbang rnams kyi'o/ /bskyed sngags ni/ khrag 'thung lnga la oṃ badz+ra ma hā shrī sogs dang / gnas yul sgom la badz+ra ste dbang rtags rdo rje mtshon pa'i mthar gau ri sogs so so'i ming sbyar ba dang / dbang phyug ma'i bskyed sngags 190

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3rtsa ba'i rgyud las ma gsungs kyang bshad rgyud rdo rjer ma nu rak+ka sī sogs 'byung bas kha bskang ngo / bzlas sngags ni/ badz+ra ma hā shrī sogs bskyed sngags la ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sogs las sngags btags pa ste/'di rtsa bskyed las gsum gyi nang gi las sngags yin la/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa man chad ma gtogs las sngags su mi 'jog par bshad pa ni las la skul ba'i sngags kyi dbang du byas par mngon pas las sngags kyi 'jog tshul gnyis su 'gyur ba 'dra'o/ /kha cig rtsa bskyed las gsum phrin las skul ba'i sngags dang bzhir bzhed pa'ang snang ngo / /'khor rnams la rtsa bskyed sbrel ba las sngags su 'jog pa sngar dang 'dra la/ de rnams so so'i mthar/ k+shi mo hūm̐ dzaḥlta bu gang 'dod kyi sngags sham btags na las la skul ba'i sngags su'ang 'gyur gsung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ le'u bdun pa dang bcu drug pa las snyan gsan dbab pa dang / spyan drangs pa dang /rig me dor ba/ bskul zhing bsnyim pa/ dbang bskur byin rlob kyi sngags dang / khro bo mchod pa'i glu rnams so/ /gsal bkra las/ /rtag tu bzlas pa byas pa ni/ /byang chub gzungs la zhugs pa yin//zhes pa ltar dngos grub spyi dang khyad par gsung rdo rje sgrub pa'i ched du gsungs pa'i gtso bo ni bzlas sngags yin pas/ bzlas brjod ji ltar bya ba'i tshul yang bshad na/ lam rim las/ skyon 191

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bcu spangs te rnam gsum gyis/ /bzlas pa grangs bzhin rdzogs par bya/ /zhes bshad de/ de la skyon bcu ni/ rngam glog las/ sgra chen ma yin chung ba min/ /mgyogs par ma yin bul bar min/ /drag por ma yin zhan par min/ /yig 'bru yan lag nyams pa min/ /yengs pas ma yin smra bzhin min/ /glal sogs bar du chod pas min/ /zhes pa ltar ha cang sgra che ba dang chung ba sogs so//rnam pa gsum ni bzla tshul te/ de la'ang gsal ba gsum dang /phyi nang gsang gsum dang / phra mo gsum gyi bzla lugs rnams las/dang po ni/ bdag dam tshig sems dpa' gsal ba dang / de las mdun du phye ba'i ye shes sems dpa' gsal ba dang / dam tshig pa las ye shes pa la 'od zer spro bsdu 'gal me'i 'khor lo lta bur gsal ba ste/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis bzlas pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dam ye phye nas spro bsdu zhal nas zhal dang gsang ba nas gsang bar 'khor ba'i tshul gyis bzla ba dang / phar spros sgrib pa sbyang bar skul zhing tshur bsdus sgrib pa sbyangs nas dngos grub kyi snod rung du bya ba ste phyir ltar bzla ba'i sgo gnyis dang / ye shes sems dpa' 'byed dam mi 'byed kyang rung ste/ phar spros dngos grub bskul nas tshur bsdus dngos grub thob par bsam pa nang ltar bzla tshul dang / phar mi spro bar tshur dngos grub bsdud 192

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3dmigs kho na bya ba dang / yab yum gnyis kyi zhal nas zhal dang mkha' nas gsang bar 'khor ba dmigs pa ste gsang ba ltar bzla tshul gnyis so/ /gsum pa la'ang tshul gnyis te/ yig 'bra dang //re/ ༄༄mishāje)phyag mtshan dang / lha sku phra mo spro bsdu rim ba na bya ba la da gas pa'i bzlas brjod dang / dbugs 'jug gnas ldang gsum sngags dang sbyar ba'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o/ /de ltar gang mos kyi sgo nas rab lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma rnyed pa'am sems brtan pa'i drod tshad thob pa dang / 'bring lo gcig gam zla ba drug sogs ji srid bzla bar dam bcas pa de srid du bzla ba dang /tha ma gtso bo la bye ba dang / 'khor rnams la khri phrag re bzla bar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa phyag rgya ni/ rig pa phyag rgya bzhi rdzogs kyi lha'i skur gsal ba las mi 'da' ba zhes bshad de/ sgo gsum bya ba dang bcas pa yongs dag gi ngo bor brtan cing mi shigs par byed pa bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi mtshan mar gyur pa ste/ rgyas pa las/'da' dka' ji bzhin mi shigs pa'i/ /rgyal po'i phyag rgya mchog gi gnas/ /bdag nyid chen po'i mtshan ma'i gzugs/ /phyag rgya zhes ni bsgrags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ gtso bor lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de la zhi khro'i phyag 193

staXd+ma/ 3 lngardo grub 'jigs cesad bstan nyi'i gsung 'dra/myo//rgya gnyis las/ dang po la/ phyag rgya 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga la dpa' bo 'bru lnga dang / g.yon gyi sor mo lnga la dpa' mo 'bru lnga bkod nas thal mo sbyar ba ste/ 'di phyag rgya thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba ni phyag rgya'i dngos grub thams cad kyi gzhi thabs dang shes rab mnyam par sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor du mtshon pa'o/ /de nas rigs lnga spyi'i dam rgya ni/ le'u brgyad par/ oṃ dang hūṃ gnyis rtse sbyar te/ /'bru brgyad bsnol nas rtse sprad pa/ /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /bde ba chen po sbyin pa'i rgya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /sor mo 'di ltar bsnol ba'i rgyu mtshan la gsung rgyun du grags pa 'gar lha rnams gzhan rigs la 'khyud par rigs pa'i phyogs nas bshad pa mthong yang / 'di skor gyi khungs tshad ldan ma rnyed la/ thal ba las/ dbyings dang ye shes bdag po nyid/ /oṃ dang hūm̐ du rang bzhin gnas/ /rwa dang 'dab ma'i thig le rnams/ /rang gi gnas kyi bsnol mar 'gyur/ /rab tu'ang 'dres par 'gyar ba las/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes bde chen po/ /myong phyir ༄thob pa zhes su gsungs/ /zhes 'byung ba las dpag na/ dbyings stong phyogs mtshon pa'i lha'i gtso bo dbyings phyug ma dang / ye shes snang phyogs mtshon pa la gtso shos rnam snang gi ye ge gnyis 194

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3mnyam sbyor du bcing zhing / sangs rgyas kyi rigs tha dad mang po thabs shes bsres pa'i bde bas mi phyed par bsdams nas lha rtog dbyer med du brten pas rgyas 'debs pa'i ched du sor mo phal cher bsnol mar sbyar la/ ma bsnol ba zung gcig yod kyang rigs 'dres pa dang ma 'dres pa'i bde ba 'dus shing bsres par 'gyur bas mdor na rigs thams cad kyi bde ba bsdams pa'i phyag rgya yin zhes bshad du rung ngam snyam ste dpyad gzhi tsam mo/ /so so'i phyag rgya ni/ re re'ang phyag rgya bdun sbrags su bya ste/ mi bskyod pa la mtshon na/ rang lha de'i skur sgom pa phyag chen/ lag pa g.yas pa'i gung mo thugs kar bsgreng ba bca' ba dam rgya/ de'i rtse mor hūṃ yig bsam pa la bsam pa chos rgya/ de la rdo rje rtse lnga bsam pa bsam pa dam rgya/ g.yon pa'i 'bru lnga sbas nas dril bu bsil zhing lha mo la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis zhabs g.yon la brten pa bca' ba las rgya/ de ltar bsam pa bsam pa las rgya/ phyag rgya g.yas nas bcas te mdun du bsgyur nas g.yon du yum gyi thugs kar dgrol ba dang lhan cig badz+ra sgrika ces brjod pa chos rgya ste/ phyi ma 'di'i bsgyur zhing dgrol ba ni bca' ba dang bsam pa las rgya'i khongs su gtogs pa 'dra'o/ /de ni shes rab la thabs kyis rgyas 'debs pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ hūṃ bsgreng rtse mor dril bsil 'bar/ /195

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhes sogs ltar dbyings phyug ma'i phyag rgya bdun ldan gyis thabs la shes rab kyis rgyas 'debs pa sogs lhag ma rnams la'ang ci rigs su sbyar ro/ /bsdus pa la dga' bas spyi'i dam rgya tsam bcings pas kyang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mnyes pa dang rgyas 'debs kyi dgos pa 'grub par gsungs so/ /khro bo'i phyag rgya ni/rtsa ba'i rgyud 'dir ma gsungs kyang / bshad rgyud rgyas pa dang rdo rje me long sogs nas kha skong ba ste ma spros so//sgrub thabs kyi mchod pa'i yan lag tu lhag par bsngags pa'i phyag rgya de ltar yin kyang / spyir lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med kyi gnad la rtogs goms las su rung ba'i sngags pas yan lag gi bsgul bskyod phra mo tshun chad de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya 'ba' zhig tu bye brag med par 'gyur ba'i tshul/ le'u brgyad par/mdor na bsgul bskyod thams cad kun/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du gnas/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /dngos po bcu'i ya gyal gyi sngags rgya gnyis ka'i gzhi mthun yang yod mod kyi/ gnyis su phye ba ni ngag tu brjod pa dang lag pas bca' ba gtso bor gyur pa'i khyad par gyis yin zhes rong zom chen po bzhed do/ /bzhi pa rgyud kyi dgos 'brel ni/ thugs thig las/ brjod 'brel dgos pa yang dgos dang / /rgyu rkyen yan lag bzhi ru 196

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar yan lag bzhi ste/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rgyud gsum brjod bya/ de mtshon byed yi ge'i rgyud ni rjod byed de/brjod bya gang ston la mi ltos par rjod byed dang dgos pa'i 'brel pa brtsir mi btub pas de ltar smos kyi/ yan lag bzhi 'i dang po dngos ni rjod byed do/ /rjod byed de la brten nas brjod bya'i don de tshang la ma nor bar shes pa ni dgos pa/ de ltar shes nas nyams su blangs pas las bzhi dang 'byung lnga'i dngos grub sogs thun mong gi dngos grub bsam pa bzhin du 'byung ba ni nying dgos dgos sam dgos pa'i dgos pa phra mo dang / slob pa dang mi slob pa'i zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'grub pa ni nying dgos gtso bo/ 'brel ba la brjod bya rjod byed gnyis shes bya shes byed dang / rjod byed dang dgos dgos pa thabs las thabs byung dang dgos pa dang nying dgos de las de byung dang /nying dgos dang brjod bya ngo bo bdag gcig gis 'brel zhes gsungs te/ 'di dag la 'brel ba dngos btags ci rigs yod cing / skabs don dngos ni nying dgos pa las 'byung / dgos pa rjod byed las 'byung ba'i de byung 'brel nyid yin te/ nying dgos don du gnyer ba'i 'khor rnams de lta bu'i 'brel ba mthong nas rjod byed rgyud gzhung len cing 'dzin pa la 'jug pa yin pa'i 197

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phyir ro/ /'on te grol lam gyis dngos grub sgrub tshul lta bu dang bstun na nying dgos dang brjod bya la bdag gcig 'brel brtsis pa 'dir yang go rgyu dmigs bsal zhig yod dam snyam mo/ /spyir ni dgos sogs chos bzhi bstan pa gdul bya gzhung de la dang por 'jug pa'i ched yin pas gzhung gi sngon du bshad par bya ba yin yang 'dir rgyud kyi dngos po rdzogs ba'i mthar smos pa ni/ ji srid rgyud 'di ma nub par 'jig rten na gnas shing spyod pa de srid du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub kyi 'byor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bas dngos sam brgyud nas sems can rnams la don chen po'i sgor 'gyur bar gzigs te/ ston pas 'khor rnams la rgyud kyi rgyal po 'dzin par nan gyis gdams shing bkas gtad pa yin zhes gdams gtad kyi 'phros btsal ba la bshad na legs par mngon no/ /lnga ba 'khor la gdams shing gtad pa ni/ gdams pa bzhi dang gtad pa gsum ste/ dang po ni/ rgyud 'dir gnas lugs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du rtogs par gyis shig ces gzhi rang bzhin gyi snang ba rtogs byar gdams pa dang /'dir gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rgyu 'bras bshad pa rnams ni dag 198

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3bya'am sbyang bya ngos bzung ba'i ched yin pas 'khrul pa'i kun rtog sbyang ba la brtson par gyis shig ces log rtog 'khrul pa'i snang ba dag byar gdams pa dang / 'di nas bshad pa'i lam 'di theg pa thams cad kyi skyel so dang sa lam gang nas zhugs kyang grub don gcig tu 'bab pa chu klung mtha' dag 'du ba'i rgya mtsho lta bu yin pas 'di kho na la skyes bu'i rtsal ci yod phyung nas slob par gyis shig ces gdul bya lam gyi snang ba bgrod byar gdams pa dang /de ltar lam 'di mthar phyin pa na bdag don bla na med pa'i ye shes la dbang 'byor zhing ci mdzad gzhan phan gyi phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam par 'jug pas don gnyis kyi bsam pa yongs sa rdzogs pa yin no zhes 'bras ba bde gshegs kyi snang ba thob riri ༅ riribargyabyar gdams pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ khog gzhung las/ sdud pa po dang bud med dang / /rnal 'byor mig ldan sogs la'o/ /zhes pa bzhin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i chos mdzod 'dzin pa po khyod yin na gsang don 'di las mthar thug pa gzhan med pas 'di nyid brtan por zungs shig ces bka'i sdud pa po 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje la gtad pa dang / gang zhig rgyud 'di phyin ci ma log par gzhan la 'doms pa de ni bla med byang chub tu lung bstan thob pa dang / der ma zad ston pa kun tu 199

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzang po dngos dang 'dra bar blta bar bya ba yin no zhes phyi rabs kyi gang zag skal ba mchog dang ldan pa rnams snod ldan la rgyud 'chad par spro ba bskyed nas gtad pa dang / bud med la gtad pa ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i zhing khyad par can sogs na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs la gtad pa ste/ rgyud 'di'i tshig zin la med kyang sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa las gsungs te/ji skad du/ nga yi thags kyi snying po 'di/ /phyogs bcu kun tu spel ༄ba dang / /de yi gzungs la gtad pa ni/ /zhes sogs so/ /don bsdus nas de dag rjes 'jug la sbyar na/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i mchog thun mong gi dngos grub gang yang sgrub pa nan tan dang bral na 'grub pa'i go skabs med pas rgyud sde mnyan nas go yul tsam du ma bzhag par rgyud nyid nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin sgrub pa snying por byos la rang gi rgyud grol bar gyis shig ces pa ni gdams pa'i don dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi chos kyi 'khor lo sems can dpag tu med pa'i rgyud la gcig nas gcig tu bar ma chad par brgyud pa'i tshul gyis 'khor zhing 'jug pa ni nyan bshad la rag las pas snod ldan la ma sbas par rgyud smin pa'i rim pa bzhin du legs par shod cig ces pa ni gtad pa'i don gtso bo yin la/ bstan pa la sdang ba tshar gcod pa dang / bstan 'dzin 200

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod 3rnams kyi dpung dang grogs byed pa sogs phrin las rnam pa bzhi ji ltar rigs pa'i thabs kyis bstan pa'i don bya ba'am de'i 'khor du yod do/ /gnyis pa tshig gi rnam grangs rnam par dbye ba ni/ yi ge 'dus pa las ming / ming 'dus pa las tshig de las tshigs su bcad pa dang / lhug pa dang / spel ma dang / le'u la sogs pa'i rim pas brjod bya don gyi rgyud mtshon par nus pa'i rjod byed sgra'i rgyud kyi gzhung du grub pa yin te/ 'di nyid las/ yi ge sgra btags ming tshogs la/ /brten pa'i tshig gis rab mtshon te/ /zhes gsungs/ de la'ang sgrar snang ba dang / sgrar grags pa dang /brdar gyur pa'i rgyud gzhung gsum yod cing / rtsa rgyud kyi cha dang gang gis don gang ston che long tsam ni/ le'u dang po dang /gsum pa'i stod dang / bco lnga pa rnams kyis gleng gzhi dang /le'u gnyis pas gleng bslang dang / bcing med rnam par grol med pa'i/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos/ /zhes pas gzhi rgyud kyang bstan/ /lam rgyud las mtshan nyid gsum mdo tsam bcu gnyis pa dang / rgyas pa le'u lnga pa las bstan/ lta ba le'u gsum pa'i smad dang bcu gcig pas bstan/ spyod pa le'u bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pas bstan/ dkyil 'khor ston pa la zhi dkyil 201

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang po dang drug pas bstan/ khro dkyil bco lnga pa dang bcu bdun pas/ zhi khro'i lhag pa gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor dgu pas/ tshogs dkyil bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pas ston/dbang gi dkyil 'khor dang der 'jug pa dang snod dang 'tsham par bskur tshul sogs dgu pas/ dbang bskur thabs dngos bcu pas/ dam tshig bcu dgu pas/ phrin las la me'i phrin las zur tsam dgu par dang gtso bor nyi shu pas ston/ sgrub pa bzhi ba dang lnga pas/ ting nge 'dzin la ting nge 'dzin gyi phan yon dang sgom thabs sogs lnga pas/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang rdzogs rim thabs grol gyi ting nge 'dzin rgyas par bcu gsum pas/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug pa sogs kyis ston/ mchod pa la/ zhi ba phyag rgya'i mchod pa brgyad pas/ lhag ting gi mchod pa dgu pas/ glu ye shes bcu bzhi pas/ sbyor sgrol dang dam rdzas kyi mchod pa bco brgyad pas/ khro bstod nyer gcig pas ston/ sngags rgya gnyis las sngags kyi rtsa ba yi ge'i 'khor lo bzhi pas/ zhi ba'i sngags bdun pas/ khro bo'i sngags bcu drug pas/ phyag rgya brgyad pas/ gdams gtad nyer gnyis pas bstan te/ 'di dang zhal lung gi tshig zin la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod kyang don gyi gnad gcig pa kho na yin no/ /de dag la sogs 202

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3pa rgyud kyi dgongs don mtha' dag zhib par ni/ le'u bcu gsum pa las/ khong nas gab sbas don 'byin pa/ /ston pa rdo rje'i thugs la gnas/ /zhes bka' bstsal pa ltar ston pa kun tu bzang po nas man ngag gi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa mnga' ba'i rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas rgyud gzhung 'khrugs pa bsdebs/ gcus pa bsrang / gab pa mngon du phyung ba'i tshul gyi legs par phye ba'i nyi zer la brten nas skal bzang rnams kyi blo'i pad+mo sad par byas te khyab bdag drug pa'i phrin las phyogs dus thams cad du rgyas par bya'o/ / bshad rgyud chu bo bzhi yis rgyas byas shing / /dngos grub nor bu'i kha dog stong gis bkra/ /rig 'dzin klu dbang rnams kyi rtse dga'i gnas/ /dpal ldan snying po'i rgyud rgyal zab mo'i mtshor/ /zhugs nas don thob gna' dus mang byung yang / /dus kyi dbang gis nyung ngur gyur mthong ste/ /ded dpon mkhas pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ /legs bshad gru yi 'khrul 'khor gsar ba byas/ /'on kyang mchog tu brling ba'i rdo rje'i gnas/ /nyam chung byis pa'i rtsal gyis dbye dka' bas/ /nongs par gang gyur rdo rje can la 'chags/ /bzod par dgongs nas tshangs pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod/ /chos mchog zhing la ngal ba'i sa bon 'ga'/ /bskyed 203

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las rgyu mthun sdong po cher rgyas te/ /zab lam ro bda'i 'bras ster nyan bshad kyi/ /yal 'dab phyogs dus khyab par bre gyur cig/phyi snod gsang chen rgyud sde'i mdzod du gyur/ /nang bcud 'gro kun rig 'dzin tshom bur sad/ /brtan g.yo mtha' dag sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gcig tu byang chub shog /dpal gsang ba snying bo'i rgyud kyi spyi don nyung ngu'i ngag gis rnam par 'byed pa rin chen mdzod kyi lde mig ces bya ba 'di ni/ sngon chad rnying bstan rin po cher gcig tu sman pa'i lhag bsam can bla ma dam pa ye shes 'od zer rgya mtshos bskul ngor spyi don zhig bris pa de dus rang nyid na tshod ma rdzogs shing rgyud gzhung la 'dris cha chung ba'i skabs yin pas 'dus gsal zhig ma byung ba'i tshul smras pa sogs la brten nas/ dad brtson rnam dpyod yangs shing thos bsam gyi nor dang ldan pa'i sdom brtson kun dga' blo gros kyis rgyud bshad la ngal ba dang len gyi zhabs tog bzang po sgrub skabs/rin chen dkar po dang / gos dbang mdog myur bde'i bzhon pa 'char ka'i snang ba lta bu'i kha dog can sogs maṇ+ḍal du phul te nan tan chen pos bskul ba dang / rtsod bral dus babs kyi 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i gter ston chen po rig 'dzin las rab gling pa'i bka' bstsal rin po che'i phreng bas bskul zhing / yi ge'i grogs 204

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3dan mdzad pas mtshams sbyar te/ bstan pa rgya mjo'i mnga' bdag snyigs dus kyi sangs rgyas mtshan brjod par dka' ba kun mkhyen bla ma rdo rje gzi brjid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs shing /dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdo rje slob dpon mkhas shing dngos grub kyis brgyan pa pad+ma badz+ra zhabs sogs rdo rje 'dzin dbang du ma'i spyan sngar dpal ldan sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbang / rgyud bshad/ man ngag dang bcas pa'i bka' drin thob pa mdo khams rdo yul gyi chos smra ba'i gzugs brnyan 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas rab tshes me 'brag gi lo rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten dbyar gyi dga' ston la ༄rol pa rdzogs ldan gnyis pa'i dus su sbyar ba 'dis kyang phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gsang chen snying po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa sgo thams cad nas phyogs thams cad dang dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /maṅga lo/ /o swa sti/ 'phags pa'i zhing khams bod yul gangs can 'dir/ /paṇa grub chos rgyal smon lam nang 'dzom pas/ /dang por gsang sngags bstan pa'i klong rdol ba/ /snga 'gyur rnying ma zhes byar grags 'di yin/ /rma gnyags be+e ro gnubs chen khu dbon dang / /zur pa mes dbon nyang rog rong zom sogs/ /'grub brnyes rig 'dzin rgyal ba dngos 'dra ba/ /grangs med brgyud pa rin chen 'di nang byung / /de rnams kun gyi pha nor gces pa'i dbyig /yo ga gsum gyi don bsdus rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /da lta'i bar du bshad rgyun ma nub par/ /legs gnas dpal ldan gsang ba'i snying por nges/ /don 205

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/thongade dgongs nas lnga bdo'i dus mthar yang / /rgyal ba'i phrin las spel la zla bral ba/ /gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer yab sras kyis/ /rgyud 'di'i bshad srol 'bad pa brgya yis bzung / /bdag 'dra'ang bka' brgyud de yi rjes skyes shing / /kun mkhyen dgyes pa'i bka' lung thob gyur pas/ /gsar bu'i blo can rang 'dra 'ga' yi ched/ /spyi don rnam bshad nyung la gsal ba brtsams/ /gang de dad 'dun lhag bsam ldan pa 'gas/ /'bad pas spar du bzhengs pa'i legs tshogs rgyun/ /snying po'i bstan pa'i zungs su smin gyur te/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i phrin las rgyas byed shog /'brel thogs kun kyang dam chos spyod pa la/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi 'byung zhing / /mthun rkyen legs dgu'i brten 'brel phun tshogs te/ /don gnyis 'byor pa rgya mtsho rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang chos skor bla ma kun dga' blo gros dang / g.yung shul bla ma gsung mchog rdo rje sogs nas rgyu yon bstabs shing / mkhyen dbang a mdo zhabs drung mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / dge tshul bde lo sogs gzhan 'ga' res kyang mthun rkyen zur gsos sbyar ba la brten nas/ nye gnas blo gros mos ldan gyi do dam pa byas te/ spyi don mdzod lde spar du brkos pa'i spar byang du bstan pa'i nyi mas sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //206
༄/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dpal rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgrang yas srid dang zhi ba'i chos so cog /snang ba'i gar mkhan gcig gyur bde ba che/ /rig dang stong pa mi phyed rdo rje sems/ /gang yin de la dang por phyag bgyi'o/ /shin tu phra ba 'od gsal chen po'i sems/ /gnyis snang glo bur 'khrul pa'i rgyar 'thums pa/ /sbyong byed thabs grol lam gyi rdo rje sems/ /nges don gsang ba'i snying por phyag bgyi'o/ /'og min zhing du mngon byang chub pa'i sku/ /gsang mchog dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bo ru/ /lhun rdzogs dang po'i mgon po mi bskyod pa/ /kha sbyor bzhi ldan chen por phyag bgyi'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang dgongs pa'i mthil/ /theg mchog rgyud sde rgya mcho re snang ba ches/ /grangs med dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i shul mtshon pa/ /brgyud gsum bla ma rnams la phyag bgyi'o/ /'di na rgyud don dpyod pa'i skal phra yang / /rdo rje'i mched kyis bskul ba don yod phyir/ /dpal ldan zur pa'i bshad srol gzhir bzung ste/sngon byung bskyar zlos kho na'i gtam du gleng / /de la 'dir dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen 208

thar tā/ 'o/jisnye95 drwa ba:re zla/cad spyo) /gra cardon ngab/ 'o/dresas sdo/ bte/da pa/ 21rngad/ 3po'i rgyud kyi brjod bya spyi'i ngag gis cung zad rnam par phye ba la/ston pas ji ltar gsungs tshul/ de las brgyud tshul/ brgyud pa de ldan gyi rgyud don dngos dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon nyi 'od seng ges rgya cher 'grel du/ ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus/ 'og min du gsang ba sngags kyi chos gsungs pa'i tshe de dang dus mtshungs par mi yul du mchog gi sprul skus yul dbus 'gyur 'chang du sangs rgyas tshul ma bstan pa'i gong du gsungs zhes bshad/ slob dpon sgeg pa rdo rjes spar khab tu ni/ mchog gi sprul skus mi yul du theg pa thun mong ba bshad pa dang dus mtshungs par ston pas 'og min du gsungs par bshad do/ /zhes sngon gyi slob dpon dag 'chad kyang de gnyis la 'jog tshul so so ba med de/ mi yul du gsang sngags kyi chos gsungs pa na 'og min du ston pa longs spyod rdzogs skus kyang gsang sngags gsungs/de'i 'og tu mi yul du 'tshang rgya tshul bstan/ phyis su thun mong gi theg pa mi yul du bshad pa na'ang 'og min du gsang bsngags 'chad bzhin pa'i gnas skabs yin pa rnams gtan mi 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar ston pa'i sku rnams pa thams cad pas sems can gyi mos pa'i rjes sa 'brang ba'i chos sna tshogs sa go rigasir+sha rigaci bar mdzad pa ni/ 'jam dpal sgyu drwa'i bshad rgyud las/ 'og 209

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/min gnas dang ri rab rtse/ /'dzam bu gling du grags pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' lha rnams dang / /mi rnams kyi ni don du gsungs/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen dang / /sprul sku 'khor los sgyur ba dang / /shākya thub pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /dus ni gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus/ /'khor rnams 'dus pa'i dus der gsungs/ /zhes ji skad gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bshad rgyud rgya mtsho las/ rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor pa/ /dgongs pa rig pa rna bar brgyud/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ sems dpa' rig brgyud/ rnal 'byor rna brgyud dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ ye shes rang snang gi 'og min chen po'i gnas su/ ston pa rigs drug pa kun tu bzang pos/ nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor rgyal ba rigs lnga/ rgyal sras sems dpa' 'joms byed khro bo sogs gtso dang 'khor gyi rnam par rol pa thams cad rgyal ba gcig gi thugs bde stong gi rol mor snang ba kho na las gzhan du mi dmigs pa'i phyir dgongs pa so so ma yin pa la brgyud pa'i tha snyad tsam zhig btags pa'o//gnyis pa ni/ rgyud 'chad pa'i skyes ba rdo rje mi bskyod pa la ༄sogs pas/ rang las rgyud tha dad pa'i rgyal sras sems dpa'i 210

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3tshogs la brjod du med par sku'i rnam rig gi brda' thabs kho nas go bar mdzad pa nyid la bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni/ thog mar rig 'dzin mi ma yin las brgyud pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'jam dpal gzhon tshul mdzes pa'i sku dang ldan pas lha yi gnas su lha grags ldan phyogs skyong la bshad de lha'i rig 'dzin rnams la dar bar byas/ spyan ras gzigs bdud rtsi sman gyi sku dang ldan pas klu'i gnas su klu rgyal mgrin pa nag po la bshad de dar bar byas/ phyag na rdo rje 'jigs gzugs bsdigs pa'i sku dang ldan pa des gnod sbyin gyi gnas su gnod sbyin kun tu bzang po la bshad de dar bar byas pa rnams so//rig 'dzin mi dang mi ma yin pa gnyis ka las brgyud pa'i dbang du na/ ston pa shākya'i rgyal po mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad lon pa na dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga nang du yang dag 'jog las langs te ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse mo seng ge'i za 'gram lta bur gyar pa'i gnas su rdzu 'phral gyi bya bas zhwag sna ra༄rdor zirab zurang rwaziga'adus nas phyags bcu' sangs rgyas thams cad yad la byas ta/kye ma kyi hud kye ma'i klong / /ston pa sgron me'i 'od nub na/ /'jig rten mun pa gang gis seme/ /zhes sogs gdung tshig nyi shu rtsa gsum bton pas kun tu bzang po nyid gsang ba'i bdag po 211

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phyag na rdo rje'i rnam par bstan nas sngar 'og min du gsungs pa'i gsang sngags kyi chos rnams slar yang bskyar zlos kyi tshul du gsung bar dgongs te/ ji skad du/ sems kyi dkyil 'khor me long bzhin/ /bstan pa de ltar bdag gis kyang / /thog ma tha ma med pa ru/ /bdag gis dam bca' mi 'dor bas/ /bskul ba'i don ni gang byung ba/ /bdag kyang de bzhin cho 'phrul snang / /zhes chos snang ba'i cho 'phrul gyis ri ma la ya'i rtser gshegs te bla na med pa'i theg pa nyid sngar lha gnas gsum du ji ltar byung ba bzhin/tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes shing / de rnams srin po blo gros thabs ldan gyis yi ger btab ste/ ji ltar na/ dgongs pa'i rtsal bdun du grags pa/ gser gyi byang bu bri gzhi phun sum tshogs par dgongs pa/ baiḍūr+ya zhun ma bri rgyu phun sum tshogs par dgongs pa/ rin po che'i sgrom bu snod phun sum tshogs par dgongs pa/ 'byung bzhis mi shigs pa'i nam mkha' gnas phun sum tshogs par dgongs pa/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams srung ma phun sum tshogs par dgongs pa/ las can rgyal po dzaḥ chos bdag phun sum tshogs par dgongs pa/ phyi rabs kyi rnal 'asdor pa chos mig can rnams brgyud 'dzin phun sum tshogs par dgongs pa ste/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis gter du sbas so/ /de 212

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3nas rig 'dzin mi las brgyud pa'i dbang du byas na/ de'i tshe de'i byin rlabs las sa ho ra'i rgyal po dza la rmi ltas ngo mtshar ba bdun byung ste/ dang po ri de'i rtse mor dpal phyag na rdo rje byon te sku'i 'od kyis 'jig rten thams cad bsregs nas mi snang bar byas shing gsung gi sgra bsgrags/ thugs las rdo rje dang nyi zla rnams rgyal po nyid kyi thugs ka dang spyi bo rkang mthil rnams su thim nas snang srid lto ba na sa 'phyo ba zhig rmis so/ /gnyis pa phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyi zla la chibs nas chos kyi bgro ba mdzad pa zhig rmis so/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/gsum pa/ sprin gser gyi snying po can las rin po che sna tshogs kyi char babs pa dang / bzhi pa/ rin po che'i sgron mes snang srid kyi mun pa bsal zhing bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi gcong nad rnam par sbyangs te sems can ma lus pa badz+ra yo gi'i sgra sgrogs pa dang / lnga pa/ sprin gyi nang nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'bar ba las gser gyi glegs bam la be+eḍūr+ya zhun mas rgya rang mtshon du bris pa'i glegs bam mang po skar mda' thang la lhung ba bzhin babs pa dang / drug pa/ glegs bam de dag la grub pa dang rig 'dzin du mas mchod bstod bskor klog byed pa dang /ba dun pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings las bdag nyid lung bstan pa'i 213

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgra byung ste/ las dang skal bar rab ldan zhing / /rgyal sras 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i/ /bsod nams chen po'i dra ma khyod/ /zhes pa nas/ bde ba can zhes bya bar ni/ /'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i/ /kun rigs bde ba chen por 'gyur/ /zhes sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i rmi ltas dang mthun par/ rgyal po de'i khang steng tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad kyi glegs bam rnams char du babs shing don gyi brgyud pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa' las rgyal po nyid kyis dngos su thob na'ang / da dung phyi rabs pa'i 'gro ba rnams gsang sngags rang gar spyod pa'i nyes pa 'gog pa'i phyir tshig gi brgyud pa lī tsa byi dri med grags pa las blangs par grags shing / de nas rim par slob dpon ku ku rā dza/ iṇ+ḍa bhu ti/ sidha rā dza/ u pa rā dza/sras mo go ma de wi/ des sgeg pa rdo rje dang sangs rgyas gsang ba/de gnyis kas paṇa chen bī ma la mi tra/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rma gnyags rnam gnyis/ rma rin chen mchog gis mkhas pa gtsug gyer gnyis/ de gnyis kas dar rje dpal grags dang zhang rgyal yon/ zhang nas gnubs chen la brgyud pa bka' srol gcig go/ /yang slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i zhabs dang bī ma la gnyis kas gnyags chen ye shes gzhon nu/ des sog po dpal ye/ des gnubs chen la bshad pa bka' srol gcig go/ /yang rma gnyags 214

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3than mong gi slob ma khu byang chub 'od nas gtsug gyer gnyis la ༄brgyud de gnubs la bshad pa bka' srol gcig ste gnubs la brgyud pa'i bka' srol thams cad 'dus shing / des gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho dang ye shes rgya mtsho so ye dbang gsum la bshad/de gsum kas nyang ye shes 'byung gnas des lha rje zur po che/ de nas rim pa bzhin slob ma rtse mo bzhi/ gsang bdag sgro phugs pa shākya seṅge nas legs par brgyud de bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bar du byin rlabs kyi sprin phung ma yal bar byung ba'o/gsum pa la/ bshad bya dam pa'i chos ngos bzung ba dang /'chad byed kyi chos ngos bzung ba'i sgo nas rgyud sde'i phyogs mtshon pa dang / ji ltar 'chad tshul gyi sgo nas rgyud don rnam par phye ba dngos so/ /dang po ni/ spyir ma hā yo ga'i tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad yod cing / de dag gi grangs 'dren la/ snga rabs pa dag sku cigasung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i bye brag gi rgyud lnga tshan sa/sum̐m dang spyi rgyud gsum ste bco brgyad du bzhed mod/ 'on kyang 'dir gter chen chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling pa sogs kyi bzhed pa ltar/ sku'i rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsung gi rgyud zla gsang thig le/ thugs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ yon tan gyi rgyud dpal mchog dang po/ phrin las kyi rgyud karmā ma le ste chos 215

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lnga'i gzhi dang rtsa bar gyur pa'i rgyud sde lnga dang / he ru ka rol pa/rta mchog rol pa/ gshin rje rol pa/ bdud rtsi rol pa/ phur pa rol pa ste sgrub pa lag len du ston pa rol pa'i rgyud sde lnga/ ri bo brtsegs pa/ ye shes rngam glog /dam tshig bkod pa/ ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig glang chen rab 'bog ste spyod pa'i yan lag tu 'phros pa'i rgyud sde lnga/ de dag tu ma tshang ba kha skong gi phyi ma lta bur gyur pa'i rgyud gnyis/ de thams cad kyi bsdus don lta bu'i rgyud sde chen po rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang bco brgyad do/ /de dag gi nang nas 'dir ni phyi ma ste/ rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse/ bstan pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs/ lung thams cad kyi spyi 'grel/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i zhe phugs/ 'bras ba thams cad kyi thag sa/rig rigami rgyal ba thams cad kyi gshegs shul/ rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi lam po che ste rnam pa brgyad kyis che ba'i dpal ldan gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /de gang gis 'chad na/ lung rigs man ngag gsum gyis dbye bar bya ste/ lung ni/ spyir sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad sogs kyang yin mod kyi/ khyad par du bshad rgyud sde bzhi ste/ rgyud sde 'dis bstan don gyi gtso bo thabs lam dang grol lam gnyis yin la/216

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3de re re la'ang rim cig char gnyis rer phye ba las/ grol lam rim cig char gnyis ni go rim bzhin du bshad rgyud ye shes snying po dang rdo rje me long gnyis kyis gtso bor ston la/ thabs lam rim cig char gnyis ni rim bzhin bshad rgyud rgya mtsho dang thal bas bstan don gtso bor byas nas 'chad do/ /man ngag ni/ rgya gar gyi shing rta chen po dri med chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i khog gzhung gsal sgron dang / pad+ma'i man ngag lta phreng dang /nyi seng ma dang / spar khab la sogs pa rnams dang / bod kyi rong zom paṇ+ḍi ta'i dkon mchog 'gre la dang / kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i ṭī ka phyogs bcu mun sel/ smin gling lo chen rin po che'i gsang bdag dgongs pa'i rgyan la sogs pa rnams so/ /rigs pa ni/ de dag gi rjes sa 'brangs pa'i dngos stobs kyi tshad ma yang ༄dag pa zhig dgos kyi rigs pa gang rung rung la mi bya'o/ /'dir zhar byung du rgyud lung man ngag gsum gyi ngo bo ni/ rtse mo las/'brel dang ma tshang med phyir dang / /phun sum tshogs pas rgyud ces bya/ /zhes dang / lung ni yid ches tshig yin te/ /nyes pa zad pas rdzun gyi tshig /smra bar mi 'gyur rgyu med phyir/ /nyes zad lung du shes par bya/ /zhes dang / tshegs chung don che thabs dpag med/ /bya sla dpag dka' man ngag go/ /zhes gsungs pa 217

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin no/ /gnyis pa la'ang / ma hā yo ga spyi'i 'chad tshul dang / bye brag tu rgyud 'di nyid kyi bshad srol ji ltar byung ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ he ru ka gal po las/ ma hā yo ga'i rgyan bdun yang / /gleng bslang ba dang sangs rgyas tshul/ /rgyas bshad mtha' dang bshad pa'i tshul/ /dbye ba'i rnam pa gang zag snod/ /bden pa'i dgongs pa shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdun las/ dang po gleng bslang ba'i rgyan ni/ rgyud 'di'i ming ni ci zhig yin/ /rgyud 'di su zhig don du mdzad/ /byed po'i ston pa'ang su zhig yin/ /rgyud 'di'i ldang tshad ji lta bu/ /dgos pa ji zhig yod par shes/ /zhes dri ba la lan du rgyud 'di'i ming ni gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa/ gdul bya dbang rnon gnyi sa sbyor gyi 'dod chags sha sa che ba rnams kyi don du/ byed po'i ston pa khyab bdag rigs drug pa kun tu bzang po/ ldang tshad la gal por/ cho ga de bzhin le'u dang / /rim par phye dang dum bu'o/ /zhes pa ltar las cho ga dbang dang mchog gi sgrub pa sogs rgyas par ston/ rab gnas dang thun mong gi sgrub pa sogs mdo tsam/ gtor tshogs dang gnas lung sogs rgyud gzhan las kha bskang dgos pa'i tshul gyis 'chad la/ le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ rim pa drug pa dang /218

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3gsum pa dang / gnyis par phye ba rnams dang / rtsa ba dang phyi ma'i dum bu gnyis so/ /dgos ched sgron ma gsal ba las/ dgos pa yang ni bshad bya ste/ /zhi sogs bya ba'i cho ga dang / /de bzhin grub pa brgyad dang ni/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni mchog yin no/ /zhes so/ /rgyan gnyis pa ni/ rgyal(gal)po las/ sangs rgyas pa yi tshul bzhi ste/ /rgyu dang gleng gzhi nges tshig rgyu/ /zhes pas/ phar phyin theg pa'i lugs la byang sems srid pa tha ma ba zhig tshe der 'tshang rgya ba la mir skye ba blang ba dang / rab tu 'byung ba dang / 'dul sdom bsrung ba dang / dka' ba spyod pa de bzhin du 'dir yang rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gcig tshe der bla med kyi lam nas 'tshang rgya ba la phung sogs tha mal gyi snang zhen dor te rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas su nga rgyal bya ba dang / de thams cad gsang chen rigs gcig tu bsdu ba dang / rdo rje'i dbang dang dam tshig legs par bzung ba dang / nye rgyu'i spyod pa la tshul bzhin du bslab pa zhig dgos te/ 'di dag la da dung zhib cha dgos so/ /rgyan gsum pa ni/ gal po las/ rgyas bshad mtha' ni rnam pa drug/drang don nges don dgongs pas bshad/ /dgongs min sgra ni ji bzhin pa/ /ji bzhin ma yin nyid du bshad/ /ces pa ltar las dang po drang nges gnyis ni/ gzhung de'i dngos zin gyi don de 219

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las da dung don gzhan zhig drang du yod pa drang ba'i don dang /don gzhan drang ba de las gzhan pa'i don du 'dren rgyu med pas nges don zhes bya'o/ /dgongs dang dgongs min gnyis ni/bstan don de kho na nyid gcig yin yang gdul bya mchog dngos 'dod pa'i sems can dbang po rnon po'i dbang du mdzad nas don de la 'gal ba'i sgras gsungs pa dgongs bshad dang / snod ldan gdul bya dbang rtul gyi dbang du mdzad nas sgra thad drang du bstan pa dgongs min yin no/ /sgra ji bzhin dang ma yin pa gnyis ni/ phyi dkyil dang sbyin sreg sogs 'jig rten dang bstan bcos la grags pa'i tshig gis gsungs pa sgra ji bzhin pa dang /'jig rten na de ltar ma grags kyang de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis don de la brda de glo bur mdzad nas bzhag pa rgyud 'di las sbyor sgrol la a li kā li zhes gsungs pa lta bu sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa'o/ //rdo// //de/ /༷༷/ rgyan ba pa / snga ma las/ bshad pa ri tshul bzhi khyed la bstan/ /tshig spyi sbas dang mthar thug yin/ /zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ tshig gi don ni/ sgra'i gzhung dang mthun par yi ge gnyer ba'i bshad pa'o/ /spyi don ni theg pa 'og ma pa dag sngags bla med kyi chos la sdang ba 'gog pa'i phyir de dag dang mi 'gal bar thun mong du grags pa'i sgo nas rdo rje'i tshig gi don bshad pa zhig dang / bla 220

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3 med rang gi bskyed rim mchog thun sgrub pa'i gang zag gnyis kyi thun mong bar gyur pa'i sgo nas spyi don du bzhag pa sogs te/gzhan du mdo lam dang rgyud sde 'og ma rnams sngags bla med kyi lam stegs su 'chad pa'ang spyi don yin zhes bla ma rnams gsung ngo //sbas don ni/ las rgya dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i cho ga rnams 'dod chags chos sbas/ snang mched thob gsum dpe'i 'od gsal dang bcas pa snang ba sems sbas/ bdag byin brlabs pa'am sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes kyi sku'i rdzogs rim kun rdzob bden pa'i sbas pa ste rdo rje'i tshig gi khongs na yod pa'i don to/ /mthar thag gi don ༄ni/ gnyis snang gi rgyu ba phra mo yang dag nas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde chen don gyi 'od gsal du mthar thug pa zab mo'i mthar thug dang / ye shes kyi rlung mtshan rdzogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs pa rgya che ba'i mthar thug go/ /rgyan lnga pa ni/ snga ma las/ nyan bshad dbye bas rnam pa gnyis/ /tshogs dang slob ma dag tu 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ de gnyis kyi khyad par zla ba'i zhabs kyis/ ji bzhin sgra dang dgongs min dang / /drang ba'i don du'ang gang 'gyur dang / yi ge'i don dang spyi yi don/ /tshogs pa la bshad yin par brjod/ /ji bzhin min sgra nges don dang / /de bzhin dgongs te bshad pa dang / /sbas dang mthar 221

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/snar+shathug pa rnams ni/ /slob ma la ni bshad par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pas shes la/ de'ang tshogs pa zhes pa tsan+dan lta bu sogs gang zag lnga dang / slob ma zhes pa de'i nang nas rin po che lta bu la bya'o/ /rgyan drug pa ni/ snga ma las/ snod kyi gang zag rnam pa lnga/ / ut+pal pad+ma dkar dmar dang / /tsan+dan rin po che yi dpe/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lnga las/ dang po ni ut+pal chu'i nang na mdzes shing bton ma thag rnying pa ltar/ bla ma las thos pa 'dzin mkhas kyang brjed par sla ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ pad+ma dkar po rnyid dka' yang nyi ma shar ba na kha zum pa bzhin du thos pa mang du 'dzin nus na'ang gzhan la ston pa'i nus pa med pa'o/ /gsum pa/pad+ma dmar po nyi mas kha 'byed cing rtsi bcud 'dzin yang 'dzag skyen pa bzhin du chos thos pas blo'i kha phye zhing dad pa dang snying rje che yang / thos pa'i don ring du mi gnas pa'o/ /bzhi pa/ tsan+dan 'bras bu med cing dri che ba tsher ma mang ba sbrul gyis dkris pa bzhin du/ thos chung nga rgyal che zhing mang du smra la gdul bya rjes su 'dzin mi nus pa'o/ /lnga pa/ nor bu rin po che rnyed dka' zhing 'gyur ba med la dgos 'dod stsol ba bzhin du/ tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la rgyud brtan pa rang gis thos nas gzhan la legs par ston nus pa'o/ /rgyan bdun pa ni/ don dam bden pa 222

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3sems nyid 'od gsal gyi dbyings dang / kun rdzob bden pa snang cha ye shes kyi sku ste bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i rdzogs rim ni rgyud don ma lus pa'i thags mthar thag pa yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /rwazir ri snazurag rigazi tshor rang der tshoragasang ba chan pa' rgyud 'ad 'dra ba rnams 'chad thabs ngas pa' tshul de dag gis bshad na mkhas pa dga' ba skyed pa'i mdzes byed kyi rgyan yin pa'i phyir rgyan zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la'ang / bde gshegs zur po che shākya 'byung gnas sogs snga rabs pa 'ga' zhig ni/ mda' ltar rtse mo nas bzung ste 'chad pa zhes mtshan gyi nang du rgyud kyi brjod bya mtha' dag bsdus nas gsang ba chen po'i gzhi/ snying po ma nor ba'i lam/de kho na nyid nges pa'i 'bras bu'i chings gsum gyis 'chad pa dang /mdung ltar sked pa nas bzung ste 'chad pa zhes le'u lnga pa'i brjod bya'i 'og tu ston pa'i mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum du rgyud kyi don thams cad dngos dang zhar byung gang rung gi sgo nas bsdus te 'chad pa dang / ral gri ltar yu ba nas bzung ste 'chad pa zhes rgyud dbu zhabs kyi don mtha' dag /gzhi rang bzhin gyi snang ba/log rtog 'khrul pa'i snang ba/ gdul bya lam gyi snang ba/ 'bras bu bde gshegs kyi snang ba ste rtsa rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa'i bstan don du dril nas 'chad tshul gsum du mdzad do/ /phyis kyi bka' 223

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sde zur pa gsang bdag sgro phugs pa shākya seṅga ni chos lnga'i sgo nas 'chad de/ chos thams cad rang bzhin bden pa dbyer med lhag pa'i chos sku chen po'i rnam rol du zad pa rang bzhin dngos po'i gnas tshul dang gcig /de lta na'ang sems rtog ma rig 'khrul gzugs su srid pa'i gnas lus longs spyod thams cad cir yang snang ba ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i snang tshul dang gnyis/ de nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa bde stong mkhyen pa gnyis ldan gyi ye shes chen pos snang dang stong pa so so ma yin par mkhyen pa thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs tshul dang gsum/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rna/mas la thugs rje chen po skye tshul bzhi ldan du 'byung ba brtse ba'i thugs rje skye tshul dang bzhi/ de las 'bad rtsol la mi ltos pa'i rtag khyab lhun grub chen po'i phrin las kyi 'jug pa dus las mi yol ba 'gro don ji ltar mdzad tshul dang lnga'o/ /gzhan yang bshad thabs 'dren pa'i tshig bcu sogs mang du 'byung yang 'dir yi ges 'jigs la/ shes par 'dod pa dag gis gzhan las rtogs par bya'o/ /'dir ni grub pa'i slob dpon shing rta chen po bī ma la mi tra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i sgyu 'phrul khog gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar bshad par bya ste/ de yang khog gzhung gsal ba'i sgron me las/224

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3gzhung gi dbye ba gsum yin te/ /rab la mtshan bstan 'bring la dbye/ /tha mar 'bru gnyer bgrol ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/mgo smos pas go ba'i dbang po rab la mtshan bshad pa dang /cung zad phye ste bshad pas go ba'i dbang po 'bring la spyi don rnam par dbye ba dang / rnam par spros pas go ba'i dbang po tha ma rnams la 'bru re gnyer re'i sgo nas 'chad pa dang gsum las/dang po la'ang / de nyid las/ rab mtshan tha snyad gsum du grags//sgyu 'phrul snying po lung gi spyi/ /lag gi rtsa bzhin dbu zhabs rtogs//skal ba can gyi ched phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum du bstan pa las/ dang po rgyud dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang 'chad pa'i skyes ba gsum gyi mtshan than mong rabargya ༄༄midu bstan pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'i don ni bshad rgyud me long las/ chos rnams ma lus gnyis med pa'i/ /rang rig byang chub sems nyid do/ /tha dad med pa'i rang bzhin ni/ rdo rje zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos nyid stong pa nyid la rdo rje zhes pa'i sgras bsnyad de/ ji ltar mi chod pa la sogs pa'i chos bdun ldan gyi rdo rje'i rdul rnams ni so sor dbye bar dka' ba de bzhin du/ stong pa nyid kyang stong gzhi chos can dang so sor mi phyed par chos thams cad 225

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mnyam pa nyid kyi tshul gcig tu gnas shing mtshan ma'i dngos po gang gis kyang mi tshugs ba'i phyir ro/ /sems dpa' ni sa twa'i sgra las spyir don drug la 'jug kyang 'dir brtan bsdus rtogs gsum la 'jug par kun gzigs rong zom pa bzhed de/ thabs rig pa byang chub kyi sems shes rab stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i zang 'jug rang bzhin rnam dag ni rdo rje ltar 'pho 'gyar med ༄shi 'i 4byud rī daske gas 'i ༄ 'ipas na brtan pa' rda rja sams dpa'/ da' chas nyad zab zha spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings su 'khor 'das ro mnyam du bsdus pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'/ gnas lugs kyi don de nyid rtogs pa mngon du gyur te bde stong so so ma yin pa'i ye shes gsal snang rab kyi mthar thug pa ni rtogs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ snga ma gnyis gzhi dus kyi bde stong gnyis dang / phyi ma 'bras dus kyi ye shes la bzhed do/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i don la/ zur pa rnams bzhir 'chad de/ dang po rtog tshogs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'byung ba lnga la sgyu ma dang / phung po lnga 'phrul ba/ de gnyis rgyu 'bras su 'brel ba la drwa ba zhes gsungs te/ gtso bor sngags spyod pa'i rten khyad par can rdo rje'i lus khams drug dang ldan pa zhig gi steng nas bzhag par mngon no/ /gnyis pa nges don sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chos nyid stong pa nyid la sgyu ma dang / de'i rang mdangs 'od gsal gyi 226

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3ye shes cir yang snang zhing cir yang 'char ba'i go 'byed pa 'phrul ba/ de gnyis ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa drwa ba'i don no/ /gsum pa drang don sgyu 'phrul drwa ba bshad ma thag pa'i nges don gyi sgyu ma de nyid mtshon byed lha yum/ 'phrul ba mtshon pa lha yab/ drwa ba mtshon pa yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa'o/ /bzhi pa lha rtog dbyer med kyi sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rtog tshogs sgyu ma dang / de nyid rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis lhar snang ba 'phrul ba/ de gnyis rang bzhin gnyis su med par 'brel ba drwa ba yin la/ gzhan yang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bshad tshul mang ngo / /de ltar rgyud kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa bar mtshan gsol ba de bzhin du 'chad pa'i skyes bu rdo rje mi bskyod pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i mtshan yang de skad du grags pa ni bshad ma thag pa'i grangs su'ang yod do/ /brjod bya mthar thug gi dbang du na sngags bla med kyi lam gyi gtso bo bden pa gnyis kyi rdzogs rim la sbyar na rlabs che bas/ mnyam sbyor las/ rdo rje stong pa nyid du brjod/ /sems dpa' ye shes chen po ste/ /de dag bdag nyid grub pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brjod do/ /zhes 'od gsal bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes la rdo rje sems dpar gsungs shing / de bzhin du mgon po klus rim lnga las/ ji ltar dwangs pa'i chu las ni/ /nya 227

thaX/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dag myur du ldang ba ltar/ /de bzhin thams cad stong gsal las/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'byung bar bshad/ /ces gnyug ma'i lus rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs pa la sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i don du gsungs so//gnyis pa lung dang mthun pa'i mtshan ni/ mtshan nyid dang rgyud thams cad kyi lung gi spyi zhes pa ste/ de'i don rdo rje las/ so sor bstan pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ /'dir ston 'dis ston 'di phyir ston/ /don kun 'di la yongs rdzogs pas/ /lung gi spyi zhes bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ ston pa bla na med pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams par gang la gang 'dul du bstan pa'i sde snod dang rgyud sde'i rnam grangs ji snyed pa spyi dang / khyad par gsang sngags bla med kyi rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i snying po bskyed rdzogs rim pa gnyis kyi lam mtha' dag rgyud sde 'di'i nang du tshang la ma nor bar ston pas na 'dir ston/ rgyud 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo bden gnyis zung 'jug gi de kho na nyid 'ba' zhig dngos sam brgyud nas rtogs pa'i don du thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa'i rnam grangs rgya mtsho lta bu zhig phro sa pa yin pas na 'dis ston/ de dag thams cad kyang mthar thug gsang ba'i theg pa 'dir 'bab cing gzhol bas na 'di phyir ston pa ste/ bshad rgyud rgyas pa las/ mnyam nyid don rtogs rang rig 228

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3rgyal po ni/ /rgya mtsho chen por chu klung kun 'bab ltar/ /bla med don rtogs thabs chen 'di dag tu/ /rnam thar theg pa bsam yas ma lus 'dus/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa man ngag gi mtshan du grags pa gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa zhes bya ste/ rgyud phyi ma las/ gsang ba chos 'byung la bshad de/ /snying po'ang de yi thabs can no/ /gnyis po phyin ci ma log phyir/ /de nyid de 'dir rnam nges so/ /zhes bshad cing / rdo rje'i tshig 'di ches brling bas rtogs dka' bar snang yang yongs grags ltar na gzhi gsang ba/ lam snying po/ de gnyis gzhi lam mthar thug tu mi bslu ba de kho na nyid/ don de rgyud gzhung 'di las sgro bskur med par bstan pa nges pa'o/ /yang na gsang ba 'i don ni/ rang bzhin gyi ye shes rtogs par dka' ba dang / de'i rgyu mtshan yang glo bur gyi 'khrul rtog bzhon pa dang bcas pas bsgribs nas gnyug ma'i rang zhal ji ba/zhin par byis pa rnams kyis nges mi nus pa gab pa'i gsang ba dang / bla med kyi dgongs spyod zab mo rnams blo chung ngu'i sems can la bstan par bya ba ma yin zhing / gzhan yang rgyal ba nyid kyis rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud dang / de nyid bla ma la rag las par mdzad de slob dpon sgo du ma nas mnyes par ma byas par gsang ba chen po'i lam rnams mi rnyed par bstan pa 229

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin/ gang zag snod du ma gyur pa rnams kyis rang dgar 'jug tu med pa yang / gsal bkra las/ gsang phyir brda thabs sna tshogs gsungs/ /zhes pa dang phyogs mtshungs pa ste sbas pa'i gsang ba'o/ /lar gab sbas gnyis la gzhi mthun yong rgyur snang ngo / /snying po'i don ni/ sā ra ṣ+ṭṛ da ya gar+bha zhes pa'i skad dod gsum gyi steng nas bshad na/ sā ra ni gcig las du ma 'phro ba'i gzhi lta bu la 'jug pas/ gnas lugs rang bzhin gyi rgyud las shes bya ma lus pa snang zhing / de 'dra'i 'od gsal de rtogs pa'i phyir du theg pa thams cad kyang dngos brgyud ci rigs su 'phros pas na snying po yin la/ ṣ+ṭṛ da ya ni srog ltar gces spras su bya ba'i don la 'jug ste/ phar phyin theg pa'i bskal chen grangs med gsam gyi tshogs gnyis rlabs po che'i dod thab theg pa 'dir bde ri ring ri bzhub chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gcig la tshang ba sogs mdor na rgyud sde 'dis bstan don gyi gtso bo ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum gang gi skabs su yang shes par bya ba'i gnad kyi mthar thug pas na snying po'o/ /gar+bha ni bcud 'dus pa'i snying po la 'jug ste 'di'i don yang bshad ma thag pa'i hri da ya'i don dang khyad par cher med kyang bshad ma thag pa ni byang chen don gnyer rnams kyis bsten bya'i gtso bo yin pa dang / 'di ni gang zhig yod pa dang med pa'i 230

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3khyad par las chos thams cad snang dang mi snang gi rjes su 'gro ldog nges pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'od gsal chen po'i ye shes kho na rlung sems mtha' dag gi nang nas mthar thug lugs dang de'i phyir bde stong kha sbyar ba'i lam gnad nges pa las shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa lta bu'i che ba brjod pa ste ldog cha'i bye brag tsam zhig yin pa 'dra'o/ /de kho na nyid kyi don ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / de phyir de rgyas ci zhig bya/ /mdor bsdus pas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar phar phyin theg pa'i lam rgyas pa ltar mkhas bya'i gnas kyi rnam grangs pha mtha' med pa tsam la slob mi dgos par zab mo'i lam gyi nang nas stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu gyar pa'i bde chen khyad par ba dang rgya che ba'i lam gyi ༄nang nas sngags dang ye shes kyi sku'i rnal 'byor te/ gtso bor gnyug ma'i de bzhin gshegs pa la gnad du bsnun pa'i gdams ngag kho na la chig sgril byas pas chog pa'i don no/ /de'i phyir dag rdzogs smin gsum tshang ba'i bskyed rim thams cad kyang de nyid kho na'i don du 'gyur bar shes par bya'o/ /nges pa'i don ni/ skal dman gyi gdul bya kha drang ba'i don tsam ma yin par ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i gtso bo rin po che lta bu'i gang zag la rgyal ba nyid kyi dgongs pa'i zhe phugs dpyis phyin par bstan pa'i phyir te/231

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /'di las gsang ba'i nges don med/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin no / /don gnyis pa dbang po 'bring la spyi don rnam par dbye ste bshad pa la/ don gyi rnam grangs rgya cher dbye ba dang / tshig gi rnam grangs bsdus te bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la'ang / rgyud 'byung ba'i rgyu gleng gzhi/ rkyen gleng bslang / 'bras bu yongs shes rgyud don/ rgyud kyi dgos 'brel/ 'khor la gdams shing gtad pa dang lnga'o/ /dang po la ngo bo ni/ phyi ma'i rgyud las/ ston pa la sogs rab dbye bas/ /phun sum tshogs pa lngar brjod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas gang du/ ston pa gang / 'khor gang dang lhan cig tshogs pa de'i tshe gleng bslang gi sbyor bas rgyud don bskul ma rag par gnas pas na/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan ni gleng gzhi'o/ /nges tshig ni legs sbyar gyi skad du/ dā na'i sgra las drangs na sbyin pa la 'jug ste/ bka' yin min du dogs pa'i the tshom can la yid ches kyi nges pa ster bas na de skad du brjod cing /bod skad du sbyin pa zhes bsgyur na dngos po sbyin pa lta bu phyogs gcig tu chad 'gro bas bod kyi brda dang sbyar te lo tsā ba rnams/ kyis gleng gzhi zhes bsgyur ba'i dbang du na gang gleng bar bya ba rgyad kyi don 'byang ba'i rgyu'am gzhir gyar pa'i phyir ro zhes bshad ༄byi ༄shi ༄shi232

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3zhe do/ /dbye na thun mong ma yin pa'i gleng gzhi dang / thun mong gi gleng gzhi gnyis/ dang po la'ang / nang thabs lam steng sgo dang sbyar te bshad rgyud rgya mtshos bshad pa dang / gsang ba thabs lam 'og sgo dang sbyar te bshad rgyud thal bas bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/ kun gzigs rong zom zhabs rgyud 'di la ma yā'i yi ge gnyis med par bzhed kyang 'di'i rgya dper ye waṃ ma yā shu ta me ka smre na sa ma ye zhes 'byung bar lo chen rin po che gsungs pa ltar rgyud sde gzhan 'dus pa la sogs pa bzhin du rgyud 'dir yang yi ge bzhi po yod par 'dod dgos so/ /de ltar na ba shad rgyud rgya mtshor/ dharmā tsakra chos kyi gnas/ /'od bzhi e sogs dbyibs su gnas/ /mi shigs thig le waṃ dbyibs can/ /rang la bde ba gsal byed dag /ma nu yid sogs rnam shes bzhi/ /ye shes myong bas sdud par bshad/ /ye shes nam mkha'i gzugs skyes pa/ pa ra māt+pa don zab mo/ /bde ba'i dus nyid snga phyi bral/ /dus gsum kun gyi ngo bor gnas/ /zhes pas/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ /ston pa phun sum tshogs pa srog mi shigs pa'i thig le/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa 'od gsal 'char ba na snying gar sdud rgyu'i rnam par shes pa rigs bzhi/ chos phun sum tshogs pa don dam pa'i bde chen nam mkha'i gzugs can/233

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dus phun sum tshogs pa rnal 'byor pa de'i ngor dus kyi 'dzin rtog dang bral ba'i mnyam pa nyid kyi dus su btags pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ thal pa las/ 'di zhes nye bar mtshon pa ni/ /e sogs rnam bzhi'i dbyibs can gnas/ /skad ces gsal byed las ming can//waṃ yig thig ler bcas ston pa'o/ /ma da ma nu sdom byed yid/ /las can rnam shes de dag la/ /gsal bar go bas bshad par 'dod/ /pa sgra don dam nges pa'i rgyud/ /ya na theg chen 'di yin no/ /dus ni bsam gyis mi khyab dus/ /nā ma de ming zhes byar 'dod/ /ces pas/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa yum gyi mkha' gsang / ston pa phun sum tshogs pa yab kyi rdo rje kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang bcas pa/ phun sum tshogs pa zhes kun la sbyar te/ 'khor byed bcing gi thabs kyis dga' ba chen po'i ngo bor bsdu bya gsang ba'i rnam shes/ chos bde stong dga' ba bzhi/dus bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dus te snga ma bzhin no/ /'dis ni rgyud 'byung ba khyad par gyi gleng gzhi'i nges don gyi bshad pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba zhig kyang 'tshol dgos par snang ngo / /gnyis pa la/ rgyud 'byung ba khyad par gyi gleng gzhi'am longs sku'i gleng gzhi/ gdul bya dgos ched du bstan pa khro bo'i gleng gzhi/bstan pa 'byung ba spyi'i gleng gzhi'am sprul sku 'gro ba 'dul ba'i 234

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3gleng gzhi dang gsum/ dang po la'ang mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po gsang bdag dgongs pa'i rgyan ltar bshad na/ e ni shes rab kyi brda ste yum lnga'i mkha' dbyings kyi rang bzhin 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang ste gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ wa ni thabs kyi rang bzhin khyab bdag rigs drug pa kun tu bzang po ste ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/thig le ni thabs shes gnyis su med pa 'i brda ste zung 'jug shin tu rnam par dag pa chos phun sum tshogs pa/ ma ni smra ta ste dran shes kyi las kyis rgyud don mi brjed par 'dzin pas 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ ya ni ya dā ste gang gi tshe zhes rgyud don ston pa'i dus phun sum tshogs pa la bshad do/ /gnyis pa la'ang phun sum tshogs pa lnga las/ dang po chos ni 'di skad bshad pa zhes pas bstan te/ rgyud dbu zhabs kyi don thams cad sdud pa'o/ /dus ni dus na zhes pas bstan te/ rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo'i dus so//ston pa phun sum tshogs pa bshad pa la/ ston pa'i rang bzhin dang ngo bo gnyis/ dang po la 'grel chung las/ byang chub mchog gi ngo bo dang / /chos rnams rol par longs spyod dang / /phyogs dus bde gshegs bdag po dang / /chos so cog dang dbyer med pa'o/ /zhes rnam pa bzhir gsungs kyang / 'dir spar khab ltar 235

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rang bzhin bdun du 'chad de/ de bzhin nyid du nar son pa'i rang bzhin/ yon tan ma btsal lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin/ye shes mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ 'bras bu la mnga' mdzad kyang ngo bo bstan du med pa'i rang bzhin/ mnyam pa nyid mngon du mdzad kyang spyod yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rang bzhin dang bdun no/ /de la dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi tshig dang lto sbyar tshul go sla la/ dngos don chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi don la sgrib byed kyi 'ching ba mtha' dag dang bral te 'od gsal yang dag pa'i mtha' mkhyen pa gnyis ldan du gshegs pa'am de nyid thugs kyi ngang gcig tu gyur pa la bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar de bzhin nyid kyi gzigs pa mthar son pa'i lag rjes kho na las yon tan gzhan du 'tshol ba'i ngal ba la ma brten par 'bras bu'i chos nyi shu rtsa lnga lhun rdzogs su 'gyar /༷༷/ //ste/ /rdo nge 11she///bye( rigang ba ri don no/ /gsum pa / ye shes ten po sne ༄ mthu las mtha' dang dbus med pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho dang /mtha' dang dbus med pa'i tha snyad kyi chos rgya mtsho chags thogs med par cig char du gzigs pa'i don no/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes kyi sku ni spros pa'i 'jug ldang las 'das pa'i 236

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum la shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas na de'i rang gi ngo bo sgra dang rtog pas dngos su mtshon par byar med pa'i don no/ /lnga pa ni/ spyir longs spyod chen po la sgra bshad tshul gzhan du yod kyang / skabs 'dir 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad spang blang med par chos nyid mnyam pa nyid gcig gi rol par mkhyen pa'i don du bka' srol las 'byung bas/ yul la yul can gyis spyod lugs khyad par ba zhig la 'dod dgos par snang ngo / /drug pa ni/ rgyal ba gcig gi yon tan la 'bras chos nyer lngar phye bas gcig gi rang bzhin dang bral zhing / rtsa ba rang byung gi ye shes gcig tu 'dus pas du ma'i mtha' dang bral ba yin zhes gsung ngo / /'dir gang zag gcig la yang dag pa'i phung po lngar phye bas gcig gi mtha' dang bral zhing / btags chos gang zag gcig gi rgyud kyis bsdus pas du ma'i mtha' dang bral ba zhig 'ong ba ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i ngang tshul can du go nus par ma zad sangs rgyas kho na'i khyad chos ye shes kyi sku gcig gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen la brten nas sku rags pa'i sgyu 'phrul mtha' yas par 'char ba sogs kyang 'thon no/ /bdun pa ni/ dus gsum gyi chos thams cad dang dus kyis ma bsdus pa'i 'dus ma byas kyi shes bya mtha' 237

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dag la khyab bdag rigs drug pa'i ye shes so so ma yin par gyur pa ste/ 'di ni rgyud sde gzhan las rang byung 'od gsal ba'i ye shes shes bya mtha' dag gi stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i sgo nas de nyid shes bya thams cad kyi khyab byed du gsungs pa dang gnad gcig go/gnyis pa ni/ skabs 'di'i ngo bo zhes pa ston pa'i sku'i rnam pa de la zer ba snang bas de bshad pa la/ ston pa sku gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa'i don rtags/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i don rtags/ ye shes drug dang ldan pa'i don rtags/ rnam thar gsum dang ldan pa'i don rtags dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ chos sku'i bdag nyid yin pa'i don rtags sa ye shes kyi sku zhal rnam pa ༄thams cad pa phyogs kun tu mi sgrib par thal ler snang ba'o/ /longs sku'i bdag nyid yin pa'i don rtags su mtshan dpe'i yon tan ma tshang ba med pas brgyan pa ste/ dang po'i mtshan so gnyis ni/ phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa/ rus sbal lta bu'i zhabs sor mo drwa bas 'brel ba/ phyag zhabs shing bal ltar 'jam pa/bdun mtho ba/ sor mo ring ba/ rting pa yangs pa/ sku che zhing drang ba/ long bu mi mngon pa/ ba spu gyen du 'khyil ba/ byin pa rim par 'tsham la rgyas pa/ phyag ring ba/ 'dom gyi sba ba sbubs 238
