sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3su nub pa/ gser gyi mdog lta bu/ pags pa 'jam pa ba spu g.yas su 'khrungs pa/ mdzod spu zla ba ltar dkar ba/ sku stod 'phel kha che ba/ dpung pa'i mgo zlum pa/ thal gong rgyas pa/ ro bro ba'i mchog mkhyen pa/ chu zheng gab pa/ gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ljags ring zhing mdzes pa/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan pa/'gram pa 'khyil che ba/ tshems shin tu dkar ba/ tshad mnyam pa/tshems thaṭa bzang ba/ grangs bzhi bcu tshang ba/ spyan mthon mthing / rdzi ma ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ni sdoms su brjod na/ sen mo zangs mdog snum zhing dbyibs mtho zlum/ /sor mo rgyas shing byin gyis phra ba dang / /rtsa mi mngon dang rtsa mdud med pa dang / /long bu mi mngon zhabs mthil kun nas mnyam/ /seng ge glang chen ngang pa'i rgyal po dang / /khyu mchog stabs dang g.yas kyi phyogs nas gshegs/ /mdzes gshegs drang gshegs 'khril bag chags pa'i sku/ /byi dor byas 'dra rab mdzes rim par 'tsham/ /gtsang 'jam rnam dag mtshan rnams yongs su rdzogs/ /kho lag yangs dang rab bzang gom snyoms dang / /spyan dag gzhon sha chags shing ma zhum rgyas/ /grims shing yan lag rnam 'byes gzigs pa dag /dku zlum skabs phyin ma snyongs pa yi sku/ /phyang nge ba dang lte zab g.yas 'khyil mdzes/ /spyod gtsang sku 239

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/la sme ba gnag bag med/ /phyag 'jam ri mo gsal la zab cing ring / zhal sgros 'tshams shing bim pa ltar dmar dang / /ljags mnyen srab dang rab dmar 'brug gi sgra/ /gsungs dbyangs 'jam mnyen mche ba rno ba dang / /dbyibs zlum kha dog dkar zhing shin tu mnyam/ /byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho rnam par dgaspyan yangs rdzi ma rab stug spyan mdangs phyed/ /smin tshugs ring 'jam snum zhing spu ni mnyam/ /phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam nyams pa med/ /skra mtshams dod cing dbyes che dbu rgyas dang / /dbu skra gnag stug ma 'dzings mi rtsub 'jam/ /dri zhim yid 'phrog g.yung drung dpal be+e'us mtshan/ zhes pa rnams so/ /gsum pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid yin pa'i don rtags su sku las spros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse nas thub pa drug gi sprul pa'i 'phro 'du nam mkha'i mtha' dang chos kyi dbyings ltar pha mtha' med par rang snang ba'o/ /gnyis pa thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i don rtags su ston pa yab kyi zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung dang / yum brtul zhugs kyi skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gsum pa ye shes drug dang ldan pa'i don rtags su rigs kyi phyag rgya rnam pa lnga/ dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi mtshan ma dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag drus dang ldan pa'o/ /bzhi pa rnam thar gsum dang ldan pa'i don 240

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3rtags su mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum mnga' ba'o/ /spyir rnam thar sgo gsum la yul dang yul can gyi ngo bor gyur pa gnyis las/ skabs 'dir ni yul can rnam thar sgo gsum la bya zhing rang don phun sum tshogs pa shes dang shes bya ro gcig pa'i ye shes dang / gzhan don phun sum tshogs rnam pa thams cad pa'i sku gnyis dbyer med du gyar pa la rnam thar sgo gsum gyi tha snyad ra mi zurag dzorang spyor tshorabatags pa'ang rgyud gzhan du 'byung zhang da nyad zhal gsum gya nges don du bshad pa yod do/ /bzhi pa gnas phun sum tshogs pa la rang bzhin dang ngo bo gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'og min rnam pa lnga'i nang tshan dbang phyug chen po'i 'og min du grags pa ye shes rang snang gi gzhal med khang zhing khams dang bcas pa bem chos las 'das pa'i dag pa rab 'byams mtha' dang dbus med pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'o/ /zhar byung 'og min rnam pa lnga po'i ngos 'dzin ni/ mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i stong nyid don gyi 'og min/ de rtogs byed kyi rig pa'i ye shes rig pa'i 'og min/ston pa gsang ba'i sku'i bzhugs gnas gsang ba'i 'og min/gtsang ma ris kyi lha lnga'i ya tha 'jig rten gnas kyi 'og min/bshad ma thag pa'i longs sku'i bzhugs gnas dbang phyug chen po'i 'og min no/ /gnyis pa la'ang 'grel chung las/ gzhal yas 241

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhi dang rgyu dang rgya/ /dbyibs dang glo 'bur rtse mo dang / /rgyan dang sgo khyud rta babs dang / /mtshan nyid gdan gyi rnam pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rten gzhi tshad med pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo la/ rgyu ye shes rnam pa thams cad pas gdul bya'i re ba skong ba'i brdar rin po che 'bar ba khams sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / rgya tshad ye shes mtha' yas pa'i brdar phyogs bcu kun tu khyab par gdal ba/ dbyibs yon tan dpag tu med pa rgyas pa'i brdar gru bzhir mdzes shing lham pa/ glo 'bur me long lta bu sogs ye shes re re'ang lhag pa'i ye shes bzhi bzhir ldan pa'i brdar gru chad las 'phyar thabs su 'bur ba'i rigs bzhi'i kha dog can/ rtse mo phyogs dus mnyam pa nyid kyi spyod yul brnyes pa'i brdar sangs rgyas kyi gtsug tor ltar bltar mi mngon pa bum pa zlum po'i rnam par 'khyil ba ste drug rgyan la rnam grangs bdun las/ 'og bzhi'i rgyan sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam pa lnga rtag tu chos nyid kyi yul las mi 'da' ba'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi rdo ra dang bcas pa/ logs rgyan ye shes kyi rtsal snang cir yang 'char zhing de thams cad bde ba chen po'i rgyan du ma gyur pa med pa'i brdar rtsig pa rim pa lnga'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dang phreng ba la sogs pas spa zhing ston pa nyid bde ba'i longs 242

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3spyod kyi mchog la brten nas 'grub pa'i brdar 'dod snam la mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis rnam par gang ba/ steng rgyan chos kyi 'khor lo dang thugs rje'i gdugs dkar dang thabs dang shes rab gcig tu 'dus pa'i ye shes bla na med pa rnams kyi brdar chos 'khor dang rin po che'i gdugs dang rdo rje'i tog gis mdzes pa/ sgo dang rta babs kyi rgyan rnam par thar ba'i mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i brdar ri dwags chos nyan dang chos 'khor dang gzhan yang dril bu dang me long zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa la sogs pa/sgo'i phyi rol gyi rgyan tā la'i ljon pa dang dpag bsam shing gi nags tshal la bris pa'i dril bu dang g.yer kha chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa sogs/ ngo bo nyid kyi rgyan bden pa bzhi dang bden gnyis dbyer med mtshon pa'i gru chad dang bar khyams la sogs pa rtsa ba'i pho brang rang nyid kyi char gyur pa/ bdag po'i rgyan la/bdag po nyid rgyan du bzhag pa dang / de'i sprul pa'i 'phro 'du la rgyan du bzhag pa dang / bdag po la yod pa'i yo byad rgyan du bzhag pa'i lugs gsum byang / stong smon mtshan med 'od gsal :she shā)re ri'i /re/ ce(1 shā1(spre(1 1)/ rnam par thar ba ༄ sgo ba ma na pa brang sgo khyud 'gram logs gsum dang bcas pa phyogs bzhir snang ba/ 'grel chung las/nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub dang / /bya ba rgyud dang gnyis ka rgyud/ /243

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnal 'byor bskyed dang rdzogs pa yi/ /rnam thar brgyad phyir rta babs brgyad/ /ces pa ltar rgyu'i rta babs brgyad/ rnam thar de dag gi yon tan mtha' dag par rdzogs pa'i rtags su rta rkang la sogs pa'i 'bras bu'i rta babs brgyad dang ldan pa/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings rdo rje'i tshul las gzhan du ma dmigs par gzigs pa'i mtshon byed phyi nang med par kun tu nang du gyur pa/ gang na khri mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khri la sogs pa srog chags kyi gdan dang thabs shes dbyer med pa'i brdar nyi zla'i gdan dang srid zhi'i rgud pa las 'das pa'i brdar pad+ma dang re ba yid bzhin skong ba'i brdar rin po che'i khri ste ston pa'i gdan lnga brtsegs dang gzhan la yang ci rigs pa/ 'dir bla ma 'ga' zhig srogs chags kyi gdan rnams byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams smon lam gyi dbang gis lus gdan du phul ba yin zhing / 'o na ston pa'i yon tan mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i mtshon byed du 'gal zhe na bla ma'i bzhon pa khong gi bsod nams kyis grub pa dang gzhan gyis dad pas phul ba gnyis khong las rgyud tha dad kyi rta gcig la 'du chog pa bzhin no zhes 'chad la bdag nyid chen po 'ga' zhig de dag ston pa nyid kyi ye shes 'ba' zhig gis bsdus par bzhed kyang gdan khri la de gnyis ka yod pa mi 244

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3'gal lo/ /lnga pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa la rang bzhin gnyis su med pa dang / rig pa khyad par can gyi 'khor gnyis las/dang po ni/ gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po lnga ston pa rigs drug pa'i ye shes bde stong thig le chen por byang chab pa'i rnam pa ༄rtags kyi phyag rgya rdo rje mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang 'byung ba lnga rnam par dag pa de bzhin gshegs ma lnga'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rgyal sras sems dpa' dang /'joms byed khro bo'i 'khor gnyis te/ dang po rnam par shes pa bzhi yul dang bcas pa dag pa'i phyag rgya nang gi sems dpa' yab yum dang / dbang po bzhi dus dang bcas pa gnas su dag pa phyi'i sems dpa' yab yum bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa phyi lus kyi chos bzhi dang nang gsang ba'i khams bzhi dang phyin ci log gi rtog pa bzhi gnas su dag pa sgo ba yab yum rnams so/ /de dag ni rnam pa'i cha nas gtso dang 'khor gyi tshul du bstan pa ma gtogs don la ye shes kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pa kho na yin cing / de las gzhan yang ston pa nyid dang rgyud tha dad kyi gdul bya/ rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i sa la gnas pa mtha' yas pa zhig kyang yod de 'di'i yig cha 'ga' zhig tu 'khor snga ma gnyis las gzhan pa dad pas gtam nyan pa'i 'khor zhes bshad pa gtso bor khog 245

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhung las/ dad pas nyan pa'i lha chen rnams/ /zhes pa la dgongs kyang 'di yang der bsdus na legs sam snyam mo/ /go phye ba'i 'khor rnams ni ston pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dngos kyi gdul byar mi 'thad pas sprul pa'i sku rdo rje mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i gdul byar 'gyur zhing de nyid longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gdul byar yang brgyud nas 'gyur ba la dgongs te skabs 'di'i 'khor du bshad pa yod do/ /gnyis pa la'ang phun sum tshogs pa lnga las/ dang po ston pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po khyab bdag rigs drug pa nyid gdul bya ru tra'i ngor 'dul byed gnyen po stobs kyi lha phrin las phyag rgya'i sku mchog 'jigs mdzad rdo rje srin po'i rnam rol du bzhengs pa/ gnas mkha' rlung gi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dkyil zhing chen gyi sa gzhi keng rus kyi ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba chen po'i klong na/'khor gdul bya gsang sngags kyi chos zab mo la las 'phro yod kyang re zhig gab pa'i gsang ba ma rtogs par sbas pa'i gsang ba la mngon par 'chel ba'i rgyus srin po las kyi rdzu 'phral can mthu dang /bye/bye ma rig ri gi 'ju pha 4155dbang bar gyur ba dang / 'dul byad khrag 'thung ral pa' dkyil 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs lnga dang gnas yul sgo 246

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ chos phun sum tshogs pa pho rgyud sgrol bas 'dul ba nga rgyal chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rol pas gdug pa can de dag gi phung po nang khrol dang bcas pa zhal du bstabs shing dregs pa can rnams kyi chung ma dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad ga/tso dang 'khor du bcas pa chags pas rjes su 'dzin pa'am/ mo rgyud sbyor bas 'dul ba la sogs pa rmad du byung ba'i cho 'phrul dang / dus phun sum tshogs pa gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i du sa la bab pa na'o/ /gsum pa sprul sku 'gro ba 'dul ba'i gleng gzhi la'ang lnga las/dang po ston pa gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdor/ rgyal ba gcig gi gzugs sku yang sems can gyi bsam pa'i dbang gis lha dang lha min la sogs par snang lugs mtha' yas pa zhig 'ong bar gsu/ngas pa rnams rigs bsdus nas 'gro 'dul thub pa chen po drug tu bstan pa yin zhes bla ma rnams 'chad do/ /gnyis pa 'a khor rigs can rnam pa gsum gyi gdul bya dge slong pha ma dang dge bsnyen pha ma ste 'khor rnam pa bzhi la sogs pa/ gsum pa gnas sgron ma bkod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams snel gzhi dang yas man gyi rgyud du gtogs pa/ bzhi pa chos la 'dul ba rnam pa bzhi las/ dang po sku bsod nams chen pos 'dul ba ni/ rgyud bla ma 247

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang //bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'da' bar ston mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du thugs mngon sum pas 'dul ba rgyud 'di'i le'u gsum pa nas 'byung ba'i mngon shes chen po drug dang / rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'dul ba sems kyi skad cig re re la'ang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mu mtha' med par ston pa dang / gsung rig pas 'dul ba sems can gyi nyon mongs pa stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan cing ston par 'gyar ba rnams te/ chos phun sum ༄tshogs pa dngos ni gsung gi rnam rig gis 'dul ba nyid la bya'o//gnyis pa rkyen gleng bslang ba la/ ngo bo ni/ thugs thig las/ston pas gnang dang 'khor gyis zhus/ /skabs las gleng bslang 248

phar tā/ khu/jisnyeshā5 rngo1 ngas:rno shārnyarngasno ༄) /gra cardozug rngapab/ 'o/dresab sdos nga/te/rngasno nga// 21rngad/ do/ston dang 'khor/ /gnang 'dri'i rkyen du gang gyur pa/ /de des gsung la ma rag pa/ /zhes pas/ ston 'khor dri lan gyi sbyor bas rgyud don gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham par 'byung ma rag pa/ nges tshig /ci'i phyir gleng bslang zhes bya na/ gang gleng bar bya ba rgyud don yin la de nyid gleng bar bskul ba ni bslang ba ste bstan pa 'byung ba'i rkyen byed pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye na thun mong ma yin pa dang / thun mong gi gleng bslang gnyis/ dang po la lhan cig pa'i 'khor la gsang dbang bskur ba dang dbang gong ma gnyis lhan cig tu bskul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir 'di dang phyogs mthan gyi ༄rgyud sde gzhan las gsang dbang gi lam du sngags bla med kyi sbyor lam 'jog cing / 'di'i bka' srol la ston pa nyid dang lhan cig pa'i 'khor gyi gtso bo sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyang gsang dbang bskur ba'i yul du gsungs pa gnyis ni bdag byin rlob pa'i rnal 'byor la ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis yin te/rgyud de dag tu sgyu ma'i lus la bshad cing rgyud 'di'i bka' srol las gzhan lus kyi sngon du rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor las su rung bar byed pa rang lus thabs ldan gyi lam la mdzad pa'i phyir ro//de lta na'ang dpyad pa'i gnas ches shig tu snang la/ skabs 'di'i bshad tshul de la'ang thabs nyid shes rab tu sbyor tshul dang shes 249

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ rab thabs su sbyor tshul thabs shes gnyis med du sbyor tshal gsum ༄gyi sgo nas yab kyis thabs kyi cha bzung ste chos thams cad ye shes rang snang du gtan la phab pa dang / yum gyis shes rab kyi cha bzung ste don dam stong pa nyid mnyam nyid spros bral chen por ched du brjod pa/ yab yum gnyis med kyis thabs shes gnyis med kyi cha bzung ste lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med zab cing rgya che ba'i sgo nas 'khor la go bar mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la dbang gnyis kyi sngon 'gro thun mong ba ni/ lhan cig pa'i 'khor rnams phyag rgya dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i thabs kyis bde stong dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rnam par drangs pa ste/ 'dren tshul ni le'u gnyis pa'i skabs kyi gzhung bshad du 'chad do/ /de nas dngos gzhi yab yum so so'i nyi zla byang chub kyi sems gnyis rdo rje dang pad+ma'i sna rtser zhal mjal ba'i yas babs kyi dga' bzhi lugs 'byung du shar bas bde stong mnyam par sbyor zhing / de nyid slar ldog pa'i thabs kyis rang gnas su 'ong ba mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i 'gros kyis ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med du gyur pa'o/ /sngon byung gi zab dbang gsum po 'di ma 'ongs go phye ba'i 'khor la ltos nas rgyud 'byung ba'i gleng bslang dang / lhan cig pa'i 'khor rang la ltos nas rgyud don dngos su 'gyur zhes bshad/ gnyis pa 250

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3ni 'khor rnams kyis gzhan don du gsang ba chen po bzhis chod pa'i zab don de kho na nyid kyi gsang ba 'chad par bskul zhing de la brten nas zhal 'dzum pa dang ljags rkyong ba sogs ston pa dgyes pa'i nyams drug gis rgyud 'chad par zhal gyis bzhes pa'o//spyi don gsum pa 'bras bu yongs shes rgyud don 'chad pa la/rgyud gsum gyi rnam bzhag spyir bshad pa/ rgyud kyi dngos po bcu bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyud phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags la bshad de/ /thabs dang rgyu las 'bras bu'o/ /zhes pas/ spyir rgyun chags pa'i don gyis na rgyud ces bya ste/dbye na/ gang rtogs par bya ba gzhi'am rgyu'i rgyud/ gang gis rtogs shing bgrod pa thabs sam lam gyi rgyud/ gang du mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i rgyud dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ brtags gnyis las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o/ /zhes dang / dpe chung rang gnas las/ mi shigs ye shes thig le ni/ /sku gsang thags kyi rdo rje'i bdag /gcig ༄ ༄dang du ma rnam spangs pa/ /sna tshogs snang la mtshon du med/ /ces gsungs shing / /gzhan yang 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud lha mo bzhis zhus pa las/ phyed tshad tsam gyi phra mo mchog /yid kyi dngos po 251

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/thig le'i gzugs/ /rtag tu snying gi dbus gnas pa/ /'od zer chen po 'bar ba can/ /zhes dang / 'od gsal gyi rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor las kyang / tsit+ta rin chen gzhal yas na/ /zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /sku ni snang la rang bzhin med/ /cha phra 'od gsal snying por bzhugs/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa bzhin gzhi 'ching grol med pa'i gnas lugs rig pa byang chub kyi sems rgyu rkyen gsar byung la mi ltos par ye nas sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la shin tu phra ba gnyug ma'i thig ler gnas pa ste/ de la gzhi zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rim gsum las/ tha snyad gnyis kyi chos rnams kun/ /ma lus 'byung phyir gzhi zhes bya/ /zhes 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rtsa ba 'od gsal ba'i ye shes las rang snang ba ste/ de'i phyir shes bya thams cad snang ba'i gzhir gyur pas na gzhi'i rgyud ces bya la/ ji ltar 'khor ba'i chos thams cad 'od gsal gyi rtsal snang du shar ba yin zhe na/ klu sgrub rdo rje can gyis/ 'gro kun rang dbang med pa ste/ /rang dbang du ni 'byung ma yin/ /de yi rgyu ni 'od gsal ba/ /'od gsal thams cad stong pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rig pa rang gnas kyi ye shes de nyid med na de las byung ba'i snang ba gsum yang med par 'gyur la/ de med na snang gsum las skyes pa'i 252

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3rang bzhin brgyad cu'i sems kyang med par 'gyur te/ rdo rje phreng bar/ snang ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid can/ /gang 'dir rnam shes gsum thob pa/ /sems can khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /rang bzhin rtsa ba 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar kun rtog las rlung gi bzhon pa can la brten nas srid pa phyi mar 'phen byed kyi las gsog cing / las de'i dbang 'bras su brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad kyang shar ba'i phyir te/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis/ sems can las kyi dbang gis ri/ /nag po dus su skyes te dper/ /sems dmyal mtho ris 'jig rten na/ /mtshon dang rin chen shing bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /ji ltar mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad 'od gsal gyi ye shes las snang ba yin zhe na/ yang mgon po klus/ sems gang gis ni byis pa rnams// 'khor ba'i 'ching bas bcings gyar pa/ /sems de nyid kyis rnal ༄'byor pa/ /bde gshegs gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes gzhi dus kyi chos sku rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes nyid e waṃ mnyam par sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor la brten nas 'bras bu shin tu rnam par dag pa ye shes mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor lhun rdzogs shing de'i rang rtsal las sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnas lus longs spyod thams cad rnam par snang ba yang rgyud 'di'i le'u dgu pa las/ ye shes thig 253

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ le de nyid la/ /ye shes thig le nyid snang ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas mchog /phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /zhing khams rnam dag bsam yas dang / /rgya dang bral ba'i gzhal yas khang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin no/ /rgyu mtshan de la dgongs nas mda' bsnun zhabs kyis kyang / /sems nyid gcig po kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na sems nyid de'i char gyur pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga dang / de dag gi dbye gzhi dbyings dang ye shes gnyis te bdun la don dam dkor bdun zhes kyang gsungs te sems kyi gnas lugs kyang yin la 'bras chos rgya mtsho lta ba'i snang gzhir gyur pas dkor mdzod kyang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bka' srol 'dir byang chub kyi sems bden pa dbyer med lhag pa'i chos sku chen po zhes bya ba'ang de nyid yin te/ gong du rgyan bdun pa'i skabs su bshad pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med kyi bsgrub gzhi dang / mdo rgyud 'og ma rnams su ma grags pa'i gzhi gnas kyi chos sku yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rim gsum las/ dang po rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /ngo bo'i gzhi dang btags pa'i gzhi/ /zhes gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i 254

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3bag chags kyang gzhi rgyud du gsungs pa ni kun nyon phyogs kyi rten 'brel tsam la dgongs te/ sgras brjod rigs kyi dbye ba mdzad par snang gi/ gzhi rgyud mtshan nyid par 'jog pa min no/ /gnyis pa la'ang ngo bo/ /rim gsum las/ ngo bo shes rab rnam gsum gyis/ /sems lnga skyes par bstan pa yin/ /zhes thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab rnam pa gsum gyis thun mong dang mchog gi sems lnga skyes sam skye ba la 'chad pa dang / mchog gi sems lnga'i skye lugs kyang gsang sngags bla med kyi lam gyi che ba la spro zhing 'dun pa'i sems mgo ldang ba'i tshal du skye ba g.yo ljang byang chab raring raring kyi sems/ theg pa de'i yon tan thob na snyam pa smon pa byang chub kyi sems/ de la 'jug pa 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems/ de la gnas pa gnas pa byang chub sems/ de'i 'bras bu thob pa mthar phyin byang chub kyi sems su 'chad pa bka' srol yin no/ /de la dbye na/ thabs kyis nges pa'i lam dang / shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba'i lam gnyis/ de gnyis kyi khyad par/ gtso bor thabs kyi khyad par brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas 'bras bu myur du 'grub par byed pa thabs lam/ gtso bor shes rab rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas rang rgyud kyi 'ching ba chos nyid du grol bar byed pa grol lam yin te/ de gnyis ka zung 'brel du 255

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byas nas 'bras bu sgrub pa yin gyi/ gcig la gcig mi ltos na grol lam tshogs sgrub kyi skabs su thabs lam 'og sgo'i gdams ngag nyams su len pa dang / thabs lam gyi gnad thams cad grol lam gyi lta bas 'dzin dgos pa sogs mi rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang rdzogs rim gyi dbang du byas nas bzhag pa gtso che zhing thabs lam steng 'og gi sgo gnyis kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa ni rdzogs rim la thog mar slob pa'i las dang po pas kyang gtso bor byed la/grol lam gyi skabs su bshad pa'i mthong ba'i rjes la 'jog pa dang /rig pa spyi blugs su 'jog pa gnyis ni theg mchog rgyal po'i rgyud ltar na rnam bzhag gzhan yang yod mod kyi/ 'di skor la ni rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa mthon po'i skabs shig la gzigs nas gsungs par mngon no/ /thabs lam la dbye na gnyis te/ steng sgo 'ju 'dul dang / 'og sgo mkha' gsang rol ba'o/ /dang po ni/rgya mtsho las/ 'khor lo gsam gnyis srog shing gsam/ /me rlung rigasir+sha rig mi'agro bas nam mkha'i ba/ bzho ba'i steng du rnam par grags/ /zhes pas/ 'khor lo gsum gnyis drug yin zhing / srog shing gsum ni rtsa dbu rkyang ro gsum ste/ lus kyi dbus su srog shing ltar gnas pa de la brten nas spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis/mgrin par brgyad gnyis bcu drug snying gar rtsa 'dab brgyad/ 256

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi/ de'i 'og tu sbar bya me'i 'khor lo gru gsum ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i 'og tu spor byed rlung gi 'khor lo gzhu'i dbyibs can/ chang zung yo gis mtshan pa dang drug gnas shing / me rlung 'gro bas nam mkha'i ba zhes pa/ steng rlung mnan pa lte 'og tu slebs pa dang / 'og rlung bskul ba'i rkyen gyis gsum mdo'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yos pas me'i dkyil 'khor sbar/ me rlung gnyis dbu ma'i lam brgyud nas spyi bo'i haṃ yig nam mkha'i ba zhes tha snyad btags pa las ba las 'o ma 'jo ba ltar haṃ yig las byang sems dngul(rngul)chu'i rdog po ltar 'dzag pas spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang / dga' ba'i ye shes skyes/ de bzhin mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba rnams su dbab pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes pa la bslab pa ni/ thabs lam steng sgo'i lam gyi rim pa'o/ /zhes legs bshad rol mtsho las bshad do/ /mdor na tshul 'di ni rgyud kyi le'u bcu gsum par gsungs pa'i kun tu bzang po'i man ngag la sogs pa 'khor lo bzhir gnad du bsnun pa/'i rdzogs rim rnams la bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa las/ lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo/ /dbye'am yang na mi dbye bar/ /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen dang / /sgrub pa dang ni sgrub chen po/ /yum gyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bde ba thugs kyi 257

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dkyil 'khor spro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyor dus kyi bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i sgo nas ston te/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i yum btsal bar brtag pa sogs bsnyen pa'i yan lag /rda bzhis bskul te phyag rgya bzhi dang 'du shes gsum ldan gyi snyoms par 'jug pa nye bar bsnyen pa'i yan lag /de nas yas bab kyi dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas byang chub kyi sems dbab cing bzung ba sgrub pa'i yan lag mthar byang byang sems ldog dgram gyi sbyor bas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong ba sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go/ /gnyis pa la'ang rim cig char gnyis yod de lta ba dang sgom pa'i dus su dbyer med chig chod du rtogs shing goms pa cig char ba dang / dbyer med du rim gyis rtogs shing goms pa rim gyis pa'o zhes rog bde gshegs chen po dang rje sgrol g.yung gnyis gsungs te 'di nyid 'thad phyogs su lo chen rin po che yang bzhed do/ /de ltar byed na ni sngags bla med kyi lam la sbyangs pa sngon song gi gang zag zhig cig char bar bzhag na bde zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan yang skabs 'di'i grol lam pa'i gtso bo ni rin po che lta bu'i gang zag snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i skal ba can zhig la byas nas/ de 'dra des dang po rten 'dir lam 258

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3'di la slob tshul myar bul gnyis su 'ong ba'i sgo nas bzhag par rāk+ta)pe //sne) dmi mi 1)((smras na gas —/ gzhan du na cung zad dka' bar ma na no/ /lam de bshad na/ le'u bcu gnyis par/ shes 'jug mtshan nyid 'byor ba'i gzungs/ /'bras bu smin byed rgyu dang rkyen/ /nus mthu can du gang gyur pa/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /zhes pas rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba/ rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting nge 'dzin/ lam gyur gyi 'bras bu rig 'dzin bzhi dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'di'i skabs kyi bka' srol las/ sngon byung dngos lnga/ rjes 'jug tshul lnga/ tshig lnga'i gtan tshigs rnams 'chad kyang / don la lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa dngos kyi char de kun mi dgos pa 'dra ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma'i zhabs kyis man ngag lta ba'i phreng bar/ lta ba'i skabs su rtogs pa bzhi'i gtan tshigs tsam las ma byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dir yang gtso bor de bshad par bya ste/ le'u bcu gcig pa/rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul/ /byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum par/ /rab tu rtogs pa rnam bzhi yis/ /thams cad mngon rdzogs rgyal po che/ /zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ /dang po rgyu gcig pa'i gtan tshigs ni/ gu ru lugs mthong ba'i don rtogs las/'khor 'das gnyis chos can/ rang byung gi ye shes su rgyu gcig 259

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa yin te/ rtogs ma rtogs kyi byed pas 'khor 'das gnyis su snang ba'i phyir zhes 'byung zhing / zhe 'dod la/ shes bya chos can/'khor 'das kyi chos rnams gang la brten nas snang ba'i snang gzhi mthar thag gcig tshul bzhag tu yod de/ sems nyid rang byang gi riri pho rigaci ye shes 'ba' zhig chos thams cad kyi snang gzhi mthar thug tu 'jog tshul de yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ sa ra has/ gang zhig blangs nas skye shi'i gnas gyur pa/ /de nyid blangs nas bde chen mchog 'grub ces/ /skad gsang mthon pos mda' bsnun smra byed kyang / /byol song 'jig rten mi go ji ltar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor ba'i rten 'brel lugs 'byung gi tshe nyer len gyi phung po lnga'i bskyed gzhi/ rlung sems thams cad kyi thug sa dang /'tshang rgya ba na snang gsum shin tu phra ba'i bar gyi nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad kyi sbyang gzhi mthar thug pa 'od gsal kho na la byed tshul de yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/'khor 'das kyi gzhi gcig tshul de las mthar thug pa'i rgyu gcig pa ma yin par sgrub byed kyi mtshan ma rnam dag med pa'i phyir/zhes yod pa 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa yig 'bru'i tshul gyi gtan tshigs ni/ snga ma las/sems nyid skye med kyi mdangs chos can/ rol pa 'gaṭas med 260

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3lha'i sku gsung thugs su rang snang ba yin te/ mtshon du med pa'i yi ge a nyid mtshon byed yi ge du mar ma 'gags par snang bas mtshon nas rtogs pa'i phyir zhes byung / 'di la'ang blo rtse ni/ rgya mtsho las/ sku gsung thugs su snang ba yi/ /ma lus gsung gi rgyan du rtogs/ /thams cad gsung gi yi ge ste/ /thabs dang ldan pas rgyas gdab bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems nyid skye med kyi ye shes chos can/ khyod kyi gdangs sgyu ma lta bu'i lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pa cir yang 'char du rung ste/ rlung gi byed rtsol las byung ba'i a yig gi gdangs gcig gnas kyi khyad par la brten nas yi ge'i bye brag du mar 'char ba bzhin ye shes kyi rlung ni cir yang snang du btub pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa yin te man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba la'ang 'brel 'grigs pa yin no/ /gsum pa byin gyis rlabs pa'i gtan tshigs ni/ snga ma las/rang bzhin skye med dang rol pa 'gag med gnyis chos can/ ldog pa so sor snang yang ngo bo dbyer med kyi byin rlabs shugs la 'byung ba yin te/ lhag pa don dam gyi snang ldog kun rdzob sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du rang snang ba'i phyir/ zhes byung yang /'di la go ba len lugs legs po zhig rnyed dgos kyi byin gyis brlabs pa sgrub byar bzung ngo zhes mi bsam ste/ rgyud kyi tshig 261

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zin bzhi ka gtan tshigs su 'dod phyin chad de'i nang nas kha cig bsgrub bya dang kha cig rtags su bkod pas chog par mi snang ngo / /de bzhi gtan tshigs rer khas len pa las 'os med yin min brtag rgyu yod na'ang yongs grags su ni de ltar brtags pa mi mdzad do/ /don du na byin gyis rlabs pa'i gtan tshigs zer tshe bla ma 'ga' zhig shes bya chos can/ bden pa gnyis don la ngo bo dbyer med yin te/ rnal 'byor pas bden pa gnyis so so nas go ba rnam dag rnyed kyang de gnyis ngo bo dbyer med la nges pa ma 'drongs pa med par/ bden gnyis so sor nges pa 'i byin rlabs sam nus mthu las dbyer med rtogs pa ngang gis 'byung ba'i phyir zhes 'chad pa cung zad bde'o/ /rdo rje 'chang chen po pad+ma sam+bha ba'i man ngag las bshad pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i sems kyi gnas lugs dang de'i rang rtsal ye shes kyi nā da gnyis po 'ba' zhig dag pa'i rang bzhin du ye nas yod par ma zad de'i byin rlabs sam cho 'phrul las gang snang gi chos thams cad bde ba chen po snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha skur rang snang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi mtha 'grub par 'gyar ro zhes bshad de rdo rje'i gnas/ no༅ ༄shishin tu brling ba zhig go/ /bzhi pa mngon sum pa'i gtan tshigs ni/ mngon sum pa 262

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3lgertags su bkod nas de 'dra'i mngon sum ma thob pa rnams la nges shes skyed pa yin gyi/ mngon sum pa la 'god rgyu'i gtan tshigs zer ba min no/ /de 'god tshul ni/ snga ma las/ bden pa dbyer med chos can/ blo'i spyod yul las 'das pa yin te/ rang rig mngon sum gyis yul med rang gsal du rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhes byung de'ang gtan tshigs snga ma gsum gyis lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med kyi don de nyid tshad ma'i gnod pa dang bral bar bsgrubs nas/ 'dis sngags bla na med pa'i chos kyi de nyid zab mo ma mthong ba'i byis pa rnams la lhag pa'i bden gnyis shin tu lkog tu gyur pa yin na de gang gis rnyed par 'gyur snyam pa'i dogs spong mdzad pa yin te/ bden gnyis thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul 'di ni rang bzhin brgyad cu la sogs pa'i rnam shes rags pa 'khor bcas la mi snang yang nam zhig sgom stobs kyis yid ches pa'i mtshan ma dang bcas te mthong bar 'gyur bas sems rags pas ma mthong ba tsam las med par nges pa min zhes pa'i don du bshad na sangs rgyas pad+ma'i man ngag gi dgongs pa ste sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho dang ye shes rngam glog gi dgongs pa'ang de yin la/ 'di 'dra ba'i 'gro lugs rdo rje snying 'grel na'ang 'ga' re yod do/ /de ltar na de dag gi theg pa gzhan dang rgyud sde gzhan gyi lam nas 263

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/spyad du mi nus pa'i snang gsum gyi bag chags shin tu phra ba rnams lam 'dis dka' ba med par snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la spyad nus pa ni rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la 'gag thug cing / rim gnyis la de lta bu'i gnad gsang yod pa de'ang mthar gtugs na gzhi lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med kyi ngo bo'i bzhugs tshal ༄'di nyid lta bas gtan la phab/ sgom pas nyams su blangs/ spyod pas bogs bton pa la rag las par dgongs te rtogs pa bzhi po 'dis rim pa gnyis kyis gnad du bsnun pa gtso bo dang / sku gnyis kyi bsgrub gzhi mthar thug ngos bzung na sa sngags bla med kyi rtogs dka'i gnas che shos bstan par mdzad la/ phar phyin theg pa dang thun mong gi bdag med pa'i lta ba yang rgyu gcig pa'i tshul gyi phyogs gcig na yod pas mdor na lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'i man ngag cha tshang ba yin no/ /dag pa gsum dang mnyam pa bzhi'i nang nas snga mas ni snod rnam par dag pa 'og min gyi zhing dang / bcud rnam par dag pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin du blta ba'i lha'i rnal 'byor bstan cing / mnyam pa bzhi la bshad lugs mi 'dra ba 'dug kyang kun mkhyen klong chen pa snang brtags kyi chos thams cad don dam par rang bzhin med 264

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3mnyam dang / tha snyad du rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i tshul du mnyam pa thun mong gi mnyam gnyis dang / snang ba lha dang dkyil 'khor du mnyam pa dang / yul can ye shes bde chen du mnyam pa lhag pa'i mnyam gnyis su bzhed pa ltar ma byas na cung zad dka' bar snang ngo / /spyir sngags kyi lta ba'i skabs su snang ba lhar sgrub pa'i man ngag gis chos thams cad dag mnyam chen por gtan la 'bebs pa rong zom partsi ta chen pos yang dang yang du gsungs la/slob dpon des snang ba lhar sgrub pa'i rigs pa 'ga' zhig ni mi slob pa'i sa na ye shes mi bzhed pa'i gnad la thug cing / gzhan du rnal 'byor pa'i mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir sa 'og grub pas sa chen po sgo yod pa'i snang lugs 'ong bar dri med 'od du bshad pa dang 'dra bar sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig la'ang gzigs pa yongs su dag pa'i 'phags chen gyis 'og min gyi 'byor ba lta bu'i mthong tshul 'ong ba sogs la brten nas tha mal ltar snang ba'i gnas 'di mtha' gcig tu ma dag pa'i ngo bor grub pa min pa dang / yul can shes pa'ang glo bur 'khrul rtog gi gzhan dbang la brten nas re zhig blo'i rang bzhin mthar thug pa mngon du ma gyur pa yin gyi/ chu'i tsha ba nam yal ba na rlan gsher gyi rang bzhin yongs su rdzogs par snang ba ltar glo bur ba'i 'khrul ba bag 265

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/chags dang bcas pa nam zad pa na sems kyi rang bzhin yul ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs nus pa'i ngang tshul can du 'gyur ba sogs 'ga' zhig ni phar phyin theg pa nas kyang ma bshad pa min la/mdo sngags gang gi lugs la'ang 'ching ba mtha' dag gis bcings pa'i so skye zhig da lta nas rdo rje sems dpa' dang spang rtogs mnyam par 'jog lugs shig ni mi srid par byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum sogs las bshad cing bdag gi bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi khyab bdag rje btsan mkhyen brtse'i zhabs ༄kyang bzhed do/ /des na rgyud sde 'di skor gyi bka' srol nas chos thams cad ye shes rang snang du bsgrub pa'i gnad che shos kyang kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos kun byed kyi rgyud drangs nas bshad pa ltar chos thams cad kyi snang gzhi mthar thug pa gnas lugs rang bzhin gyis brjod du med pa'i dbyings dang / de'i snang cha sems nyid 'od gsal ba'i ye shes zung 'jug gi gzhi/ ye grol 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan nyid can de yin par grub song bas chog gi/snang ba 'di lha dkar ser dmar ljang du khra shig shig lang song ba'i gu dog gi sgrub lugs tsam mi dgos par mthong ste/ kho bo skyes thob kyi blo gros dman yang kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gzhung la cung zad ngal ba'i mthus 'di 'dra ba'i tshul rnams lung rigs 266

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3dpang por bzhag ste bshad na theg mchog thabs kyis che ba rang ba zhin rdzogs pa chen po man chad gang la'ang bstan pa'i bla mi 'tshong ba'i bshad tshal rib tsam re yodade/ 'dir yi ges ༄ 'jigs nas snying po bsdus so/ /don gnyis pa rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting nge 'dzin la/mos sgom dang / nges rdzogs gnyis/ de yang 'di'i skabs kyi mos sgom zhes pa bcos ma'i rnal 'byor ram mos pa lam byed kyi bskyed rim spyi la mi zer gyi/ bskyed rim nyid la'ang mos sgom dang nges rdzogs gnyis su phye bar snang ngo / /de ltar na mos sgom ni stong chen la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin lnga po rnams snga ma snga ma'i gsal brtan gyi tshad rdzogs rdzogs su phyi ma phyi ma mi sgom par dus la sdod pa ma yin gyi/ dang po nas gsal brtan med pa'i lha'i don spyi'i rnam par shar sgom tsam byed pa la zer bar 'dug go/ /nges rdzogs des zhar la rtogs shing bskyed rim pa'i nges rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor lnga bo'i ngos 'dzin ni/ lam rim las/ srid pa rim pa smin tshul gyis/ /'jug pa'i yan lag lnga ru bzhag /gang dag dngos kun rang rig phyir/ /shi ba don dam bden pa ste/ /skye ba bar ma kun rdzob yin/ /skye ba rim gsum gnyis med don/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po 'chi ba chos skur dag byed stong pa chen po'i 267

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnal 'byor ni/ thal rgyud las/ snang ba thim dang rtog pa thim/ /phra ba thim dang rags pa thim/ /thim pa'i rjes la goms pa yis/ /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal 'char/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lus can rnams 'chi ba'i tshe snying ga'i rtsa mdud yongs su rdzogs pa grol nas rlung thams cad mi shigs pa'i thig ler thim pa las byung ba'i snang gsum 'od gsal dang bcas 'char ba ni gzhi dus kyi stong pa chen po yin no/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pas lam du byas nas 'od gsal mngon sum du shar ba lta bu'i ye shes chen po'i nga rgyal gyis rang bzhin ma bcos pa'i de kho na nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa ni stong chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor te/ 'di'i stong pa chen po zhes pa blo de'i dbang gis tha mal pa'i blo kun rdzob pa 'di nang du bsdus nas skabs der chos can gyi snang ba dmigs su med par stong pa nyid kyi rnam can du gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /gnyis pa snying rje sgyu ma ni/ yid can tha mal pa rnams 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi sems las slar sad ma thag tu bar srid kyi lus rlung sems las grub pa'i dbang po kun tshang du grub pa ni gzhi dus kyi snying rje sgyu ma yin la/ de lam du khyer nas stong pa chen po'i ngang las de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la dmigs med kyi snying rje chen pos bskul te sgyu 'phral drwa ba'i lha sku cha zla'i zirab skur 268

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3rnam pa lta bur langs la gzhan don rgya chen po bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyi g.yo ba de nyid bskyed rim pa'i skabs 'dir snying rje sgyu ma ra gsungs te/ 'di med na gtso 'khor thams cad du ma ro gcig gi tshul du 'char ba dang / 'bras dus kyi gzugs sku dang rnam pa shin tu mthun pa zhig mi 'ong ba la dgongs nas snying rje sgyu ma khyad chos bzhi ldan du bsngags pa sogs gzhung 'dir yang bshad pa dang / gzhan du grub chen mtsho skyes sogs kyis kyang bshad do/ /de lta na'ang sgyu 'phrul lam rim las snying rje sgyu ma la drug tu gsungs pa'i skabs su phyag rgya sgyu ma chu zla lta bu zhes gsungs pa de don zab la dbyings che ba zhig yin pas legs par dpyad do/ /snying rje sgyu ma zhes pa'i don yang sems can la brtse ba'i snying rje chen po sgyu ma lta ba'i spyod yal can rnam bdag dang no༅ rabasems can sgyu ma ltar rtogs pa yin pas na de ltar brjod cing /yang na snying rje ni bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang de nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i lha skur ldang ba'i don la sbyar bar bya'o/ /gsum pa skye ba sbyong byed phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor la/ bar srid kyi sems can tshe phyi ma'i 'jig rten du lus rags pa bzung ba ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ de la'ang mnga' zhugs nas btsa' ba'i bar dang / btsas nas rigs kyi bya ba la dbang bsgyur ba'i bar dang /269

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de nas kyang dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi bya ba la 'jug pa'i rim pa gsum 'byang ba ltar sbyong byed kyi lam yang gsum du gsungs pa'i/༄dang po phyag rgya gcig pu ni/ gzhi dus kyi nur nur po sogs mngal zhugs yan lag ma dod pa'i skabs dang chos mthun pa snying rje'i rang rtsal rgyu'i rig pa a yig dkar por bsgoms nas yi ge'i 'phro 'du la sems sbyangs ba phra ba yig 'bru dang / mngal nas yan lag rdzogs pa dang chos mtshungs pa sa bon gyi yi ge las cho ga gsum bskyed lta bu'i rtsa lha yab yum yan lag gi lha dgu dang bcas pa/ yul gsum gyad du ma gyur pa de srid du bsgoms pa rags pa lha sku la bslab pa'o/ /gnyis pas phyag rgya spros bcas la/dkyil 'khor tshom bu/ grangs/ zhal phyag spro ba ste bzhi las/ dang po/ zhi ba la dkyil 'khor rgyas pa rigs lnga rigs chung dang bcas pa yab yum lnga bcu'i steng du sems dpa' sems ma bcu drug sgo ba yab yum/ bya byed/ thub drug ste brgyad cu rtsa gnyis/'bring po rigs lnga yab yum/ sems dpa' sems ma/ sgo skyong /bya byed thub drug bcas zhe gnyis/ bsdus pa rigs lnga yab yum bcu dang sgo rba yang yum brgyad de bco brgyad do/ /des mtshon nas khro bo la dkyil 'khor rgyas pa ltar brgyad kyi steng du khro bcu yab yum nyi shu rigs chung gi khro bo yab yum bzhi bcu bsnan pas 270

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3lha grangs brgya dang bco brgyad/ 'bring du rigs chung gi khro bo rnams phri bas don brgyad/ bsdu na khro bcu yab yum rnams phri bas lnga bcu rtsa brgyad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ zhi ba la rigs lnga yab yum rigs chung gi sems dpa' dang bcas pa'i khro bo yab yum nyi shu ste bdun brgya ni tshom bu lnga pa/ de'i nang nas lho byang gi rigs kyi gtso bo rigs chung dang steng 'og gi khro bo bcas phri bas zhe drug tshom bu gsum pa/ de las shar nub kyi rigs gtso rigs chung khro bcu bcas gzhan rnams phri nas rdo rje mi bskyod pa rigs chung zung bzhi sgo ba yab yum brgyad dang bcas pa ni tshom bu gcig pa'o/ /de bzhin du khro bo la yang phyogs mtshungs pa las/ bgrang gzhi gtso bo khrag 'thung dang / 'khor gnas yul sgo skyong dbang mo khro bcu bcas yod pa gzhir bzhag tshom bu gcig pa la rdo rje'i rigs chang gi khro bo yab yum brgyad bsnan/ gsam pa'i de'i steng risi bye ri ringadu shar gnyis kyi rigs gtso rigs chung bcas bsnan/ lnga par de'i steng du lho byang gi rigs gtso rigs chung bcas bsnan no/ /dkyil 'khor dang tshom bu'i khyad par la/ rigs tha dad kyi gtso bo gcig tu gyur pa dkyil 'khor dang / rigs tha mi dad kyi gtso bo so sos byed pa tshom bu yin zhes gnyal sangs rgyas grags bzhed pa ltar lo chen rin po che yang bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni/ snang pa 27 1

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnam 'byed la bslab pa ste/ de la'ang zhi khro gnyis las/ zhi ba la tshom bu stong dang / nyi khri bzhi stong dang / bsam yas lhun grub la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yan lag gi lha bzhi bcu tham pa rtsa lha yab yum gnyis la tshang bar bsgom pa ste/ mi bskyod pa la mtshon na yab kyi yan lag lnga la byed pa po dang rgyal ba rigs bzhi/mig rna sna lce bzhi'i g.yas kyi cha la nang sems dang / g.yon gyi cha la phyi sems bzhi/ rkang lag gi mthil bzhir sgo bzhi rnams dang / yum gyi gnas de rnams su lha de dag gi yum rnams bsgom/ yab la lhag por mtshog ma la sogs pa'i gnas drug tu thub drug ste/de ltar bzhi bcu ni rags pa dang phyi na gnas pa'i cha nas thabs lha zhes bya'o/ /de rnams re re la sku gsung thugs kyi lha gsum gsum dang / shes rab kyi lha'am ye shes sems dpa' bzhi bcu/thabs lha dang byin rlabs kyi lha brgya drug cu po re re la dbang lha lnga lnga tshang bas bsdoms na chig stong ngo / /de'i rigs pas lhag ma gnyis kyang go bar nus so/ /thub pa drug ni re re la'ang chig stong re bsgom pa yin la/ rtsa lha gang yin gyi rtogs pa'i gnas su byed po spro ba khyad par ro/ /de bzhin du khro bo la gtso bo badz+ra he ru ka'i yan lag lnga la khrag 'thang yab lnga dang / yum la yum lnga/ yab bi rigadzub rlobastadabang rten gyi nang rtsar kau ri ma brgyad/ phyi rtsar sing ha ma brgyad /272

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3mthil bzhi la sgo ma bzhi/ mjing mjug gi tshigs bsnan pas sgal tshigs nyer brgyad la dbang mo nyer brgyad de thabs lha nga brgyad/de thams cad la ye shes sems dpa' dang byin rlabs kyi lha rnams tshang ba re dang / de las shes rab kyi lha nga brgyad phri ba'i lhag ma rnams la dbu rgyan gyi lha lnga lnga ste/ bsdoms pas stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu'o/ /de 'dra ba re khrag 'thung gzhan bzhi dang / gnas yul sgo skyong dbang mo rnams la'ang tshang bar bsgoms pas bdun khri drug stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu yin la/ de ltar rdul gcig gi khyon la rdul snyed kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho grangs dang blos mi thug pa zhig/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rol mor 'phral ba ni bsam yas lhun grub ༄kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ zhal phyag grangs med dang /zhal gsum phyag drug la sogs pa dbu phyag gi spro bsdu mtha' yas pa zhig bshad kyang sgrub thabs su zhi ba la rgyas par thub drug dang yum rnams ma gtogs pa zhal gsum phyag drug 'bring du gtso bo zhal gsum phyag drug bsdu na thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis su bsgom pa dang / khro bor rgyas pa rigs lnga'i he ru ka zhal gsum phyag drug bsdus par thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis par kasungs so/ /lnga pa tshom bu tshogs sgrub la/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas gzhi bzung / bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis gzhung bsrang / 273

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'bras bu rig 'dzin thob pa'i dus bstan pa dang gsum las/dang po ni gnas phun sum tshogs pa bdag dbang bar chad med pa'i gnas su/ lam rim las/ bskor khang phyi nang bar ldan pa/ /zhes pa'i tshogs kyi khang par/ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ rgyud las/tshes grangs yar gyi brgyad nas brtsams/ /shin tu skar ma rgyal rnams la/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i bza' skar sbyor byed bzang por/ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa/ 'tsho ba zas/ rkyen zlog sman/sgrub pa rdzas/ mchod pa rdzas kyi yo byad rnams spogs chog ldang tshad du bsags nas/ sgrub pa po phun sum tshogs pa/ rang bzhin brgyad ldan gyi ston pa rdo rje'i slob dpon dang / de dang dgongs pa mnyam pa'i rdo rje'i rgyal tshab/ skad gdangs che zhing las khrigs mkhas pa'i rdo rje las mkhan/ sbyor ba'i sgyu rtsal shes pa'i las bzhi'i gzungs ma/ mi ma yin mthong ldog nus pa'i rdo rje spyan pa/drod 'dzin pa'i rdo rje bya rog sgrol ba'i las la mkhas pa'i rdo rje ging / g.yos la mkhas pa'i rdo rje byan po/ phyi nang gi brda sbyor mkhas pa'i rdul phyag skyes bu sogs tshom bus 'brel pa'i gtso 'khor gyis/ cho ga phun sum tshogs pa/ spros bcas man chad la brtan pa thob pa zhig gis bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i sgo nas dngos grub bsgrub pa'o/ /274

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3gnyis pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha gnas so sor rnal 'byor pho mo rnams grangs sprad de 'dug nas rim pa shoms dang 'brel bar nub dang po mgo 'dzin gyi bsnyen pa nas bzung bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i rim pas sgrub pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen dang / /sgrub pa dang ni sgrub chen no/ /zhes pas/ gtso 'khor gang yin de'i lha so so'i nga rgyal bya ba sor bzhag nas nub dang po sgrub pa dbu 'dzugs kyi bsnyen pa dang /ji tsam bsgrub pa'i zhag grangs phyed tshud chad du nye bsnyen bya ba ste/de gnyis la bdag dam tshig pa/ mdun bskyed ye shes pa/ bar gyi 'phro 'du ste gsal ba gsum ldan gyi sgo nas 'od zer dkar po'i 'phro 'du bsnol mas rgyud dngos grub kyi snod rung du dag par byed pa yin la/ nub tha ma ma gtogs pa'i phyed phan chad 'od zer dmar po'i 'phro 'dus dngos grub bskul zhing bsdu bar byed pa sgrub pa dang / nub tha ma la 'od zer mthing ga tshur bsdu bas rdzas dang rgyud dag par byed pa'i sgo nas srod kyi cha la lha las dngos grub blang zhing / nam gung ta na'i mdzad spyod kyis dgra las dngos grub len pa dang / tho rangs yum dang gnyis su med par snyoms 'jug gi bya bas phyag rgya'i mkha' las dngos grub len pa rnams sgrub chen te/ lam rim las/ zla phyed phyed zhag nye 275

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bsnyen pa/ /lha gsal 'phro 'dus snod du rung / /bco lnga mar phyed sgrub pa ste/ /'phro 'du bsnol mas bsgrub par bya/ /zhag grangs tshad nas rtags byung na/ /dngos grub blang ba sgrub chen po/ /zhes dus tshad zla ba gcig la dper brjod nas gsungs pas mtshon zhes yan lag bzhi po'i ngos 'dzin de ltar mdzad do/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar zla drug spogs chog dang bcas pas rig 'dzin gyi 'bras bu 'grub pa'o zhes bshad la/ spogs chog bya lugs ni/ sgrub dus kyi cho ga dkyus ma nyid yang bskyar gyi tshul du bya ba ma gtogs rgyud sde gzhan nas gsungs pa'i bsam gtan gyi phur gdab lta bu'i man ngag zar pa gsung srol cher mi snang /༄rig 'dzin 'grub lugs kyang rgyud sde gzhan nas bskyed rim gyi dus su spyod pa byas pa'i dgos ched thun mong gi dngos grub chen po rnams 'thob pa yin la/ de ni 'dir yang 'dod dgos par snang ste/ kun mkhyen bla ma shan+ta pu ri bas kyang / gsang ba snying po dpal ldan 'dus pa sogs/ /bskyed pa ma hā yo ga ji bzhin du/ /zhes rgyud de dag rgyud sde'i bab kyang 'dra bar gsungs so/ /spyir bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi 'jog byed srog dhū tir btsud pa las byung ba'i brtan pa'i rnal 'byor dang / de las gzhan pa'i sngags bla med kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bcos ma'i rnal 'byor gnyis yin 276

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3par gsungs shing / de gnyis la gzhi mthun yang med pa sngags gsar rnying gnyis ka'i lugs su bya ba rgyud kyi le'u bcu gsum pa'i thad so'i dgongs rgyan na'ang yod la/ da dung rnying ma rang lugs la rdzogs rim pa'i lha sku'i rnal 'byor la bskyed rim zhes btags pa zhig kyang yod par mngon te/ kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyi gzhung na lhag par mang ngo zhes pa ni zhar byung ngo / /don du 'di'i thad kyi spyi don rnams sa 'dod gzags kyi rig pa 'dzin ra༄mi rigazipa'i lus 'grub par gsungs pa de bskyed rim pa'i spyod pa byas pa la brten nas bcud len grub pa'i rig 'dzin gyi lus gzhom gzhig bral ba dang / tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par gsungs pa de 'dra'i rigs su gnas pa'i gzugs can gyi rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur zhes 'dod par snang gi/ rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i ya gyal la mi zer ba 'dra'o/ /phyi ma gsum po'i ming de ltar 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rtsa ba'i lha gcig la dmigs pa dang / de nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i ting 'dzin rgyas pa dang bcas nas sgom pa dang / de yang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma tshogs pa'i tshom bu'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i phyir bzhag pa yin zhes bshad do/ /da ni lam gyi gzhung shing rdzogs rim ltar sbyar lugs bka' srol las byung ba ltar sdom tshig tsam brjod na/ tha mal gyi snang zhen lha'i nga 277

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyal du 'pho thub pa'i bskyed rim zhig sngon du btang nas/ bsam gtan la tsher ma mi 'byung ba'i gnas su/ lus gnad rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos bdun dang ldan pas sngar/ 'khor lo gsum gnyis srog shing gsum/ /sogs drangs pa ltar 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa dang thig le la yid rtse gcig tu bzhag pas/ lam rim las/smig rgyu du ba srin me khyer/ /mar me nyi ma'i tshul du sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nam zhig na rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas stobs kyis dngos su drangs pa'i rtags dang rtags can gyi 'od gsal 'char ba na rdzogs rim gyi mgo brtsams pa yin te 'chi srid kyi 'od gsal dang / 'bras bu'i dus kyi chos sku rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes gnyis kar mthun pa stong pa chen po'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de'i ngang las tha mal pa la 'chi ba 'od gsa' las lugs ldog tu snang gsum 'char ba dang mnyam du bar do'i yid lus sgyu ma lta bur 'grub dang rnam pa cha 'dra ba'i lam stong chen gyi ngang nas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha sku grib ma'i rnam pa lta bur ldang ba ni 'bras bu'i dus kyi bde ba chen po'i sku mi slob zung 'jug dang mthun pa snying rje sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de'ang dper na bar do'i lus de nyid ma'i mngal du zhugs na sa lus rags pa 'dzin pa dang / 'bras bu'i dus su'ang longs spyod 278

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3rdzogs skus gzugs sku rags pa bzung nas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa de bzhin du 'dir yang bde stong zung 'jug gi rnam rol chu dwangs pa la gzugs brnyan 'phos pa lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpa' gsang chen rigs gcig gi ye shes sems dpa' de nyid rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i gzugs sku rags pa la 'jug pa phyag rgya gcig pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de 'dra'i lha sku de'ang gtso rkyang tsam ma yin par gang snang thams cad zhu bde'i lha skur rtsal sbyong byed pa phyag rgya spros bcas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /de bzhin ni dang po srog dhū tir thim nas yun mi ring bar yang 'ong bas dus kyi lo tog brje ba lta bu'i go rim gtan min no/ /de ltar rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa brtan pa'i gang zag gis spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum gang rung bya zhing / des kyang dgos pa'i don ma gab na spogs chog gi sbyor ba bya ste tshom ba tshogs sgrub bo/ /de shā//kyi riri byetsam las ma bshad kyang spyod pa nam bya ba ni rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i nang nas rnam smin dang tshe dbang gang rung la sbyor ba'i don du sngags bla med kyi sbyor lam pa zhig gis bya zhing / des na sbyor lam nas mthong lam du 'gro ba'i don du byed ces zur pa rnams gsungs shing / de'i sngon dang phyi nas kyang spyod pa dgos pa'i skabs yod par 'dod dgos te/ dper na o ṭi ya na'i slob 279

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpon chen po pad+ma'i zhabs kyis don la rang nyid rgyud kyi ston pa dang rnam dbyer med pa'i go 'phang sngar nas brnyes kyang tshur mthong gi snang ngor/ dang por sngags kyi sbyor lam la gnas pa'i skabs su spyod pa lan gnyis mdzad cing / yang le shod du phyag rgya chen po grub zin rjes su yang gangs can gyi ljong 'dir jo mo ye shes mtsho rgyal la bsten nas spyod pa mdzad par snang ba bzhin no/ /da dung 'di la yang bshad par bya ba dang dpyod pa'i gnas mang po zhig snang ngo / /gsum pa lam gyur gyi 'bras bu rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi ni/'dir bka' sde zur pa'i lugs la rig 'dzin bzhi po'i ma mtha' mthong lam dang / ya mtha' rgyun mthar 'jog pas/ de bzhi gang rung yin na sngags bla med kyi slob pa 'phags pa zhig yin pas khyab bo/ /so so'i ngos 'dzin ni/ bla med kyi mthong lam pa yin yang rten gyi gang zag dbang po rtul ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'byung ba snyigs ma'i lus ye shes kyi mes sbyang bar mi nus shing yid 'od gsal gyi lha skur smin pa/ lus rgya'i 'ching ba bral ma thag phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin la sbyor ba rnam smin rig 'dzin/ rnal 'byor pa dbang po rno bas snyigs ma'i lus phra yang la sogs pa'i 'ja' lus kyi yon tan khyad par can dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i sku mi dang 280

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3zhe'adod gzugs lha'i gtso bo'i cha byad du ston pa tshe dbang rig 'dzin te/ lar 'di gnyis don gyi 'od gsal grub pa la khyad med kyang de las zung 'jug gi lha skur dngos su ldang nus mi nus las bzhag par snang zhes kyang kho bo'i bla ma rig 'dzin gyi sa la bzhugs pa chen po gsung ngo / /sgom lam pa ni zung 'jug ye shes sgyu ma'i sku can mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin no zhes bshad kyang don du sgom lam sa dgu la gnas pa phal cher yin no/ /mthar kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub ma rag pa'i sa bcu pa'i khyad par lam pa zhig lhun grub rig 'dzin du bshad do/ /'di'i tshe thod rgal 'byung mi 'byung gis mtshams sogs kyang bshad mod kyi shes par 'dod pa dag gis gzhan du blta'o/ /don gsum pa gang du mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i rgyud ni/ de ltar bla na med pa'i lam gyis dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs pa las gzhi la ji ltar yod pa'i yon tan mngon du gyur pa mthar thug pa ste/khog gzhung las/ grub pa mthar phyin 'bras bur brjod/ /ces so/ /dbye na/ khog gzhung las/ 'bras bu'i ngo bo sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rnam pa lnga/ /de yang skabs kyis lnga lnga ste/ /zhes/rten sku/ brten pa ye shes/ mdzad pa phrin las dang gsum las 281

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang po ni/ shes bya'i de kho na nyid la shin tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes dang de'i chos nyid sgrib bral gyi cha chos kyi sku dang /de las ma g.yos bzhin du 'og min chen por nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs skur snang ba longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / nges pa lnga dang mi ldan pa'i gzugs sku rags pa sprul pa'i sku ste gsum ni sangs rgyas sku gsum du grags shing / sku lnga phye ba'i tshe de'i steng du sku gsum snang cha ma 'dres pa mngon byang gi sku dang / ngo bo dbyer med pa'i cha rdo rje'i sku gnyis bsnan pas lngar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'ga' zhig chos dbyings yul dang / lhag ma bzhi yul can du bzhed mod kyi skabs 'dir lnga ga yul can du 'jog pa'i dbang du byas na/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad las 'das pa'i de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig pa'i ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa chos dbyings ye shes/ de nyid kyi sgo nas tha snyad rten 'byung gi chos thams cad me long la pra phab pa ltar gzigs pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la bden par snang ba'i blos spu ris mi 'byed pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ shes bya thams cad ma 'dres par so sor gzigs pa sor rtog ye shes/de 'dra'i ye shes bzhi po sems can thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i phrin las 'jug pa'i rten gzhir gyur pa'i cha nas bya grub ye 282

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3zheshes so/ /gsum pa ni/ ye shes de dag gi bdag rkyen thun min la brten nas nam mkha' ji srid du rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa rgyun chad med pa rtag pa'i phrin las/ de'ang yul phyogs re ba tsam ma yin par sems can thams cad la nye ring mi mnga' bar 'jug pa khyab pa'i phrin las/ de gnyis gang la'ang 'bad rtsol phra rags thams cad las shin tu 'das pas na lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las so/ /mdor na sku dang ye shes phrin las dang bcas pa thams cad bla na med pa'i yon tan gyi chos su rtsal rdzogs pa ste/de la'ang g.yung ston rdo rje dpal phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyi 'bras bu mthar thug gi sangs rgyas nyid las theg pa 'di nas sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas khyad chos brgyad kyis che bar bshad cing / bla ma gzhan kha cig kyang de ltar 'chad mod kyi/ 'dir ni rog bde gshegs chen po dang / rgyal ba klong chen zhabs mdo sngags so so'i lugs kyis sangs rgyas la khyad par med na'ang / sngags bla med ma brten par mdo nas bshad pa'i skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs kyi sangs rgyas de nyid mi 'grub par bzhed pa shing rta chen po'i lugs yin no/ /spyi don gnyis pa lam gyi cha rkyen rgyud kyi dngos po bcu bye brag tu bshad pa la/ lta ba spyod pa dkyil 'khor dbang / /dam tshig 283

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phrin las sgrub pa dang / /ting 'dzin mchod pa sngags phyag rgya/ /phyi ma gnyis bsdoms bcu ru 'gyur/ /zhes pa rnams las/ dang po de kho na nyid lta ba ni/ lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med gshis ji bzhin par 'jal byed kyi shes rab khyad par can la bya'o/ /nges tshig /dṛsbyi'i sgra las lta ba ste/ yul de la ji bzhin du lta ba'i phyir ro/ /dbye na/ don dam rtogs pa'i lta ba dang / tha snyad pa'i yul can gyi lta ba gnyis te sngar dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa la dor ba spyod pa ni/ rim gsum las/ ting 'dzin khyad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /rjes mthun spyod pa gzhung bzhin spyad/ /ces pas/ thabs shes khyad par can gyis zin pa'i sngags lam pa'i sgo gsum gyi bya bar gyar cing hogs pa'i ye shes bogs dbyang bar byed pa'i thabs su skurab /re/ /ste/ ྅rngo 11pa hāX/ ri'i /ste/bstan pa ga tsho / sa teg tsar+ya ri sgra las spyod pa / gang spyad bya'i yul la dus tshod dang 'brel ba'i tshul bzhi'i spyod pas na de skad bya'o/ /dbye na las dang po'i dus su dge sbyong gzhon nu bas dang ldan pa ltar spyod pa/ rtogs pa rkyen thub kyi dus su dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i zhing khams nyul zhing he ru ka'i chas kyis rgyu ba smyon pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa/ rtogs pa bri gang med pa'i dus su 'dod yon la gang dgar spyod cing gzhan phan byed pa rgyal po sa 'dzin gyi spyod pa zhes gsum du bshad cing gtso bor gyur pa 284

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3rdzeni phyi ma gnyis te/ 'di gnyis 'byor ba'i khyad par las tshogs kyi spyod pa spros bcas dang spros med dang shin tu spros med gsum gsungs pa'i dang po rgyal po sa 'dzin dang lhag ma gnyis smyon pa brtul zhugs su byas kyang chog par snang bas brtan pa 'bring dang chen po'i gnas skabs so sor bzhag pa ni rags rim tsam mo/ /yang na/ bskyed rim pa dang / rdzogs rim pa'i spyod pa gnyis las/dang po la/ 'dod chags chen po rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dngos su byed nus pa'i skabs dang / mi nus pa'i skabs gnyis las/ dang po bskyed rim tshogs sgrub kyi skabs su yo byad lnga la longs spyod pa de yin cing / phyi ma la dad brtson gyi sbyong ba/ shes rab dang mthun pa/ thabs dang mthun pa/ phyogs gcig pa/spros bcas te thun mtshams kyi spyod pa la bslab tshul lnga/ gnyis pa la'ang / skabs kyi sgo nas dbye ba 'ga' zhig yod kyang don la tshogs kyi spyod pa yin cing lam rim du sgyu 'phrul gyi spyod pa gsungs pa ni rnam pa gzhan no/ /gsum pa bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ lha gtso bo dang 'khor ni rnam par bstan pa'i rigs su gnas pa zhig ste/ nges tshigamaṇ+ḍa la'i sgra las snying po'i yon tan gyi gzhi 'dzin cing len pas sam/ yang na gtso bo la 'khor gyis zlum por bskor ba'i don no/ /285

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dbye na/ rgyud phyi ma las/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba las/dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum 'dod de/ /zhes sogs dbye bsdu'i rim pa mang yang / 'dir rgyas pa las/ 'dis ni rang bzhin dkyil 'khor dang / /gzugs brnyan lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan gsum/ /ting 'dzin lhag pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /byang chub sems dang tshogs mchog bstan/ /zhes pa ltar bdun du bya ba las/dang po rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /rang bzhin nyid kyi dkyil 'khor dang / rang bzhin 'bras bu mthar phyin gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis/ dang po ni/ khog gzhung las/ chos nyid rang bzhin spros bral te/ /dngos po kun kyang de bzhin pas/ /rang bzhin nyid kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes pa ltar 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bsgrub gzhi mthar thug pa gnyug ma mi shigs pa'i rdo rje gsum la bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nyid las/ 'bras bu mthar phyin 'og min na/ /bzhugs pa dkyil dang 'khor gyi tshul/ /zhes pa ltar/ mi slob lam gyis bsdus pa'i lha dang tsho ma bu'i snang ba rnams so/ /gnyis pa gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ rgyas pa las/ gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor yang dag ni/ /chen po rags pa thabs su rtogs/ /so so'i mtshan nyid shes rab rtogs/ /gnyis med 'brel ba thabs chen yin/ /zhes gsungs pa 286

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3ltar/ lhag pa don dam bden pa'i rtsal snang kun rdzob rig pa sgyu ma'i snang brnyan du shar ba ste snod bcud thams cad 'di'i mtshan ga/zhir 'jog chog pa 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa (gsum pa)lhag pa gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor na/ sa gzhi mnyam pa la sogs pa'i bya ba mang po sa lhag pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje las rim las/ sa gzhi mnyam dang tshad thig dang / /tshon dang bri ba rnam pa dang / /rab gnas sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor du/ /'jug dang zhugs pa'i yon tan no/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis so/ /rnam bzhag zhib mor ma brjod de 'bru gnyer bkrol ba'i skabs su 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ rgyas pa las/ de bzhin ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor gyis/ /thams cad dbyings su bsdus nas ni/ /nyid kyi thugs la thim byas te/ /thams cad chos sku phyag rgya che/ /zhes pa ltar nges don gyi dkyil 'khor rang rig ma bcos pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog pa ste gnyug ma'i ye shes nges don gyi lhar 'jog pa dang babs 'dra zhing don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sdud rim rgyud gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar dgongs pa btsal na legs te/snang phyogs lha'i 'khor lo la dmigs nas gtso bor rgya che ba'i thabs mkhas ji snyed cig sdud nus pa de'i don du/ stong phyogs rang rig pa'i dbyings su gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba thams cad 287

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bcings pas kyang zab mo'i lam gyi gnad de snyed cig bsdu nus pa la dgongs nas stong phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs pa'ang yin no/ /lnga pa lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ khog gzhung las/ lhag pa ting 'dzin rnam pa gnyis/ /gdul ba'i don phyir zhi khro ste/ /zhes pas sngon 'gro las bdun nas brtsams te /bsgom bya'i gtso bo/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin dang / kun snang gi dang / rgyu'i dang / dkyil 'khor lha'i/ las kyi rim pa'i ste ting 'dzin rnam pa lnga la mkhar bca' zhing / rjes go bgo lus bsrung gi bar gyi cho ga'i bya ba mang pos lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor bas snang phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor zhi ba dang khro bo'i tshul du bsgom pa ste 'brel ba bzhi ldan du 'chad shes par 'dod na dkyus ma dang zhal lung blta'o/ /drug pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyi nang gsang gsum du spyan 'grel las bshad de/'khor lo bzhi la sogs pa phyi rtsa rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ rlung sngags rdzas gsum dang gnas bzhi'i thig le sogs thig le spyi dang khyad par khams dkar dmar gyi cha rnams nang thig le'i dkyil 'khor/ de'ang rtsa yur ba lta bu/ thig le chu lta bu/ rlung kha lo ba lta bur gnas te rnal 'byor pas rtsa'i de nyid shes shing / rlung rang dbang du 'dus pas lte ba'i gtum mo zhes khrag gi ngo bor 288

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3lge gyur pa'i ti la ka spar zhing / de'i mthus spyi bo nas zla ba'i thig le zhu ba gnas bzhir rim pa bzhin du son pa las byung ba'i bde ba chen po ni gsang ba bde ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ rtsa rlung thig le dang bde chen 'dren tshul gyi gnad rnams la grub chen gyi lam srol mi 'dra ba mang po yod pas zhib tu mkhas par bya'o/ /bdun pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ sngar tshogs sgrub kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa rim pa dbang la/ ngo bo ni/ rdo rje 'chang gi spyod yul rmajani byung du h+phub pa'i sngags kyi cho ga la brtemā nas rang gi ngo skal gyi sgrib pa lus sgrib sogs bzhi'i gang rung spyod pa'i nus pa'am bde chen ci rigs pa ste/ khog gzhung las/ rno la ngar btags nus pa bzhin/ /nus pa skyes pa thob pa'i tshad/ /ces thob tshad kyi ma mtha' gsungs pas shes so/ /skabs 'dir dbang gi rgyu gnyis dang rkyen bzhir grags pa ni/ slob ma'i lus la rtsa rlung thig le rang chas su bzhugs pa mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu/ rab gnas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbang rdzas lhan cig byed pa'i rgyu/ snod ldan gyi slob ma rgyu'i rkyen/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon bdag po'i rkyen/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gsum tshogs pa'i nus pa khyad par can dmigs pa'i rkyen/ dbang snga ma snga mas sgo phye nas 289

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phyi ma phyi ma 'byung ba de ma thag pa'i rkyen te 'di rnams chos mngon pa nas grags pa'i rkyen bzhi sogs dang lto sbyar nas gsungs pa kho na'ang min pa 'dra'o/ /nges tshig a bhi ṣiñca'i sgra las mngon par gtor ba'am blugs pa ste/ dri ma gtor ba dang ye shes kyi nus pa rgyud la 'jog pa'i don to/ /dbye na le'u bcu par/ dad brtson brtul zhugs rab rtogs na/ /phan pa'i dbang sbyin nus pa'i dbang / /rim pa bzhin du sbyin par bya/ /snying rjes chud ma zos par gzung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar dad pa can la phyi phan pa'i dbang bcu/ de'i steng du bdag don nus pa'i brtson 'grus can la nyan sgom/ gzhan don nus pa'i brtson 'grus can la 'chad 'phrin/ gnyis ka'i don nus pa'i brtson 'grus can la rdo rje rgya'/ po ste nus dbang lnga/ de nas spyod rig mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs/ can la gsang ba zab mo'i dbang gsum bskur ba ste/ de dag thams cad kyang bsdu na bla med spyi la grags pa'i bum gsang shes rab tshig dbang ste rnam pa bzhir ma 'dus pa med cing / spyir bum dbang gi don mtha' rten bum pa'i chu dbang gis byed pa la 'chad kyang skabs 'dir bza' btung dang go cha sogs la de 'dra'i mtha' rten mi 'dug pas bum dbang gi yan lag tu bsdu bas na bum dbang zhes btags pa 'dra la/ gsang dbang gi 290

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3skab sa sa rdo rje slob dpon gyi mi 'dzag pa'i bde bas byin gyis ༄brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi myang ba la brten te/ rtsa gnas kyi khams rnams chan la phabs btab pas myos byed kyi nus pa 'byung ba ltar bde ba chen po'i byin gyis khyab par byed pa ni thabs lam steng sgo'i smin byed du gsungs pa dang / dbang gsum par shes rab ma la brten nas yas babs kyi dga' bzhi ngo sprod cing / tshig dbang gi skabs su'ang rgyud sde gzhan nas zung 'jug gi lha sku ngo sprod pa sogs gsungs kyang / 'dir de'i tshab tu mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi ngo sprod tsam zhig mdzad pa dang / rgyud sde gzhan du khas blang gi sgo nas rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ma byas par dbang gi dngos gzhi bskur tshul med kyang 'dir de'i dod du sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig 'bogs pa'i cho ga gzhan zhig mdzad pa sogs mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig snang zhing / de dag rnam dpyod can gyis legs par mtha' bcad par bya la/ lar gsang sngags bla med kyi lam thams cad dbang gi khog nas 'don shes pa zhig byung na bla med kyi rnam bzhag chags pa'i rtags su nges par bya'o/ /lnga pa mi 'da' ba dam tshig gi ngo bo ni/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis bcas pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi 'dul khrims rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis bslab bya'i gtso bor gyur pas rab tu phye ba yin la/291

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nges tshig sa ma yā zhes pa 'da' bar dka' ba'i don te ji skad du/ dam pa sku gsung thugs yin te/ /de las 'das na tshig par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /dbye na rtsa ba dang yan lag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngags bla med spyi'i rtsa ltung slob dpon chen po bha byas rtsa ltung gi rnam bzhag tu bshad pa dang / de'i khyad par 'ga' zhig/ 'grel chen dri med 'od nas 'jog tshul mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas bshad pa sogs mtha' dag pa 'dir mi 'chad kyi/ rgyud sde 'di nas 'byung ba'i rtsa ltung lnga'i don sngon gyi bla ma dag gis che long tsam phral te bshad pa rnams rjes brjod kho nar 'chad do/ /de ni le'u bcu dgu par/ bla med mi spang bla ma bkur/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad/ /yang dag lam du zhugs la byams/ /gsang ba'i don phyir smra mi bya/ /'di ni rtsa ba lnga rnams te/ /bsgrub dang bsrung ba'i dam tshig mchog /ces gsungs te/ dang po bla med mi spang ba ni zhi rgyud las/ byang chub sems gsum bsgom pa ni/ /rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig go/ /zhes gsungs shing de'i don yang don dam par dag pa'i lha dang snang ba thams cad cir yang mi dmigs pa blo bral gyi dbyings dang / tha snyad tsam du'ang rig pa sgyu ma'i ngo bor ro gcig pa'i tshul shes nas de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa de gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lta ba dang / 'bras bu la smon pa dang /292

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3tsharadangos su 'bras bu lam byed la 'jug pa gsum kar song bas byang chub sems gsum du 'jog pa phyogs 'di'i mkhas pa chen po rnams zhal 'cham pa'i bshad tshul yin/ de 'dra ba'i smon 'jug btang ba las rtsa ltung du 'gyur ba bzhin du theg chen thun mong ba'i sems bskyed btang ba las kyang rtsa ltung 'byung bar slob dpon bha byas bshad la/ de la ni kun dkris kyi yan lag bzhi yang tshang mi dgos par sems can gcig blos btang ba'am rdzogs byang don gnyer la tshong thag bcad nas slar log pa lta bu'i sems gcig skyes pa na sngags sdom gtong bar kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas bshad do/ /bla med spang ba'i rtsa ltung gi 'jog tshul snga ma 'di'i 'byung mtshams gsal po zhig mi 'dug kyang / dam tshig gsal bkrar/ dus gsum rgyun du ma dran na/ /theg chen sngags par ci yis chud/ /ces gsungs shing gzhan dang rigs pa sbyar na go cung zad sla'o/ /de'ang de ni gtso bor rang byung ye shes la mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i gzhi las gyur par snang gi/ yi dam lha'i sku phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor dang gsung bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor rgyun bcad pa las gyur pa ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i rtsa ltung gsum par bsdu dgos pa 'dra'o/ /gal te bden gnyis dbyer med la bla med kyi tha snyad 'dogs pa ni bla 293

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ /na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum mi gtong ba'i sgo nas rong zom zhabs gsungs na/ thun mong ba'i sems bskyed la de ltar 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan med do zhe na/ 'di ni rdo rje rtse mo las/byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /zhes pa la sogs pa khungs thub kyi gzhung mang po nas 'byung ba zhig yin te sla'o/ /gnyis pa bla ma bkur ba ni/ gsal bkra las/ spyi dang 'dren dang dam tshig dbang / /nyams chag skong dang shes rgyud dgrol/ /man ngag lung gi slob dpon drug /ces slob dpon drug/ po bkur thabs drug gis bkur pa ste/ de nyid las/ yul la dbang ba'i rgyal po dang / /khu bo pha dang ma dang mig /snying bas lhag pa'i tshul gyis te/ /zhes bstan pa spyi'i slob dpon ni chos kyi yul 'khor skyong bas rgyal po lta bu dang / chos kyi sgor 'dren pa'i slob dpon ni bstan pa'i 'jug ngogs slob pas khu bo lta bu dang de bzhin du nyams chag skong ba'i slob dpon gyis yon tan gyi lus chud mi za bar byed pas ma dang / dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon gyis rigs kyi cod paṇa byin pas pha dang / shes rgyud dgrol ba'i slob dpon gyi rgyud don gsal bar ston pas mig dang / man ngag ston pa'i slob dpon gyis zab don snying 'dra ba 'chad pas 294

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3snying bas lhag pa'i tshul gyis bkur ba'i don du gsung rgyun las 'byung zhing / skabs 'di'i rtsa ltung 'byung yul dngos ni/ zhi rgyud las/ rgyud 'grol dbang bskur de nyid bstan/ /zhes pa'i slob dpon gsum po la bya zhing / de'i nang nas kyang dbang bskur gyi slob dpon nyid shin tu gnyan pa yin no/ /rtsa ltung 'byung ba'i tshad ni yon tan rin po cher/ byang chub sems las gzhan pa'i rtsa ltung la/ /kun dkris zhes bya da dung bya ba de/ /byed 'dod ma log de la 'gyod pa med/ /rang ngor ltos pas ngo tsha shes pa dang / /gzhan ngor ltos pa'i khrel yod med pa ste/ /chos gsum tshang ba'i kun slong bya ba'i mthar/ /gtugs pa de srid rgyun chags yod gyar na/ /kun dkris tshang ba'i pham par 'gyar ba yin/ /'e/sa no༅ zug lhurwag yig zi sna༄༄mi theg zurangazi phadam tshag ga skabs su gsungs shang / 'gyad pa mad pa' dan la mnga' ris parnyi ta chen pos/ rgyun mi 'chad spyod ngo tsha khrel med dang / /des mgu dga' dang de nyid yon tan du/ /lta ba kun dkris chen pos sdom pa 'joms/ /zhes pa'i tha ma gnyis ka bsdu ste/ de lta bu'i kun dkris kyi yan lag tshang ba dgos shing / spyir rdo rje slob dpon la ma gus pa dang the tshom gyi rnam pa skad cig tsam zhig skyes kyang dngos grub chen po la bar chad kyi chos lci zhing 'thas par 'gyur mod kyi/ rtsa ltung 'byung ba ni sngags sdom gtong 295

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i don yin pas gtso bor rdo rje slob dpon blos dor ba las 'jog pa 'dra'o/ /'di ni gsang sngags pa rnams kyi dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yod med so mtshams 'dzin byed yin pas srog bsdos byas nas bsrung dgos te/ bha wi lhas/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsungs/ /de bas de la brnyas pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad/ /ces so/ de'ang rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa'i sa tshigs la sngags kyi chos shwa lo ka gcig thob pa nas 'jog dgos par gsungs shing / sngags bla med kho na'i chos thob pa la mi ltos pa dang / de la brnyas pas sngags sdom chud 'dza' ba tsam du ma zad ko sa la'i rgyan las/ tshigs bcad gcig tsam nyan pa la/ /gang gis bla mar mi 'dzin pa/ /khyi yi skye ba lnga brgya dang / /sme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i nyes dmigs mtha' yas pa zhig 'byung ngo / /gsum pa sngags rgyun mi gcod pa ni/ gsal bkra las/ rab kyis chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nam/ /nyin gsum mtshan gsum gnyis gcig tu/ /ma/ yengs tsam du ngang gis bzla/ /'bring gis zla gcig dus drug dang / /dus bzhi'i bar du mi gcad cing / /tha ma bya ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /zla re'am ra ba'i dus dag tu/ /brtson pas 'bad de mi byed pa/ /byang chub sa bon brlag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs 296

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3shing / gang mi gcod rgyu'i sngags dang phyag rgya'i rnam bzhag rags pa ni 'og tu ston no/ /dus tshad kyi nges pa drangs ma thag pa'i lung gi tshig nus dang / yang de'i 'phror/ tshogs dang gtor ma'am de bzhin du/ /tha na lo zlar mi 'da'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams la brtag na sngags rgya rgyun chad nas lo gcig gi mtha' ma 'das par rtsa ltung du 'jog gin med pa 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa mched la byams pa ni/ de nyid las/ mtha' yas sems can rang rig phyir/ /gang yang bdag las gzhan min dang //zhes spyi'i mched sems can thams cad la bshad cing / sangs rgyas chos zhugs ring pa dang / /lta spyod mthun pa nye bar bshad/ /pha gcig dam tshig nang 'dres pa/ /zhes nye ring nang 'dres kyi spun gsum yang bshad do/ /'on kyang sems can gang rung rung rdo rje'i spun mtshan nyid par bzhed pa min gyi sems can thams cad gnyug ma rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal rgyud la skal ba mnyam par bzhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas spun zla lta ba'i 'du shes kyis ༄byams par bya ba dang / de'i nang nas kyang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la zhugs pa dang / khyad par sngags bla med kyi lam la zhugs pa'i skyes bu rnams chos kyis bsdus pa'i spun grogs su gsungs pa tsam zhig yin no/ /des na rkang pa phyi ma'i don ltar rdo 297

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rje slob dpon gcig gi spyan sngar gsang sngags kyi chos skal ba mnyam par nod pa'i mched cig dgos par mngon la rkang pa snga ma rnams de'i zhar la 'ong ba 'dra'o/ /gsung rgyun 'ga' zhig nas pha bla ma gcig gis bsdus pa/ ma dkyil 'khor gcig gis bsdus pa/ dbang gral gcig tu 'dus pa rnams gang yin kyang rtsa ltung 'di'i yul du 'gyar zhes kyang 'byang ngo / /ci tsam gyis rtsa ltung du rathuX/ :nge/ /rdo/ shes/ 1(1'gyur tshul bka' la 'a nas gsal yang ba da na bha byas//rdo rje spun la khros pa yis/ /nyes pa brjod pa gsum pa yin/ /zhes bshad pa dang bstun na kun dkris kyi yan lag tshang ba dgos so /lnga pa gsang ba mi smra ba ni/ dam tshig phra rgyas las/ dam rtags dam las log pa dang / /dam med dkyil 'khor ma mthong dang / /'dres dang ma 'dres thams cad la/ /zhes gsang ba'i yul bstan cing / gang gsang na/ spyi dang bar gsang bzhi bzhi dang / /'os dang gnyer gtad rnam pa bcu/ /zhes gsungs te/dang po spyi gsang bzhi las/ lta zab ni theg dman sogs 'phang dma' ba rnams dang / spyod pa ni ma 'dres pa thams cad la gsang / yi dam gyi lha sngags dang grub rtags ni ma 'dres pa la bstan na dam tshig nyams shing / 'dres pa la'ang rang gar bstan 298

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3na dngos grub nyams par 'gyur bas gsang bar bya'o/ /bar gsang bzhi ni/ sgrub pa'i gnas du sa grogs rdzas bzhi po sgrub pa ji srid ma thon gyi bar du gsang ngo / /gsang bar 'os pa ni gang mthong ba dang thos pa las ma dad par 'gyur ba bla ma dang bla ma'i phyag rgya dang sras dang mched kyi skyon brjod pa lta bu byar mi rung ba'o/ /gsang bar gnyer gtad pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dang mched kyis gsang bar gdams pa rnams so zhes bka' srol las 'byung zhing gzhan mi gsal lo/ /'on kyang bha byas/ yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrogs pa bdun pa yin/ /zhes pa dang tshul gcig na kun dkris kyi yan lag tshang dgos shing /yul dbang gis ma smin pa dang / dbang bzhi ma rdzogs pa dang /rtsa ltung byung ba sogs la sngags kyi gsang ba zab mo rnams dgos pa med bzhin du bshad pa na ltung bar 'gyur bas gong du lta spyod gnyis la gsang ba'i yul so so ltar bshad pa ni bshad lugs kyi sgo nas yin zhing / gzhung de'i 'grel pa 'ga' zhig las gsang chos rna bar bsgrags pa min pa'i gsang rdzas mig lam du bstan pa la rtsa ltung mi 'byung bar gsungs na'ang bka' srol 'di las ni de 'dra las kyang rtsa ltung 'byung bar bshad pa smos ma thag pa bzhin no//de dag gi nang nas gnyis pa dang bzhi pa gnyis sku'i dam tshig 299

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang / gsum pa gsung gi dam tshig lhag ma ga/nyis thugs kyi dam tshig tu bshad do/ /gnyis pa yan lag gi dam tshig la/ mi spang ba lnga dang mi dor ba lnga las/ dang po ni/ 'di nyid las/ gti mug chags dang zhe sdang dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog mi spang ngo / /zhes pa ltar lnga yin la/ de'i tshal ni gsal bkra las/ mi spang dam tshig ༄bshad bya ba/ /yang dag dug lnga log dug lnga/ /zhes bshad de/yang dag pa'i dug lnga ni/ thugs rjes sems can la chags pa'i 'dod chags/ rig pa'i ye shes kyis log rtog 'joms pa'i zhe sdang / mnyam nyid kyi rtogs pa dbu 'phang mi smod pa'i nga rgyal /rtogs pa'i klong du gnyis 'dzin gyi bdud mi shong ba'i phrag dosadon dam par 'khor 'das gnyis su mi 'byed pa'i lta ba yang das/ pa'i gti mug gi sgras bsnyad pa yin zhes slob dpon rnams 'dod do/ /'di rigs la ltung ba'i 'byung mtshams gsal kha ma mthong yang slob dpon dz+nyā na shrī gzhung dang rigs pa bstan na yang dag pa'i dug lnga po 'di'i rtsi dang skad cig tsam bral na'ang yan las/ gi nyams chag byung bar 'dod dgos sam snyam mo/ /log pa'i dug lnga mi spong lugs ni spang bya'i rang bzhin ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes legs bshad rol mtsho nas bshad kyang de tsam gyis chog lugs mi 'dus pas sngags bla med kyi lugs la nyon mongs pa yin 300
