sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3na nyon sgrib pa yin mi dgos pa slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos de nyid grub par rigs pa du mas bsgrubs pa ltar thun mong ma yin pa'i spyod pa byed dus rig ma'i 'dod yon la rjes chags kyi me sbar ba lta bus mtshon te nyon mongs lhag ma bzhi la'ang de 'dra re sbyar nas/tshul des nyon mongs lam du byed nus pa'i rgyud tshod la slebs bzhin du de ltar lam du ma byas pa la bya ba'am/ yang na nyon mongs pa lnga la nyan thos ltar dgrar bltas nas de dag gi gnyen po rnams 'bad pa lhur len gyis ched cher 'dzin pa gang rigs la bya'o/ /gnyis pa mi dor ba lnga ni/ 'di nyid las/ dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri sha chen/ /dag pa'i snod chu mi dor ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / de'i don ni rgyud gzhan las/ tha mal lus kyi chos la ni/ /dri ma lnga rnams snang ba ni/ /ye shes lnga yi byi na rlabs las/ /bdud rtsi lnga zhes bya bar bshad/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar sbyang rtog spar ba byas nas longs mi spyod na ltung ba ste/ 'di la'ang gtsang dme'i 'du shes kyis dang du mi len pa 'ga' zhig rtsa ltung yin yang / 'dir ni bza' ba'i dam tshig las 'das pa nyid kyi ltung bar 'jog go/ /skabs 'dir mi spang ba lnga la rgyu mtshan gsum dang dgos pa gsum bshad pa'i/ dang po/ spang bya'i rdzas ma grub pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa'i lam yin pa dang /301

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ de'i rang bzhin ye shes chen por dag pa rnams yin zhing / phyi ma//dngos po'i mngon zhen ldog pa/ sngags lam la ngo mtshar skye ba/chos nyid zab mo la rtogs pa myur ba rnams su bshad do/ /mi dor ba lnga'i skabs/ yin pa gsum dang / grub pa bzhi'i/ dang po/nad lnga sel ba'i sman/ yon tan lnga ster ba'i rdzas/ rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yin pa rnams dang / gnyis pa/ chos nyid ngo bos grub pa/ chos can rang bzhin gyis grub pa/ nus pa mthus grub pa/ byin gyis brlabs pas grub pa ste bzhi'o/ /gzhan yang dam tshig phra rgyas las/ sum brgya drug cu'i dbye ba mdzad pa sogs mang ngo /drug pa rol pa phrin las ni/ snying rje chen po dang 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i thabs mkhas kyi mdzad spyod tshar gcod dang rjes 'dzin gang rung gis bsdus pa'o/ /nges tshig karma zhes pa'i sgra las sgo gsum gyi bya ba'i mtshan nyid can no//dbye na/ nad gdon sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi ba dang / tshe dpal sogs mthun pa'i phyogs rgyas pa dang / dmigs bya dbang du bsdus pa dang / bsgral ba'i zhing la mngon spyod bya ba ste las tshogs bzhi po me rdzas bro mchod rten phyag rgya'i sgo nas sgrub pa rnams te/ khog/ gzhung las/ bdag gzhan don sgrub phrin las ni///302

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3mchod rten phyag rgya'i sgo dang ni/ /hom bro glu dang rdzas kyis bya/ /zhes so/ /de la me'i sgo nas bya ba ni/ sbyin sreg rtsa bar/ gnas rdzas thabs kyi rnam pa dang / /gzungs dang gtso sems bsgrub bya dang / /phur bu lha dus las rim dang / /lhag ma bcu gcig shes par bya/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /rdzas kyi sgo nas ni liṅga bca' ba dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sogs le'u nyi shu par/ bdud rtsi lnga'am zas lnga la/ /mtshan ma ming du bcas par bya/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /bro'am lu gu rgyud kyi sgo nas/ e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du sprel bsdams nas/ /bcings gyar bskyod nas phyogs bcur g.yo/ /zhes sogs 'byang ba rnams ༷༷mi de'i zi zi zi 05 der ra ri ta zar dang lha bskyad sags las sa sa' ngas pa dang bstun na/ /mchod rten gyi sgo nas/ rgyas pa las/ drag po gtum po 'dul ba'i phyir/ /bdag nyid drag por bsgoms nas ni/ /chos sku nag po 'od 'bar gyis/ /bgegs kyi liṅga mnan par bya/ /zhes so/ /kha dog dang dbyibs dang lhar snang sogs las so sor bstun zhing / spyan 'grel las/ mchod rten 'byung ba gang la 'debs kyang zhes 'jim pa las gzhan pa'i me 'debs chu 'debs sogs chog par bshad do/ /phyag rgya'i sgo nas/ rgyas pa las/ yan lag snying po'i rtse gcig dang / /rtse lnga rtse dgu bcu gcig tu/ /las rnams so 303

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sor rab tu sgom/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams so/ /las de dag sgrub pa la gtso che ba'i gtso sems ni/ don gyi sems zhi dang khro bo'i lha'i nga rgyal la gnas shing snang srid dag mnyam du shes pa'i lta bas/ stongs kyi sems zhi bar zhi zhing dwangs pa/ /rgyas par dga' zhing spro ba/ dbang la chags shing zhen pa/ drag por khro zhing rngam pa'i tshul gyis bya ba dang / gnas ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ljon pa dang ni lcug phran tshal/ /sdong gcig dang ni mes reg drung / zhes 'byang zhing / 'di'i nges don las bzhi'i gzungs ma dang ma pha ri mi rdo byer ///pesbyar bar yang 'gral chung las/ ma rmas pa dang pu tra mang 'a la dang / /skye rgyud med dang bkra mi shis gsang ba/ /zhes bshad do/ /dus ni/ lo gcig gi dbang du btang ba dang / zhag gcig gi dbang du btang ba gnyis te/ dbyar dang snga dro zhi ba/ ston dang nyin phyed rgyas pa la sogs pas shes so/ /gzhan yang las so so'i skabs su kha lta phyogs dang chas gos kyi kha dog sogs a bh+ya kā ra la sogs pa chen po rnams kyi gzhung nas 'byung ngo / /bdun pa don du gnyer ba sgrub pa ni/ rgyud phyi ma las/'jig rten pa yi dngos grub ni/ /bskyed pa'i rim pas sbyor bas so/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub ni/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pas sbyor bas so/ /zhes pa ltar mchog dang thun mong gi dngos 304

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3grub rnam pa gnyis sgrub byed kyi thabs khyad par can zhig la byed do//nges tshig dha na'i sgra las kun tu len pa ste 'dod pa'i don len par byed pa'o/ /dbye na/ thun mong dang mchog gi sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khog gzhung nas bshad pa'i ro langs dang tshe dang pra sen sgrub pa la sogs pa rnams dang / rgyud kyi le'u lnga pa las nad zhi ba dang / dug bdud rtsir sgyur ba la sogs pa yon tan 'byung ba'i dngos grub drug dang / nam mkha' la rdo rje'i skas 'byung ba la sogs pa 'byung ba'i dngos grub lnga/ dgug pa dang gtad pa la sogs pa las phran tshegs brgyad gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /mchog sgrub pa ni rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor la goms pa gdeng du gyur pa na spyod pa gsum gyi nye rgyus de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa la khyad par chen po thob pa'i sgo nas zung 'jug gi ye shes sgrub pa'o/ /de'ang bskyed rim 'byongs pas rig mthong gi mtshan ma brtan po rnyed pa'i mtshams shig nas grogs khyad par can dang 'grogs na thun mong gi dngos grub chen po rnams kyang sgrub par nus mod kyi/ /rin po che lta bu'i gang zag ni de tsam gyis yid drang mi nus par de las ches lhag pa'i rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po sgrub pa la 'dun pa shugs drag pas myur du mchog sgrub pa'i nan tan kho na hur thag byed pa yin te rgya gar na 305

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/grub chen lo dril dang bod du le btsan seng ge dbang phyag bzhin no//425 nodang ririg brgyad pa mi g.yo ba ting nge 'dzin ni/ he ru ka 'dus pa las/gang dang gang du gsal ba'i yid/ /ma yengs pa nyid ting 'dzin te/ /zhes pa ltar bsgom bya'i don khyad par can bskyed rdzogs kyi don las mi g.yo bar gnas pa'i sems phyogs gcig pa'o/ /nges tshig sa ma dhī'i sgra las mnyam pa'i blo la 'jug pas/ bsgom bya'i don la sems rtse gcig tu zin pa'i don no/ /dbye na/ bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin gnyis su yod cing / de'i nang nas bskyed rim la'ang / rgyud phyi ma las/ bskyed rim la brten skye gnas te/ /mngal skyes la sogs dbye ba yis/ /de yang rnam pa bzhi ru 'dod/ /ces pa ltar spros pa rgyas pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bdag sras gzhan sras gnyis kyi sgo nas sgom pa sogs dang / 'bring po rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed dang / bsdus pa sa bon tsam las bskyed pa'am bskyed sngags brjod pa tsam gyis bskyed pa dang / shin tu bsdus pa skad cig gis dkrong bskyed byed tshul bzhi'o/ /de dag gang la'ang tha mal gyi snang ba dag par byed pa rnam pa gsal ba dang / zhen pa dag par byed pa dag pa dran cing nga rgyal brtan pa ste mdor na lha'i snang zhen mtshan nyid 306

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3tshang ba dgos shing / de ltar blo sbyang ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rten dang brten pa'i rnam pa spyi la dmigs pa'i 'du byed ma nyams par gtso 'khor so so'i sku'i cha shas dang / rgyan cha lugs re re nas gsal snang 'don zhing / de yang gzugs kyi mtshan ma 'ba' zhig tsam ma yin par yongs su dag pa'i stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa 'bras bu'i yon tan mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas su nga rgyal bya ba dang snang phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad don la rang bzhin med pa rten 'byung sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam par 'char ba'i zab gsal gnyis med chen por bzhag ste bying rgod dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin mar me lta ba'i ༄rgyun bskyang ba la brten nas zla drug la sogs pa'i dus nges pa can na yul gsum gyad du gyur pa'i lam rtags gdon mi za bar 'byung ngo / /rdzogs rim gyi ting nge 'dzin ni gong du bshad pa'i thabs grol gyi lam gyi tso bo rnams la bya'o/ /dgu pa gnas su stob pa mchod pa ni/ thugs thig las/ bya byed bya ba byed 'dus pas/ /dgyes tshims gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid / /ces pas/ mchod pa'i yul du gyur pa rnams bkur zhing mchod pa'i bsam pas sgo gsum gyis mnyes pa sgrub cing yo byad stob pa'o//nges tshig pū dza zhes pa bkur ba'i don gyis gnas su stob pa la 307

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bya'o/ /dbye na/ legs rol sogs las 'jig 'das kyi mchod pa gnyis dang de gnyis kyi khyad par bzhi sogs bshad kyang zhi khro'i khog gzhung gi dbang du byas na bcu bzhi ste/ dkyil 'khor ba'i lha'i yon tan dran pas phyag 'tshal ba dang / phyag rgya bdun sbrag tu bya ba dang / spyod yul yongs su dag pa kun bzang dang /bsil chab thogs pa'i lha mos phyag dang zhabs bsil ba dang /rang gi thugs ka nas byung ba'i lha mo spos ma la sogs pa bzhis mchod pa dang / ye shes sman gyi bdud rtsi'i sprin phung spro ba dang /gtor ma 'dod yon gyi lha mo'i rnam par 'bul ba dang / bdud rtsi'i rgyun gtor mar lan gsum spreng bas lha rnams dgyes pa bskyed pa dang nyan thos rnams 'gog pa las bslang ba dang rgyal ba rnams gzhan don la bskul ba'i gsang nan dang / lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par rol ba'i mchod sbyin rgyan dang bgo ba dang skyed mo'i tshal la sogs pa nam mkha' gang ba sna tshogs su 'bul ba dang / rang gi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi me 'bar bas sems can rnams kyi rigs drug gi sa bon bsreg pa dang / lha rnams rjes chags kyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i nga rgyal bya ba dang /bza' bca' btung ba sogs 'dod yon ro mnyam gyi mchod pa dang / rol mo ye shes phyi nang gi yo byad thams cad sems nyid 308

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3 gcig pu'i cho 'phrul du sdud pa dang / lha tshogs rnams la 'bras chos lnga ldan du bstod pa ste bcu bzhir bshad cing / dmigs bsal du khro bo la gsang nan gyi tshab tu rak+ta tshar gsum 'bul ba sogs khyad par 'ga' zhig yod do/ /de dag gi sdom ni/ gus pa phyag dang phyag rgya gar/ /kun bzang zhabs bsil bzhi bsnol te/ /bdud rtsi gtor ma gsang nan dang / /lhag pa ting 'dzin sgrol dang sbyor/ /'dod yon rol mo glu ye shes/ /zhes pa rnams so/ /bcu pa 'ching zlos sngags dang phyag rgya ni/ thabs shes kyi yi ge ā li kā li 'dus shing grub pa bzhis mtha can du gyar pa sngags 'iri 47 mu yir ri ra༅05 yirar kya nga pha dang / rag pa phyag rgya bzha rdzags kya lha' skur gsal ba las mi 'da' ba phyag rgya'i ngo bo/ /nges tshig man+t+ra'i sgra las yid shes bde myur du skyob pas sngags dang / mu tra'i sgra las phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab pa las 'da' bar dka' bas na phyag rgya'o/ /dbye na/ sngags la gsum ste/ rgyud las/ gsang sngags kun gyi dbye ba ni/ /rnam pa gsum du shes bya ste/ /rig sngags thabs kyi ngo bo la/ /gzu ngas sngags shes rab ngo bo yin/ /gsang sngags gnyis med ye shes so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ram/ yang gu ru lugs las dang po ni/ thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid/ de'i sgo yig 'brur snang bas gsang ste ngag tu brjod pa dang bcas shing 309

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shes skyob kyi las kyis log rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni shes rab dang ye shes kyi bdag nyid dngos po'i don rig par byed pa'i las kyis ma rtogs pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'o / /gsum pa ni/ dran pa dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid chos kyi tshig don mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i las kyis dran nyams kyi gnyen por gyar pa'o/ /de gsum mtshon pa'i rtags lhar snang tshul yang gsang rig me 1)/1//bye/ /jiX) //)resngags rnams lha chi dbyibs dang / — ma gnyis lha mo ༄ gzugs su bzhugs zhes 'byung ngo / /zhes kyang bshad do/ /bye brag tu gsal bkra las/ rtsa ba bskyed dang las sngags dang / /zhes pas/dang po rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags ka kha ga gha nga sogs yi ge 'khor lo'i sa bon dang / hūṃ māṃ sogs rigs kyi sa bon gnyis/gnyis pa bskyed pa rkyen sngags badz+ra dh+rika ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa bzlas pa las sngags de gnyis sbrel te dzab tu bzla ba'o/ /de dag rdzogs rim dang sbyar na thig le chen po'i bde chen gyi rang bzhin gdod nas rang chas su bzhugs pa rtsa sngags/ de la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs kyi sgo dhū ti'i nang nas rlung sngags dbyer med kyi ngor bzlas bya ba rkyen sngags/ rnal 'byor de nyid yang nasasku yang du bskyar ba las sngags yin zhes mthong bas don rtogs sogs las bshad do/ /phyag rgya la'ang rtog tshogs ye nas lha'i dkyil 310

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3'khor du gnas pa rang bzhin gyi dang / de nyid nges shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas rtogs pa lta ba'i dang / rang 'bras mngon du gyur pas 'og min du zhi khro'i phyag rgyar bzhengs pa 'bras bu'i phyag rgya ste gsum mo/ /bye brag tu lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang du na/gsal bkra las/ dam tshig las dang chos dang ni/ /de nyid phyag rgya chen po bzhi/ /zhes pa ltar sgom pa phyag chen/ bca' ba dam rgya/bsam pa chos rgya/ bsam pa dam rgya/ bca' ba las rgya/ bsam pa las rgya/ brjod pa chos rgya ste le'u brgyad pa nas 'byung ba bzhin no/ /yang rang nyid dam tshig sems dpar sgom pa phyag chen/de'i thugs kar pad nyi zla ba la gnas pa'i phyag mtshan sgom pa dam rgya/ de nyid thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pas mtshan par sgom pa chos rgya/ de las 'od zer spro bsdu bya ba las rgya zhes kyang 'byung la phyag rgya bzhi'i 'jog tshul gzhan yang snang ngo / /de rdzogs rim dang sbyar na steng sgo tsaṇ+ḍa li dam rgya/ 'og sgo phyag rgya gsum las rgya/ sgyu lus snying rje chen po chos rgya/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes phyag chen du bshad do/ /spyi don bzhi ba rgyud kyi dgos 'brel ni/ thugs thig las/brjod 'brel dgos pa yang dgos dang / /rgyu rkyen yan lag bzhi ru 'gyur/ / zhes pas dang po ni/ khog gzhung las/ mtshon bya 311

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rang bzhin gzhi yi rgyud/ /ces sogs rtogs bya gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rgyud don rnams so/ /dgos pa ni/ rang bzhin gyi rgyud de nyid lam rkyen yi ge'i rgyud kyis mtshon par byas pa la brten nas don de la thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab khyad par can skyes pa'o / /nying dgos thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub grub pa chen po brgyad dang rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi la sogs pa rnams so/ /'brel ba ni de rnams ci rigs par de byung dang ngo bo bdag gcig gis 'brel pa'o/ /lnga ba gdams gtad ni/ ngo bo bstan pa gsang ba'i snying po rjod byed yi ge'i rgyud dang bcas pa mi nub par bya ba'i 'khor rnams la gdams shing gtad pa'o/ /nges tshig ni/dbye ba'i skabs su zhar la rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /dbye na gnyis las/ dang po gdams pa la'ang bzhi ste/ le'u tha mar/ kye phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rang bzhin 'di/ /zhes sogs gzhi rang bzhin gyi snang ba 'od gsal ba'i de kho na nyid rtogs byar gdams pa dang /gzung 'dzin spros la 'chel ba yis/ /sogs log rtog 'khrul pa 'i snang ba tha mal gyi snang zhen bden 'dzin cha dang bcas pa thams cad dag byar gdams pa dang / sa rnams khyad par bkod pa yang / /sogs gdul bya lam gyi snang ba gsang sngags thabs kyis che bar bstan pa'i sgo nas sam/ yang na sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa 312

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3gzhan rnams kyang dngos brgyud gang rung gis 'di'i lam stegs su 'gro ba'i tshul gyis bgrod byar gdams pa dang / ye shes ngo mtshar rab 'byams kyis/ /sogs 'bras bu bde gshegs kyi snang ba rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zung 'jug gi go 'phang thob byar gdams pa'o//gnyis pa gtad pa la'ang / khog gzhung las/ sdud pa po dang bud med dang / /rnal 'byor mig ldan sogs la'o/ /zhes pa ltar gsum las/ dang po rgyal ba thams cad kyi bka'i bsdu ba po gsang 'dzin lag na rdo rje la gtad pa dang / gnyis pa phyi rabs kyi gang zag rin po che lta bu'i snod ldan chos mig can la nges par lung bstan pa'i sgo nas gtad pa dang / gsum pa ma mo dang mkha' 'gro dam tshig gi rjes gcod pa rnams la gnyer du gtad pa rnams te rim pa bzhin du/ le'u tha ma'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ /sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi//sogs tshig sde tshan gnyis kyis snga ma gnyis bstan zhing / phyi ma ni rgyud gzhan las kha bskang bar bya ste/ rgyas pa las/ nga yi thugs kyi snying po 'di/ /phyogs bcu kun tu spel ba dang / /de yi gzungs la gtad pa ni/ /sogs dgongs rgyan le'u tha ma'i rnam bshad du 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de ltar ston pas ji ltar yongs su gtad pa bzhin du dang por mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob 313

casarngad/ do/ jordo sdo/ba khur:drob/ba/ byaspurngasno ba/lngacad nyi:reb/sdo/nga khuradra/zug/ tharadapon gyi zhabs la gtugs te dbang gis rgyud smin par byas nas rgyud kyi rdo rje'i gnas chen po rnams rtsa bshad lto sbyar ba'i sgo nas nyin mtshan du sems shing legs par gtan la phab ste/ don ji lta ba bzhin du nyams su len zhing / de'i sgo nas snod ldan gyi gang zag gzhan yang bla na med pa'i theg pa la dkri mkhas pa zhig byung na rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud gtad pa don yod par byas zhes bdaka nyid chen po dag gis gsungs so/ /gnyis pa tshig gi rnam grangs rnam par dbye ba la/ rgyud phyi ma las/ gang gis brjod bya 'char byed pa/ /de ni rjod byed du bshad do/ /zhes pas brjod bya'i don go bar byed pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa'o/ /de la'ang shes brjod 'jug pa'i tha snyad sogs phye yang 'dir bstan la ming tshig yi ge gsum ste/ don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa ka ba zhes pa lta bu'i ming / de nyid rtsom gzhir byas pa la brten nas don gyi khyad par ston pa'i brdar byung ba/ bram ze chu la ci tsam zhig /mi yi bdag po pus nub tsam/ /zhes pa lta bu tshig de gnyis gsal bar byed pa'i nga ro dang gsal byed kyi 'bru rnams ni yi ge ste/ ming tshig gnyis brda'i dbang gis 'gyur zhing yi ge mi 'gyar ba'i phyir/ de'i skad dod du aka ra zhes pa yod do//riri pho /ཿ/jide re re la'ang dbye na sgrar snang ba dang / sgrar grags pa dang /314

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3brdar gyar pa ste gsum re yod de/ dang po ni/ skyes bu'i yid la ༄sgra spyir shar ba'i ming tshig yi ge zhes 'di'i yig cha mang po byung la/kha che bye smra lta bu de nyid dngos por 'dod pa'i lugs la 'du byed kyi phung po yin zhing / sgra don dngos por mi 'dod kyang de gsum ldan min du 'jog dgos pas gzhan dag sgra'i gnas skabs la 'dod pa yin zhes yongs su grags la/ bsdu ba las gsung tshul la dpyad gzhir bzhag pa yang snang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ mgrin rkan spyi bo so mchu ste gnas lnga'i byed rtsol las byung ba'i ngag gi rnam par rig byed do/ /gsum pa ni/ de dag gi gzugs brnyan ni gang la sogs pa'i phyi mo'i yi ger 'du byas pa ste/ de'ang phyi mo go bar bya ba'i phyir yi ge rnams bzhag pa min gyi/ yi ge go bar bya ba'i phyir phyi mo rnams bzhag pa yin pas phyi mo ni sgras brjod rigs kyi dbye ba'i grangs su nges par bya'o/ /rgyud 'di'i dbang du byas pa'i ming tshig yi ge la byas na bcad lhug spel ma gsum dang dum bu nyi shu rtsa gnyis sogs yod par bshad kyang sgo dog por byas na spel ma min pa'i bcad lhug gi dbye ba gzhan med de spel rgyu ni bcad lhug gnyis su zad pa'i phyir ro/ /sgo yangs por byas na ltos sa ltos 'jog gi sgo nas de ltar bshad kyang mi 'gal ba sogs don chung sa yin pas ma brjod do/ /de ltar na khog 315

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhung las/ mtshon bya rang bzhin gzhi yi rgyud/ /sgro skur med par bstan pa ni/ /mtshon byed sgyu 'phrul dra ba ste/ /mdzub mos ri bong can bzhin no/ /zhes pa ltar rjod byed tshig rgyud kyi khongs na brjod bya gab sbas kyi gsang ba zab cing rgya che ba rnams mtha' drug dang tshul bzhis bcings pa de nyid brgyud ldan bla ma'i man ngag la brten te thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral bar sgrub pa snying por byed pa de dag gru legs par bcos pa'i ded dpon mtsho gling du 'gro ba ltar myur du rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la snyegs pa ni nges pa kho na'o/ /zhes de dag gis spyi don rnam par dbye ba mdo tsam zhig bshad zin to/ /gsang chen ston pa rdo rje 'chang dbang gi/ /gsung rab rgyud sde rgya mjo'i gsang ba che/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba'i lam gyi gnad/ /nges don gsang ba'i snying po 'dis 'chad do/ /de slad 'phags bod grub pa'i shing rta che/ /pad 'byung bī ma'i zhabs dang gnubs zur sogs/ /sngon byung mkhas pa'i bshad srol bskyar zlos su/ /brjod 'di blo gsar yongs la phan phyir yin/ /phyogs 'dir bka' srol rnam pa mang mthong zhing / /bdag kyang rnam dpyod blo nus ches phra bas/ /'dir ni nyes bshad bgyi bas gang nongs pa/ /de kun dkyil 'khor gtso la snying nas 'chags/ /316

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3gang zhig legs smras bdud rtsi'i zegs ma tsam/ /mchis na de dag dri med ston zla ltar/ /dkar ba'i dge mtshan srid zhi'i khams snang zhing / /rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor pa phun tshogs shog /dpal gsang ba'i snying po'i spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di'ang theg pa mchog la gus pa'i gnas brtan dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos bzhin du spyod pa ye shes 'od zer rgya mtsho'i brtson 'grus dang snying stobs kyi go cha rmad du byung bas rdo rong gi sa'i cha/ 'chi med dga' ba'i tshal du sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i bshad pa gsar 'dzugs su mdzad pa'i tshe nan tan gyis bskul ma gnang zhing /shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang kun dga' grags pa sogs gzhan yang don gnyer can du mas blo gsar las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir du gsang bdag dgongs rgyan gyi klad la sbyar rgyu'i spyi don go bde ba zhig bris zhes bskul ba ltar/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po pad+ma badz+ra pa'i zhal snga nas sogs dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdo rje slob dpon du ma'i bka' drin las tshul 'di la dad pa'i snang ba cung zad brtan pa mdo smad kyi sprang smyon 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas rang lo nyer gcig pa sa skyong shing bya'i lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i dmar 317

pong/ nya rjo mob 'jiyos meng lhasamarme t+ta'i yosngang 'bracha((phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa la rdzogs par byas pa'i yi ge pa ni dge tshul chos kyi grags pas bgyis pa ste 'dis kyang gsang chen snying po'i bstan pa la bya ba byeng nas par gyar cis/ gu// phyi lo tre/ snar/ de/nyid kyi phyi ma'i phyi ma la yig lam du phab slar yang dag par byas pa'o/ /gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bcud/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang dgongs pa'i mthil/ /dpal ldan sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yi/ /rgyud du paṇa grub che rnams bzhed/ /de yang rtogs dka' rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhis rab bcings pa/ /bshad pa'i rgyud la brten nas su/ /'chad pa rgya bod mkhas pa'i srol/ /gang de tshad mar gyur pa yi/ /dpal ldan zur pa'i man ngag bzhin/ / sngon byung mkhas pa brgyas bkral nas/ /de bskyar dag la dbo/sa pa chung / /'on kyang snyigs mar spyod pa yi/ /dus kyi dbang gis skye bo rnams/ /blo gros nus pa zhan mthong nas/ /gtam 'di rdo shod smyon pas byas/ /rtogs sla 'khyer bde gnad 'dril phyir/ /blo gsar rnams la phan gdags slad/ /chos sbyin spar gyi phyi mo 'di/ /'chi med dga' ba'i tshal du bsgrubs/ /dge 'dis rnam dkar 'di sgrub pa'i/ /sbyin bdag sde bzhi'i 'byor pa 'phel/ /mthar thug sngags kyi gsang lam nas/ /zung 'jug bde ba che 'grub shog /gzhan yang ris med bstan pa rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin 318

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ pod/ 3zhemo〉mchog rnams zhabs brtan cing / /'a gro kun phan bde'i snang ba yis/ /rnam kun dal 'byor sbyin gyur cig /ces pa'ang gsang bdag dgongs pa'i rgyan gyi spyi don las dang po pa la nyer mkho legs bshad dga' ston zhes bya ba ngag rtsom bgyis pa'i thog /gnas brtan dge ba'i bshes gnyen ye shes 'od zer rgya mtshos spar du bsgrub rgyu'i nan tan lhur blangs pa'i tshe spar byang du sprang smyon rang nyid kyis so/ /'dis kyang snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ dge'o/ /dge'o//dge'o// //319

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ yongs su dag pa'i lha sku thams cad skyed pa'i sa bon ni gsung sngags kyi yi ge ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad ming tsam la gnas pa la gtugs nas le'u bzhi par rgyas bshad mdzad/ phung sogs cir snang ba thams cad skyed pa'i sa bon ni chos kyi dbyings sam sems kyi gnyug ma'i khams te 'dir 'od gsal gyi bsam mi khyab bam mi rtog pa'am spros pa med pa'i bzhugs tshul gyi cha'o/ / de nyid ni yid skyob pa'i man tra thams cad kyi mthar thug ste/phyag rdor dbang bskur du chos kyi dbyings la lha sngags phyag rgya sogs mang por brtags nas dngos grub kyi don byed par gsungs pa lta bu/ de glo bur ba'i spros pas stong pa'am dag pa yin cing / gang snang thams cad ni de'i ngang las mched pa ni snang ba thams cad ka nas dag pa'am mched gzhi'i sa bon mthar thug nas dag pa dang gdod nas dag pa'o/ /de'i phyir dbyings de ni sa bon gyi sngags te a/ de'i rnam 'gyur rang snang ris med sngags kyis mig bsgyur ba'i rang snang gi sgyu ma lta bur mched pa ni lha'i sku ste os mtshon/ de ltar dbyings dang / de nyid snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba thams cad sngags bla med kyi rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi dkyil 'khor gcig tu'am rang bzhin rnam dag gi sku gsung ngam lha sngags kyi yo lang kho nar 322

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3gnas pa de rtogs byed kyi thugs ni 'od gsal rang gi mkhyen cha'am rig pa'i cha ste/ des rtogs tshul yang dbyings dang yul snang gnyis char rig cha nyid las mi gzhan par mngon du gyur nas rtogs bya gnyis ka rtogs byed kyi klong du rdzogs pa a o gnyis char oṃ la rdzogs pa lta ba'o/ /oṃ gyi don 'di/ gzang 'dzin bral rabargya riring ba'i sems la ltos/ /snang ba thams cad rang snang yin/ /ye shes rig pa ngo mtshar che/ /dang gcig red/ rtogs dus snang rig dbyings gsum khyab gdal du 'dres nas mtha' dbus med pa'i 'od gsal du 'gyur bar ma zad dbyings ma rtogs/ rang snang snod bcud rgyud gsum rang rgyud par zhen pa'i dus nyid nas shes pas gar khyab rig pas bdag nyid gcig pa'i tshul gyis khyab cing rig pa rang gi ngo bo bzang ngan du mi 'gyur bar mtha' dang dbus med pa ste zab cing rgya che rgya chad phyogs lhung med par gdal ba ste sems rang snang rnams sems dang ye shes rang snang gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i ye shes rang snang min yang / mthar gtugs na ye shes kyi rang snang yin dgos/ rang zhes pa'i sgor thams cad snang ba snang yul gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i snga ma rang la sbyar na 'grigs che/ kun mkhyen chen pos snang ba 'di rnams bag chags smin pa'i snang char bshad pa'ang de ltar dgos(dgongs)/323

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/snang yul dag ma dag gam phyin ci log yin min snang ba dag min gyis phye ba thal 'gyur ba'i yang log gi rnam bzhag dang kun rdzob bden pa gnas snang mi ma thun pa'i steng nas bshad lugs lta bu ste zhar byung ngo / /rang snang thams cad dag pa'i lha'i rang bzhin nam ngo bo nyid yin lugs ni/ dag pa'i dus su rnam snang du 'ong rgyu de ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis bslad tshe tha mal pa'i gzugs phung du 'char ba sogs so/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul la rtogs pa bzhis yid ches tshal yang gtso bor 'di dang rgyu gcig pa gnyis sa sa ring ri ringasnang / rgyu gcig par chos thams cad ces pa ni gong du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos tham sa cad ces pa dang gcig red/don dam 'od gsal gyi dbyings la 'jig 'das kyi mtshan ma'am spros pa gnyis char mi dmigs/ kun rdzob rang snang gi ngor de gnyis so so'i bya ba byed nus su shar ba'i rten 'brel du mnyam/de gnyis dbyer med du mnyam pa rnams red pas 'dis mnyam pa dang / yig 'brus dag par rtogs pa bstan 'dra/ 'di'i stong mnyam snang mnyam gnyis ka dbu ma ltar mi 'jog par bla med lugs kho na ltar 'chad pa 'di gtsang ṭika na gsal/ mnyam lugs snga ma gnyis thun mong ba dang / phyi ma gcig thun min du rong 'grel gnyis na snang ba ni/ srid zhi gnyis bden mnyam rdzun 324

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3mnyam tsam thun mong theg par yang bzhed kyang / de gnyis bden pa gnyis kar 'od gsal las phyi rol du ma gyur par gcig pa'am dbyer med pas bzang ngan med par mnyam pa 'di bla med kyi thun min yin zer ram snyam ste/ kun rdzob tu'ang dbyer med de/ lta ba mtho dman de tsam mo/ /zhes pa lta bu red dam brtag don dam ma skyes pa a dang / kun rdzob sgyu ma o gnyis rig pa 'od gsal gcig pur rdzogs pa'i oṃ 'di bden gnyis dbyer med lhag pa'i chos sku chen po zer rgyu de yin pa 'dra/ byin gyis rlabs par rtogs pa'i thad/ dpe la lar/ ye nas sangs rgyas par byin gyis rlob pa'i zhes snang yang ye nas zhes pa med pa'i dpe dag par snang / de'ang rtogs pa snga ma gnyis kyis phung sogs chos thams cad dag pa rab 'byams su rtogs pa na/ rtogs pa bzhin du phung sogs byin gyis rlob nus pa ste/ rtogs pa de dag gi stobs kyis rtogs bya'i don de dag mngon du gyur 'ong ba'o/ /de'ang rtogs pa gnyis pa'i stobs kyis ma dag pa'i 'am tha mal pa'i snang zhen glo bur gnyis ka nub nas/ gzhi dus su gzugs tshor sogs tha mal pa'i snang bar 'ong rgyu de rnam snang rin 'byung sogs kyi snang zhen du go 'pho ba skye shi bar do sku gsum du sgyur zhing rlob pa lta bu/ de'ang ras dkar po lta bu ni phung sogs rang 325

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin rnam dag /dmar po ni glo bur rnam dag gam rtogs pa mngon gyur/ btsod ni rtogs pa gnyis red/ ras nag po sogs la tshos kha tshon po gzhan du sgyur mi btub/ dkar po kho na gang 'dod du btub/ de bzhin du gang snang thams cad rang snang ris med yin pa'i gnad kyis yongs su dag pa'i lhar sgyur nus pa sna tshogs nor bu lta bu red/ de'ang rang snang yin tshad mthar gtug na ye shes rang snang kho nar nges pa la thug /lar skye 'chi bar do'ang thabs mkhas kyis zin na sku gsum du 'ong zhes pa tsam gyis 'di'i lugs kyi lhar sgrub la dran pa rnyed dka'/ de'i kha skor phyogs bsgyur nas gdod nas sku gsum dngos su 'ong rgyu de 'khrul rgyus rnyog nas tha mal pa'i skye shi bar dor 'char zhes pa'i steng nas 'gro dgos/ 'dir sgyu ma ngal gso'i le'u dang por ma dag gzha na dbang nub ste dag pa'i gzhan dbang 'ong tshul gsungs pa'ang dran par bya/ de lta bu'i rtogs pa gsum po'ang thos bsam rkyang pa'i go yul tsam gyis ni gong du/ rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul la rtogs pa bzhi'i lam gyis yid ches zhes gsungs pa'i yid ches mtshan nyid rdzogs par mi 'gyur gyi rtogs pa de gsum gyi don thos shing bsam pas 'di cig char ba red pas rtogs pa myur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis me dang spra ba phrad pa ltar snang sems rang rgyud par 326

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs rang zhig ste rig pa yul med rang gsal du bud pa'i steng nas dag ma nyam chen po'i bzhugs tshul la myong stobs kyis gting slebs pa las yid ches rnyed pa shes nas dad pa thob pa zhes pa lta bur gyar dus lta ba'i lag rjes 'jog thab pa //sdu/ dmi mi //|) niri ba red pas shes pa mtshan nyid — lam dngos la slebs pa'o/ /'di ni mngon sum par rtogs pa ste/ rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul la yid ches pa'i rtogs par 'jog pa la rtogs pa snga ma gsum po'i khyad par 'di lta bu dgos zhes bye brag tu phye nas bstan pa'o/ /rong zom pas so sor rtog pa'i dus na yin gyi rnal 'byor gyi dus na min gsungs pa dang / g.yung gis snga ma snga ma'i rgyu mtshan gyis phyi ma phyi ma bstan yod snang shar pa dpyod/327

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /sgyu 'phrul rdzogs rim gyi skor/man ngag 'di'i lugs kyis rdzogs rim thabs grol gnyis kyi khyad par/ mtshon byed kyi thabs rdzogs rim pa'i zhu bde myong ba tshun chad thabs lam dang / mtshon bya don rig stong gdod ma'i gnas lugs dngos la reg pa nas grol lam du bzhed/ /spyir rgyud sde 'dir stong phyogs las snang phyogs rtsal du 'don te/ pha rgyud ma hā yo ga'i spyi rgyud yin pa'i gnad kyis so/ /'don tshal ni/༄snang srid thams cad gdod ma nas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes zab gsal gnyis med kyi lha'i 'khor lor ngo sprad na sa/ de nyid goms pa mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par ye shes rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ zhes pa'i thad kyi lta phreng dang rgyud kyi le'u lnga pa sdogs du mas shes so/ /lam rim pa gnyis ka'i bsgom bya sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gcig po de yin par 'dra yang sgom byed kyi dbang gis khyad che ste/ bskyed rim ni sems rags pa'i steng nas sgom la/sems de ni phyin ci log gi bag chags kyi snyigs ma'am rnyogs pa las skyes pas stobs chung / rnyogs pa de las ma skyes pa dwangs ma chen po'i gnyug sems kyi steng nas sgom pa'i rdzogs rim ni rlabs 328

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3po che'i mthu can yin pas so/ /de la 'di'i rdzogs rim lugs gzhan dang ma 'dres par rkang tshugs su shod pa shin tu dka' yang gsang thig rtsa 'grel dang / bod kyi sgyu 'phrul mkhan po mkhas grub rnams kyi gzhung la brten nas gzhi bzhengs su slong ba'i tho yig ni rdo rje'i lus las ye shes skye ba'i gnad dang / de shes nas gnad du bsnun pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ lugs 'dir snying ka'i gnad gtso bor byed de/ de la rtsa 'dab brgyad dang / 'od bzhi'i rlung gi rnam bzhag shes sla/ 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba na dwangs ma lnga ldan gyi thig le'am/ mi shigs pa'i thig le dang / chos nyid kyi rtsa la oṃ dang su tri/ ye shes kyi rtsa la hūṃ dang a dṛ/ rang rgyud kyi rtsa(dpe chung rang gnas las/ yon tan gyi rtsar bshad) la āḥdang pre du gnas te/ mi shigs pa'i thig le ni dwangs ma chen po dang / yi ge gsum ni nye ba'i dwangs ma zhes gsung la/ sa bon drug ni snyigs ma'i cha'o/ /yi ge gsum po 'di rtsa 'dab kyi nang phyogs dang / rtsa dar skud lta bu'i phyi rol du yod par bshad pas dbus kyi dwangs ma lnga 'dus dang nye ba'am cha 'dra ba'i yon tan dang byed las can te dwangs ma'i thig le gzhan las cha phra bar mngon no/ /de'ang dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi yon tan gyi cha las bskyed pa 'dra ste/ oṃ yig rtsa shel sbug can gyi yon tan las sprul 329

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba dang / āḥyig mi shigs pa'i dmar cha'i yon tan las dang /hūṃ yig mi shigs pa'i rlung gi yon tan gyi dbang las byung ba'o / /yang oṃ yig gis ni lus la rtsa'i dwangs cha rnams dang de'i yon tan rnams skyed cing / de rnams kyi rgyun gsos nas rgyas par byed do/ /de bzhin du ās khrag gi dwangs cha dang yon tan/ hūṃ gis dbugs kyi dwangs cha dang yon tan skyed cing gso'o/ /oṃ du 'jog pa ni thig le de la phun sum tshogs pa'i gzugs snang sna tshogs skyed pa'i nus pa yod pa'i sgo nas yin te/ oṃ sku rdo rje'i sa bon yin pas so/ /des mtshon te sgra tshig khyad par can sna tshogs skyed pa'i cha nas a dang / ting nge 'dzin bzang po skyed pa'i cha nas t+t+waṃ du 'jog pa'ang shes par bya la/ da lta sku rdo rje sgrub byed kyi las bsags pa rnams oṃ gyi steng du sogs pa dang / gsung sgrub byed kyi rnams āḥl sog pa sogs kyang bshad do/ /su tri gnyis la da lta rtsa'i snyigs ma ste rgud pa skyed pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na lha min dang dud 'gro'i snang zhen skyed pa'i nus pa gnyis yod cing / da lta 'gro ba de gnyis su skye ba'i las bsags pa rnams kyis kyang de gnyis kyi nus pa gsos 'debs pa dang / pre du gnyis kyis khrag gi snyigs ma bskyed nas rang nyid kyang der rgyu zhing spyod la/ yi dwags dang dmyal ba skyed pa dang / a dṛs 330

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3d+kudabugs kyi snyigs ma la bya ba 'jug cing / lha mi gnyis kyi snang ba skyed pa'ang des mtshon nas shes par bya ste sa bon drug po de ni rtsa 'dab kyi sgab bam mthar gnas so/ /lte ba'i dbyings phyug lnga'i thig le dang / mgrin pa'i rngams ma sogs kyi gnad kyang shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa la nyams myong gi thabs dang / thabs byung gi nyams myong gnyis/ dang po la/ rang lus dang / gzhan lus la brten pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ steng sgo 'ju 'dul te/ dhu ti dang / der 'khor lo bzhi'i thig le/ snying ka'i gsang mdzod gsum/ sa bon drug bcas bsgom ste/ ji skad bshad pa'i dwangs snyigs kyi gnad shes pas/ mi shigs pa de dwangs ma thams cad kyi nus pa dang yon tan 'dus pa'i cha la dmigs nas rtse gcig tu bsgom pa(dang de'ang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dang sbrel mar bskyang ba)las/nam zhig dngos gnas la lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar bas spyi bo nas bdud rtsi drangs te/ snying ga'i dwangs ma lnga gsos btab pas/de'i steng gi dwangs ma'i yon tan gyi stobs sos nas/ dang por byung ba'i rim pa ltar yi ge gsum gyi gzi mdangs dang nus pa cher spar/ de dag sbar ba'i dbang gis mar me gsos na rang 'od mched nas 'ong ba ltar stod smad kyi lus kun gyi dwangs ma'i phyogs rnams stobs su gyur nas 'bar bar 'gyur te/ 'di ni 331

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dper na gtum mo'i dngos gzhi lte ba'i de bskul bas/ des rtsa gnas gzhan gyi gtum mo'i cha rnams kyang sbar dwangs ma'i phyogs stobs su gyur zhes pa'ang dwangs mas bzhu btul byas stobs kyis las rung gi nus pa cher song ba'i don te/ 'di la ma rgyud phal dang thun mong yin min gyi cha gnyis 'byed dgos/te/ thams cad bsdongs nas dbu mar zhu bde skyed pa dang tshul 'dra'o/ /shin tu phra ba dang dwangs ma'i phyogs dang / rags pa dang snyigs ma'i phyogs kyi thig le ni dhu ti dang ro rkyang ltar gcig rgyas pa na cig shos zhum 'gro ba chos nyid yin pas yi ge gsum ji ltar 'bar ba de ltar sa bon drug po shugs zhan du 'gro ste/ 'di la rdzogs rim pa'i rigs drug bsreg sbyang zer ro/ /'di ltar mi shigs gnyug ma'i dwangs chen bskul stobs kyis/ rtsa phran gyi dwangs ma sbar ba ni/ ci tsam sbar ba de'i tshod du de rnams mi shigs pa'i dbang du yang 'du bas/ rim gyis dwangs ma gzhan rnams rtsa ba'i yi ge gsum dang / de gsum yang dwangs ma chen po la zhugs nas/ dwangs chen gyi nus pa slar la ches cher gsal zhing rgyas par 'gyur te/ ji ltar zhe na/ dwangs ma lnga las sas bde ba brtan par byed/ chus bde ba sdud cing mnyen/ mes bde ba smin/ rlung gis bde ba rgyas/ nam mkhas mkha' mnyam rdzogs pa chen por byed ces bshad do/ /rlung thig snying ka'i dhu tir 332

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3'ching ba'i sdud rim bla med rgyud gzhan du'ang rgyas mod kyi/dwangs ma'i gnad skul tshul khyad par can la brten nas/ rtsa rlung thig le'i nyes pa sbyong ba dang / yon tan rgyas pa shin tu phul che zhing / de yang 'khor lo'i lte bar sdud rim du gzhol ba'i sgo nas 'od gsal gyi nyams myong 'thug cing rgya che ba dang rgyun brtan por bde blag nyid du sgrub pa 'di ni rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi rtsa khams las rung sgrub tshul thun mong ma yin(dwangs mas snyigs ma phug ste/ lus khams skye gnas kyi zag pa zad par byed tshul yang 'dis shes)pa'o/ /'di pa'i ye shes kyi sku sgrub lugs ni stong gzags kyi sgo nas 'gro bar zar rabye 15 nyerdzo rtsa'i ༄shilugs sogs kun zhal 'cham pas/ dang ra gas ram la 'jug dus kyang stong gzugs sgrub pa'i gnad cig gal che la/ de ni rtsa'i dwangs ma dar skud lta bu zhes pa rgya mtsho gser gyi nyi ma'i rtsa rgyun de la dmigs pa gtad nas sgom pa de nyid yin te/ shin tu phra ba'i zhing dang sku dang gzhal med khang sogs kyi snang ba rab 'byams skyed pa'i nus pa mthar thug ni snying ka'i mi shigs pa 'od lnga'i thig le'i steng na yod pa dang / de mngon du 'byin cing gsal bar byed pa'i nus pa ni rtsa shel sbug can la yod pas 'od rtsa des mi shigs pa bskul ba'i rkyen byas na ye shes kyi snang ba tshad med pa mthong bar rdzogs chen snying thig tu rgya cher bshad/ 'on 333

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyang snying thig dang khyad med min te/ der ni gnad gsum la brten pas srog rtsol 'di 'dra ba la mi ltos pa'i phyir ro/ /lus gnas kyi dwangs ma gzhan yang 'od rtsa der zhugs na rdo rje gsum gyi snang ba skyed pa'i dwangs mas mchog gi khams sa 'gyar zhing der ༄ ༄dwangs ma ci tsam mang du zhugs pa de ltar 'od rtsa rang gi nus pa'ang cher rgyas par bzhed do/ /'dir rdor bzlas kyis rtsa mdud 'grol ba ma bshad mod/ 'on kyang lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar gyi dbu ma'i nang du 'bar 'dzags 'khor mar sbyang bas lam der 'bar 'dzags gnyis ka shugs je cher 'gro/ /de song ba ltar lam der bde ba skye tshabs cher 'gro/ de song rim bzhin rtsa 'dab kyi rlung rnams kyang dhu ti'i lam nas 'drong phul che ste/ sems bde bas 'drong tshan che ba dang / rlung sems 'jug pa gcig pas so/ /de ltar rlung 'drong stobs kyis rtsa mdud bshigs 'gro bas gnad 'dra'o/ /gzugs sku sgrub pa ni gzhan don du chos ston pa'i ched yin pa la/ da lta lus rags pa'i steng nas ming tshig rab 'byams spro ba ltar rnal 'byor pas shin tu phra ba'i lus kyi steng nas spro nus pa ni rdor bzlas kyis gsung rdo rje'i nus pa mi shigs pa'i steng du bzhag pa la rag las par rgyud sde gzhan du grags kyang / 'dir ni gsung rdo rje'i yi ges rtsa khams thams cad la 334

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3dbang bsgyur te/ slar de nyid kyang dbus kyi dwangs ma chen po la bsdus nas/ mi shigs pa'i steng na rjod pa sna tshogs gsal bar skyed pa'i nus pa gdod nas yod pa de sad cing yar ldan du byas pas 'grub par bzhed do/ /gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi pa'i lag len dngos ni zhal lung dang / sems nyid ngal gso'i don khrid/mun sel sogs las shes te sla/ man ngag 'di'i dngos bstan dang de gnyis ni spyi dang khyad par ba'i khyad yin te/ shes byed kyang yod/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'og sgo'i man ngag ste/ sbyor ba'i dus kyi bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang sems lnga sogs dang / thal ba las rdo rje dbyings phyug ma'i rtsa 'gugs shing bsdam pa gal che bar gsungs pa sogs bsgrigs la bshad de/ 'dir ma brjod/gnyis pa la/ mnyam bzhag rjes thob/ mnyam bzhag skyong tshul gyi khyad par gzhan te gsum/ dang po ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i thabs kyis drangs pa'i 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa stong chen/ de'i ngang las nyin snang dang rmi lam gyi snang bar 'ong rgyu rnams sgyu ma'i grong khyer bzhin du stong gzugs la mthong ba'i rkyen gyis dmigs med kyi snying rje mkha' khyab tu sad pa snying rje sgyu ma/ snying rje'i 'phen pa de dang ting nge 'dzin gyi rkyen gyis ris med pa'i stong gzags kyi snang ba de las ༄33gi

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lha sku phyag rgya gcig par 'char zhing / de las mched de snang ba thams cad lha'i 'khor lor mngon sum du spro nus pa rgya spros/ de dag la brtan pa cher thob pa na nye rgyu'i spyod pa gsum gang rung spyad de bogs dbyung ba tshogs sgrub bo/ /de'ang sngar bskyed rim pa'i stong chen las bar ma chad du snying rje sgyu ma dang / de las rgya gcig tu 'char ba sogs byang stobs kyis/ skabs 'dir/rdzogs rim pa'i stong chen mtshan nyid pa zhig shar na/ de nas de'i rtsal snying rjer 'char ba la tshegs med cing / de nas snying rje'i rang mdangs phyag rgya gcig spros su 'char ba'ang sla'o/ /'on kyang 'di dag ni grol lam ltar bris par zad pas/ zhib cha 'don rgyu mang / de ltar stong gzugs kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba na/ de nyid la rig pa rtse gcig tu bzhag nas bsgom pas/ dwangs ma'i nus pa gong 'phel du rtod la non cing / snyigs ma'i rang snang 'char ba'i nus pa 'grib ste/ dag pa'i snang ba de dag je gsal la dang je brtan rgya je cher song nas rim gyis mtha' dang dbus med pa'i sgyu 'phrul drwa bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /lugs 'dir bde bas stong nyid sgom pa dgos sam zhe na/ dgos par sems te/ 'dir bsgom bya lta ba dang / sgom byed ting nge 'dzin yin par shes 'jug mtshan nyid sogs le'u gsum par yang / de kho na 336

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3nyid gsal bar gtan la phab cing / stong nyid bdag med ye shes rang rig thugs/ /zhes sogs shin tu rnam dag gi zhing sku mdzad pa sogs kyi rtsa ba bdag med pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i ye shes su gsungs so/ /kyis bstan la/ lta ba'i skabs su ni/ rang bzhin skye med stong pa nyid dang / rol pa 'gags med lha'i 'khor lo sogs su lta bar bshad pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi gtso bo rdzogs rim skabs snang phyogs lha'i 'khor lo sgom pa bzhin du stong phyogs kyang mi sgom par mi 'thad pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/rjes thob tu gang snang thams cad la mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa'i rgyas 'debs pa ste/ la dor ba spyod pa'i thad na rgyas shing / khyad par du 'dod yon thams cwad sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis kha dog bsgyur nas longs spyod pa'i sgo nas bde ba chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyun skyong tshul tshogs dkyil gyi thad na gsal bar bstan pa de thabs lam brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i srog rtsa 'dzin tshul spyi khyab tu'ang gces par mthong ngo / /gsum pa ni/ dgongs rgyan dang sdom ṭika sogs mang por stong chen gyi skabs su/ sad pa'i dus kyi 'od gsal dang / mtshan mo gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal gnyis sbrel te nyams su len par gsungs shing / snying rje sgyu ma'i thad du sad rmi gnyis kyi snang ba mthong bar bshad pa'ang snang ba de dag stong gzugs su lam 'khyer byed pa'am/ tha mal pa la 337

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mamasnang ba de gnyis 'char ba'i dod du stong gzugs mthong zhes par mngon pas/ des ni rnal 'byor dang po gnyis gnyid rmi gnyis kyi skabs su skyong tshul bstan no/ /rmi lam du 'ong rgyu rnams stong gzugs ye shes kyi snang bar 'char zhes bstan pa dang / de ltar shar ba'i stong gzugs de rim gyis phyag rgya gcig spros su'ang 'char bar gong bzhin bshad pas/ phyag rgya gcig spros rmi lam du sbyang tshul thon no/ /gzhi la srid pa bar do ma grub gong chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char ba ltar rmi lam ma mthong ba'i sngon du lhun grub kyi gzhi snang mthong bar man ngag snying thig tu gsungs pa dang /'di'i steng sgo'i rnal 'byor pa'i gnyid 'thug gi rgya spros gnyis mthun dgos te/ 'di'i stong gzugs dang / chos nyid bar do'i snang ba gnad gcig par dgongs rgyan dang shing rta chen mor bshad pas so/ /des na grol lam gyi thad du bshad pa'i tshig ris la brten nas gong du/ snang ba de gnyis 'char ba'i dod du/zhes pa'ang 'dir zhib cha dgos sam zhe na 'di dpyod/ yang lam rim du/ gang dag dngos kun rang rig phyir/ /shi ba don dam bden pa ste/ /sogs kyis bskyed rim pas mos ngor dang /rdzogs rim pas dngos su 'chi ba chos skur sbyong byed stong chen/bar do longs skur sbyong byed snying rje sgyu ma sogs sgom par bstan 338

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3pas/ stong chen dang 'chi ba sre ba sogs kyang 'thon no/ /'on kyang 'di'i sad pa dang skye ba sbyong byed ni/ rmi lam dang bar do sbyong byed du'ang mi 'gal bas/ snying thig tu/ 'chi ba dang /chos nyid bar do'i lam khyer gnyis po kho nas bar do dang skye ba kun sbyong bar bzhed pa dang mthun no/ /de ltar na rdzogs rim la dpyod pa'i sgo tsam bshad zin to/ /lugs 'dir rtsa mdud gnyis re grol bas sa re re 'thob par bshad pa ni/ shing rta chen mor rlung 'gags pa dang / mdzod 'grel pad dkar du/ rtsa 'od du dengs pa la bshad de/ rlung 'gags pa'ang gtan du 'gags pa'o//rtsa mdud ni dhu ti kha phye ba'i gegs yin la/ de dngos grol nas dhu ti'i lam shul po che ltar song yang / da dung ro rkyang gi las rlung skye ba'i nus pa ma dag na mnyam bzhag tu dbu ma kha phye yang /rjes thob tu ro rkyang las rlung gis rgyas te/ dbu ma zhar 'gro bas/de 'dra'i ro rkyang dang las rlung de rtsa mdud kyi las can yin te/dhu ti'i kha 'ching byed yin pas so/ /des na dhu ti gtan mi zam ༄par byed pa la/ ma dag pa'i ro rkyang dang las rlung gtan byang ba dgos te/ de'ang ro rkyang gi mas rim 'di ni rtsa khams 'od du dag byed kyi ye shes dngos la mas brtan gyi dga' ba kho na dgos pa'i gnad kyis yin la/ de'i phyir 'phags lam tshe dbang rig 'dzin la dang por 'phos pa'i mtshams yang mas brtan 339

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/cig nas 'jog par mngon te/ sgyu 'phrul thal bar dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes la mas brtan dang / de las bsgrub pa'i mtshan dpe kho na bstan pa dang gnad gcig par sems so/ /nas mthar gyis 'od du dengs pa'am dwangs mar gyur nas 'gro ba yin no/ /yang 'og sgo'i rnal 'byor skabs/ yas babs kyi dga' ba bcu drug theg chen thun mong ba'i sa lam dang /phar phyin bcur sbyar zhing / mas brtan gyi bcu drug gsang sngags nang gis lam dang sbyar ba ni/ rdo rje las rim du/ pha rol phyin dang sa mtshan nyid/ /mtshungs phyir rdzogs par bshad pa yin/ / zhes mtshan nyid mtshungs pa'am chos mtshungs kyi sgo nas yin par bshad de/ phar theg tu/ thun mong ba'i phar phyin bcu'i rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba'i gnas skabs las sa bcu sogs su 'jog pa bzhin du/ 'dir sa lam thams cad bde chen gyi rtogs pa de nyid gong du 'phel ba'i rim pa'i steng nas 'jog par mtshon pa dang / dga' pa bcu drug po bde ba'i gnas skabs kyi khyad par las phye ba bzhin du/ sngags bla med kyi sa lam rnams kyang bde ba chen po'i rnal 'byor na 'phar ba'i gnas skabs kyis dbye ba dalta bde ba na 'phar ba'i gnas skabs la dga' ba bcu drug tu phye ba 'di ltar/ ma 'ongs pa na bde chen 'di'i rgyun 'phel ba'i gnas skabs rnams rab dga' la sogs pa'i sa bcur 'ong zhes bshad na mun sel gyi dbang bzhi ba'i ngo sprod thad du 'grig /dang/ 340

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3phyag rgya dang snyoms par 'jug thengs gcig gis dga' ba bcu drug po rdzogs nus pa bzhin du/ bde chen gyi lam la brten na sa dang lam thams cad ches myur ba kho nar rdzogs par 'gyur zhes mchog gi bde ba'i rnal 'byor skad cig ma tsam yang lam bgrod pa'i nus pa phul du byung bar shes ched/ gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba thun gcig la sa bcu lam lnga tshang bar bgrod pa lta bur bstan pa ste/ bde stong gi lam gyi che ba bstan pa'o/ /mdor bsdu na dwangs snyigs kyi snang ba thams cad mi shigs pa gcig pu'i rnam 'phrul yin yang / da lta snyigs mas bskyed pa'i sems dang snang cha'i steng nas tha mal pa'i zhen pa rtsal shugs mched de 'khrul pa yin cing / de sbyong ba la/ dang por bskyed rim gyis sems de ka'i steng nas snang zhen de sdud pa'i sgo btod nas/ slar rdzogs rim gyis dwangs ma'i sems mthar thug pa gsal zhing rjen par phyungs te/ de'i rang snang gi steng nas dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin sbyangs te sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyal srid 'dzin pa yin no/ /sems can gyi shes pa'i cha thams cad snyigs ma'i snang bas phrogs pa'i skabs ni mi srid de/ gnyug sems snang ba de dang mi 'grogs pas so /dwangs ma'i snang bas ni shes pa'i cha ma lus par bsgyur du yod de/sems gzhan thams cad dwangs ma'i snang ba'i rnam pa can gyi 341
pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gnyug sems kho na la bsdus pa'i skabs yod pa'i phyir te/ rang byung kun ngam lhun gyis grub/ /ces so/ /342

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3༄/ /sgyu 'phrul spyi'i skor/bla ma chos rje rin po che la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pas gsung tshul thad/ spar khab mkhan po ltar na mchog sprul gyis rgyud bstan pa'i rnam bzhag ma mdzad mod/ le'u gsum pa'i/bla na med pa'i theg pas/ zhes dang / gos su med par ston pa'i/zhes pa sprul skus gsungs tshul yin pas dpyad rgyu yod kyang rgyud kyi tshig rim 'di ltar bsdebs pa bka' bsdu'i dus byung zhes 'chad par mngon/lam rgyud thad lam thun mong yin min gnyis/ dang po la/phar theg ltar byang chub kyi spyod pa la slob par khog gzhung nas gsungs pa ltar bstan pa'i spyi sgrom gal che ste/ der ma smin na gong mar 'jug lo byas kyang gab gsang ma rtogs par sbas pa la 'chel bar 'gro/ yang na lta phreng las gsungs pa ltar gong ma la skur ba 'debs so/ /thabs grol skabs/ lam gyi gzhung shing rdzogs rim gyi steng nas de gnyis phye zhing / de'i tshal yang / 'di'i rdzogs rim la/༄rtsom pa dang por rno myur btsan thabs/ gyi thabs la brten nas thob 343

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa dang / rang babs kyi bzhag thabs la brten nas thob pa'i rdzogs rim gnyis zhes stong chen sogs rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor lnga la dang por sbyor tshal dang thob tshal mi 'dra ba gnyis yod pa'i rasgro rangasgo nas bzhag pa ste/ grol lam skabs bskyed rim nas rdzogs rim du 'pho byed la rtsa rlung gi gdams ngag ma bshad par/ mthong ba'i rjes 'jog sogs/ bzhag thabs gnyis po rang bshad do/ /thabs lam khe nyen che ba mak+ṣi ka ltar bshad pa'am rtsom pa dang po da lta'i gdul bya lta bu 'ga' zhig la/ 'thad kyi/ rdzogs rim byang ba tshogs sgrub pa sogs la gar 'thad/ 'di'i lugs kyi/ sems dang ye shes rang snang bden pa dbyer med dam chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par rtogs pa'i lta ba'am shes rab kyi sgrom nas lam gyi khog 'bub pa yin la/ grol lam yang de 'dra'i lam gyi khog dkyus ma de bskyang ba rang gi sgo nas bskyed rdzogs kyi lam phal cher bgrod pa zhig la byed cing / de'i steng du gdams ngag gi thabs zur pa gtso bor bsten rgyu zhig kyang bsnan nas lam sgrub pa la thabs lam zer bas/ mtshan gsum gyi khog rgyas par grol lam dus bstan cing / thabs lam dus thabs lam rang gi dgos chos tsam las cher ma bstan par zad kyi/ thabs lam la mtshan nyid gsum gyi sbyor ba gtan min no/ /dper na phar phyin drug 344

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3la(mtshan nyid gsum)sngags su'ang(thabs lam)slob mod kyi/ phar phyin theg pa(grolalam)zer dus sngags theg(thabs lam)der go mi rung zhing /phar phyin gyi(mtshan nyid gsum)spyod pa'i skor la phar theg (shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba'i lam)gi gzhung gsal zhing rgyas la/ sngags su(thabs lam) sngags rang gi khyad chos rnams gtso bor ston pa dang 'dra'o//rim gnyis kyi 'jog tshul gsar ma dang 'dra ste/ rgyud phyi ma las gsal te/ lha yi rnam pa'i sogs so/ / 'dir sngags sdom skyed dus ni dam tshig byin pa'i mjug tu yin la/ byang sdom ni zhal lung du sngon rabs pa'i gsung sgros drang ba ltar na dkyil chog gi sngar phog nas byed pa lta bur snang la/lus dbul dgos pa gsum phyir byed pa'i skabs su thob rgyur byas kyang rung ngam ste/ dam tshig gsum bkod bzhin no/ /dbang gi grangs bzhir rgyud phyi ma las te/ der dbang dang po la bum dbang zhes ma bshad cing / nyan dbang sogs la mtha' rten chu dbang mi 'dug pas/ slob dpon gyi dbang zhes bya ste gtso bo'i sgo nas btags pa'o/ /dbang de dkyil 'khor pa las thob par bya dgos te/ gzhan du na dkyil 'khor bzhengs sgrub kyang / der dbang bskur bar 'dod nas min dgos la/ dal gyi lhas dgongs gtad mdzad pa'i tshig zin yang cher ma thon yang /345

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'jug pa'i 'og dbang dngos gzhi'i mtshams sbyor na/ dkyil 'khor ba la mchod bstod byas nas/ bdag gis slob ma 'di dka/ la dbang bskur byed pa la byin gyis rlob pa'i grogs mdzod ces gsol ba 'debs par bshad pa des thon snyam ste/ de dgongs pa gtod ched yin pas so/ /phan dbang la bcur phye ba'i rgyu mtshan gsal por ma bshad kyang / le'u bcu par rgyal po sbyin pa'i ting 'dzin zhes gsungs pa ltar phan dbang gis chos kyi rgyal po'i chas su bcug nas rigs lnga'i rgyal thabs la dbang ba'i rten 'brel gzhi bsgrigs nas/ nus dbang dang zab dbang gis rim gyis chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang ba'i nus pa dngos su skyed pa yin la/de'i tshe rgyal po rnams la rgyal po'i che rtags gtso bo dab rgyan/ cod ༄ pan/ rgol bas mi tshugs pa'i go cha/ bza' btung sogs 'dod yon/ srid mtho ba'i rtags gdugs sogs yod pa dang bstun nas bzhag pa/ dus 'khor du byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun zhes pa bzhin no snyam ste dpyad/ dbu rgyan rin po che'i khang bu rin chen rigs kyis lhag gnas 'thad pa nas/ bza' btung lus brtas byed yin pas sku'i rigs rnam snang rab gnas 'thad pa'i bar du dpyod tshul dgos 'dra yang mi gsal bas blo bzor 'gro'am snyam/ phan dbang dang nyan sgom gyi dbang rdo rje 346

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3slob ma'i dbang du don gyis 'gro yang tha snyad mi byed/ 'chad phrin gyis ngag gi thig le la rgyud 'chad pa'i byin rlabs skyed ched 'od dpag med kyis dbang bskur nas gnang ba ston pa dang /las kyi thig le la byin gyis brlabs nas las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i mthu skyed pa'i sgo nas slob dpon du 'os pa'i gzhi bsgrubs te/gdod slob dpon gyi dbang dngos ster ba yin pas de gsam slob ༄dpon dbang gi phyogs su 'gro bar bshad/ 'di dbang bzhi pa'i thal rgyud kyi tshig na/ bde chen las bsgrub pa'i mtshan dpe ngo sprod yod pas/ chos gzugs kyi sku zung 'jug la ngo 'phrod rgyu gal che/'di'i rdzogs rim gyi stong chen dang / snying rje sgyu ma gnyis la nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gnyis re bshad pa'i mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal dang nyin dus bsgom pa'i stong chen sre zhing sgom pa stong chen/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal de'i snang ba thams cad snang dus nas rang snang las logs su ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogasabyunas 'od gsal nyid kyi rgyas btab ste'am 'od gsal nyid dang bsres nas sgom pa snying rje sgyu ma zhes dge rtse'i dkar chag tu snang ba lo chen gyi gsung dang ji bzhin 'dra bar snang / des ni mtshan mo'i 'od gsal gyi snang ba 'char dus ting 347

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nge 'dzin dang snying rje'i stobs kyis stong gzugs kyi lha skur sad par byed pa'i phyag rgya gcig spros kyang go nus pas gnyid rmi dang bsre ba'i zab lam yin no/ /gnyid rmi gnyis dang bsres pas lam de dag rno myur du byed pa'i gnad kyang 'dir spro/ 'on kyang sad rmi gnyid gsum dang sre ba'i lugs gzhan ltar rmi lam rlung sems kyi skus/ sad pa rags pa'i sku 'dzin pa'i rnam bzhag med de/ stong gzags sad dus su med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rmi lam ༄gyi rgya spros ni mnyam bzhag gi rgya spros yin la/ de sad pa na rjes thob kyi rgya spros rjes mthun tsam du ldang ba yin/ sad dus kyi 'od mnyam bzhag tu stong gzugs kyi rgya spros dang / rjes thob tu gang snang lha skur yid ngor sbyong ba'i rgya spros gnyis yod pa 'dzing mi nyan/rjes thob kyi de ni le'u bcu gcig par gsungs pa tshogs sgrub kyi sngar yang sbyang dgos te/ la dor ba spyod pa'i thad na gsal/'di bas rdzogs rim pa'i lha sku la zung 'jug gi sku zhes 'chad pa ni/ stong chen dang snying rje sgyu ma zung du 'jug pa'i sku tsam la byed pas gsang 'dus pa'i zung 'jug dang mu tshod ches mi gcigathal rgyud las/ spangs nas rdo rje dbyings phyug rtsa/ /dgug dang bsdam pa ma shes na/ /zhes thabs lam 'og sgo'i skabs rtsa 'ching ba gal che gsungs pa 'di 'bor mi nyan/348

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3thub drug skabs/ dud 'gro 'dul byed du sprul pa'i sku la klu'i rgyal po dang ri dwags dbang po sogs dud 'gro'i rnam pa can dang / yid bzhin nor bu 'dod pa sbyin shing dang / lta bu bem po'i rnam can dang / mchog sprul mtshan dpes spras pa'i rnam can sogs mang du yod kyang / dkyil 'khor la 'god dus/ de thams cad dud 'gro 'dul byed kyi sprul skur rigs bsdus nas lha gcig 'god/ de'ang bshad ma thag pa de thams cad kyi nang nas sku'i rnam pa'i cha nas mchog tu gyur pa ni mchog sprul rnam can rang yin pas de'i rnam par 'god pa yin/ de 'dra'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa de dud 'gro 'dul byed kyi thub pa yin yang dud 'gro'i rten can gtan nas min no/ /de sku'i rnam pa'i chas mchog tu gyur tshul ni/ dag pa'i rnam can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ngo bo nyid ye med na chos thams cad ji ltar snang zhe na/ ming tsam gyis bzhag pas na yi ge'i rnam 'phrul tsam mo/ /yi ge de'ang gnas snang mi mthun pa'i 'khrul pa phyin ci log gi bslad pa gtan ma zhugs na/ des gang btags dang cir sprul gyi snang ba thams cad kyang snang tshul phyin ci log las 'das pa'i shin tu rnam dag gi snang ba 'ba' zhig tu zad pas/ snang srid thams cad gdod ma'i sdod tshul la gsung gsang sngags kyi sgyu 'phrul kho nar gnas te/349

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsung gsang sngags kyi yi ge bya ba phyin log gi bslad pa dang bral ba'i dag pa'i yi ge/ dag pa rab 'byams kyi rnam 'phrul dang byed las can de la byed pas so/ /snang tshal sems rang snang gi yi ༄ge la 'khrul pa'i ming tshig mtha' med srid kyang / gnas tshul ye shes rang snang gi ming tshig la gsang sngags kyi yi ge sprin min pa med pa'o/ /'di le'u bzhi pa dang / yig 'bru'i gtan tshigs skabs mkho min dpyod/tshe dbang rig 'dzin skabs/ rtog tshogs sgyu drwar bshad pa'i khams drug ldan gyi rdo rje'i lus kyi dwangs ma stobs su gyur cing /snyigs ma dang de las gyur pa'i lus khams skye gnas kyi zag pa zad pa'i dbang gis/ phar phyin dus sa thob dus thams cad du mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa dang mthun pa/ zhes pa ltar/ 'dir yang las rlung gi 'khrul rgyus dkrugs pa'i sems mi gsal ba rnams mnyam rjes kun tu shas cher dengs shing / gzi byin chos kyi dbyings ltar tshad gzung dang bral ba'i 'od gsal sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor gyis snang sems thams cad non cing kha dog bsgyur ba ni/ gsang 'dus pas/ sgyu lus thob nas lus sems phra rags kyi 'brel rags pa chad nas mi rgyu ba dang dod mtshungs pa'am yang na zung 'jug thob nas 'brel phra mo chad pa'i dod do/ /'di rgya 350

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3d+kutrapya ma/tsho las/ 'byung bzhi dwangs ma la brten pas/ /rig pa'i bde chen bar chad med/ /rnam rtog 'gyu ba'i rlung dwangs pas/ /bde chen nam mkha'i mtha' ltar gnas/ /zhes le'u bcu bzhi par bshad pa dang phyogs 'dra'o/ /'dir g.yung gi gsung nas/bden pa'i phyogs gcig mthong ba rnam smin/ bden don rdzogs par mthong ba tshe dbang / mthong zin sgom byed phyag chen gsungs pa dang / spyod bsdus las/ sems dben pa la bden pa mthong ba 'di/ zhes pa'i 'od gsal la spros pa phyogs re khegs pa'i cha nas don dam 'od gsal zhes btags pa ltar btags 'dug pa'ang ma 'bor/kyu ru lugs dang zhal lung nas/ thabs grol mgo 'brel bar gsungs pa ni/ thabs lam gyi skabs su bshad pa'i pho nya'i lam dang / grol lam gyi skabs su bshad pa'i mtshan nyid gsum rtsi gzhir byas nas/ de la 'brel brtsis pa tsam las/ lam gnyis dngos la brtsis pa min nam dpyad/ spar khab mkhan pos/ 'di skad bshad pa'i sogs sdud pa po'i tshig tu bzhed pa ltar na bshad rgyud las/ 'di zhes nye bar mtshon pa ni/ /sogs cung zad dka'/gleng slong skabs/ gleng slong gi gzhung la drang nges kyi don gnyis 'byed pa gleng gzhi'i 'gros ltar byas nas/ zab dbang 351

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/snyedang sbyar ba sogs gleng slong nang ltar 'chad tshul du byas na go bde yang / sngon gyi 'chad tshul ma dkrugs pa bzang bas re zhig dkyus ltar zhog dam tshig thad/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig lngas rtsa ltung ston pa min te/rigs lnga'i dam tshig bzhin no/ /yan lag la/ nang dug lnga'i rnam rtog ci shar yang de la ma dag pa'i snang zhen gyis spong bsgyur gzhan mi byed par nyon mongs pa de rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i gnas lugs kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa'i gnad kyis/ mi bskyod pa sogs rig lnga'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gdod nas dag tshul sngags bla med spyi'i gang shar bde stong du lta lugs bzhin du bltas nas/gang shar gyi nyon mongs thams cad bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i grogs kho nar 'khyer ba dang / phyi 'jig rten na shin tu dme bar(smad par)grags pa'i rdzas lnga yang dag pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bdud rtsir byas nas bde chen gyi bcud len du sten pa ste lnga tshan gnyis so/ /yang dag dug lnga ni log pa'i dug lnga po 'khor 'das so sor mi rtog pa'i gti mug sogs su blta ched bzhag gam dpyad/rgyud 'dir chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par mthong zhing sgom pa'i rnal 'byor lam gyi srog tu yang yang rtsal bton gyis ston la/ de'i tshe phyi rol gyi rdzas ma dag pa phyis sogs dang / nang rnam 352

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3rtog ma dag pa dug lnga lta bu'ang dag pa rab 'byams kyi rnal 'byor gcig pa'i grogs sa 'khyer ba 'di nyid kyi sgos kyi dam tshig dag rag tu bstan pas kyang lam gyi srog de nyid dang rnam pa kun tu 'bral mi rung zhes bstan par nges pa rnyed do/ /rgyud 'di'i bshad srol la/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i don las phyi rol du gol zhing g.yeng ba'i cha gtan log pa na sangs rgyas pa yin la/ lam dus su chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor ches phul du byung ba brtan cing mi 'phrogs pa 'thob pa'i ched du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa ste tshogs spyod byed pa yin par le'u bcu gcig par/ thams cad mngon rdzogs rgyal po che/ /zhes dang / dkyil 'khor kun tu bzang po'i zhing / /zhes sogs so/ /de'ang bde stong gi rnal 'byor gsal brtan thob pa'i mthus dag pa rab 'byams kyi snang zhen ches mthu chen du 'gro ba ni/ stong nyid bdag med ye shes rang rig thugs/ /sogs dang / thabs la brten pa'i shes rab nyid/ /sogs ltar ro/ /de ltar dag pa'i lha sngags ye shes kyi snang zhen khyad par can nam mthu phul byung can sgrub nus dang skyed nus kyi bde stong gi rnal 'byor khyad 'phags sgrub pa la rnal 'byor pho mo rnams dkyil 'khor ba'i chas 'jug byas pa la sogs pa'i 353

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mtshan nyid can gyi tshogs spyod dgos pa yin no/ /des na 'di'i lam thams cad ye shes rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug cing sgrub pa'i lta ba'i rnal 'byor gyis bsdus shing bsdam par lta phreng gi don bsdur gsungs pa la nges pa rnyed do/ /da dung bshad na/ lugs 'dir chos thams cad sangs rgyas par 'chad dus/ ma dag pa'i dngos po yod med dang / gnas tshod la dag ma dag ji ltar yin dpyod pa ni/ spyir ma dag pa yod med dpyod pa sogs min gyi/ gnyug ma rkyang pa'i gnas tshod dbang du byas pa ste/ glo bur ba'i chos rnams med pa'i dbang du byas na zhes dpyad pa'o/ /de'i dbang du byas nas ji ltar yin dpyad na/ 'khor 'das kyi snang ba gnyis ka snang tsam las med par 'dra yang / 'khor ba ni phyin ci log gi snang ba'am 'khrul snang tsam yin te/ sems rang snang zhes pa'i sems ni 'khrul pa'i sems rags pa ste/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi blo kun rdzob pa thams cad gnyis snang 'khrul pas sbags la/ khyad par 'dir bstan sems rags pa ni phyin ci log gi(snang gsum gyi)bag chags las bskyed pa'i 'am 'khrul ba'i bag chags las skyes pa'i sems kho na yin pas/ de'i snang ba thams cad ni ra ro dang bla brtol gyi snang ba'am/ dha du ra zos pa sogs 'khrul rgyus dkrugs pa'i snang ba 354

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3ltar dag bya dang glo bur ba kho na'o/ /dag pa'i snang ba zhes pa'i dag pa ni gnas snang mi mthun pa'i cha dag pa ste/ ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis dag pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang ste/ de ni gnyug ma'i ye shes kho na'i rang mdangs yin pas rang bzhin babs sam 'bral mi rung ngo / /de'ang srid pa'i gnas las sogs dang /lha'i sku dang zhing khams sogs la snang phyogs yin par khyad med kyang / glo bur ba dang / gnyug ma'i rang snang gi khyad ches che bas snang ba phyi ma ltar goms dgos te/ phyin ci log goms par bya mi rung bas so zhes snang phyogs gtso bor 'chad pa yin te/ sems ye rang snang ba zhes dang / snang ba bzhir gdams pa lta bu'o/ /'dir le'u gsum par chos thams cad gtan la phab dus kyang /'khor ba'i snang ba thams cad ni gshob gcig la rtsa ba brten pas log pa yin tshul dang / shes bya'i de nyid ni gshob des bzung tshul gyi bzlog phyogs(stonganyid)su yod tshul/ gnas lugs bden zhing mi bslu ba ma nor ba de mngon du byas pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba ni/ dag pa rab 'byams sgyu 'phrul drwa ba kho na las med pas sgyu drwa kho nar la bzla dgos zhes/ ngo mtshar sku gsung yon tan/ /sogs kyi bar ro/ /le'u lnga par sgyu drwa'i ting 'dzin bshad dus kyang / sgyu 'phrul zhes pa ni rlom sems med pa sgyu ma'i skyes bu lta 355

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bu zer ba ltar zab gsal gnyis med kyi sku(dkyil 'khor)la byas nas/drwa ba ni mang la 'brel ba ste/ dper na phal chen las/ mtha' dang dbus med pa sgyu ma'i drwa ba lta bur ston pa/ zhes pa 'dra bas/sgyu drwa'i don de ltar dgongs nas/ de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya kun gyi rgyu/ /thabs las thabs byung thabs bsam yas/ /tha dad min las tha dad pa'i/ /nang dang nang gi phyi rol gyi/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas ye shes rol/ /zhes stong pa nyid kyi ye shes de/ rang snang gi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams bsam yas(dra ba)su rnam par 'phral ba la sgyu 'phral drwa bar gsungs/char rtsa'i /byeX ri mo tshog zirab 'ar 'jidas na sgyu 'phrul gya drwa ba na rmangs pa' rab rab dag pa' snang cha yin cing / bden snang gi drwa ba ni rmongs pa'i rab rib kyi snang cha yin no/ /de dag thams cad kyang gtso bor snang phyogs kyi lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du mdzad nas gsungs te/ pha rgyud ma hā yo gar snang phyogs kyi lha dang / ma rgyud a nu yo gar stong phyogs kyi ye shes gtso bor byed par bshad pa dang sbyar na rgyud 'di ma hā'i spyi rgyud du dang / bsdus don dang / rtsa ba'i rgyud du bshad pa la nges pa chen po ster/ 'di las dpag na 'di ba'i stong gzugs kyi sku yang ye shes rang snang gi dkyil 'khor dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gtso shes su bshad dgos pas sgyu lus sgrub lugs dang ma 356

sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzogs skor/ pod/ 3'dra rung / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku ni sgrub pa nges par 'dod nga ra bya'o/ /sngar ma go ba zhig la/ 'dus pa sogs las bskyed rim mthar son nas spyod pa'i mthar bsam gtan dang / sbyin sreg sogs kyis thun mong gi grub chen rnams sgrub par bshad la/'dir spyod pa'i dus de nyid du rig 'dzin gnyis gang rung 'grub par bshad pa'i/ snga ma bskyed rim cung zad brtan pa dang / phyi ma cher brtan pa'i dbang btang du sdom ṭika las so/ /'on kyang nang la gzhol ba'i sngags pas kyang snga ma ltar byed par bshad pas/spyi skad du las rgya la dang / ye rgya la gtso bor brten pa'i khyad ltar dbang po rno rtul gyi khyad lta bur 'thad dam brtag go/ /bskyed rim gyis 'jig rten pa'i dang / rdzogs rim gyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub par 'di nyid kyi rgyud phyi ma las so//'di dag rje nyid nas zin tho lta bur btab yod pa rnams gzhan du 'khyar gyis dogs nas rjes 'jug 'ga' zhig gis phyogs gcig tu bsgriṭa khul byas te phyag bris ji lta ba bzhin bcos bslad med par spar du bskrun pa dge legs 'phel// //357
gyi/ /dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa'i don rnam par 'grel ba legs par bshad pa'i gan mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ /ye shes gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab snang stong sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs te/ /lhun grub rang byung sgyu 'phrul rol mos mtha' klas yid can smin mdzad pa/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i rnam thar rmad byung dad brgya'i 'dzum gyis legs bsus nas/ /'phags yul grub pa'i gzhung bzang rin chen rnam 'grel rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'god/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje la bstod pa don zab cing rgya che ba dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po zhes bya ba 'di'i don cung zad 'chad pa la spyi don lnga ste/ spong ba chen po bshad pa/ rtogs pa chen po bstan pa/ sems chen po la bsngags pa/ tshangs dbyangs chen po la bstod pa/ sku'i rnam rol chen po smos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral/zhes pa'o/ /de la 'di'i gang gi sgra ni 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la snyegs te/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ spyi sgra spyi la bshad du rung ba rnams de ltar 'jog dgos kyang / 'di ni de lta ma yin te/ ga'/ te de lta yin na rus pa dang gyo mos kyang sgrib gnyis spangs par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir 'di ni spyi sgra bye brag la 'jug pa'i skabs yin te/ khyad par can gyi tshig dang 'brel ba'i phyir ro/ /rtags grub ste/ spang bya mtha' dag dang bral ba'i ye shes ni 360

'jam dpal bstod 'grel/ pod/ 3'jam dpal 'ba' zhig yin pa'i phyir te/ mkhas pa smri tidz+nyā nas mtshan brjod bshad 'bum du/ ma dag pa gzhi dus kyi 'jam dpal/ ma dag dag pa lam gyi 'jam dpal/ shin tu rnam dag 'bras bu'i 'jam dpal dang gsum bshad pa las 'jam dpal mtshan nyid pa ni gsum pa yin la/ de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te 'jam dpal dang rnam mkhyen gcig yin na gang gi blo gros zhes brjod par mi rigs te blo gros kyi blo gros zhes pa ltar zlos skyon snang ba'i phyir zhe na/skyon med de/ 'di ni 'jam dpal yang yin la blo gros kyang yin pa gzhi gcig pa'i bsdu ba ste/ rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes zhes bya ba lta bu'o/ /'jam dpal de ni sgrib pa gnyis dang bral ba ste/ 'jam ngatsā zhes bya ba'i mtshan gyi don de de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sgrib pa kanyis gang zhe na/ thar ba dang rnam mkhyen gnyis kyi nang tshan gtso bor thar ba la gegs byed pa 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon sgrib/ gtso bor thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob pa'i gegs byed pa ma rig bag chags kyi sa la sogs pa shes sgrib ste/ rgyud bla mar/ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang / /de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod/ /'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang / de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ces so/ /de dag sprin dang mtshungs pa yin te/361

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4misprin ni nyi zla'i 'od shin tu gsal ba la gegs su gyur ba dang /'thor rlung chen po'i shugs kyis myur du skred pas gzhig sla ba dang 'dra bar/ sgrib pa rnams kyang blo'i nus mthu chags thogs med pa la gegs byed cing / 'dzin stangs phyin ci log yin pas zab mo'i ye shes kyis spong bar sla ba'i phyir ro/ /rgyu mtshan phyi ma 'dis 'jam dpal gyi ye shes sgrib bral chen por yang 'grub ste/ ji ltar zhe na/ spyir don mthun gyi blo ni rtsa ba brtan pa yin te/gnod pa thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /'di nyid rnam 'grel las/ 'tshe ba med dang yang dag don/ /ngo bo nyid la phyin log gis/ /'bad du zin kyang mi bzlog ste/ /blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro/ /zhes gsung / log shes 'khrul pa'i 'dzin stangs ni mi brtan pa ste/ tshad ma'i gnod pa dang bcas pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid las/ dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba can thabs kyis mthar phyin pa ni dngos po rnams kyi gnas lugs dang mthun par zhugs pa'i tshad ma yang dag phul yin la/ de dang bden 'dzin la sogs pa'i sgrib pa phyin ci log rnams 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal yin zhing / ye shes de goms pa'i mthu las me stobs chen po'i shugs kyis non pa'i sa phyogs na grang 'bras spu 362

'jam dpal bstod 'grel/ pod/ 3long byed zad pa bzhin du spang bya'i phyogs 'grib ste ma lus par spangs pa zhig nges par 'grub cing / de lta bu'i spangs pa gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi spangs pa chen po ste/ 'jam dpal dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i chos nyid kyi sku yin no/ /de skad 'i phyogs 'uglang gis 'jam dpal bstod pa las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste//'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /rnam rtog de dang bral bas na/ /khyod ni rab tu mya ngan 'das/ /zhes bshad do/ gnyis pa la/de dngos bshad pa dang / zhar byung de'i mtshon rtags bshad pa gnyis las/ /dang po ni/ nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal bas/ /ji snyed don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ltar 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' ni nyi ma dang chos mtshungs pa ste/nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la mun nag gi tshogs med pas dag pa dang /'od zer gyi snang ba 'bar bas gsal ba dang / nam mkha'i ngos mthon por gnas pa ltar/ 'jam dpal yang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas dag pa dang / chos kyi sku'i phrin las kun tu gsal ba dang / dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dbyings mthar phyin pa la bzhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /de 'dra ba'i 'jam dpal des shes bya ji snyed pa'i don mtha' dag ma 'khrul par ji ltar ba bzhin du gzigs te/ mtshan brjod las/ shes rab chen pos 363

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skad cig la/ /chos kun khong du chud pa 'chang / /chos kun mngon par rtogs pa ste/ /thub pa blo mchog yang dag mtha'/ /mi g.yo rab tu dang ba'i bdag /ces gsungs so/ /de la shes bya ji ltar gzigs na/ chos thams cad rten 'byung sgyu ma lta bu'i rol mor gzigs te/ 'di la byed po gzhan med cing bdag rang dbang can la sogs pa med la rgyu med pa dang rgyu'i rgyun chad pa las kyang 'bras ba mi skye zhing rgyu de nyid 'bras bar 'phos pa'ang ma yin rig mi rig mimod kyi srang mda'i mgo mjug mtho dman bzhin du rgyu yang 'gags la 'bras bu'ang skye ste/ de'ang rgyu dang 'bras bu rigs 'dra ba dang / rgyu chung ngu las 'bras bu chen po 'byung ba la sogs pa ma brtag nyams dga' ba'i snang char rgyu 'bras kyi rnam par bzhag pa thams cad bslu med du yod do zhes ma nor ba ra gzigs la/ dngos po rnam par bcad pa'i dngos med rnams kyang dngos po la ltos te bzhag pa tsam du mkhyen cing sems kyi skad cig gcig la gzigs pa 'jug go/ /gal te rkang ba 'dis ji snyed gzigs pa ni bstan mod kyi don dam gzigs pa ma bstan nam 'e na/ ji bzhin gzigs phyir zhes pa'i shugs la bstan pa ste/ chos 'di rang bzhin gyis grub par mthong na des chos log par mthong gis/ /ji bzhin du mthong ba ma yin pa'i phyir te tha snyad du'ang mi 364

'jam dpal bstod 'grel/ pod/ 3srid pa'i zhen yul la zhen pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na rten 'byung snang bzhin du rang bzhin stong / rang bzhin stong bzhin du kun rdzob kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa 'char ba ste stong rten 'byung zung 'jug tu mngon sum gzigs pa ni chos ji bzhin du gzigs pa'i mchog yin la/ rten 'byung gdod nas ma grub pa'i chos nyid gzigs pa de ni ji lta ba mkhyen pa ste/ sdud pa las/ gzugs rnams mi mthong tshor ba dag kyang mi mthong zhing / /'du shes mthong ba med la sems pa mi mthong zhing / /gang la rnam par shes dang sems yid mthong med pa/ /'di ni chos mthong yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /'dir bshad dgos pa mang yang yi ge nyog gis dogs nas ma bris so/ /de lta bu'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' de yod par gang gis shes zhe na/ 'di ni dngos stobs kyi rigs pa'i lam nas grub pa ste/sems kyi rgyud gzungs dang spobs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan la 'dris par bslab na/ de 'dra ba'i blo snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi ma nus pa mthu can du byas te yon tan gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i phyir dang / blo'i rang bzhin tshad med pa yin pas shes bya pha mtha' med pa bzhin du ye shes rgyas par 'thad pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel du/ 'di ltar goms pa snga ma dang / /snga ma'i sems chos 365

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brtse ba dang / /chags bral blo sogs gzhan dag gi/ /gsal ba yi ni rtsa ba yin/ /zhes sogs bshad pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyid kyi thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di'i don la rje btsun lcang skya pa chen po ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i ye shes chos sku'i phrin las kyi gtso bo gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa legs par 'doms pa'i sgo nas skal bzang thar bar 'khrid pa'i brdar thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs kyang / de ni 'bras bu'i don la ma zhugs par snang ste/tshig 'dis chos thams cad ji bzhin du gzigs pa'i brdar pusti ka 'dzin pa bstan gyi chos ston pa'i brda thabs su dngos shugs gang gi kyang ma bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te 'di ni shugs la bstan pa ste/ chos sku'i brdar bstan pas phrin las kyi brdar go ba'i phyir zhe na/ de lta na mes bud shing bsregs so zhes brjod pas me'i kha dog gis shing bsreg pa zhig shugs la bstan par thal te/ rgyu mtshan mtshangs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir rang gi lugs ni/༄theg gsum lam du zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams kyis bsgom par bya ba'i gnas mtha' dag gi sdom don mngon rtogs brgyad kyi rnam par bzhag pa ma lus pa thugs su chud pa'i brdar brgyad stong ba'i glegs bam thugs kar 'dzin pa'o/ /'o na don mngon rtogs 366

'jam dpal bstod 'grel/ pod/ 3brgyad du ma gtogs pa'i shes bya gzhan mkhyen par mi mtshon nam zhe na/ de'ang shugs la mtshon pa yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ gtso bo'i don la mi bslu phyir/ /gzhan la'ang rjes su dpag pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'jig rten na lha chen po mngon shes grub pa rnams kyis kyang ma rtogs pa'i lam zab mo 'di lta bu dag gzigs par bstan na rtogs sla ba sgyu rtsal dang snyan ngag la sogs pa gzigs par rjes su dpog nus pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang spyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i cha lugs dang phyag mtshan ji ltar snang yang de thams cad 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yin pas glegs ral kho na zhig 'dzin pas ma khyab mod/ 'on kyang 'dul ba'i dbang gis sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ye shes mchog gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid rgyal sras mthu chen gyi gzugs su snang ba la 'jam dpal gzhon nu gyar ba zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa 11////sde/ risi pho phyag mtshan gtso bo'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ snying rje'i yul bshad pa dang / de la bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje 'byung tshul bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gang dag srid pa'i btson rar ma rig mun 'thum sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i/ /'gro tshogs kun la/ zhes pa ste/ de la srid pa zhes bya ba ni nye bar len pa'am nyon mongs las byung zhing 'phags 367

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa rnams dang mi mthun pa'i zag bcas kyi phung po lnga la bya ste /mdzod las/ de dag zag bcas nyer len pa'i/ /phung po'ang de dag 'thab bcas kyang / /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'jig rten dang //lta gnas srid pa'ang de dag yin/ /zhes gsung / de nyid ni rgyal po'i btson ra dang tshul mtshungs pa yin te/ ji ltar btson ra ni thar bar dka' ba dang / rkun po rnams rgyal po'i chad pas dbang med du 'jug dgos pa dang / khri mun stug pos khebs pa dang / lcags sgrog dam pos 'ching ba'i gnas yin pa ltar/'di'ang thar dka' ba dang / sred ldan rnams dbang med du 'jug pa'i gnas yin pa dang / ma rig pas khebs pa dang /sdug bsngal gyis 'ching ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la ci'i phyir srid pa las thar dka' zhe na/ rin chen phreng ba las lam gsum thog mtha' dbus med par/ /'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor 'gal me yi/ /'khor lo lta bur phan tshun gyi/ /rgyu can 'di ni 'khor bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar nyon mongs pa'i lam ma rig sred len gsum dang / las kyi lam 'du byed dang srid pa gnyis dang / sdug bsngal gyi lam rnam shes/ ming gzugs/ skye mched/reg pa/ tshor ba/ skye ba/ rga shi ste bdun po rnams la rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis zhes grags te/ de dag dper na tshe snga ma 368

'jam dpal bstod 'grel/ pod/ 3nas 'dir 'ong 'di nas phyi mar 'gro ba'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i ma rig pa de nyid tshe snga ma nas snga mar 'ong zhing snga ma nas 'dir 'ong ba'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i sred len du 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i rim pas ji srid du srid rtsa drungs 'byin gyi gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes ma rnyed pa de srid du srid pa mtha' med par 'khor ba'o/ /yang ci phyir sred ldan rnams dbang med du 'khor zhe na/ ji ltar myu gu mngon par 'byung ba'i dngos rgyu nus pa thogs med tshang bar gyur na myu gu mi skye ba'i dbang med pa ltar 'khor bar ltung ba'i rgyu nus mthu thogs med bdag tu lta ba dang bdag tu sred pa'i blo ma spang ba de srid du chags sogs kyi nyon mongs rnams mi 'dzad la/ de ma zad na/ zag bcas kyi las gsog cing / de'i dbang gis skye ba'i 'khor lor dbang med du 'phyan pa yin te/ snga ma las/ ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa/ /de srid de la ngar 'dzin yod/ /ngar 'dzin yod na yang las te/ /de las kyang ni skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de la ma rig pa zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad ngar 'dzin gyi rtog pas bzhag pa tsam ma yin par rang ngos nas gcig dang du ma sogs su grub par 'dzin pa'i 'khrul shes te/ sa lu ljang ba'i tshig 369
