rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3bya dngos dang rnam pa bdun yin no/ /gnyis pa la bdun las/ dang po brgyud pa khungs kyi che ba ni/'di ltar ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po sa gsum gyi bla ma des thog mar sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chen por thugs bskyed/ de nas bar du bskal ba grangs med gsum du ye shes chos sku'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen ye shes kyi tshogs dang / gzugs sku'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen bsod rnams kyi tshogs rgya cher bsags te/ de'ang bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi tshogs gnyis rgya chen po'i dod thub bsags pa yin gyi/ grangs med gsum gyi bskal yun dngos su 'gro dgos pa ma yin te/ gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdor/ /ded dpon snying rje chen pos mi nag po bsad pas bskal ba 'bum gyi tshogs rdzogs par bshad pa dang / sa bcu par/ ma dag sa bdun du bskal ba du mar gsog mi nus pa'i tshogs rgya mtsho dag pa sa gsum du skad cig skad cig la gsog par bshad pa dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyis kyang de ltar sa sde las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de la tshogs bsags pa'i tshul ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag mang po la bsnyen bkur ba ste/ /bkur tshul ni/ zhabs tog dang / zang zing nyi tshe ba tsam du ma zad kyi byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba mtha' yas pa thams 439

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/cad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bsnyen bkur ba'i mchog ni sgrub pa'i nan tan nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sbyin tshul bzod nga gsum bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi bsnyen bkur dang / bsam sher yelkesochosgoyosh+lau0sgron phokyar( brtson phohrū7 hash+lau 5 rmo73 phyok+shi/rte dang 'brel ba'i bsnyen bkur ram/ sbyin sogs phar phyin snga ma lnga bsod nams dang phyi ma ye shes tshogs kyi bsten bkur du rim bzhin 'jug pa dang mdo rgyan nas bshad pa ltar tshogs gnyis de 'dra ba'i sgo nas byang chab chen po smon lam gyi tshogs rgya mtsho'i ༄rtsal yongs su rjogs shing / thugs bskyed ji 'dra bas yongs su bzung ba ltar sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bkod pa 'byongs pa'am grub pa dang / rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya rnams smin par mdzad pa ste rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum phul du son ba'i mthar ji ltar sngon bcom ldan 'das nyid bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul du gyur pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po'i sbyan sngar sems can bskal ba ngan pa rnams kyi don du ma dag pa'i zhing khams yongs su bzung ba'i thugs bskyed dus su smin pa las 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed kyi bskal pa mar 'grib pa snyigs ma lnga bdo ba ste/srog rgud pa'i che'i snyigs ma dang / khyim pa'i dge phyogs rgud pa nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma dang / rab byung gi dge phyogs rgud pa 440

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3ṅgelta ba'i snyigs ma dang / lus rgud pa sems can gyi snyigs ma dang /longs spyod rgud pa dus kyi snyigs ma ste/ snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba'am rgyas pa mi rnams tshe lo brgya pa'i dus kyi gnas skabs su/mi mjed kyi stong chen po'i bye brag gling bzhi bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i lho gling shing dzam bu'i 'bras bu dang mtsho chen po ma dros pa'i rgyu rkyen las rin po che gser gyi khams yongs su dag pa 'byung ba'i yon tan gyi sgo nas ming du btags pa 'dzam bu'i gling zhes grags pa'i sa'i thig le/ /dbus 'gyur 'chang rdo rje gdan gyi dbus/ byang chub shing gi rtsa ba la brten te srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rangs rig pa gsum mngon du mdzad de/ slar yang gdul bya'i don du smon lam sbyangs pa mthar son pa'i stobs kyis rang nyid ji ltar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i spyod yul gyi tshul dang mthun par/rtogs don gzhan la 'doms pa'i sgo nas nyan rang byang sems te theg pa gsum gyi gdul bar bya ba'i rigs can rnam pa gsum gyi gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung ba'o/ /de'ang rtogs don gzhan la 'doms pa zhes pa ni gtso bor gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i 'khor lo dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor dang theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs can gyi gdul bya dbang 441

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnon rjes su gzung ba'i phyir 'khor lo bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ theg chen thun min gyi gdul bya dbang rtul rjes su bzung ba'i phyir 'khor lo tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor te 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor ba nyid yin la/ de dag chos 'khor du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan dang 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag) mtha' choja par 'i mdzoja jang sa sde la sogs pa las zhib tu shes par bya'i/ /'grel chung gi yig byang nyi tshe'i loganu/ su 'god pa skabs su ma bab pa nyid do/ /de ltar ston pas chos 'khor bskor zhing rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa zhig rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan zhing byang chub la bkod de/spyir byang chub la theg pa gsum gyi dbye bas zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes kyi rigs gsum yod par mdzod nas bshad kyang skabs 'dir bstan ni byang chub chen po yin par mngon no/ /rgyal sras lung bstan pa der yang ma zad bstan pa'i rgyun rjes 'jug phyi ma rnams kyi don du gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams la chos kyi mdzod gnyer du gtad cing /khyad par du theg pa chen po'i sde snod rnams byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang / 'jam dpal dang byams pa gsum la bka'i bsdu ba mdzad par gsung gis bsgos/ rgyal tshab shing rta'i 442

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3srol 'byed gnyis la sogs pa 'byung 'gyur du lung yang bstan to/ /de'ang bshad ma thag pa'i theg chen gyi sde snod gtad tshul de nyid sgras zin du byung ba ni/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug sems dpa' mched gnyis la/ bstan pa gtad nas zhes pa'o/ /'phags pa kun tu bzang po yang theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rnams kyi bka'i bsdu ba por rtog ge 'bar ba nas bshad mod kyi 'dir ni shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lhag pa'i lha'i nges bzung gi dbang du mdzad par snang ngo //ston pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs shing mya ngan las 'da' ba chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i 'og tu sras kyi thu bo zhes pa rgya cher rol pa las/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs rgyun mi gcod pa byang chub sems kyi gter dang zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi dngos rgyu'i gtso bo byang chub kyi sems rin po che gang la mnga' ba'i byang sems rnams kho na sangs rgyas kyi sras yin gyi nyan rang rnams ni de lta ma yin no zhes dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mya ngan med kyi byin pas zhus par dpe dang bcas te gsungs la/ de dag gi yang tha bor gyar pa ni dpa' bar 'gro no༅ ra :treba'i ting nge 'dzin dang 'od zer chen po ri dbang bskur ba/sangs rgyas kyi sku'i kha dog mtha' yas pa sgrub pa'i gzungs sogs byang chub sems dpa'i gsang ba mtha' dag gi pha rol tu phyin pa 443

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnams te/ de lta bu'i che ba'i bdag nyid mtshungs pa med pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu yis ni/ /rnga bo che dang sprin chen po'i mdo la sogs par rgyal bas 'byung bar lung bstan pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs dang / rgyal sras mtshungs med slob dpon zhi ba lha rjes su bzung ste gtso bor zab mo lta ba'i lam srol snang bar mdzad cing sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab chen po ma pham pas ni slob dpon shing rta chen po thogs med rjes su bzung ste byams pa'i chos sde lnga zhes rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs rtsal du 'don pa mdo sde rgyan dang 'byed gnyis/ dbu ma'i lta ba ston pa mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla ma rnams bshad pa yin no/ /de slad brgyud pa'i bka' srol gsum du 'dod pa yin te zab mo lta ba dang rgya chen spyod pa'i srol dang zab cing rgya che zung 'brel gyi srol rnam pa gsum po go rim gyi nges pa ltar lta ba dbu ma rang bzhin med pa'i de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i tshul gtso bor bstan pa dang / rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya che ba phar phyin drug gi phyogs gtso bor bstan pa dang /sa bcu lam lngas bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs drod tshad kyi rim pa gtso bo ru bstan pa ste srol gsum po'i rnam bzhag slob dpon gsum so so'i rang rang gzhung gis ston phyir de ltar ro/ /de'ang srol dang po las rgya che ba'i spyod phyogs mi ston pa'ang ma yin te /444

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3rin chen phreng ba las spyod phyogs bstan pa dang mdo sde kun las btus su theg pa chen po'i lam gyi lus rgya cher bstan pa bzhin no/ /srol gnyis ka zab mo'i lta ba mi ston pa'ang min te/ bslab btus dang spyod 'jug tu/ thal 'gyur ba'i lugs ji lta ba bzhin gyi zab mo'i tshul bstan pa bzhin no/ /srol gsum pa las kyang phyogs de gnyis ka rgya cher bstan mod kyi 'dir ni gtso bor bstan tshal las yin la 'di'i srol gsam dang shing rta'i srol 'byed don rigang rig ༅mi gcig ste/ shing rta'i srol 'byed ni zab mo dbu ma'i srol 'byed 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa'i srol 'byed slob dpon thogs med gnyis gang rung dgos pa'i phyir te rgyu mtshan dang mtha' dpyod rgyas par gzhan nas shes par bya'o/ /de ltar brgyud srol tshul gsum gyi man ngag rnam dag bdud rtsi'i chu klung ltar skye dgu rnams kyi nyer 'tshor gyur pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i smon lam gyi rgya mtsho las byung zhing rgya bod mkhas grub stong gi 'babs stegs las legs par 'ongs pa nyid gang gi thugs yid bzhin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i mkhyen rab kyi bum pa bzang bor legs par bskyil nas skal bzang 'gro ba rnams la stsol mkhas shing /gangs can gyi ljongs su tshul gnyis shing rta'i lam srol nyi ma dang zla ba ltar snang bar mdzadapa'i bka' drin bla na ma mchis pa'i 445

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /bdag nyid chen por gyur pa ni rgyal ba'i sras bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bdag por thub pas lung bstan pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rje dri med 'od zer zhabs yin no/ /kun mkhyen chos rje lung bstan pa'i rgyud sde'i khangs ni 'dren pa yod mod kyi 'dir skabs sa ma riri kya ri riXbabs la/ nges don shing rta chen mo'i 'jug tu/ rnga sgra'i dbyangs bzhin 'jigs med gsung gi rjes 'gro bas/ /ri rab mar me'i rgyal mtshan rgyal ba de 'gyur zhes/ /dbugs chen 'byin pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dbu stod zhwa'i lha khang du de bzhin gshegs pa dang rgyal tshab ma pham pa las byang chub tu lung bstan thob pa la byas na bde'am snyam mo/ /de dag las ring brgyud snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa dang nye brgyud 'phags pa thogs med kyis 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa dang mgon po klus dpal ldan rgyal ba'i myu gu mkhyen brtse'i lha rjes su bzung zhing rgyal ba klong chen zhabs kyis kyang gter chen gnyis ka la dgongs pa'i gtad rgya mdzad de byin rgyud kyi pha phogs thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gter chen rnam pa gnyis po nas mkhan chen chos dpal rgya mtsho dang / rje btsun lag na rdo rje la sogs pa las rim par brgyud de ngos cag gi dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byung ba'o//446

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3spyi don gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis las/dang po/ gnyis pa byang chub sems kyi phan yon ni rgyas par dbye na mu mtha' tshad med cing rnam grangs bgrangs ba las 'das pa zhig ste/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dang chos 'dzin dang / /chos sgrub pa dang srog chags snying brtse ba/ /chos bzhi 'di dag yon tan mtha' med de/ /de dag mtha' ni rgyal bas mi gsungs so/ /zhes so/ /de lta na'ang mdor bsdu na rnam pa lnga yin te/ ming don gnas 'gyur ba/ mi dge ba'i gnyen po byed pa/ dge 'bras gong du 'phel ba/ ngan song gi sgo 'phar gcod pa/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa ste lnga'o/ /gnyis pa la sa bcad lnga las/ dang po ming don gnas 'gyur ni/ gang zag 'khor ba'i sems can zhig yin kyang byang chub kyi sems 'di la brten nas rgyal ba'i sras po zhes ming gi cod paṇa thob pa ste/ rgyal ba'i sras ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams yin la/ de ni byang chub kyi sems kho nas phye ba'i phyir ro/ /ming gi grags pa tsam du ma zad don du yon tan gyis mtho ba'ang yin te/ skye shi zo chan gyi khyad mo ltar brgyud cing / 'khor ba'i nor ra 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal chen po'i btson rar nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bas bcing zhing / bdag lta'i btson srung gis bsrungs 447

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i nyam thag btson bu 'dra ba de so so'i skye bo'i gnas skabs ma btang bzhin du byang chub kyi sems skyes pa'i mod la skad cig gcig gi bye brag gis 'jig rten lhar bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi phyag gi yul du 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ lha dang drang srong rnams kyang rung / /tshangs pa la'ang 'di yod dam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'jig rten thams cad las bsod nams kyi gzi brjid chen pos mngon par 'phags pa'i phyir te/ bsod nams 'phel tshul 'og tu ston to/ /gnyis pa mi dge'i gnyen po byed pa ni/ mdzod las/ de'ang nges dang ma nges dang / /zhes sogs kyi skabs nas rgya cher 'byung ba ltar/ sdig pa la myong bar nges pa dang ma nges pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mthong chos tshe 'di la myong 'gyur dang / skyes nas myong 'gyur dang / lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur ste gsum yod cing de gsum gyi khyad par yang bye mdo'i lugs mi 'dra ba dang / phyi ma la gnas skabs dang rnam smin gyi sgo nas mu bzhi brtsi mi brtsi'i dgag bzhag sogs yod de/mdor na nges ma nges ni myong nges yin min gyi steng nas dbye'o/ /de dag las nges pa'i sdig pa rnams byang chub sems 'dis zil gyis gnon pa ste/ sems de ma brjed kyi bar du ngan 'gror dbang med du mi mchi ba'i don yin gyi sems bskyed skyes myong yin 448

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3pa tsam la khyab pa med de rgyal ba'i blo gros bzhin no/ /ma nges pa'i sdig ltung nges pa'i sdig ltung la ltos nas phra mo zhes brjod du rung ba rnams ni sems 'di'i mthus drungs nas 'byin pa ste/ de dag gi dper go rim bzhin du/ skar ma'i tshogs la nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor chen pos reg pa dang / rtswa sbur phra ba la dus mtha'i me 'bar ba bzhin no/ /sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang / /sogs rkang pa drug po'i don bla ma 'ga' zhig byang sems stobs che chung gi sgo nas 'chad kyang 'dir phyogs gzhan nas 'grel ba'i lugs so/ /gsum pa la/ smon sems kyi phan yon dang 'jug sems kyi phan yon bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni 'og nas 'chad pa'i smon pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas ma nyams pa de srid du bsod nams dge ba'i 'bras bu 'phel stobs che ba bza' shing gi sdong po bzhin no/ /de'ang 'di ni smon sems skyes zin gyi yon tan yin mod kyi/ bskyed ces brjod pa mi 'gal te myu gu smin pa la 'di sa bon gyis bskyed do zhes brjod du rung ba bzhin te gzhan yang dpe mang du sbyor rgyu yod do/ /dge 'bras 'phel zhes pa'i 'bras bu ci 'dra ba zhig yin zhe na/rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob bar du lha dang mi la sogs pa mngon mtho'i 'bras bzang dang / mthar thug bsod nams pha mtha' 449

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yas pa'i bdag nyid can/ rgyal ba stobs bcu'i dbang phyug tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bsod nams mtha' yas pa'i tshul ni rgya cher dkon mchog sprin la sogs par blta'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jug pa sems bskyed las ni bsod nams dam pa'i rgyu dge ba'i nus pa nyid gong du 'phel ba ste/bsod nams dam pa'i rgyu zhes pa ni bde ba'i rgyu dge ba zhes pa lta bu min gyi shing gi ka ba zhes pa lta bu ste bsod nams dam pa'ang yin la rnam smin yid 'ong gi dngos po 'byin pa'i rgyu nyid kyang yin pa'o/ /de ltar 'jug sems sam rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtshos zin pa'i sems bskyed thob la ma nyams pa'i sems dpa' chen po de smyo 'bog dang ra ro ba la sogs pa'i dbang gis bag med pa'am gnyid logs su gyar kyang rung ste tshogs gnyis kyi mtha 15tā rig ji //shes ris mishugs gong du 'a la bas ba na ldan byang chub mas dpa' gzhan las ches lhag pa kho na'o/ /brtson ldan gzhan ni smon sems tsam rgyud ldan gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams te sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las 'jug sems kyi spyod pas ma bsdus pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po'i spyod pa bstan pa lta bu'i nan tan gyi brtson pa de tsam zhig bskyed pas ni 'jug sems rgyud ldan du 'gyur mi dgos so/ /bzhi pa ni/ bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi 450

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3sems dang ldan pa'i rgyal ba'i sras des mi dge ba'i rnam smin ngan 'gror 'phen pa'i kun slong sdig pa'i rgyun mtha' dag sems bskyed la brten nas ma skyes pa mi skye ba dang / skyes zin gyi nus pa nyams smad cing gcod pa'i phyir bde ba nas bde ba'i lam du 'gro yang gnas skabs su dge ba'i dran pa nyams pa dang sems zag pa las mi bsrung ba'i bag med kyi dbang du gyur phyir ngan song gi gnas ngan len du gtan mi mchi ba yin no/ /de lta na yang lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen 'ga' zhig la brten nas ring por mi thogs par byang chub sems kyi rigs kyi nus pa sad de thar ba ra 'gyur ba ni ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mo dang gyad pag shi ta'i rnam par thar pa bzhin no/ /lnga pa ni/ sngar byon pa dang / da lta 'jig rten gyi sgron mar bzhugs pa dang ma 'ongs pa na 'byung 'gyur gyi rgyal ba kun dang rgyal ba'i sras po mtha' yas pa kun gang la brten nas bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi sa mthor 'gro ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam chen po ni byang chab kyi sems 'di yin te/rig me rari midang po pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rnam thar rgya mtsho yongs su 'dren pa dang / bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi dge ba'i tshogs sdud pa la mi skyo ba'i go cha dang / tha ma sangs rgyas nas sems can sman pa dang grol bar mdzad pa'i phrin las kyi 'jug pa 451

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyun mi 'chad pa'i thabs dang gnas dang rten chen por gyur ba'i phyir te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang ba'i bdag po thams cad ma.o pa'i ye shes de ni snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba can byang chub sems kyi rgyu las byung ba thabs kyis mthar phyin pa yin no/ /zhes gsangs pa'i snying rje chen po ni kun rdzob byang chab kyi sems sa rib bye riri sgro ri brgyaslob dpon kā ma la shi las bshad pa bzhin no/ /byang chub kyi sems yod na sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rgyu tshogs su 'gyur zhing /med kyang byang chub chen po gtan mi 'grub pa min no zhe na/ de ltar yang ma yin te/ lam mchog 'di dang bral ba la ni kun mkhyen 'grub pa'i gnas med pa'i phyir te byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas sgrub pa ni sems can kho na'i phyir yin gyi rang nyid srid pa'i ra ba las 'da' ba tsam gyi phyir ni rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang thabs mkhas kyi sgo 'phar tshad med pa phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du slob pa mi 'ong ba'i phyir/ brgya'i grangs slob pa'i phyir stong gsum gyi rdul brtsi ba bzhin te/ gzhan du na snying rje chen po kho nas gzhan phan bla na med pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i bdag po'i rkyen thams cad ma.o pa kho nar tshad mas drang ba'i nges shes kyis byang chub don du gnyer ba 'ba' zhig go/ /rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos spyod 'jug gi/ srid 452

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag gzhom 'dod cing sogs la rjes 'gro yod cing ldog khyab med par gsungs pa ni re zhig gsung ba tsam mo//des na mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang / /zhes pa ltar gyi rang bzhin gnas rigs rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi de kho na nyid du 'gyur rung bde gshegs snying po'i khams de nyid byang chub sems kyi rgyas 'gyur dang 'grogs pas chu lud drod gsher 'dzom pa'i sa bon grung po bzhin du gong du 'phel zhing rgyal ba'i yon tan gyi 'byor pa rgya chen po'i lo tog phun sum tshogs par 'gyar ba yin no/ /༄gsum pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che de'i ngo bo gang zhe na/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir//yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/zur gnyis dang ldan pa ste/ shes rab kyi stobs kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa dang / snying rje'i mthu yis mtha' yas pa'i 'gro khams la dmigs pa dang gnyis so/ /de gnyis ji ltar ldan na sems can thams cad la yid 'ong gi rnam pa ma gcig pus bu ltar shugs drag pa dang / de dag thams cad kyi sdug bsngal la mi bzod pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems gnyis po stobs su gyur pa las gzhan phan don gnyer la bcos min gyi myong ba thon 453

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag gi snying rje chen po thog mar 'byung la/snying rje chen po ni bod kyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig 'bral 'dod dang skyabs 'dod kyi sgo nas gnyis su dbye bar mdzad mod kyi/ nyan rang dang thun mong ba'i snying rje chen po 'bral 'dod kyi rnam pa tsam bzhed pa ni ma yin te/ bsod nams thams cad sdud pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdor/ snying rje yin la snying rje chen po ma yin pa gang zhe na nyan rang gi rgyud kyi snying rje lta bu'o/ /zhes shin tu gsal bar bshad cing sgrub byed gzhan yang mang du yod do/ /de ltar snying rje chen po skyes nas kyang 'gro ba ma lus pa byang chub dam pa'i go 'phang du bkri ba'i nus pa de su zhig la mnga' snyam du dpyad pa na/ spel mar bstod pa las/ gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba yi/ /mtsho'i nang na rnam par gnas/ /'dod chags la sogs mi bzad pa'i/ /cha srin gyis ni lus zos pas/ /de ring ༄gang la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du/ gang zhig la ni nyes pa kun/ /gtan du yong ye mi mnga' zhing / /gang la rnams pa thams cad du/ /yon tan thams cad gnas gyur pa/ /de nyid la ni skyabs 'gro zhing / /zhes sogs bshad pa lta bu'i skyabs kyi gnas bla na med pa ni/ rnam 'grel las/ brtse ldan sdug bsngal gzhom bya'i phyir/ /thabs rnams la ni mngon sbyor mdzad/ /thabs 454

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3byung de rgyu lkog gyur pa/ /de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa kho nar yid ches shing /de'ang rgyu med pa las skye na ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sangs rgyas sgrub pa don med par 'gyur ba zhig na/ byang chub spyod pa'i rgyu rkyen las 'byung du yod par rtogs nas gzhan yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi yid kyi rnam shes zhig go/ /blo la gtso sems dang sems byung gnyis dang de re re la'ang dbang shes dang yid shes kyis phye bas rnam grangs mang na'ang skabs 'dir bstan ni dper na mdzod las ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa gnyis sogs dge ba bcu gcig po yin kyang mtshungs ldan dang kun slong gi dge ba gzhan yang yod par bshad pa ltar byang chub kyi sems zhes pa'i sgra 'jug yul dngos ni sems dang yid dang rnam shes gsam po gtso sems kyi ming yin zhing /༄dbang shes la 'di 'dra'i sems spyir btang du med pas yid shes kyi nang tshan gtso sems de yin mod/ 'on kyang mtshungs ldan 'dun pa sogs la'ang de 'dra'i tha snyad byas pa mi 'gal ba dang der ma zad ngo bo tsam bzhag pa la mtshan nyid kyi zur chod pa dgos kyang mi dgos so/ /sems bskyed de la dbye na kun rdzob 455

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang don dam sems bskyed gnyis yod cing de las kyang mtshan nyid pa kun rdzob sems bskyed yin la/ de ni smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid de 'di dag gi ngo bo tsam brjod na/ 'phags pa zhi ba lhas/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi phung pos zin pa dang ma zin pa'i khyad par las dbye'o/ /de'ang zin byed byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang zin mkhan gang zag sogs nas mi dbye'i/ /bshad ma thag pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid nyams len gyi bya bas zin ma zin gyis 'jog go/ /chos kyi rgyal po klong chen pas 'bras bu la dam bca' ba smon sems dang / rgyu la dam bca' bas zin pa 'jug sems su bzhed pa'ang de 'dra'i don yin gyi/ rdzogs byang don gnyer rkyang ba dang spyod pa la slob 'dod rkyang ba tsam min no/ /'on kyang da lta yongs su grags pa'i smon 'jug gi 'jog tshul dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad yod de/ smon sems dang byang chub kyi sems don gcig de dang 'jug pa sems bskyed la shing dang pa la sha lta bu'i khyad yod pa kun mkhyen gyi bzhed par snang ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ byang chub smon pa'i sems las 456

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3ni sogs smon 'jug gnyis la phan yon gyi khyad par bshad pa mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ sems bskyed kyi dbye ba de gnyis spyi dang bye brag tsam yin na smon sems la bsod nams rgyun chags su mi 'byung ba dang 'jug sems la 'byung ba'i rnam dbye mi 'ong ba'i phyir te/ de dag la gzhi mthan yod pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de ༄dper na sdug bsngal chos shes kyi skabs su yang sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos nyid la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa yod mod kyi/ de ni sngar chos bzod kyi skabs nas thob zin pa'i phyir khyad chos gzhan nas brjod pa dang sems can chos dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje gsum sems can la dmigs par khyad med kyang phyi ma gnyis la khyad par gzhan gyi sgo nas ming btags pa ltar smon sems rkyang pa dang 'jug sems gnyis smon sems yin pa la khyad med kyang spyod 'jug gi lung don ni smon sems tsam min pa'i khyad chos lhag po med pas rang ming gis smos pa snga ma dang / khyad par gzhan las smos pa phyi mar 'jog chog pa'i phyir/ smon sems rkyang pa dang smon sems spyi khyab pa la khyad par chen po yod do/ /'gro 'dod dang 'gro ba dngos kyi dpe'i steng nas smon 'jug gi khyad par phye lugs gang yin zhe na/ 'di'i skabs kyi 'gro ba ni 'gro ba'i dus kyi lus kyi rnam rig de la mi bya'i 'gro bzhin pa'i sems kyi 'gro 457

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'dod de la bya dgos so/ /de la 'gro 'dod dang 'gro bzhin pa'i 'gro 'dod gnyis spyi bye brag gi khyad yod pa dang / 'gro 'dod tsam la khyad med pa dang 'gro bzhin pa'i 'gro 'dod yin min yang gom pa bsgyur ba tsam gyis mi chog gi skabs der 'gro sa gang la ltos nas skabs de'i 'gro 'dod du 'jog pa'i yul de nyid du 'gro ba'i bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa zhig gis zin ma zin nas 'jog dgos pa de bzhin du smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed gnyis la spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par yod pa dang / byang chub kyi sems de nyid bsod nams kyi bya ba cung zad res zin pa tsam nas 'jug sems su mi 'jog gi byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rnam dag gis zin pa'i mtshams nas 'jog pa sogs dpe don gyi khyad par mang po zhig yod do/ /des ni kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi ngo bo'i sgo nas rnam par dbye ba byas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sems bskyed de la byang chub kyi sems zhes brjod pa'i nges tshig gang zhe na/ 'di ni lhas byin gyi ba lang ltar byang chub kyis bdag tu bzung ba'i sems dang shing gi ka ba ltar byang chub las byas pa'i sems dang / nas kyi myu gu ltar byang chub las byung ba'i sems sogs sgra'i sdud lugs de ltar min gyi zas don du gnyer ba la zas kyi 'dun pa zer ba bzhin byang chub don 458

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3du gnyer ba'i sems la byang chub kyi sems zhes brjod do/ /byang chub la theg pa gsum gyis dbye bas zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes kyi rigs gsum du yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin te mdo sde las kyang srog chags sum khri nyis stong ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de'ang rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'dun pa bcos ma tsam ma yin par/yon tan rin po cher/ gang la rang don sems pa yod ma yin/ /bkres pa zas dang skom pa chur gdung bzhin/ /sems can 'ba' zhig don du rnam mkhyen gyi/ /go 'phang gnyer la byang chub sems zhes grags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ /snying rje chen po dang /rdzogs byang thob 'dod la bcos min gyi myong ba thon pa'i sgo nas byang chab chen po'i yon tan yongs sa rdzogs pa'i phyir spyod pa bya risi rgyu rig ༅dka' ba'i gnas dang dus bskal pa mang po'i yun dang / gdul bya 'gro ba'i khams mang po'i mtha' sogs la brten nas zhum pa dang sgyid lugs pa sogs ma yin par sa ltar mi skyo ba'i sems stobs kyi go cha mchog tu bgos pa'i rnam can gyi rigs gnas yin pa'i phyir sems kyi nang nas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis sgrub pa la dpa' bo'am brtul phod pa dang 'di dang mtshungs pa srid na 459

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhegazhan med do zhes sbrel lo/ /lnga pa ni/ sems bskyed de'i dbye ba'i gnas la spyir bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod na'ang skabs 'dir dbye sgo bdun du bshad de/ gcig tu stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab snying rje'i snying po khyad par ba can dang / gnyis su bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas sam btags pa tsam du na kun rdzob dang don dam ste bden gnyis kyi dang / ngo bo'i sgo nas smon sems dang 'jug sems/ gsum du lhag pa tshul khrims ting nge 'dzin shes rab kyi bslab pa rnams dang 'brel ba'i de dang / bzhi ru theg chen tshogs sbyor gyi lam dang ma dag sa bdun dag pa sa gsum sangs rgyas kyis rnams na go rim bzhin du/ mos pas spyod pa dang / lhag bsam rnam dag dang / rnam par smin pa dang /thugs rje chen po sgrib kun spang ba zhes bya ba'i sems bskyed bzhi'o //lnga ru theg chen gyi lam lnga la las dang po pa'i sems bskyed dang /gzhan yang de'i lhag ma ni yongs su sbyang ba byas pa dang chos mthong ba dang / rnam par grol ba dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi sems bskyed de lnga bo go rim bzhin du sbyar ro/ /drug tu sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol phyin drug gis zin pa la ltos nas zin rgyu'i sems bskyed kyang drug tu gtso bor ldog cha'i steng nas 'jog go/ /460

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3dbye sgo bdun pa ni/ sa mtshams dbye ba nyi shu rtsa gnyis rnams te re re'ang dpe grogs chos mthun gyi rnam bzhag gsum gsum mo/ /de dag gi ming tsam brjod na yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i phyir byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed sa lta bu/ de bzhin du sbyar te bsam pa 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir gser lta bu/ lhag bsam la brten nas yon tan gong 'phel du byed pa'i phyir zla ba tshes pa lta bu/ sbyor ba khyad par du 'gro ba'i phyir bud shing chen po'i me lta bu/ de dag dang 'chad 'gyur kun la mtshungs ldan zhes 'gro zhing / sbyin pa mi zad pa'i phyir gter lta bu/ tshul khrims yon tan gyi gnas yin pa'i phyir rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu/ bzod pa mi 'khrugs pa'i phyir mtsho lta bu/brtson 'grus mi shigs pa'i phyir rdo rje lta bu/ bsam gtan mi g.yo ba'i phyir ri lta ba/ shes rab kyis sdug bsngal zhi ba'i phyir ༄sman lta bu/ thabs mkhas phan pa sgrub pa'i phyir bshes gnyen lta bu/smon lam gyis don thams cad sgrub pa'i phyir nor bu lta bu/stobs gdul bya'i rgyud la dge tshogs bskyed pa'i phyir nyi ma lta bu/ye shes chos ston pa'i phyir glu dbyangs lta bu/ mngon shes mthu che ba'i phyir rgyal po lta bu/ tshogs gnyis tshad med pa'i phyir mdzod khang lta bu/ byang chub phyogs chos 'phags pa rnams kyi shul yin 461

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ pa'i phyir lam po che lta bu/ zhi lhag mtha' gnyis su mi gol ba'i phyir bzhon pa bzang po lta bu/ gzungs spobs tshig don mi zad par 'dzin cing ston pa'i phyir bkod ma'i cha bo lta ba/ chos kyi raX ༄4dga' ston kun yid 'dun par byed pa'i phyir sgra snyan lta bu/bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam rnam mkhyen gyi rgya mtshor ngang gis 'bab pa'i phyir chu bo lta bu/ chos sku rnam par 'phrul ba'i char 'bebs pa'i phyir sprin lta bu ste/ de dag las gsum dang gcig dang bcu dang / lnga dang / gsum rnams go rim bzhin du/ tshogs lam/sbyor lam/ sa bcu/ dag sa/ sa bcu pa rnams dang rim pa bzhin sbyar ro/ /drug pa ni/ sems bskyed dang de'i sdom pa len tshul gang ltar yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen las blang ba dang / rang gis mos pa'i stobs kyis sras bcas rgyal ba rnams bsgom pa'i spyan sngar blang ba dang / tshul des rten gyi drung du blang ba rnams tshad ldan gyi gzhung las gsungs so/ /cho ga dngos la/ shing rta chen po gnyis kyi srol tha dad pa'i sgo nas sems tsam lugs dang dbu ma lugs kyi byang sdom len lugs rten dang rnam pa mi 'dra ba du ma zhig bzhed pa snga rabs pa'i dgongs pa dang / de ltar mi bzhed pa phyis kyi mkhas pa chen po rnams kyi dgongs par song ba las 462

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3gzhung 'dir snga ma'i lugs bskyar ba yin pas phyogs de la ni dang po sngon 'gro/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum mo/ /de la sngon 'gro ni/ khyad par rnam pa bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ dang po len yul dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par can tshul khrims la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la mkhas pa sogs skyes bu chen po'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa de la maṇ+ḍal phul zhing byang chab sems dpa'i sdom pa nod pa'i don du ༄gsol ba shugs drag tu gdab/ khyad par gnyis pa blo sbyong gi gdams ngag khyad par can sdug kun gyi nyes dmigs la bsams te srid mthar skyo ba bskyed/ ma rgan sems can rnams la drin du gzo ba'i bsam pas zhi mthar zhen pa dgag byang chub chen po'i yon tan la bsam ste mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i lam la bsngags pa brjod pa rnams bya'o/ /khyad par gsum pa sdom pa skye ba'i rgyu tshogs kyi nang tshan tshogs bsags pa'i thabs las sam sbyor ba khyad par can phyag dang mchod pa sogs yan lag rnam pa bdun gyis dge ba'i tshogs rgya chen du bsags/ khyad par bzhi pa/ sdom pa'i rtsa ba rten mchog khyad par can yul dkon mchog gsum dang dus mtshams byang chub kyi snying po'i bar dang gang gi ched yin pa'am khyad du bya ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub ste thun min theg chen 463

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i khyad par gsum ldan gyi skyabs 'gros gzhi 'ding ba'i phyir skyabs 'gro'i tshig kyang lan gsum du bya bar bzhed de de ltar sa bzung ngo / /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la dgongs su gsol ba gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas smon dang 'jug pa gnyis stabs gcig tu blang bar gsungs te smon pa'i sems bskyed len tshul la gzhan don du rdzogs byang don gnyer tsam cho ga la mi ltos kyang de nyid rtag tu mi nyams par bya ba'i dam bca'i lcags kyu gnyis pas zin pa la cho ga dgos par phul byang zhabs kyis bshad pas de 'dra la dgongs ri'i zurang charang zurang zi snasam snyam yang snga rabs pa' lugs bskyar ba la da 'dra' spras pa ma byas kyang rung ngo / /gsum pa mjug tu rgyal ba'i sras kyi bslab bya la spro shugs cher bskyed de rang dga' ba sgom pa dang / lha dang lha min sogs la go bar bya ba'i tshig gis gzhan dga' ba sgom du gzhug pa/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la btang rag 'bul ba sogs bya'o/ /blang yul tshad ldan med na mos pa'i shugs kyis rang gis blang tshul ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thogs med kyi mkhyen rab dang ldan zhing thugs rje chen pos mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba la rtag tu dgongs pa rnams yul du byas la dus der yan lag bdun gyi tshogs bsags bya bas mdun bsus ste/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin 464

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3gshegs pa rnams kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang sems can sdug bsngal gyi chu bo las ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang / kun 'byung gi 'ching ba las ma grol ba dgrol ba dang / 'phags pa'i lam gyis dbugs ma phyang ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / zhi 'gyar yang dag pa'i riri bye ///du riri shimatha' la ngas su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las bzla'o zhes lan gsum brjod de sdom pa blang / de'ang mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis/ thob mtshams brjod pa gsum gyi tha la'o/ /zhes gsungs/ mjug tu rang gzhan dga' ba sgom zhing sgom du gzhug pa dang smon lam gdab pa rnams bya'o/ /rgyas par na byang sdom len pa'i tshul la bshad bya ches mang mod de 'dir smos kyis mi ldang la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa len 'dod pa rnams kyis ni ma mtha' 'ang sdom pa nyi shu pa tsam la bslab gnyer spus dag re mi byed du mi rung bas yig ldeb gsum gyis gzhung lugs mtha' dag gi gting sleb par 'a dod pa rnams blun po'i rang rtags yin no/ /bdun pa la/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi bslab bya bshad pa la ji ltar srung ba'i thabs dang / gang bsrung rgyu'i bsrung bya ste gnyis yod do/ /zhes 465

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad nas/ gnyis pa la srang thabs dang bsrang bya gnyis las/1(do ༷te/ /khro// nor /nges rtse(rdodang la dran sa dgos pa rgyu mtshan dang / da sa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bslab pa srung ba'i thabs kyi gtso bo dran pa dang shes bzhin gnyis yin la/ thabs 'di dag med par bslab pa srung bar 'dod nas byang sems gyi sdom pa len pa de ni go mtshon med pa'i dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug pa dang 'dra ste dran pa mngon du ma bzhag cing spong sgrub kyi gnas la yang dang yang du kha nang du log ste rnam par ma brtag na sems kyi 'dzin stangs ni goms pa'i shugs la rag las shing 'o skol gang la goms pa'i phyogs ni nyes spyod chen po'i las lam yin pa'i phyir/ bag med la sogs pa kha na ma tho ba'i tshogs kyis rang rgyud kyi bslab pa 'dral zhing de ltar dral na blo gros rgya mtshos zhus par/ byang chub sems dpa' de ltar dam bcas nas ji skad smras pa bzhin du mi byed na lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad bslus pa yin no zhes gsungs shing / de ltar bslus na spyod 'jug las/ bla na med pa'i bde ba la/ /bsam pa thag pas mgron gnyer nas/ /'gro ba thams cad bslus byas na/ /bde 'gror ji ga 'gro 'gyur ram/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar rang srog brlag par zad pa'i phyir ro/ /des ni ldog pa dngos su bstan 466

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3nas rjes 'gro shugs la bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ dran shes gnyis kyi dang po dran pa gang zhe na/ thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba gang gi tshe yang rung ste mngon par 'dod pa'i don dang de sgrub pa'i thabs rnams mi brjed par rang gi rgyud dang lhan gyis 'dres par bya zhing / khyad par du skabs don 'dir bshad bya rgyal ba'i sras kyi bslab bya'i gnas sdom sdud don byed kyi tshul khrims dag par bya ba'i sgo kun la blo phyin ci log tu ma song bar legs par bslabs te mi brjed par bya'o/ /mi brjed pa de'ang yul de la 'dris tshabs che ba nyid las 'byung zhing der ma zad thos don dran pas bzung ba'i snying po'ang lhag bsam bskul ba las/ de lta bas na smra la dga' spang ste/ /rtag tu bag yod byos la don soms shig /ces pa ltar/ don bzhin rgyud thog tu sbyor ba nyid yin pas dran pa skye ba dang dran pa'i don po gnyis kar spang blang gi gnas rnams yang nas yang du bsngo bgrang bya zhing dran dgos so/ /gnyis pa shes bzhin ni/ spyod lam thams cad dang dus rnam pa kun tu bdag gis rigs pa ci ltar bya/ mi rigs pa ji ltar spong / da lta bdag gi sems 'di dge'am dge ba min pa'i gnas skabs su gyur/ bdag rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa las ma nyams sam zhes yang dang yang du rtog cing rang rgyud la bya ra ste 467

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mel tshe bya ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ /lus dang sems kyi gnas skabs la/ /yang dang yang du brtag bya ba/ /'di nyid kho na mdor na ni/ /shes bzhin bsrung ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ bstan bshad gnyis las/ dang po/ gang bsrung bya tshul khrims kyi rnam bzhag de la'ang / sdom sdud don byed rnam pa gsum yod de/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad ni bdag dang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa'i thabs gnyis su 'du la/ de las dang po la nyes spyod spang ba dang / dge tshogs sdud pa gnyis su ma 'dus pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/sdom sdud don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum las/ dang po nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/ rtsa ltung las bsrang tshul dang / de'i rwa/de/ 1)was /lnga nge //re/yan lag dbang du byas pa dag go/ / la rtsa ltung ga ga ba /bco brgyad du dbye ba rnams rim pa bzhin du/ gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo yi rjes su 'brangs te rnam/ par bshad do zhes spyir smos nas/ bye brag tu bshad pa la/ dang po gcig pa ni smon sems mi gtong ba'i gzhi las bsrung bya'i gtso bor bzhag pa ste/ 'di ltar mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dam pa nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir bdag 468

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3gis dus rtag tu dge tshogs rgya chen po sgrub cing mi dge ba mtha' dag spong ngo snyam pa 'di nyid dam pa gsum dang 'brel bar yid la bya zhing / lag len gyi sgo nas kyang dge tshogs gang 'grub sgrub pa ste sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo lung bslab btus su drang ba bzhin no/ /de'ang smon 'jug la gzhi mthun med na 'jug sdom blang ba'i 'og tu smon sems mi gtong ba bsrung byar bzhed par mi rigs kyang gong du smos pa lta bu'i phyogs bzung bar snang ngo / /'on kyang de la ni dge tshogs sgrub pa dang mi dge ba spong ba'i phyir brtson 'grus brtsam pa nyi tshe ba tsam zhig gis mi chog pas byang chab sems dpa'i tshul khrims yongs su rdzogs pa la ༄tshul bzhin du slob pa'i smon sems dgos so/ /las gzhan yod min zhes pa 'jug sdom ma blang ba'i dbang du mdzad nas gong du smos pa de tsam zhig gis chog go zhes bshad rgyur snang bas dngos bstan de ltar yin yang bshad ma thag pa'i rgyu mtshan nyid kyis don la khyab pa med do/ /byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba 'di ni rgyal ba'i sras kyi nyams len mtha' dag gi don po mchog tu bya ba/sdom sdud don byed kyi bslab pa kun gyi rtsa ba'i gzhi'am sdom gcig tu gyur pa ste/ shes sla/ gnad zab/ don 'dus/ phul du byung ba nyid yin pa'i phyir mtshungs bral drin chen bla ma'i man ngag las 469

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyang don 'di kho na rtsal du bton pa ste gtso bor mdzad nas gsungs so/ /gnyis pa'i phyogs la ser sna dang / 'dod chags dang / khong khro ba dang / gti mug gi kun slong bzhis kun nas bslangs te rim pa bzhin du/ sdug bsngal ba dang mgon med du gyur pa rnams la chos mi ster ba dang / rnyed bkur la chags pas bdag nyid bstod cing gzhan la smod pa dang / pha rol po la sems 'khrugs te brdeg btsog byed pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang mgon med du gyur pa rnams la chos mi ster ba dang / rnyed bkur la chags pas bdag nyid bstod cing gzhan la smod pa dang / pha rol po la sems 'khrugs te brdeg btsog byed pa dang / shad sbyang tshul mthan byas kyang len par mi byed pa/ yang dag pa'i riri pho /rdo sku ///dedam chos spongs shing chos na chos su bcos tsho ston pa rnams la pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i rtsa ltung bzhi zhes bya ste/ de dag las gang yang rung ba zhig byung na rten gyi gang zag de la 'phags pa'i lam tshe 'dir mi skye ba'o/ /phyogs gsum pa ni/ rgyal po/ /blon po/dmangs phal pa rnams la 'byung nye ba'i sgo nas de dang der ngos bzung ltar mdzad pa'i ltung ba'i rnam bzhag rkang grangs lnga dang yang lnga dang / brgyad de go rim ji lta ba bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /de la lnga tshan dang po ni dkon mchog gi dkor 'phrog pa dang /470

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3chos spong gi las gsog pa dang / tshul khrims dang ldan yang rung tshul khrims 'chal yang rung ste dge slong la khrims gcod pa dang /bslab pa las phab pa dang / ngur smig 'phrog pa sogs byed pa dang / pha bsad pa/ ma bsad pa/ dgra bcom pa gsod pa/rgyal ba'i sku la ngan sems kyis khrag 'byin pa/ 'khor lo'i dbyen te mtshams med lnga las gang rung byed pa dang / rgyu 'bras la log par lta ba ste lnga yin no/ /lnga tshan gnyis pa snga ma de lnga las log lta phri zhing de nyid kyi tshab tu grong / ljongs/ grong khyer/ grong rdal dang yul 'khor 'joms pa rnams gcig tu brtsis nas de bsnan pa'o/ /de la grong ni mi khyim gcig la sogs pa dang / ljongs mi rigs bzhi gnas sa/ grong khyer bzo sna bco brgyad gnas sa/grong rdal tshong 'dus chen po'i sa/ yul 'khor rgyal po'i mnga' ris lta bu yin zhes gsungs/ gsum pa brgyad ni rdzogs byang du sems bskyed cing nan tan gyis blo ma sbyangs pas/ stong nyid bstan na skrag par 'gyur ba'i rigs la de kho na nyid ston pa dang /theg chen gyi lam zhugs rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir ldog tu bcug nas theg dman du bcug pa'am 'dzud pa dang / so sor thar pa spangs nas sems bskyed la theg chen bklag pa tsam gyis chog par smra ba dang / nyan rang gi theg par nyon mongs drungs phyungs kyi 471

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'bras bu med par 'dzin pa dang / rnyed bkur la chags pa'i rgyus bdag bstod gzhan smod byed pa/ rang gis zab mo'i don ma rtogs bzhin du rtogs rdzun byed pa/ dge slong chad pas gcod la 'jug cing de las dkon mchog gi dkor sug 'bul du len pa/spong ba bsam gtan pa'i longs spyod ma byin par blangs nas kha ton pa la sbyin pa dang / 'di'i char gtogs chos spyod pa'i dge slong rnams la khrims ngan 'cha' ba ste bsdoms pas bco brgyad do/ /de ltar rtsa ltung gi tshul ji skad gsungs pa rnams legs par shes nas rang gi rgyud bsrung bar bya zhing gal te nyams na bcos tshul rab 'bring tha ma gsum yod de rtogs pa rab kyis stong nyid zab mo'i lta ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa'i sgo nas bshags pa bya zhing sdig ltung rang bzhin med par shes na 'gyod tshangs rnams kyi mchog yin zhing / 'bring gis rigs sngags kyi lha la gsol ba gdab ste/ de'i nang nas kyang bslab btus las/ rmi lam 'phags pa nam snying po'i/ /mdun du 'dug ste bshags par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar bya ba la de yang zhes sbrel la nyin mo gso sbyong gi sdom pa blangs te byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la rtse gcig tu mos pas gsol 'debs bya zhing thugs rgyud bskul ba la 'bad/ tho rangs kyi char bdag gi ltung ba sbyong ba'i 472

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3phyir du rmi lam gyi tshe sprul pa ston par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab la nyal bas byang sems chen po de'i sprul pas ltung ba rnams las ldang ba ste grol bar byed do/ /gal te de ltar ma byung na skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su/ skya rengs skya rengs thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa zhes sogs kyis phrin gsol la/ sngar bzhin byas te bshags pas 'dag pa yin no/ /tha mas ni sdig ltung gi nus pa nyams smod pa dang / rnam smin thag sring ba dang / 'bras bu mi myong bar byed pa sogs kyi sgo nas bzhag pa'i gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba yis nyes ltung mang ba dang / tshogs kyi bsags rgyab nyung ba dang / chos spang ba'i gnyen por yang dang yang du bsngags pa/ sdig bshags dang yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ste phung bo rnam pa gsum la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'gyod bshags bya'o/ /gzhan yang dngos su byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun tshogs pa'i dbus te spyan sngar nongs pa bsgrags nas mthol bshags brjod pa'i sgo nas bshags pa bya'o/ /gang ltar yang byed 'dod ma log pa/ dga' zhing mgu ba/ yon tan du blta ba/ ngo tsha dang khrel yod ma skyes pa ste/ kun dkris chen po'i yan lag bzhi ka tshang na rtsa ba'i ltung ba dngos yin pas de la ni sdig pa bshags tsam gyis mi chog gi byang sems kyi sdom pa gsar 473

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du blang bar bya dgos te/ ltung ba'i rnam smin bshags pas dag cing / de kho nas sdom pa sor mi chud pa'i phyir ro/ /de las gzhan du kun dkris chung 'bring la ni sdom pa nyi shu par/ zag pa 'bring ni gsum la bshags/ /gcig gi mdun du lhag ma rnams/ /nyon mongs mi mongs bdag sems bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa de yi yan lag ni nyes byas bzhi bcu rtsa drug byang sar gsungs pa rnams dmigs bsal dang bcas par/ dkon mchog gsum la gsum mi mchod/ /'dod pa'i sems kyi rjes su 'jug /ces pa nas/ snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang / /sems dge ba la nyes pa med/ /ces pa'i bar gyi mdor bsdus te sdom pa nyi shu par gsungs pas shes par 'dod pa rnams kyis byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u 'grel ba dang bcas pa rnams dang / sdom pa nyi shu pa'i ṭī ka snga phyi rnams su zhib mor bltas te rtogs par bya'o/ /'dir ni de dag mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis gsungs te dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang dang gzhan la 'phral tshe 'di dang /yun gyi tshe rabs brgyud ma rnams su gnod par 'gyur ba'i las ma lus pa spong sgrub kyi gnas la mkhas pa'i sgo nas bya dang mi bya'i tshod shes par byas la snying thag pa nas brtags te bya bar mi 'os pa rnams spang par bya'o/ /'phral dang yun du gnod pa'i las ma 474

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3lus pa spang zhes rtsa bar gsungs ba la spong sgrub kyi gnas la mkhas pas sogs 'bru snon dgos pa ci yin zhe na/ 'phral du gnod la yun du phan pa dang / 'phral du phan zhing yun du gnod pa sogs yod pa'i phyir de dag gi nang nas gtso bor gang byed ston pa'i phyir yin te sdom pa nyi shu par/ gzhan rnams dang ni bdag kyang rung / /sdug bsngal yin yang gang phan dang / /phan dang bde ba rnams bya ste/ /bde yang mi phan mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims gzhung 'dir dngos bstan du byung ba la smon 'jug gi bslab bya gnyis las/dang po smon pa'i bslab bya lnga zhes grags pa ni/ dang po zhes pa thog ma'i don du dz+rel nas der gyur pa'i sems can blos mi btang ba ni 'gro ba'i rigs gtogs kyi sems can gang yang rung ba tha na gcig tsam la khong khro ba la sogs pa'i sems kyis 'di snyam du bdag gis sems can gzhan thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba yongs sa sgrub mod kyi sems can gcig po 'di la ni gnod pa ༄spong ba dang / phan 'dogs nus pa'i skabs shig byung yang mi byed snyam du dam bca' ba'i blo sna zhig skyes phan chad smon sems rtsa ba nas gtong bar 'gyur zhing / de btang na theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rkang rtsa chad pa yin pas rnam pa kun tu nyes pa 'di la 475

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dug gi chig thang ltar blta ba'i bag yod kyi sgo nas spyir sems can su la yang rung ste gnod sems skad cig kyang mi skye bar bya zhing gal te gnas skabs su rkyen gyi dbang gis khong khro ba'i gzhan dbang can du gyur na yang phugs su rang gzhan thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi nyams pa'i don du bsam pa bzang bos smon lam gdab pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad yid la bya zhing sems can kun gyi don bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i blo dang nam yang bral bar mi bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed kyi phan yon dran pa ni/ rgyas par na sangs rgyas phal po che las ji skad 'byung ba rnams dang / 'bring du spyod 'jug le'u dang po'i don dang / mdor bsdus dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i byams zhus kyi le'u'i smon lam las byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa sogs sdom tshig blo la bzung ste brjod don gting thug par ci nas kyang shes par byas la yang dang yang du de dag gi don la bsam/ mdor bsdu na srid zhi'i bde legs ji snyed pa thams cad byang chub sems kyi mthu nyag gcig las byung ba'i tshul dus rnam kun tu mi brjed pa'i dran pas nges shes bskyed par bya'o/ /gsum pa byang chub sems kyi stobs bskyed pa la phyag mchod la 476

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3sogs pa tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa dang / yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang sgom pa ste/ /zhes pa ltar chos rnam pa bcu la sogs pa 'khor gsum dmigs med kyi lta ba'i rtsis zin pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis sgo du ma nas bsags pa'i thabs la 'bad pa ni jo bo bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyi tshe gcig nyams len dril nas bstan pa'i gdams ngag gi chings stobs rnam pa lnga'i nang dkar po rnam par 'phel ba'i stobs zhes grags so/ / bzhi pa byang chub kyi sems dngos sbyong ba la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/bslab bya ste gsum yod pa'i dang po rgyu la sbyong ba tshad med rnam pa bzhi ste/ de'i sgom tshul bsdu na spyir tshad med bzhi'i rten bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi dgos par shing rta chen po'i gzhung las mang du bshad kyang skabs 'dir bstan ni tshad med rnam pa bzhi'i phyogs su bsdu rgyu'i byams sogs la dgongs par snang gis tshad med bzhi mtshan nyid pa zhig dgos na byang chub kyi sems skye ba la bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi mi dgos pas de 'dren byed kyi rgyu la dgos na ha cang thal ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang 'di la byams sogs tsam gyis mi chog pas skyes ba chen po'i than mong ma yin rabye no༅477

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i byams sogs bzhi sgom tshul du song ba zhig ni nges par dgos te spros pas chog go/ /byams sogs bzhi po'i dmigs yul ni sems can bde ba 'dod pa/ sdug bsngal can/ bde ba dang ldan pa/ nye ring chags sdang can bzhir dmigs nas rim pa bzhin du/bde ba dang ldan 'dod/ /sdug bsngal dang 'bral 'dod/ bde ba las mi 'bral 'dod/ chags sdang zhi 'dod rnams rnam pa'i khyad par te mardo rgyan las/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can/ /'es sogs gsungs pa bzhin/ de bzhi re re la'ang sgom tshul rnam pa gsum rer dbye ba ni yul sems can tsam la dmigs pa dang /de nyid skad cig ma'i chos kyis khyad par du byas pa la dmigs pa dang / bden med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas bdag lta'i dmigs pa med par sgom tshul rnams so/ /sems dngos la sbyang ba ni/ nyin dang mtshan mo'i dus drug tu nyin re dang / thun re bzhin du gong du smos pa'i rang sdom len pa yi cho ga rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba yis mi chog par byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang yang bskyar zhing blang ngo / /khyad par du mgon po klu sgrub kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga ltar blangs na sems bskyed dngos sbyong bar 'gro zhing byang sdom bskyar na bslab bya la sbyang bar 'gro rgyur mngon no/ /478

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3gsum pa bslab bya la sbyang ba/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang /brje ba dang / bdag bas gzhan gces sgom pa ste gsum las/dang po ni/ bdag dang 'gro kun blo gcig tu mthun par bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa la mtshungs pa sha stag yin zhing de ltar yin bzhin du rang gzhan la khyad phye ba'i sgo nas bdag bzhin du sems can gzhan la brtse bar mi sems pa skyes bu dam pa'i tshul min gyi rgyu mtshan des na bdag dang 'gro kun phan 'dogs pa'i yul du mtshungs pa ru bzung ste phan pa sgrub cing gnod pa spong ba la brtson par bya'o snyam du thun bzhir bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi rgyud la yod pa'i bde ba dang dge ba ji snyed pa thams cad gos phud de g.yogs pa bzhin du 'gro ba kun la sbyin zhing 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad bdag gis khur du len pa nyid dbugs 'byung 'jug dang bstun te sgom na phyin drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams len du 'gro bar gsungs so/ /'on kyang brje bsgom tshul gyi drag shos ni spyod 'jug las gsungs pa ltar bdag gzhan gtso bor byas pa'i skyon yon gyi steng nas sgom lugs nyid yin pas sogs kyi sgras bstan don yang de la byas na 'thad do/ /de ltar bdag gzhan gnyis go sa spos la yang dang yang du sgom pa ni bdag gzhan brje ba'o/ /479

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsum pa rang don sgrub 'dod kyi blo rnam kun tu spangs nas zhes pa bsam pa dang dngos su na lus dang srog dang longs spyod thams cad kyis 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho ma lus pa bsgrub par bya zhing bya dka' ba'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob pa ni sbyor ba'o/ /lnga pa skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs kyi phreng ba thams cad du mi brjed par byang chub sems mchog dran pa'i rgyu ni/ sems nyid ngal gsor/ mdor na nag po'i chos bzhi spang bya zhing / /dkar po'i chos bzhi dag la nan tan bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dkar nag chos brgyad la blang dor bya ba ste/ de la nag po'i chos bzhi ni/mchod 'os bslu ba dang / 'gyod med la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang /skyes bu dam pa la skur ba 'debs pa dang / 'gro ba la g.yo sgyu spyod pa ste bzhi'o/ /nag chos de bzhi spangs nas dkar chos bzhi la bslab pa ni/ srog la bab kyang shes bzhin du rdzun mi smra ba dang /'gro kun theg pa mchog gi lam la zhug cing gzengs bstod pa dang /rgyal sras rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes kyis gus par bya ba dang /'gro ba kun la rgyud drang po'i ngang tshul du bya zhing sgyu dang g.yo med pa la nges par bslab bo/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa'i bslab bya ni/bdag med rtogs pa dang / snying rje chen pos zin pa'i sgo nas 'jig rten pa dang / nyan rang gi dge ba las 'phags pa'i phyir 480

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3phar phyin zhes brjod pa drug ste/ sbyin tshul bzod brtson bsam gtan shes rab rnams so/ /ste zhes lhag bcas kyi sgra sbyar ro/ /de la lhag ma ni 'di yin te phyin drug gi ngo bo khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi dge ba'i tshogs gang zhig byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i phyogs su gyar pa'o/ /bye brag gi ngo bo la/ ngo bo nyid dang / mtshungs rami mi 'o/de/ldan dang / kun slong sgo nas 'jog tshul yod pa las/ gtso bor ngo bo nyid kyi phyogs las bsnyad na sbyin pa'i ngo bo ma chags pa/tshul khrims kyi ngo bo spong sems/ de bzhin du bzod pa mi 'khrugs pa/ brtson 'grus dge ba la spro ba/ bsam gtan sems rtse gcig pa'i rab phye/ shes rab chos rab tu 'byed pa rnams so/ /de dag bsgrub tshul ni/ yon tan bzhi bsgrub pa dang / chags pa bdun spang ba dang / dam pa gsum gyis zin par nyams su blang ngo / /bshad ma thag pa'i khyad chos bzhi ni/ ser sna la sogs pa phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs nyams pa ste de dag dang bral ba dang 'khor gsum bden par mi rtog pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa ste des zin pa dang / sems can gyi 'dod pa kun yongs su rdzogs par byed pa ste/ de dag gi re ba skong ba dang theg pa gsum gyi lam la 'god pa ste chos kyi sbyin pa dang 'brel ba'o/ /yon tan bzhi ni/yul sems can thams cad la dmigs shing / ched du bya ba 481

〉21rngad/ do/ jordo sdispyings khur:drob/thag byaspurngosno thab/ltazug rta):re tha/sdo/jiṭakhurasdo/zug/ 〈r+shardzogs pa'i byang chub kyi don du 'dun pas drang ba'i phyir rgya che ba dang legs smon 'dod pa la sogs pa'i zang zing gi bsam pa med pa dang / mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir don che ba dang / khyad chos drug ldan gyi bsngo bas zin pa'i phyir mi zad pa ste bzhi ldan no/ /chags pa bdun ni ser sna sogs mi mthun phyogs dang / phyi bshol byed pa dang / cung zad res chog par 'dzin pa dang / 'phral gyi lan dang phugs su rnam smin la re ba mi mthun pa phra mo dang / rang don yid byed kyi rnam g.yeng dang / mtshan ma'i rnam g.yeng gang rung la chags pa rnams te de dag spang bar bya zhing sbyor ba sems bskyed/ dngo sa gzhi dmigs pa med pa/ rjes su bsngo bas rgyas thebs pa'i dam pa gsum ldan du bya'o/ /gsum pa sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims la dbye na byang sar bcu gcig tu gsungs pa sogs mang po zhig snang yang bsdu na mdo rgyan las/ bsdus dang sdud par 'gyur ba dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gdul bya smin grol du byed pa'i thabs kyi sgo ches che ba bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi ste mkho ba sbyin pas 'khor yongs su bsdus nas de dag rang gi mos pa ji lta ba bzhin 482

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3du dpe dang sgrung dang glu gar la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyi lam nas dam pa'i chos nyan par bshad/ khyad par du de dang de'i skal ba dang mtshams pa'i sde snod dang theg pa'i 'jug ngogs legs par bstan nas don bzhin spyod pas sgrub pa la gzhugadon mthun rang gis kyang tshul bzhin du slob par bya'o/ /rgyas par byang sa'i bsdu dngos kyi le'u las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus ru shing bzang po ltar thang lhod med pa'i sgo nas nyams su blang bar byas na gnas skabs su'ang dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis srung ba dang rgyal ba sras bcas kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i byin rlabs las phan bde kun 'du zhing sems kyi gnod pa dang lus kyi gdug pa thams cad spong nus pa'i dge rtsa smin zhing mthar thug lam lnga dang sa bcu'i spang rtogs mngon du byas nas yon tan thams cad kyi mthar phyin zhing thob bya thams cad kyi rtse mor thug pa rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob pa'o/ /spyi don gsum pa mjug gi don ni/ brtsams tshul bsngo smon sbyar byang dang bcas pas bstan te/ 'di ltar rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa gting zab cing yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas su gyar pa'i rnam thar rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' ni ༄483

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nam mkha'i mtha' dang sems can mtha' yas pa'i blo ste sems kyi 'jug pa'i mtha'i rjes su 'gro ba'i phyir phyogs re tsam gyis tshad gzung bar mi 'os kyang dang po'i las can gang dag la bslab pa'i gnas gal 'gangs che ba rnams gzhung 'di ru bsdus te cung zad bstan pa yin no/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba dri med zla ba ltar rnam par dkar bas lhan cig byed rkyen byas te/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rgyud theg pa mchog gi snod du rung zhing / rgyal ba'i ye shes byang chub chen po'i go 'phang gi dngos rgyur gyar pa'i theg chen gyi sung tsho zu rig rig mi zugacig ma rig zugasingalam la brtsan pa mthar phyan nas/ mtha' yas pa' skya dgu' 'dren pa rgyal ba'i dbang por 'gyur bar shog cig bdag kyang deng nas skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs rnams su mtshungs bral drin chen bla ma'i bka' 'khor du skyes nas chos kyi bdud rtsir longs spyod cing thos bsam sgom pa'i dga' bas dga' bar gyur cig ces sho lo ka phyi ma la dge rtsa blo yul du bzhag pa'i tshig rtsa dngos su ma byung yang / tshigs bcad gong ma'i/ de dag dri med zla ba ltar dkar bas/ /zhes pa nyid sbyar rgyu yin pa'i phyir smon lam rkyang par mi 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug smon lam du'ang / bdag gis byang chub spyod pa la/ /'jug pa rnam par brtsams pa yis/ /zhes pa gong 'og thams cad du 'gres sbyar ba bzhin no/ /de'ang 'di 484

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3ltar bsngo ba dang smon lam rkyang pa'i khyad par dge rtsa blo yul du bzhag pa'i smon lam yin min las phye ba dpal ldan phyogs glang gis bzang spyod 'grel bar gsungs shing / rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling bas kyang de ltar gsungs so/ /de ltar gzhung don rdzogs nas/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi bslab bya mdor bsdus pa/ /zhes sogs ni go bar sla ba nyid do/ /chos tshul zab brling ma dros 'khyil ba'i 'jing / /rnam bshad zla ba gzhon nus snang byas pas/ /tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba'i chos 'dzin zhing / /rgyal sras spyod pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig /skye zhing skye ba kun tu bla ma mchog /o rgyan chos kyi dbang pos rjes bzung ste/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi yun ring myang ba las/ /rgyal ba'i lam la nges pa rnyed gyur cig /srid pa sdug bsngal 'khor lor 'phyan pa yi/ /nyam thag ma rgan 'gro drug sems can kun/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon chen por bdag 'gyur zhing / /byang chub zhi ba dam pa'i sa thob shog /ces pa'ang sprul pa'i sku blo bzang 'jigs med rab brtan gyi bzhed pa bzhin mdo smad rdo rong gi sprang smyon 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis gang dran thol byang du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni nye gnas shākya'i btsan pa sha ring riri phudad gtong khrel yod kyi yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i dge rgan blo 485

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gros bzang pos mdzad pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ //༄7/ /sras bcas rgyal ba kun dngos bla ma la/ /mi phyed dad pas lan brgyar phyag byas nas/ /rgyal sras bslab bya'i 'bru 'grel bdud rtsi'i thigs/ /blo gros gsar bu'i rna bar sbyin par bya/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi bslab bya mdor bsdus nyams len snying bo'i tshig gi 'bru gnyer ba la gsum ste/ klad don/ gzhung don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po ni/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha la mchod par brjod pa ste/rgyal ba kun bskyed pa'i yab gcig tu gyur kyang sems can gyi don du rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshal 'dzin pa/ thags snying rje'i mnga' dpa rang bdag mkhyen rab kyi ral gri can/ phul du byung ba'i nus mthus bdud kyi sde tshar gcod par mdzad pa/ rigs gsum dbyer med 'jam dpal dpa' bos skyongs shig ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa la mdor bstan dang / rgyas bshad gnyis las/dang po ni/ /dus gsum gyi rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yang dag pa/ rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bslab par bya ba'i gnas rmad du byung ba/ ma lus 'gro ba'i phan bde'i legs tshogs mtha' dag gi rgyu gcig pu ba/ byang chub 486

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3sems kyi bslab pa thams cad mdor bsdu na/ brgyud pa'i khungs dang / phan yon dang / ngo bo dang / nges tshig dang / dbye ba dang / ji ltar byang sems kyi sdom pa len tshul dang / bslab bya dngos dang rnam pa bdun yin no/ /gnyis pa la bdun las/ dang po brgyud pa'i khungs kyi che ba ni/ ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po shākya seng ge des/dang po sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chen por thugs bskyed/ de nas bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te/ ji ltar bsags na byang chub kyi sems kyis zin par sangs rgyas 'phags pa bye ba mang po la bsnyen bkur byas shing sems can gyi don rgya cher mdzad nas/ mthar tshogs rdzogs zhing 'byongs gdul bya smin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa brnyes pa ste/ dga' ldan nas 'pho ba nas byang chub snying bor gshegs pa'i bar gyis mdzad pa brgyad rdzogs pa'i mthar/ snyigs ma lnga bdo tshe lo brgya pa'i dus der/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams chen po'i bye brag 'dzam gling rdo rje gdan dbus su/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ nyan rang byang sems te rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya rjes su bzung ste ji ltar na/ chos kyi 'khor lo bden bzhi dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang / rnam par phye ba zhes 487

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/grags pa'i rim pa gsum du bskor bas so/ /de'i tshe rgyal sras chen po grangs med pa sangs rgyas su lung bstan zhing byang chub chen por bkod de/ bstan pa'i rgyun bzhag bstan 'dzin gyi rgyal tshab 'byung bar lung bstan/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug sems dpa' mchog gnyis sogs la bstan pa gtad nas tshur mthong gi ngor mya ngan 'da' tshul bstan to/ /de'i phyis su bstan 'dzin ji ltar byung na/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo 'jam dpal gzhon nu yis ni/rgyal ba'i lung bstan pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang / rgyal sras mtshungs med zhi ba lha la sogs pa rjes su bzung zhing / sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab ma pham pa 'phags pa thogs med kyi lhag pa'i lhar gyar te/ thogs med rjes su bzang ste byams chos sde lnga rig /byerdo/ 1rdo sna rir mi/rjeX/ /byebye/ shāX/bshad do/ / slad slob da skun gsum 4 gzhung la ba tshon pa ri brgyud pa'i bka' srol gsum yin te zab mo lta ba dang rgya chen spyod pa'i srol dang zab cing rgya che ste srol rnam pa gsum rim pa ltar lta ba dbu ma spyod pa phar phyin drug sa lam ting 'dzin drod tshad gtso bo ru rang rang gzhung gis ston phyir de ltar ro/ /de ltar brgyud gsum gyi man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu klung rgya bod mkhas pa stong las legs par 'ongs pa mtha' dag gang gi thugs kyi bum pa bzang por legs bskyil nas skal bzang 'gro la gdams ngag 488

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3stsol mkhas pa'i rgyal ba'i sras su thub pas lung bstan pa ni kun mkhyen chos kyi rje yin no/ /de las ring brgyud snyan nas snyan du dang / nye brgyud shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis kyi dgongs pa'i gtad rgya thob par gyur ba bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gter chen ak+ṣa ra badz+ra dang a bh+ya dī ba ste rnam pa gnyis nas rim par brgyud de rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du'o/ / gnyis pa byang chub sems kyi phan yon bshad pa ni rgyas par dbye na bgrang las 'das pa zhig yod na yang mdor bsdu na rnam pa lnga yin te ming don gnas 'gyur/ mi dge'i gnyen po byed pa/dge 'bras gong 'phel/ ngan song gi sgo 'phar gcod pa/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang zag gi bye brag 'khor ba'i sems can zhig sems 'di rgyud la skyes pas rgyal ba'i sras zhes ming gi cod pan 'thob cing 'khor ba'i btson rar nyon mongs kyi 'ching bas bcing la bdag lta'i btson srung gis bsrang ba'i nyam thag pa'i btson ba de byang chab kyi sems rirang niring norang bskyed pa'i mod la skad cig gis lhar bcas 'gro ba'i phyag gi yul du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnam smin myong bar nges pa'i sdig pa thams cad zil gyis gnon zhing / myong bar ma nges pa'i sdig ltung phra mo drungs nas 'byin pa ste/ de dag gi dper rim bzhin/489

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgeskar ma'i tshogs la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / rtsa sbur phra la dus mtha'i me bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ smon pa byang chub sems bskyed las dge 'bras 'phel che ba dper na 'bras bu yang dang yang du 'byin pa'i bza' shing gi sdong po bzhin te/ byang chub snying bo'i bar du mngon mtho'i 'bras bzang dang mthar thug bsod nams mtha' yas pa'i phung po rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /'juka/ pa byang sems bskyed pas bsod nams dam pa'i rgyu nyid kyang gong du 'phel na 'bras bu lta ci smos/ de'i phyir 'jug pa thob la ma nyams pa'i sems dpa' chen po bag med dang gnyid log pa ra gyur kyang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis gong du 'phel ba ste 'jug sems dang mi ldan pa'i brtson ldan gzhan las lhag go//bzhi pa ni/ bsam pa bzang po byang chub sems dang ldan pa'i rgyal ba'i sras de rnam smin ngan 'gror 'phen pa'i kun slong gi rgyun gcod phyir bde nas bde ba'i lam du 'gro yang gnas skabs su dran pa nyam chung ba dang bag med stobs chen po'i dbang du gyur na/de'i rnam smin mi bslu ba'i phyir re zhig gnas ngan len du mchi yang mthar byang sems kyi rigs sad par 'gyur ba mdza' bo'i bu mo bzhin no/ /lnga pa ni/ 'das pa'i dus su byon dang da lta bzhugs dang phyis 'byung 'gyur gyi rgyal ba kun dang rgyal ba'i sras 490

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3po kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam chen po ni byang chub kyi sems 'di yin te/ lam mchog 'di dang bral bzhin du gang zag de la kun mkhyen gyi ye shes 'thob pa med do/ /des na rang bzhin gnas rigs rgyal ba'i khams sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'byung rung gi cha de nyid byang chub sems kyi rgyas 'gyar dang 'grogs pa chu lngaphru snore zedza de/nolud drod gsher 'ad+kums pa sa san ba na gong nas gong du 'phel bas rgyal ba'i yon tan gyi lo tog phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ / gsum pa byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ni/ dmigs pa'i zur gnyis dang ldan pa ste/ shes rab stobs kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba dang snying rje'i mthu yis mtha' yas pa'i 'gro khams rgya mtsho la dmigs pa'i gzhan phan don gnyer te 'dun pa de dag dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i gtso sems zhig ste bsdu na gzhan phyir sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi blo zhig go/ /de ni smon dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid de de'ang 'gro 'dod dang 'gro ba dngos ltar spyod pa nyams len gyis zin dgos mi dgos kyis dbye ba'o// bzhi pa nges tshig ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob pa'i phyir du bya dka'i gnas phyin drug gi spyod pa la slob pa dang bskal pa'i yun dang 'gro mang mtha' la mi skyo ba'i sems stobs kyi go cha 491

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ mchog bgos pa'i snying dpa' bo'i rang bzhin du byed pa la byang chub kyi sems 'di dang mtshungs pa gzhan med pa'i phyir grags pa don dang ldan pa yin no/ /lnga pa de'i dbye ba'i gnas la dbye sgo ba dun te/ gcig tu stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can/ gnyis su tshogs gnyis la ltos te'am/ kun rdzob dang don dam sems bskyed de bden gnyis dang / smon dang 'jug pa gnyis su dbye la/ gsum du tshul khrims dang / ting 'dzin dang shes rab kyi bslab pa dang ldan pa'i byang sems gsum/ bzhi ru tshogs sbyor gyi lam dang / ma dag sa bdun dang / dag sa gsum dang / sangs rgyas kyi sa na go rim bzhin du/ mos spyod dang / lhag bsam rnam dag dang /rnam par smin pa dang / thugs rje chen po sgrib pa kun spang ba'i sems bskyed de bzhi'o/ /lnga ru lam lnga las tshogs lam du las dang po dang / sbyor lam du yongs su sbyang byas dang / mthong lam du chos nyid mthong ba'i dang / sgom lam du rnam par grol ba'i dang / mi slob lam du bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi sems bskyed de rim zhes pa'i don no/ /drug tu sbyin tshul bzod brtson bsam gtan shes rab ste phyin drug la ltos pa'i sems bskyed drug dang /dbye sgo bdun pa sa mtshams dbye ba nyi shu rtsa gnyis su phye ste 'dun 492

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3pa sa lta bu la sogs pa'o/ /de rnams re re'ang dpe grogs chos mthun gsum gsum mo/ /drug pa byang sdom len tshul ni gnyis te dge ba'i bshes gnyen las len pa dang / rang gi stobs kyis sras bcas rgyal ba yid la byas te rten sogs las len pa'o/ /dang po la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum las/ sngon 'gro ni khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa ste dang po len yul dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par can de la maṇ+ḍal phul zhing byang sdom gnang bar gsol ba gdab pa dang /gnyis pa blo sbyong gi gdams ngag khyad par can srid mthar skyo ba bskyed pa zhi mthar zhen pa dgag pa mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa mngon du byed pa'i lam theg pa chen po la bsngags pa brjod pa dang / gsum pa sdom pa rgyud la skye ba'i rgyu thabs sam las kyi cho ga khyad par can/ yan lag bdun gyis tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsags pa dang / bzhi pa sdom pa'i rtsa ba rten mchog khyad par can/ yul dkon mchog gsum dang dus byang chub snying bo'i bar dang gang gi ched du na sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'thob pa'i phyir yin pa ste gsum gyi rnam bzhag theg chen thun min gyi gzhung las bshad pa ltar khyad par gsum ldan gyi skyabs 'gro dad pa'i rang bzhin can 493

zi pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ gyis gzhi bzung ngo / /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ dgongs su gsol ba gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i smon sdom dang 'jug sdom stabs gcig tu blang ba'o/ /gsum pa mjug tu rang gzhan dga' ba sgom par bya bas sems gzeng bstod pa'o/ /gnyis pa rang gis bla ma las min kyang blang ba'i tshul ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa chags pa dang thogs pa ci rigs spangs shing med pa'i mkhyen pa dang ldan pa rnams ni mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba la thugs rje rtag tu dgongs pa ste/ yul der yan lag bdun gyi tshogs bsags bya zhing sdom pa blang la mthar dga' ba sgom pa dang smon lam gdab pa'o/ /bdun pa bslab bya bshad pa la srung thabs dang bsrung bya gnyis las/ srung thabs dran pa dang ni shes bzhin gnyis te 'di dag med par bslab pa gsum srung bar 'dod pa de ni go mtshon med pa'i dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug pa 'dra ste ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar rang srog brlag par zad pa'i phyir ro/ /de la dang po dran pa ni/ thos bsam sgom pa'i chos rnams mi brjed par rang gi rgyud dang 'dres par bya zhing / khyad par du byang sems kyi bslab bya'i gnas kun legs par bslabs te yang yang bsngo bgrang bya zhing dran gso bya'o/ /gnyis pa shes bzhin ni spyod lam dus kun tu 494

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3bdag gis ci byas sems dge'am dge ba min pa'i mi dge ba zhig yin zhes brtags shing / rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa las ma nyams sam zhes yang dang yang du brtags te/ rang rgyud la bya ra bya ba'o//gnyis pa srung bya la nyes spyod sdom pa dge ba chos sdud sems can don byed de gsum las dang po nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni rtsa ltung las bsrung ba dang de yi yan lag go/ /rtsa ltung gcig dang bzhi dang bco brgyad du dbye ba rnams rim/ pa ltar thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo dang byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo yi rjes su 'brangs pa'i phye tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ smon sems mi btang bar bsrung bar bya ste/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba sangs rgyas nyid thob pa'i phyir du bdag gis dge tshogs bsgrub cing mi dge ba spong bar bgyi snyam pa mi brjed pa de nyid dam pa gsum dang 'brel bar bya zhing / dge tshogs gang 'grub bsgrub las gzhan yod pa min zhes gsungs te dpyad par bya ba ni snang ste rig par gyis shig don 'di ni bslab pa kun gyi sdom gcig ste shes sla zhing don 'dus la gnad zab phul du byung ba'o/ /mtshungs bral drin chen bla ma'i man ngag las kyang don 'di kho na rtsal du bton nas gsungs so/ /zhe'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ser sna dang / 'dod chags dang / khong khro dang / gti mug gi kun slong 495

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhi yis rim pa bzhin du/ chos nor mi ster ba dang / bdag nyid bstod cing gzhan la smod pa dang / gzhan la brdeg btsog byed pa dang shad sbyang len par mi byed pa dang / yang dag pa'i chos spang zhing dam pa'i chos ma yin pa gzhan la ston pa rnams so// gsum pa ni/ rgyal bo la 'byang nye ba lnga dang / blon po la 'byang mjug rar mazer tshodami zurang skur nya ba lnga dang / phal ba la 'byung nya ba' ltung ba' rnams grangs brgyad rim bzhin/ dang po dkon mchog gi dkor phrog pa/ chos spang ba'i las gsags pa/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'am tshul 'chal la khrims gcod bslab pa las 'bebs pa sogs byed pa/ mtshams med pa'i las byed pa/ rgyu 'bras med par log par lta ba ste lnga yin no/ /gnyis pa/ snga ma lnga las log lta bri zhing de tshab tu grong ljongs grong khyer grong brdal dang / yul 'khor 'joms pa rnams gcig tu brtsis nas bsnan pa'o/ /de'ang grong ni mi khyim nyi tshe ba dang / ljongs ni mi rigs bzhi gnas pa/ grong khyer ni bzo sna bco brgyad yod pa/ grong rdal ni tshong 'dus chen pos gang ba/ yul 'khor ni yul gru chen po'o/ /gsum pa blo ma sbyang la stong nyid ston pa/ theg chen gyi rigs can rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa las phyir ldog par byas te theg dman du bcug pa dang / theg dman gyi rigs can so so thar ba spangs nas 496

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3sems bskyed kyi spyod pa la mi nus bzhin du slob tu bcug pa/nyan rang theg pa la rang 'bras med par 'dzin pa/ rnyed bkur 'dod pa'i rgyu yis gzhan smod phyir/ rang gis zab don ma rtogs rtogs rdzun byed pa/ dge slong chad pas gcod 'jug sug 'bul len pa/ spong ba bsam gtan pa'i longs spyod kha ton pa la sbyin pa ste/ de ltar rtsa ltung gi tshul rnams kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar bslab pa legs par bsrung zhing nyams na bcos tshul la rab 'bring tha ma gsum ste/ rab kyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba'i ngang la bzhag ste/ sdig ltung blos btags pa tsam ma gtogs rang bzhin med pa'i tshul ji bzhin shes pa ni 'gyod tshangs kyi mchog go//'bring gis rig sngags kyi lha la gsol ba gdab bo/ /de yang nyin mo gso sbyong gi gdams pa blang la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la gcig tu mos pa'i gsol 'debs rgyud bskul la 'bad de tho rangs bdag gi ltung ba sbyong ba'i phyir rmi lam sprul ba ston zhes gsol ba btab la nyal bas byang sems 'phags pa'i sprul bas ltung ba las ldog par byed do/ /de ltar ma byung na'ang skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su skya rengs la phrin gsol zhing sngar bzhin bshags pas nyes pa 'dag par 'gyur ro/ /tha ma rnams gnyen po stobs bzhi zhes nyes byas sun 'byin dang rten gyi stobs dang 497

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zheganyen po kun spyod dang sdom pa'i stobs te 'di dag tshang ba yis bshags pa yi rang bsngo ba'i phung bo gsum pa la sogs pa'i mdo klog cing bshags pa bya la dngos su byang sems kyi dge 'dun tshogs pa'i dbus su nongs pa bsgrags pa'i mthol bshags sgo nas bshags pa bya'o/ /de dag gang yang sdom pa gsar du blang bar bya/ gnyis pa de yi yan lag dus kun tu rang dang gzhan sems can rnams la 'phral dang yun du gnod pa'i las ma lus pa snying nas brtags te spang ngo / /gnyis pa dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims la/ smon 'jug gi bslab bya gnyis las smon pa'i bslab bya ni lnga ste/ dang po sems can rnams blos mi gtong ba ni 'gro ba lnga'i rigs su gtogs pa gang yang rung ba gcig la gnod pa spong ba dang phan 'dogs nus pa'i skabs shig byung yang mi byed snyam du dam bca' ba'i blo skyes na des smon sems rtsa ba nas gtong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir gnas skabs khro ba'i dbang du gyur na yang phugs su bsam pa bzang pos smon lam gdab cing sems can kun gyi don bdag gis bsgrub par bya snyam pa dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed kyi phan yon dran pa ni/ rgyas par mdo phal bo che las 'byung ba dang / 'bring du spyod 'jug gi le'u dang po'i don dang / mdor 498

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3bsdus byams smon las 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad sogs shes par byas la yang dang yang du de don bsam ste mdor na srid zhi'i bde legs ji snyed pa byang chub sems kyi mthu las byang ba'i tshul dus kun tu mi brjed par dran pa'i nges shes bskyed do/ /gsum pa byang chub sems kyi stobs bskyed pa ni phyag dang mchod pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa dang / yi ge 'bri mchod sogs chos spyod bcu'i legs tshogs mtha' dag dmigs med kyi lta ba'i rtsis zin pa'i sgo nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis bsags pa la bslab po/ /bzhi pa sems sbyong ba la rnam pa gsum ste rgyu la sbyong ba tshad med rnam pa bzhi ste/ dang po dmigs yul bde 'dod sdug bsngal can bde ldan chags sdang can bzhi rim pa bzhin du ldan 'dod bral 'dod mi 'bral 'dod zhi 'dod pa'i byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms te bzhi po sems can la dmigs pa dang chos la dmigs pa dang dmigs pa med pa'i tshul du sgom mo/ /sems dngos la sbyang ba nyin mtshan dus drug tu nyin re bzhin du rang gi sdom pa len pa yi cho ga rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba yis mi chog byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa bskyar zhing blang ngo / /bslab bya la sbyang ba bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang brje ba dang bdag pas gzhan gces bsgom pa gsum ste/ dang po bdag dang 499

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gro kun blo mthun par bde ba 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal mi 'dod par mtshungs pa la bdag bzhin gzhan la phan par mi sems pa rigs pa'i tshul min pas/ des na bdag dang 'gro ba gzhan kun mtshungs pa ru phan pa sgrub cing gnod pa spong ba la brtson par bya'o//gnyis pa bdag gi bde ba dang de'i rgyu dge ba ci mchis pa bos phud de ster ba bzhin du 'gro kun la sbyin zhing 'gro ba'i sdig pa dang sdug bsngal bdag gis len pa sogs bdag gzhan go sa spos la yang nas yang du bsgom mo/ /gsum pa rang don sgrub 'dod kyi blo kun spangs nas/ dngos su lus dang srog dang longs spyod thams cad kyis 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho ma lus pa bsgrub par bya zhing bya dka' ba'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che slob pa'o/ /lnga pa skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs gzhan thams cad du mi brjed par byang chub sems mchog dran pa'i rgyu ma nor ba dkar nag gi chos brgyad la blang dor bya ba ste mchod 'os bslu ba dang 'gyod med la 'gyod pa skyed pa dang dam pa'i skyes bu la skur ba 'debs pa dang 'gro ba la g.yo sgyu spyod pa rnams te nag po'i chos bzhi spangs te shes bzhin du rdzun mi smra ba dang / 'gro ba kun theg pa mchog la zhugs par bkri ba dang / rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gus pa dang / kun la rgyud drang zhing g.yo sgyu med par nges par 500

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3bslab pa ste dkar chos bzhi la spyod do/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa'i bslab bya phar phyin drug ste/ sbyin pa/tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab ste/ ngo bo khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi dge ba'i tshogs bsgrub tshal yon ༄tan bzhi sgrub pa/ chags pa bdun spong ba/ sems bskyed bsngo ba stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab ste dam pa gsum gyis zin par nyams su blang ngo / /de la khyad chos bzhi ni rang rang gi mi mthun phyogs mnyam pa/ mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ 'dod pa kun rdzogs par byed pa/ theg gsum gyi lam la 'god pa'o/ /yon tan bzhi ni/ rgya che ba dang / zang zing med pa dang / don che ba dang / mi zad pa ste ba zhir ldan pa'o/ /chags pa bdun ni/mi mthun pa/ phyi bshol/ chog par 'dzin pa/ lan dang / rnam/ smin dang / mi mthun pa phra mo dang / rnam par g.yeng la chags pa spang bar bya zhing / sbyor ba sems bskyed dngos gzhi dmigs med bsngo ba'i rgyas thebs pa ste dam pa gsum ldan bya/ gsum pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims la/ dbye na mang yang bsdu na bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi ste sbyin pas 'khor bsdus/ dam pa'i chos snyan par bshad/ don spyod pa bsgrub tu gzhug/ don mthun par legs tshogs la rang gis slob pa'o/ /de ltar brtson pas nyams 501
