pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/su blang byas na/ gnas skabs kyi phan pa dang bde ba kun 'du zhing gnod pa dang sdug bsngal mtha' dag spangs te/ lam lnga sa bcu'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mngon du byas nas mthar thug rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes dang ldan pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bla na med pa thob par 'gyur ro/ / gsum pa mjug gi don la/ rtsom pa'i rgyu mtshan/ brtsams pa'i dge ba bsngo ba/ sbyar byang bstan pa ste gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rgya maspyo9) mtha'/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang sems can mtha' yas pa'i blo dang 'tsham par bstan pas gdul bya'i mtha'i rjes su 'gro bas tshad bzung bar mi 'os kyang dang bo'i las can gang la bslab pa'i gnas gal 'gag che ba rnams 'di ru cung zad bstan te/ 'di tsam gyis kyang theg pa chen po'i lam gyi 'jug sgo mdo tsam bshad zin to/ gnyis pa ni/de las byung ba'i dge ba dri med zla ba ltar dkar ba'i mthu la brten nas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rgyud zab rgya che gnyis ldan theg pa mchog gi snod du rung zhing / rgyal ba'i lam la brtson pa mthar phyin par byas nas skye dgu'i 'dren pa rgyal ba'i dbang bor shog cig pa'o/ /rtsom pa po bdag kyang deng nas skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs gzhan thams cad du/ mtshungs med drin chen bla ma'i 502

rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ pod/ 3bka' 'khor du skyes nas chos kyi bdud rtsir longs spyod cing thos bsam bsgom pa'i dga' bas dga' gyur cig /gsum pa ni/rgyal ba'i sras kyi bslab bya mdor bsdus pa/ theg pa mchog la slob par 'dod pa'i skal bzang mched kyi bzhed pa ltar rmongs pa a bu lhod pos 'phral du bris pa dge/ zhes pa ste go sla'o/ /de skad rgyal ba'i sras kyi bslab bya'i gzhung / /tshig gi gnyer kha bzung ste bkral ba 'dis/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i yid kyi mun sel zhing / /snying la ye shes snang ba 'bar gyur cig ces pa'ang lcags mo sprul skus lha rdzas kyi skyes dang bcas gnas kyis bskal pa'i phyogs nas kyang don gnyer chen pos bskul ba ltar gzhon nu 'jigs med pas tshig 'bru dgrol ba kho na ga tso bor byas te don gyi mtha' dpyad pa btang snyoms su bzhag nas gang dran bris pa'o////503
༄7/ /nag po chen po'i man ngag snyan brgyud lung gi snying po'i don cung zad bshad pa bdud dpung byer 'thag rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'phrul 'khor zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ /na mo gu ru lo ki shwa ra ya/ ye shes mtshon cha 'bar bas bdud sde'i mgo/ /'gem mdzad bla ma he ru ka dpal la/ /btud nas bstan srung man ngag zab mo'i don/ /cha tsam bla ma'i lung gis rnam par dbye/ /'dir bstan srung drag sngags kyi chos sde/gnad zab la kha tshang ba/ 'khyer bde la byin rlabs che ba ste khyad par bzhis 'phags pa/ nag po chen po'i snyan brgyud lung gi snying po 'chad pa la gsum/ klad don phyag 'tshal/ gzhung don dngos/mjug don gtad rgya zhar byung dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ na ma shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes pa dpal rdo rje khrag 'thung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes par 'gyur te/ de'ang mtha' yas pa'i yon tan gyi gzhir gyur pas dpal dang / sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin pas rdo rje/ bde ba chen po'i thod khrag la rol pas khrag 'thung ste/ de la bdag dang lha gnyis gdod ma'i dbyings su ro gcig par 'jal ba'i phyag gis mchod pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ lo rgyus kyis nges pa skyed pa/ lha'i rnam grangs dang rtsa ba'i sngags bstan pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa ste gsum las/ dang po la/ nag po chen po mngon 'byung gi tshul dang / de'i gdams pa ji ltar byung ba/506

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3gang las ji ltar brgyud pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po la'ang bzhi ste/ gnas lugs stong phyogs kyi mgon po ngos bzung ba/ de las snang phyogs mgon por bzhengs tshul/ snang stong gi sku gnyis zung du 'jug tshul/ de'i mdzad pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ji ltar kha dog gi nang na nag po ni kha dog gzhan ltar 'tsher bag dang mngon tshan che ba ma yin zhing / kha dog gang dang 'phrad kyang rang gi kha dog tu sgyur bar byed la/ tshur kha dog gzhan gyis sgyur dka' ba ste/ mdor na kha dog gzhan zil gyis gnon pa dang /gzhan gyis tshar zil gyis mi non pas kha dog gi rgyal po yin no/ /༄de bzhin du don dam pa'i dbyings kyi gnas lugs kyang dmigs bsam spros brjod las 'das pas bltar mi mngon pa'am zab pa yin zhing / 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi mdangs su shar bas kun la khyab cing kun gyi spyi dpal du bzhugs pa yin yang rang nyid spros pa'i mtshan ma gang gis kyang bsgyur du med pas nges don gyi nag po chen po'o/ /'dis dbyings rig gnyis ka'i bzhugs tshul bstan te/ de'ang rig pas dbyings mngon du byed lugs mthar thug ni/ rig pa de rnam par mig rtog pa'i dbyings rjen par gyur nas g.yo byed phra rags thams cad dang bral ba'i dbang gis dbyings de'i ngang las cung zad kyang 'gyur ba med pa 507

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ste/ dbu ma'i skabs ltar bshad du mi btub kyang / lugs 'dir 'od gsal gyi mi rtog pa'i cha la chos nyid dang dbyings su 'jog pas than mong ma yin pa'i lhag mthong gi rig pa der gyar pa'i ridapumi dmi mirnam bzhag 'thad do/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gnyug ma mi shigs pa'i gnas lus longs spyod gsung gi mdzad pa thams cad dbyings de sgrib bral du song ba'i rang snang nyag gcig ste/ du mar shar yang dbyings gcig pa dang / gcig pu nyid snang phyogs ris med du 'char ba dang / shar dus nyid na 'khrul pa'i gzung 'dzin gyis brtags pa ltar gyi ngo bo ngos bzung med pa ste/ de ltar snang cha dbyings las mi gzhan par ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa ni dbyings kyis snang ba la dbang bsgyur ba ste tshogs kyi bdag po'i nges don no/ /nag po chen po dang tshogs bdag gi nges don du 'gro rgyu gnyis po gcig yin kyang 'jog byed kyi ldog cha tha dad la brten nas de dang der bzhag par zad do/ /de ltar byas na ma hā ka la'i nges don ni/ gsang snying las/stong nyid bdag med ye shes rang rig thugs/ /dmigs bya dmigs byed med par dran dbang sgyur/ /zhes pa dang 'dra zhing /tshogs bdag ni/ ngo mtshar sku gsung yon tan zhing khams las/ /508

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3gzhan na med de de nyid de ltar yin/ /zhes pa dang mthun no/ /'di dag zhib tu shes pas rdzogs rim pa'i mgon po bsnyen sgrub kyi man ngag kyang tshang bar rnyed nus te/ 'di'i rdzogs rim ni dbyings rig ngo sprod kyi gnad kho nas rtsol med du grol ba 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs su bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbyings de'i ngang las rang snang ba'i gdul bya gzhan snang gi ye shes mgon po ni thags rje'i dbang phyag ste dmigs pa med tshog charazur byedro/ )drozi po char chagather rwa'ipa' thugs rja' dbang gas khams gsum gya grang khyar ya shas chan po'i mtshon cha'i thabs kyis dbyings su sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzad pa'i slad du sa gsum na 'jigs shing che ba rnams kyang 'jigs par byed pa'i bdud 'dul dpa' bo'i gzugs su shar te/ de nyid ni dngos grub kyi 'byor pa tshad med pa dang ldan pas dpal chen po'o/ /khams gsum dbyings su sgrol ba la 'jigs rung gi gzugs ci dgos zhe na/ srid pa'i dpal 'byor snying po med cing byis pa 'drid pa sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor lta bus rgyags shing / de'i ched du sdig pa mi zad pa rgyun du byed pa/ mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dang dpung dang ngan g.yo'i sbyor ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor lta bus 'jig rten la dbang sgyur zhing des snyems pa/ rmongs pa shas che ba chos dang chos min sems pa'i mthu med cing lta ngan gyis yid 509

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dkrugs pa/ ji ltar gdams kyang 'dul ba'i 'os su ma gyur pa rnams gtum drag khro bo'i gzi brjid dang / 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan nas/ bsdigs shing gzir ba dang /bsad cing gnas spar ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas rang gnas kyi ye shes la btsan thabs su sbyor ba ma gtogs pa 'dul ba'i thabs gzhan med pas de rnams drang ba'i phyir te/ sgyu mas sgyu ma bcom pa bzhin no/ /sngar tshogs bdag gi nges don thad du'ang snang phyogs kyi mgon po 'di cung zad bstan mod kyi/ der dbyings kyi cha las gzhan tshogs bdag tu bshad pa med pas 'di dang khyad che'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar gdul bya tha mal pa'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul drang don gyi sku dang / don dam gzigs pa kho na'i spyod yul nges don gyi sku ste/ zab pa dang gsal ba'i tshul gnyis tha dad ltar snang zhing ji ltar snang ba de ltar bshad pa ni gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs mkhas kyi rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang du byas te 'gro ba'i blo ngo dang bstun pa ste/ 'jig rten na mkhas pa rnams kyis gnas lugs dang snang lugs gnyis la bden pa gnyis su rnam bzhag byas pa dang bstun nas drang don kun rdzob dang / nges don don dam bden pa zhes kyang brjod do/ /510

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3gzhan du sangs rgyas nyid kyi gnas tshod dang sbyar na de gnyis zab pa dang mi zab pa'i tshul so sor bzhag tu med de/ mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das thob pa'i phyir ro/ /zab pa spangs pa'i gsal ba dang / gsal ba spangs pa'i zab pa ni rim bzhin rang don phun tshogs dang gzhan don phun tshogs las nyams pas drang don gyi mtha' dang nges don gyi mtha' zhes bya ste/ mtha'i sgra ni lhung du dogs pa'i zon bya dgos pa'i gnas la bya'o/ /mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i tshul dngos ni/ stong chen chos dbyings nyid ye shes kyi dngos po'am ngo bo nyid dang / ye shes de nyid kyi ngo bo spros pa med pa'i chos dbyings ka dag tu gnas te/dbyings dang ye shes de gnyis rnam pa thams cad du so sor mi phyed pas rdo rje dang / tshul de las gzhan du bsgyur du med pas nag po/ skra yang rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sku'i cha shas phra mo re yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i yon tan mtha' dag gi bdag nyid du bzhugs pas kun tu bzang po'i sku zhes bya'o/ /'dir ye shes zhes pa gnyis ni 'od gsal gyi stong cha la dbyings dang / gsal cha la ye shes zhes brjod pa'i ye shes te/ rang bzhin gsal ba lhun grub kyi ye shes zhes rdzogs chen snying thig nas 'byung ba de'o/ /de'ang khro gtum bzhin lag gi rnam pa can gyi 511

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/drang don gyi sku de dbyings kyi gsal mdangs nyid lha skur snang ba kho na yin pas sku de la ye shes kyi sgra sbyar ba ste/ 'dis ni chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis zung du 'jug tshul la go ba chen po ster ro/ /bzhi pa la bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phrin las spyir bshad pa dang / sngon byung dang sbyar nas bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/de ltar dang por drang don gyi nag po chen pos gdul bya rjes su bzung ste rim gyis nges don la sbyor zhing / mthar drang nges dbyer med kyi nag po chen po'i dngos grub stsol ba'i tshal gyis ༄bden pa gnyis kyi tshul chen rdzogs par ston pa po de ni brtan g.yo'i khyab bdag de bzhin gshegs pa gcig pu nyid yin pas de'i mdzad pa ni/ dngos grub 'byung gter las/ 'jig rten 'di na gang mkhas pa/ /tshangs pa la sogs dbang phyug rnams/ /mthu dang dam tshig ldan na yang / /khyod kyi spyod yul 'dra ba med/ /ces sogs ltar dregs pa tha mal pa rnams kyi 'gro ba dang grub pa'i khyad par las byung ba'i rnam 'phrul nyi tshe ba lta bu min gyi/ la lar zhi rgyas sogs rjes 'dzin dang / gzhan du rmongs rengs sogs tshar gcod kyi mdzad pa dang / de dang 'tsham pa'i sprul pa'i gzugs skad cig rer yang bsam mtha' yas shing dpag tu med pa gdul bya'i bden pa gnyis kyi dngos grub kyi don du so 512

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3sor blo la snang ste/ ji skad du/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pu'i nyams ni du ma'i gar mdzad do/ /zhes pa ltar rgyu dang mi rgyu'i rnam pa 'di ltar mi snang mi 'char zhes bya ba med pas snod bcud kyi chos rnams sna tshogs gang dang gang yang khyab bdag dpa' bo'i ye shes sgyu ma'i gar te rnam 'phral du mi 'gyar mchog mchir mjug snangar zir r+sātsho nor ba mad da/ /yang na dpag mad cas pa gdul bya la sbyar ra/ /spyod pa des sems can ci tsam 'dul zhe na/ ngan song sogs 'gro ba drug dang / lhag par bdud dang gshin rje sogs ma rungs pa'i sems can gyi tshogs mang po ste/ sdug bsngal che chung dang / grangs mang nyung / rang bzhin bzang ngan sogs kyi rnam dbye med par dus dang skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas te he ru ka'i sku dngos kyi gdul zhing dang / sprul pas 'dul ba'i yul ci rigs su 'gyur bas/ mdor na thams cad kyang gdul bya nyid du mtshungs so/ /nyid ni kho na'i don to/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang /don dam pa'i gshis la 'khor ba grub na gnyug ma'i rang bzhin la 'bral 'dod skye ba gnas min la log zhugs yin pas lus can rnams snying rje'i yul du mi rigs kyang / de lta ma yin te gshis nam mkha' ltar dag kyang slo bur ba'i las nyon gyi gzhan dbang du gyur cing / mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba'i tshang tshing stug por 513

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'khyams pa'i khams gsum gyi skye dgu 'di dag la snying rje'i 'os ma yin pa su zhig yod de/ /de'i phyir rgyal ba rnams kyi rtag pa rgyun gyi thugs rje'i yul du mnyam par gnas shing / thugs rje ji ltar 'jug pa de ltar 'gro ba 'dul thabs kyi spyod pa 'jug ste gzhan gyi rgyud rnam par grol bar byed do/ /de'ang khams dbang mos pa tshad med pa'i sems can de rnams spyod pa'i tshul gcig gis mi 'dul bas rnam 'phrul dang mdzad pa'i sgo sna tshogs de snyed bstan la/ mdzad pa re res kyang gzhal du med pa'i sems can rnam par 'dul te/ rgyan las/ phal cher don med don yod dang / /rnam kun don yod shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar rnam kun don yod kyi spyod pa mthar son pa'i phyir ro/ /gdul bya'i nyes pa glo bur ba yin du zin kyang 'dul ba'i thabs nye bar ston pa dang bral na rang grol bar mi 'gyur bas sems can yongs su sgrol ba de 'ba' zhig gi slad du theg gsum rnam par bzhag pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams byung ngo zhes phrin las mdzad pa'i 'thad pa bstan to/ / gnyis pa la gdul bya dang / 'dul byed bshad pa gnyis las/dang po la/ re zhig gdul bya ngos bzung ba ni/ bye brag lha ma yin ru tra zhes te/ ru tra ni drag po'i skad dod do/ /zhes sngon byol 514

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3song brgyud pa'i rgyu mthun gti mug lhag par che zhing yi dwags brgyud pa'i rgyu mthun 'dod zhen dra ba can no/ /mi srun bdud kyi rigs gtogs pas/ /zhe sdang che zhing dpa' rtsal che thag bzang ris sam rab dgod ni sgra gcan dang me tog phreng sogs lha ma yin chen po rnams kyi yang rje bo ste/ de'i bur skyes pas shin tu nga rgyal khengs sems che ba'o/ /nga rgyal dang khengs sems gnyis gnyis smos pa ni/ nga rgyal che la mang bar brjod pa'i ched do/ /lha'i dbang po'i dpal la 'gran sems 'byung ba ni/ de dang 'gran nus pa'i phyir ro/ /dkar phyogs lha la phrag dog rgod pa ni rang nyid nag po'i phyogs 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe sngon bsgrubs pa'i rgyu ni dka' thub drag po ste tshul khrims ngan pa dang / sbyin sreg la sogs sbyin gtong dang / log smon mang zhing shugs drag pas 'phen rdzogs ci ltar rigs par byas so/ /des na mnga' dbang ste dbang phyug che la/ stobs che/ mthu dang ldan no/ /klu srin mo zhes pa 'di'i ma klu dang srin po 'dus pa'i bu mo ste/ de ltar 'di klu las chad pas snying nag pa'am khon 'dzin che zhing /srin po las chad pas sha dang khrag la dga' ba'o/ /de'i ming ni khyab byed nag po dang / 'khrugs byed gtum po dang / phung byed drag po dang / gzhan gyis mi thub zhes bya bar grags so/ /bu ga 515

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dgu nas rlangs 'thul ba ni nad kyi bskal pa spro ba'i phyir gzhung don dngos/ mjug don gtad rgya zhar byung dang bcas pa'o /kha nas dug gi me 'bar ba ni dbugs tsha bas 'jig rten sreg pa'i phyir ro/ /yang sgra ni snga mar ma zad pa'o/ /lus la lcags kyi ba spu skyes pa ni re zhig 'di'i spu yang lcags kyi rang bzhin yin na lus thob par dka' ba lta ci smos pa'o/ /mig dmar lcags kyi mche ba can ni khro bo'i bzhin gzugs 'jigs su rung bar mtshon pa'o/ /de ltar na sngon gyi las dang rigs rus cho 'brang dang ming dang lus gzugs mi bzad pa'i khyad par brjod nas/ de ni des 'jig rten la dbang sgyur ba'i tshul ston te/ ma rung de yi bsam pa'i mthus/ /lha min gzhan dag rgyud rab 'khrugs/ /de yi las dbang dang rig sngags kyi mthu drag pos sngar med pa'i 'thab chas kyi mtshon cha mang po byung ste/ de'i phyir 'di dmag mang po dang ldan zhing dmag de dag kyang mtshon cha mang po dang ldan par gyur to//de las cir gyar zhe na/ 'byang po bye phrag dgu 'dus te/ dpung yig ༄shilan dge ra spre'i tshorazung chag zurags lha dbang rtong du rgal/ da'ang 'da' dpung rgyal chan ras bzhi la thug pa'i lha thams cad kyis mi bzod cing / brgya byin dbang dang bcas pa yang pham par bya ba la zhugs pa'o/ /des brgal bas lha rnams pham pa'i dbang shugs kyis mi rnams kyi 516

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3dkar po'i phyogs kyang nyams shing 'grib nas nag phyogs kha dar zhing nad mug 'khrugs rtsod sogs sdug bsngal gyi myos chus rgyud 'khrugs par 'gyur te/ lha dang chos ldan gyi mi gnyis gcig gis gcig 'phel bar byed cing / gcig la gcig mgon du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la dngos kyi gdul bya lha min drag po de 'khor bcas 'dul zhing / brgyud nas 'gro ba thams cad sdug bsngal las skyob phyir/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas grangs med kyi/ /thugs rje gcig 'dus spyan ras gzigs/ /de yi ye shes sgyu 'phrul las/ /byang ba'i mthu stobs dbang phyag che/ /zhes rtsa ba'i sprul gzhi skur cho gu /)sgo 1byeje/ rerwa( )ngordo /rte/bstan nas gas gang na sa bzung ba —/ / na ldan — mtshan nas smos pa ni/ khyab byed nag po ltar mthu stobs che yang phung khrol gyi gzhir song ba ma yin par srid zhi'i phan bde mtha' dag 'byung ba'i shes rab dang snying rje'i dpal mnga' bas dpal ldan/rdo rje theg pa'i bstan srung gi gtso bor dbang bskur brnyes pas rdo rje/ nag cir thung ba'i gzugs su snang yang stobs dang / spro ba dang gzi brjid kyis sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha nyi zla'i 'od zer can rnams las che ba ste mchog tu gyur pas nag po chen po/ lha'i dpung tshogs mtha' yas pa'i rje bor gyur pas tshogs rje tshogs kyi 517

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bdag po ste/ de byung ba'o/ /'di nyid gsang ba spu gri las legs ldan dbang phyug chen po'i sras dang / nag mo re ma ti'i ming bor bshad cing / bya rog mtshan can stobs po che/ /zhes kyang 'byung ste/ bya rog mtshan can ni phyag bzhi pa'i mtshan du yang grags so/ /yang bi na ya ka zhabs kyis brdzis pa dang / grong khyer sum brtsegs bcom pa dang / srin yul laṅka pu ri'i grong khyer bshig pa dang / lha ma yin gyi bu mo glog ma sprin rdul du brlags pa sogs myur mdzad phyag drug pa'i gtor chog las bshad pa rnams gsang spur las kyang mthun par 'byung bas phyag drug pa'i rnam 'gyur gcig tu byas kyang rung ba 'dra ste/ gnyis char spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul skur bshad pa dang yang 'grig go/ /drag po'i g.yul bshams pa'i tshul ni/ sku gsung thags kyi cho ///re ri bca ///)'phrul las shar ba las mgon ga sum sogs sprul pa yang sprul d+ngha mgon dmag mang po dang bcas me rlung 'tshub ma'i dkyil nas byon/ bing chen klad la bskor zhing dpa' bo'i bshug skad kyis brdas bskul bas bing gi rgya mdud las dmag dpung kha dog sna tshogs rdo rje'i ser drag ltar bzod par dka' ba bye ba dung phyur gdug pa'i mtshon char 'bebs shing 'thon te/ lhun po'i chu mtshams bar gyi nam mkha' rgyas par bkang ba'o/ /des ru tra 518

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3btul ba'i tshul ni/ lha min bdud kyi rgyal po bsgral ba ste bsad pa'o/ /de las phan yon gang byung ba ni/ lha dbang rgyal zhing des mthus dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba rnams dar bar gyur la/lus dang bsam pa'i dug gis snod bcud ma rung bar byed pa'i nag phyogs kyi klu sogs stobs bri bas/ 'jig rten srog chags bde ba dang / bstan pa la sdang ba rnams mthu chung du song bas sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdud 'dul dpa la ldan mgon po che/ bsten cing sgrub pa'i las rim dang / phrin las kyi sbyor ba mang po bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po'i mthus spyan ras gzigs kyis bshad pa'i dus mkha' 'gro mang pos bka' bsdu mdzad do/ /gsum pa ni/ de dag las snying po'i yang zhun bcud du dril ba'i snyan brgyud kyi man ngag lung gi snying po 'di mkha' 'gro su kha da ri ste bde ba 'dzin mas/ slob dpon chen po seng ge sgra sgrogs hanyid la gtad cing / des rdo rje phag mo'i sprul pa'i sku mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal dang / zhang sna nam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms gnyis la mon kha ne ring seng ge rdzong du gnang ba ste/ shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug ces dngos grub sgrub pa la rno nus gtugs pa med par bsngags so/ /'di dag gis ni gdams ngag khungs btsun pa 519

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang / gdams ngag las dngos grub 'byung ba brgyud ldan gyi bla ma la ltos par bstan to/ /mchod bsten sgrub gsum gang la bya ba'i lha'i rigs dang / byung tshul/ mdzad pa/ de nyid rnams kyi rgyus dang / bla ma brgyud pa sogs shes pa dang mi shes pas mgon gsol byed pa gnyis la snang ba dang mun pa la rdzas tshol ba lta bu'i khyad yod pas le'u 'di ni tshogs bdag mkhan po rnams la shin tu gces so/ /le'u dang po'i bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa lha'i rnam grangs dang rtsa ba'i sngags bshad pa la gnyis las/ dang po lha'i rnam grangs bstan pa la/ gtso bo/ yum/'khor gyi lha bshad pa ste gsum las/ dang po la/ ye shes dag pa'i lhar bstan pa ni/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thags rje chen po'i ye shes kyi sku gcig ༄pu/ 'jig rten kun la dus drug tu so sor gzigs pas spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces grags pa de nyid khro bo'i gzugs su sprul pa dur khrod kyi ma mo'i tshogs la sogs pa 'khor mang po'i mnga' bdag tu bzhugs pas tshogs bdag nag po'i gzugs kyis nag phyogs gzi byin 'phrog pas ma hā kā la ste nag po chen po ni'o/ /spyir sangs rgyas kyis sprul pa'i bstan srung chen po la yang dgos pa'i dbang gis las dang ye shes ltar shes lugs mang du 520

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3yod pa las/ 'dir ni sku'i ngo bo thugs rje chen po'i ye shes kyi de nyid dang sbyar bas mchog gi dngos grub ster ba'i byin rlabs kyi tshan che ba dang / rnam pa khro gtum 'bar ba'i gzugs su byas te cha byad phal cher phrin las kyi don dang sbyar bas bdud 'dul las kyi dngos grub 'byung ba'i khyad par dang ldan pa las/ re zhig phyogs dang po ston pa'i phyir le'u dang po'i/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas grangs med kyi/ /sogs kyi don slar yang bsdus te rkang pa snga ma 'di gnyis byung bar gsal lo/ /sku'i rnam pa'i khyad par/ 'jigs gzugs sprin nag 'khrigs pa lta bu ste/ char sprin ngam gnag la cher 'khrugs pa dang / glog dmar 'gyu bas spras pa dang / drag cang zab pa'i 'brug sgra dang ldan pa ltar/ mdog nag la cher khros shing 'khrugs pa dang /'bar ba'i me phreng gi nang na bzhugs pa dang / hūṃ gi nga ro zab mor dgod pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas tsan+dan gyi bing dang / g.yon thod khrag can/mchan khung g.yon du tri shul 'chang ba/ sag ti'i lham gsol zhing gyad kyi dor thabs su bzhengs pa/ dar ber nag po dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ bstan pa sna tshogs dang 'tsham par chos skyong ba'i phrin las mdzad pas chos gos dang dar dpyang stag sham sogs 521

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'chol ba'i chas gos 'chang ba ste/ 'di dag phrin las kyi don rtags su sbyor tshul zhib mo ni/ ral pa gyen brdzis nas gdan rdo rje brag chen la thug gi bar gyis sa gsum gyi dregs ldan mtha' dag las rnam par rgyal ba'i mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug brnyes pa mtshon tshul mnga' gsol chen mo sogs las shes par bya la/'dir phyag mtshan tsam mtshan gzhir smos na/ bing dang thod khrag gnyis po rim bzhin gshin rje dang ma mo rnams kyis che rtags su phul ba dang lha dmag spros nas pha rol gyi g.yul zlog cing /dgra'i snying khrag rol bar mtshon la/ thod khrag 'di ma mo'i khrag thun du bshad pas/ dgra sde nad kyis myos par byed pa la'ang sbyar rung ngo / /gsung sgros dang bstun na/ phyag mtshan thugs mtshon byed yin pas thabs dang shes rab kyi phyag rgya ste/ bing gis snang phyogs lha'i gsang mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / thod khrag gis stong phyogs bde chen rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mtshon te/ 'di ni mchog gi de nyid la sbyar ba'o/ /rtse gsum ni/ 'di nyid las/ rtse gsum mtshon chas khams gsum g.yul ngo zlog /ces so/gnyis pa ni/ de yi yum ni rdo rje gnod sbyin mo bai tā li zhes thal byed ma'am ro lang ma ste/ 'di 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i 522

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3gzugs 'gyur du las gzhung las bshad pas tshogs bdag rnying mar/ spyi bor zla ba tshes shing lte bar nyi ma 'char ba zhes bshad pa'ang / re ma ti'i thad du de ltar 'byung ba dang mthun no/ /gsum pa ni/ gtso bo'i sku las sprul pa'i mgon po tri shul can dang / gsung gi bing can dang / thugs kyi gri gug can te rim bzhin/ nag po stong / gshin rje 'bum/ ma mo bye ba rnams kyi sde dpon las byed kyi mgon po gsum dang / phyogs skyong la spyir mang du yod pa las/ 'dir mgon po nyid phyogs so sor rnam 'gyur gzhan dang gzhan gyis skyong zhing bzhugs pa la mtshan tha dad du grags pa'i phyogs bcu'i mgon po dang / sogs sgras bstan pa dregs pa'i rigs phal cher/ 'jig rten na rigs spyod pas dbye zer ba ltar drag po'i las thabs mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas rigs kyi sde tshan brgyad du bsdus nas bzhag pa/ dmod pas bsdigs pa lha/ khram la 'debs pa gshin rje/ rims nad spro ba ma mo/ mun 'thib byed pa bdud/ smyo 'bog gtong ba rgyal po/gzer thabs gtong ba btsan/ gdug rtsub sna tshogs ston pa gnod sbyin/ zha rengs mdze nad gtong ba klu ste de dag gi gtso bo rnams mgon dmag gi sdebs su gnas pa na mgon po'i sde tshan du bsdus nas sde brgyad kyi mgon po zhes bzhag pa dang / gzhan 523

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yang phyogs skyong gi 'khor sogs mgon po lha dmag bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa la/ sngags kyi che ba/ sngags dngos/ de'i phan yon dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhan yang gi sgra srog snying ni zhes pa dang sbyor ba gsung sgros yin pas/ gzhan yang brjod par bya'o zhes drang ngo / /ci zhig ce na/ srog gi snying po'i sngags ni'o/ /ci 'dra ba zhig ce na/ ji skad bshad pa'i lha rnams kyi sngags rgyud khri 'bum dung phyur zhes mang po yod de/ de dag gi bcud 'dus pa'i mar gyi yang zhun lta bu'o/ /yang na lha dmag gcig nas gcig tu sprul te mang por mched pa'i rgyud la lha rgyud ces bya ste/de ltar na sa ra has/ 'khor rnams gtso bo'i yan lag phyir/ /tha dad par ni bzla mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sprul pa'i lha dmag rnams gtso bo nyid las mi gzhan pas gtso bo'i sngags la 'khor rnams kyang 'dus par dgongs shing / der ma zad sde brgyad dregs pa gzhan rnams kyi sngags kyang sngags 'di'i mnga' 'og tu 'dus pa ste/ de rnams la mgon po'i sngags kyi 'khor du so so nas phul ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngags de gang zhe na/ oṃ yig mchog ster ba/shrī ni dpal te/ rtogs pa bdag gi dang / thugs rje gzhan gyi 524

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3dpal gnyis stong phyogs dang snang phyogs kyi ma hā kā la gnyis dang rim bzhin sbyar ro/ /ma hā kā la ni nag po chen po ste/ sngar bshad pa'i drang don snang phyogs dang / nges don stong phyogs kyi nag po gnyis dang / chos dbyings nyid de ye shes dngos/ / sogs kyis bstan pa'i zang 'jug gi nag po rnams so/ /hūṃ ༄thug sa bskul ba/ phaṭa gdug pa can rnams khos shig pa ste khyad par gyi mdzad pa'o/ /rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ hūṃ 'joms par gyis shig dang / phaṭa ltung bar gyis shig par gsungs so/ /sngar nag po chen po phrin las dang bcas pa'i rnam bzhag rgyas par bshad pa nyid sngags don 'di'i yang rgyas bshad du 'gyur bas dran par bya'o/ /de'ang sngags tshig 'dis don de ltar ston zhes pa rkyang par mi gzung gi/ sngags don de dag nyid sngags sgra'i rnam par shar bar go dgos te/ sngags kyi dngos grub ster ba'i gnad che shos ni lha sngags ngo bo dbyer med du shes pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ rig sngags thabs kyi ngo bo ste/ /gzungs sngags shes rab ngo bo yin/ /gsang sngags gnyis med ye shes so/ /zhes rgyud drangs pa ltar ram/ yang na lha pho'i rnam pa can gyi gsang sngags dang / mo'i rnam pa can gyi rig 525

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sngags dang gzungs sngags gnyis te/ de gsum gyi bye brag mang pos dngos grub la dbang bsgyur ba'i sngags kyi rgyal po 'di nyid gang zhig 'chang ba de ni nges par 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi g.yul las rgyal te sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de'ang sngags kyi sgra tsam 'don pa gcig pus mchog gi dngos grub la sbyor ba ni min gyi/ sngags de'i de nyid shes nas 'chang ba'i gnad la thug go/ /de'i tshul ni shrī ma hā kā la'i nges don sngar bshad pa nyid rang gi gnyug sems mi shiṭa pa'i dbyings las gzhan du med par thag bcad de bzlas sgom la 'grus par byas pas lha dang sgrub pa po'i srog ro gcig tu 'dres te ye shes mchog gi dngos grub stsol la/ des dgra gsum/ bdud bzhi/ g.yang sa drug la 'jigs pa med pa'i gdeng chen rnyed pa ni khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dngos grub ces bya'o/ /sngar ga na pa ti'i nges don bshad pa'ang cir snang dbyings kyi rgyan du shar ba'i nyams myong gi thog tu ngo 'phrod pa dgos mod kyi/ de ni rig pa dbyings mal nas mi g.yo ba ma hā kā la'i de nyid kho na'i stobs las 'ong bar zad pas logs su btsal mi dgos so/ /'di dag gi gnad rnams rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag las rgyas par bshad mod/ snga 'gyar bka' babs kyi chu bo bzhi'i skabs su/ phyag bzhes phrin ༄526

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3sgrub kyi chu bo bstan srung drag sngags dang bcas pa/ zhes bstan srung gi chos skor 'di rnams bskyed rim gyi gdams pa'i phyogs su gsungs pas rgyas par ma spros so/ /le'u gnyis pa legs par bshad zin to/ /gsum pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa la/sgrub pa po dang gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan ma'i rten dang yo byad 'du bya tshul bsnyen sgrub rtags tshad dang bcas pa/ grub nas las la sbyar ba'i rim pa ste bzhi/ dang po ni/ dngos brgyud kyi bla ma dang / lha dang gdams ngag la yid ches pa'i dad pa dang dam tshig dag pa dang ldan pa ste/ dam tshig ni dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang / rgyun gyi gsol kha dang /tshes brgyad dang bco lnga dang nyer dgu'i dus gtor la brtson pa dang / sku gzugs dang sngags dang rdzas sogs gsang ba dang /bya nag dang khyi nag la mi 'tshe zhing / lhag par mgon po'i rgyud las/ sgrub pa po rnams skyong ba'i tshe/ /bya rog chen pos srung bar byed/ /ces pas bya rog chen po mi skrod pa sogs mgon po'i sgos kyi dam tshig rnams te/ 'dis ni dbang thob pa'ang ston to/ /thags rje chen po zhi drag sogs rang gi lha'i bsnyen sgrub kyi rnal ༄'byor las su rung ba'i sngags pas rgyal bstan srung ba dang /527

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sems can yongs sa bskyab pa'i phyir nag po chen po bsten cing ༄sgrub par 'dod na zhes pa ste/ bsam pa'i khyad par 'di lta ra dgos pa ni mgon po nyid kyi byung tshul la brtags na shes so/ /gnas ni mtsho gling dang nags tshal brag nag po'i 'gram mam/dur khrod dang / gzhan yang rab tu 'jigs pa'i dben rtsa ru'o//gnyis pa ni/ g.yul bkye ba'i sa dang / phung shul gyi sa sogs gdug pa'i sa las maṇ+ḍal byas la/ der tshon gnyis gang rung gis 'khor lo nag po rtsibs bcu pa/ de'i nang du gru gsum mthing nag logs gcig mdun dang / zur cig rgyab tu bstan pa bris pas zla gam gsum yang grub bo/ /de'i dbus su bhan+dha gling ste dum bu gsum pa'i nang du dur khrod kyi ras la nag po chen po'i sku bris la bshams shing / de dang lhan cig tsan+dan gyi bing gi mgul bar dar nag la sngags bris pa byang bu gdags shing smyug ma tshigs lnga pa'i mda' bzang rgod sgro ma la dar sna lnga dang gser g.yu btags pas brgyan te/ de la srog rten gyi tsakra 'dogs shing bzhag go/ /tsakra 'bri ba'i gzhi ni ras sam shing shun la'o/ /rgyu ni snag tshas so/ /de'ang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar srog snying 'bru brgyad pa ste rtsa sngags 'god pa ni/ lho byang du drang por 'bri ba yin zhing / rtsibs brgyad la rtsa sngags re'i mthar dz+nyā na 528

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3dang / kā ya dang / wak+ka dang / tsit+ta dang / gu ṇa dang / karma dang / sa ma ya dang / sarba ste brgyad po re re zhing sidzhai pha la rgyu re sbyar ba so sor btags la 'bri/ de'i rgyab kyi mu khyud dag la gang 'dod kyi gsol byang dang / rten 'brel snying po 'bri zhing / phyi rol du rdo ra me ri byas na'ang legs gsung ngo/ /srog 'khor de mgon po'i sku gzugs kyi lto bar bkod pa'i lto 'khor byas na lhag par byin rlabs che'o/ /gsang rdzas gsum ni/ dug dang / khrag dang / lcags phye rnams te ma dag dug gsum dang / dag pa sku gsung thug sa mtshon pa'o/ /de dang bdud rtsi chos sman ni tsakra la byug pa'i rdzas so/ /rab gnas ni/ spyi'i rigs pa sbyar na sngags 'khor 'od dpag med kyi rigs yin pas de'i lhag gnas byas kyang rung bar mngon mod/ phyag bzhes su mgon po nyid bskyed bsnyims sogs mdzad nas gnang bas de ltar bya/ dar snas dril la gdag go/ /gzhan yang nas nag rjen btags gi ngar phye khrag chang gis sprul pa las mgon po'i gtor ma 'di nyid kyi rgyud las/bshos bu snying 'dra gtor mar bshams/ /ngos gsum bā ling gsum du bzhag /ces sogs ltar bzhengs shing / nad sha dang sna bug gi sha dang god sha rnams ma gtogs pa'i sha sna tshogs kyi gtor rdzas dang / pho rgyud skyur la brid pa/ mo rgyud dmar la 529

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dbab pa zhes bshad pas chang dang khrag sogs bskang gzhung nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs bzang mang du bsham par bya ste/rdzas dngos ma 'byor pa rnams ri mo'i gzugs su byas pa tsam yang dgod do/ /gsum pa la/ mchod bsten sgrub gsum bya tshul spyir bshad/bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags so sor dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid bsgom pa'i he ru ka'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu'i cho 'phrul las mdun du rin po che'i ri rab kyi steng gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i pho brang gi dbus su cho ga gsum gyis gtso bo dang / de'i g.yon phyogs dang / gru gsum gyi rgyab tu zla gam gsum la sa bon gyi yi ge las yum dang sku gsung thugs mgon bskyed cing / ri rab kyi bang rim rnams la phyogs bcu'i mgon po sogs 'khor gzhan rnams nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du bskyed/ de ltar bsgom pa'i lha rnams la sems rtse gcig tu bzung ste lhar snang gyad du gyar //ste/ //bye( //bye( 13wa/ rig papar slob pa sku srog 'phrog pa gnad do/ /'a skun pa dang btags pas srog nas drang zhing bos te dngos grub kyi don du snyan gsan 'bebs pa'i tshul gyis sngags dag cing sel ma zhugs par bzlas brjod nan tan du bya ba ni gsung gi srog 'phrog pa'i gnad do/ /lha dang sngags kyi nges don la sems sre zhing mnyam par 530

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3'jog pa ni thugs kyi srog 'phrog pa'i gnad do/ /'od zer spro bsdus phrin las kyi rtsa la sbyong ba dang 'di bzhi la srog sdom gyi gzer bzhi zhes bya ste/ med du mi rung bar gsang rdzogs kyi rgyud las/ ye shes 'jig rten gang sgrub kyang / /srog sdom gzer bzhis ma thebs na/ /drang don rdzun gyi 'khrul 'khor yin/ /nam yang don med yug sa rkyang / /zhes so/ /'jig rten mchod bstod kyi sgrub par gtogs pas thun mtshams kun tu mchod bstod la 'bad pa gces te/ tshul de lta bus bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags mthong ba'i bar du brtson/ de'i yan lag tu lha dang bdag gnyis bde ba chen po'i dam rdzas kyi ston mo la lhan cig spyod pa'i sgo nas phan tshun dga' bas 'dris shing yid phebs pa'i grogs su sgrub pa tshogs mchod dang / lha dang 'khon gcug sbyong zhing dam tshig gso ba'i ched du skong bshags dang / lha tshim zhing mnyes par byed pa gtor ma'i las rim che chung rnams bya'o/ /gzhan yang zhal du gyar pa'i me zhes lha tshim pa'i zhal lam sgo phul du byang ba ni me lha rami 11re///bye( shāwa/rdo/bye/mi /jisnye/ste/ sgo nas lha dang sngags gzi byin skyed pa chi da du snen sreg bya ste/ de'ang thab nag po gru gsum par tsher ma can gyi shing gis hom byas la/ rgyu de dang 'dra ba'i yam shing dang / rtsi mar khrag sbyar gyi mar khu dang / sha sna lnga sbyar ba'i ril bu/ nas nag 531

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang bra bo sogs 'bru sna dgu ste rdzas de rnams la bya'o/ /de la gtor chog ni bsnyen sgrub kyi dus kun tu bya zhing / tshogs dang skong bshags ni bsnyen pa'i skabs ci rigs dang / sgrub dus nar mar bya la/ sbyin sreg ni sgrub pa'i mthar byas na legs par sems so/ /de ltar zhag bdun phrag gsum la sogs par thang lhod med par rgyun chags su brtson pa dang / sems gzhan du ma yengs par rtse gcig tu brtson pa ste khyad par gnyis ldan du bslabs pas thugs rtags su rnal 'byor pa'i rig pa sngar las dwangs pa dang / sku rtags su lha'i zhal dngos sam mi nag dang mun pa nag po sogs kyi rnam par mthong ba dang / gsung rtags su sngags kyi sgra sogs gsung thos pa ste dngos nyams kyi rtags dang /rmi ltas ya mtshan chen po 'byung ba yang / sku nye ba'i mtshan mar mkhar brtsigs pa/ thags nye ba'i nyi zla shar ba/ gsang gi rol riri pho risibargya mo 'bud dkrol te bsnyen pa'i rtags dang / dngos grub 'byung ba'i mtshan mar gter rnyed pa sgrub pa'i rtags te dngos bstan bzhi dang / sogs sgras phyag mtshan rnyed pa dang / skye bo mang pos 'dud pa sogs sdud de/ de dag kyang lan re tsam la nges pa med kyang / yang dang yang du 'byung na byin rlabs kyi rtags so/ /gang yang dga' brod dang mngon rlom ma zhugs par bden med rtogs 532

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3pa'i rtsal sbyong du 'khyer ba gces so/ /mtshan ma 'di dag ni/gzhung rang las/ 'grub rtags rdzogs nas rbad pa ni/ /zhes gsungs shing / sbas pa mig 'byed las/ mtshan ma ma mthong las brtsams pa/ /'ja' tshon spar 'dzin don med yin/ /zhes rtags mthong gi nus pa ma rnyed bar du las la mi bkol bar gsungs pas nus pa de gtan la 'bebs pa'i ched du bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngon du dngos grub sgrub nus kyi nus pa ma thon par dngos grub kyi las gang yang byar med la/ lha dang sgrub pa po nye bar ma gyur na dngos grub kyi nus pa skye ba'i gzhi med pas/ lha nye bar byed pa'i bsnyen pa dang / dngos grub kyi nus pa skyed pa'i sgrub pa dang / las dngos su sgrub pa'i las sbyor te gsum po rim bzhin rdzing rko ba dang / chu skyil ba dang / rdzing chu zhing la 'gyed pa dang 'dra bar bla ma dgongs 'dus su gsungs so/ /re zhig las dngos su mi byed kyang las sbyor gyi sngags la bzlas pa skyel ba tsam ni sgrub pa'i khongs su 'du'o/ /de la bsnyen pa'i sngags ni nag po chen po'i 'bod sngags/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsit+ta sogs te 'di ni srog snying gi gnad la bzang ste dgug cing tshad med bzhi'i phyag ༄rgyas dbang du byed pa'i sngags yin pas lha myur du nye bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /533

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgrub pa'i khyad par gyi sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la sidzhai sogs te/'di la tshogs bdag rnyed mar rlung ltar myur ba'i snying po zhes bshad pa ltar dngos grub myur mgyogs su 'beb pa rlung gi shugs can sngags yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bsnyen dus rtags mtshan med par ring du 'gyangs nas sngags snga ma dang / sgrub dus dngos grub mi 'gyangs par byed pa la phyi ma bzla zhes de gnyis char rno la ngar 'dogs lta bur bshad pa 'di'i shugs la bsnyen sgrub gnyis ka'i skabs su mthil bcol yul gyi sngags gzhan yod par ston te/ de ni le'u gnyis pa nas gsungs pa'i rtsa sngags 'bru brgyad nyid do/ /bsnyen sgrub gnyis kyi dzab dgongs la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mi gsal yang / las gzhung du 'byung ba'i bzlas dmigs nyid la/bsnyen pa'i tshe bdag gi 'od kyis mgon po 'khor bcas kyi thags ༄rgyud bskul ba dang / sgrub pa'i tshe 'od zer dang sprul pa'i pho nyas dngos grub kyi las rnams yid bzhin sgrub pa gtso bor byed pa'i cha phyes na legs sam snyam mo/ /sgrub sngags kyi cha gzhan bstan pa ni/oṃ gyis mgo drangs/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ a yu sirji zhes pa tshe'i dngos grub/ hūṃ bskul ba/ r+ghaṃ brtan par byed pa ste/ sbrel bas che'i sgrub sngags so/ /'di'i dmigs gnad kyang bshad ma thag pa'i sgrub pa'i dzab dgongs nyid kyi khog nas 'phrul zhes 534

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3gsung ngo / /de ltar dngos grub bskyil ba'i tshul du sgrub sngags gong ma dang / dngos grub dbang du bya ba'i tshul du tshe sngags bzlas pas dngos grub kyi rtags mtshan nges par 'byin la/ de'i tshe dngos grub blang bar bya ste/ len tshig ni dbang chog gi dngos grub bcud dbang dang / 'chi med rdo rje'i dbang tshig sbyar na rung bar rtogs so/ /bzhi pa la/ las sgrub sngags kyi rnam grangs spros te bshad pa dang / rtsa sngags gcig pus las thams cad nus par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i bka' sdod 'di rnams dmag dpon rin po che ltar drag po'i mtha dpung gi sgo nas chos kyi rgyal srid srang ba'i /rdotā //spri/ rig mi //bye/ //bye 11nge/dming na las — lha ste/ bstan srung zhes pa ni sgra sna don yang yin no//lhag par mgon po mngon 'byung gi skabs las tshul 'di rgyas par shes te sngar bshad zin to/ /de'i phyir drag sngags kho na dang 'brel bar ston la/ drag sngags la'ang dbye bskrad rmongs rengs sogs kyis dbye bas spyir mtha' yas kyang / 'dir ni srung ba'i go bgo ba dang / drag po'i g.yul 'gyed pa gnyis/ phyi ma la'ang /g.yul bsres pa'i dgra rnams mtshon chas 'joms pa dang / ma bsres par thag ring na bsham/sa pa'i dpung rnams phyir zlog pa'i tshul du bsad bzlog gnyis te gsum dang / srung ba dang byed 535

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las mthun pa mnan pa'i las kyis dgra btson du bzung ba/ zlog pa dang mthun pa rlung la skur ba zor las kyis dgra dpung gtor ba/bsad pa dang mthun pa me'i las kyis phas rgol thal bar byed pa ste/rtsa ba srung zlog bsad gsum/ mtha' sdud mnan sreg 'phang gsum du dbye zhing / g.yul 'gyed kyi dang por dmag dpung bsdu zhing las la mngag pa dgos pa ltar bsad bzlog gnyis ka'i sngon du 'bod rbad 'gro bas de ltar brgyad do/ /de la sngags gtso bo yin pas dkyus su de tsam las ma smos kyang / de bzla thabs su ting nge 'dzin med na phrin las kyi dgos pa byed mi nus pas sngags dang dgongs pa sbrel nas brjod na/ dgongs pa la/ las kun la thun mong du 'jug pa dang / so so'i sgos kyi ting nge 'dzin gnyis las snga ma ni/ gnas lugs zab mo rtogs pa lta ba'i rdzong dang / yi dam lha'i snang zhen brtan pa sgom pa'i 'phrang gnyis so/ /phyi ma ni rang rang gi thad du 'chad de/ de'ang 'bod pa'i sngags ni bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad zin te/ 'di la 'bod sngags kyis dang por bsnyen pa dang / slar rbad bsad kyi ched du 'bod pa gnyis po'i cha byed dgos so/ /rnal 'byor rang srung gi gsang sngags ni ma ma rak+ṣa sogs te/ bzla thabs kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag 'khor yo byad thams cad 536

ca/bo/na dzesa'o/ snyan brgyu/da ༷/nga snying ro/na bshad/ casaḥd/miX4srung skyob g.yel med du mdzad pas 'jigs pa gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed par bsam pa ste/ 'di la khyad par gyi srung dmigs ches zab pa'ang yod do/ /nag po las la rbad pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la dgra la bh+yo sogs te/ ting 'dzin ni/ bdag gi 'od kyis mgon po 'khor bcas bskul bas de rnams shin tu rngams shing 'khrugs te/ cho 'phrul kyi 'od dang / las byed sprul pa'i pho nya grangs med pa spros/ dgra bgegs gang yin rang dbang med par bkug nas 'chor ba'i skabs med par bsam pa ste/ 'di'i skabs su dmigs pa'i 'ben bca' ba gces so/ /de ltar nan tan du bzlas pas dmag dang chom rkun ling pa chas pa sogs srung ma las byed pa'i rtags dang / srog chags rnyis bzung ba dang / ra bar bcug pa sogs bla khug pa'i rtags mthong ba na bsad las la 'jug pa yin no/ /mi mthun 'gal rkyen bzlog pa'i sngags ni/ mā ra thun bh+yo sogs te shin tu gsang ba'i sngags nyid do/ /ting 'dzin ni mgon po gtso 'khor las sprul ba'i khro bo'i dmag dpung dang / mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi bu yug phyogs bcur spros te/ gnod byed thams cad 'thor rlung chen po phog pas na bun rjes med du yal ba ltar phyir zlog gi phrin las mdzad par bsam pa'o/ /drag sngags kyi gtso bo bsad pa 537

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las kyi sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la dgra bo'i snying 'byin sogs te/sngags 'di'i che ba ni/ nag po dgra bo'i gshed de mngon spyod kyi don du gzugs skur bzhengs pa yin pas bsad sngags 'di dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa byed pa rnams la dmigs nas rgyun du cung zad re bzlas na mgon po nye zhing phrin las myur te/mi rnams rang gi rigs chos kyi las la lhag par dga' ba bzhin te/rgyud las/ khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ /bsod la rtag tu brtson pa rnams/ /grub pa mchog gi chos can la/ /gsod pa'i don gyis grub par 'gyar/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /ting nge zurigatsho zu rig zu rig rami la /)(1'jan na/ sbyar khu rdul rlung gsum la gca phal mang du da pa las sems kyi rten byed pa'i gnad che shos rnams tshe rten dang /de rnams phan tshun phan 'dogs pa'i nus pa ma nyams pas rnam shes dang tshogs pa gcig tu gnas pa'i cha la tshe zhes btags pa dang / tshe rten gyi nus pa 'dzin cing skyed sdud byed pa'i srog 'dzin gyi rlung sogs srog dang / lus stod smad na gnas pa'i khams kyi cha rnams la 'gro 'ong gi tshul du nus pa 'pho ba'i bla dang /de'i gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du lhan cig skyes pa'i lha g.yag dang sha ba la sogs par sprul pa yang bla chags shing sbed pa'i rten phur yin pas bla zhes 'dogs te/ de dag la sgrub pa pos drag sngags 538

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3 kyi mtshon chas gzir zhing bsnun pa na bla'i rten mkhar bcom/ tshe rten dang srog gi gnad bcad/ dbang yul shes gsum gyi 'brel ba bkum/ rnam shes dbyings su bsgral te/ che'i 'khrul 'khor rang dbang med par bshigs nas las ngan gyi rgyun bstung bar byed pa'i rnam bzhag legs par shes pas/ mgon po'i lha dmag rnams las gri gug dgra sta/ rtse gsum/ tho phur sogs sprul pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char babs pas dgra bgegs kyi bla srog brag rul la thog brgyab pa ltar thal byung du brlags par bsam pa'o/ /bsad rtags ni/ srog chags bsad pa dang / ri brag bshigs pa sogs so/ /'bod pas dam can 'du ba'i rtags ma mthong bar las la rbad na khyi med par sha ba la 'gyed pa lta bu dang / rbad pas bla khug pa'i rtags ma mthong bas bsad las byed na ri dwags med par mda' 'phen pa lta bu yin zhing / 'bod rbad kyi rtags rdzogs kyang bsad las btang snyoms su lus pa dang / bsad rtags thon yang las kyi 'phro mi brtul bar phur tshugs phyed pa'ang lha dang 'khon 'jug cing rang la ldog par bshad pas mtshams legs par zin pa gal che la/ rtags tshad med kyang 'bod rbad bsad gsum chu 'babs su byed pa ni las sbyor gyi 'dra 'bag tsam mo/ /las sngags 'di dag gi nang na lhag par rnyed dka' ba ni 539

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/srung zlog gi sngags gnyis te/ 'bod rbad sogs ni/ tshogs bdag mkhan po spyi la rlung ltar grags shing / 'di'i las gzhung du yang gsal bar bstan kyang / 'di gnyis sbas nas ma bshad pas shin tu gsang bas rang nyams su blang bar bya ste/ 'chol bar byin na rno nus chung du 'gro ba yin no/ /dgra bo bsad pa'i las sgrub na yan lag tu zor sgrub kyi sngags 'di yang 'dren dgos te/ shrī nag po kha thun sogs so/ /ting nge 'dzin ni/ zor thun rnams gdug pa tshar gcod reg phung gi mtshon sna tshogs su blta ba'o/ /gzhan yang drag sngags spu gri dmar po zhes bya ba yod de/'di ni dgra bo'i srog gshed do/ /de'ang / oṃ nas/ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ste/ 'di ni bsad sngags kyi snying po lta bur snang zhing / dgra'i sems 'phrog pa la lhag par mtha che ba thags zhe ༄ ༄sdang rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin 'a joms byed chen po'i yi ger snang ba hūṃ rno sor yod pas khyad par du 'phags te/ tshogs las su 'di nyid srog phur 'debs pa'i sngags dang / bsang sngags gong ma sgrol gris liṅga gtub pa'i sngags su gsungs pas dgra srog gi gnad gcod pa dang / rten gzhi'i phung po sgrol ba'i sngags kyi khyad par du mdzad la/ mnan gzhung ltar na/ gong ma bsad thun sgrub pa'i sngags dang / 'di nyid thun gyis bsad pa'i sngags te 540

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3— gang ltar yang dgra srog 'phrog pa'i sngags dngos 'di la byed par mthun no/ /dgra bo ldang med mnan pa'i las byed na/ de'i sngags ni/ oṃ nas/ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ zhes pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin ni/mnan snod rnams lcags 'bar ba'i khang sgrom du dgra bo tshud pa la/r+ghaṃ hūṃ me te so so'i yi ge las byung ba'i 'khor lo nag po rtsibs brgyad pa dang / rdo rje rgya gram gyis steng nas mnan/ bskal pa'i mun pas g.yogs pas thar ba'i skabs med par bsam pa'o/ /'bar ba me'i las kyi drag sngags ni/ oṃ nas/ dz+wa la ram̐ mā ra ya phaṭa ces pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin ni/ drag po'i me lha'i lto bar mgon po 'khor bcas bskyed de/ gang la bya ba'i dgra bgegs dngos su bkug nas/ gson por ma hā kā la'i zhal du song bas rtsa sbur me nang du bcug pa lta bur bsam pa'o/ /sngags 'di dag legs sbyar kho nar ma nges pa ni/ nag po chen ngo/ nyid yul sna tshogs na bstan pa'i don byed cing bzhugs pa ltar/ drag sngags kyang yul sna tshogs kyi skad du byin gyis brlabs pa yod pas/'dir yang lha rang gi rtsa ba'i skad legs sbyar dang / gdul bya nye ba bod yul pa'i skad gnyis 'dres mar bstan pa yin nam snyam ste/mang du spros pas chog go/ /ji skad smos pa'i drag sngags de rnams la brten nas so so'i las sgrub tshul man ngag gis rgyas par phye ba 541

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ni tshogs las dang gtor chog sogs snyan brgyud 'di'i rgyas bshad kyi yi ge logs su bzhugs pa rnams las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ drag sngags kyi bye brag de ltar cung zad phye ste bshad mod kyi/ thams cad kyi rtsa ba yig 'bru brgyad pa'i sngags gcig nyid gang la gang dgos su spro bsdu'i dmigs pa'i lde kha bsgyur na yang bzlas sgom gyi nus pa cher son pa'i sngags pas las de thams cad dang / der ma zad zhi rgyas sogs gzhan yang ci 'dod kyi las kun 'grub par 'gyur te/ srog sdom gzer bzhi'i 'phro 'du'i gzer gyi skabs su/ 'phro 'du'i gzer ni dmigs pa yi/ /sgyur kha shes na 'dod dgur 'grub/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phro 'du yis/ /sems kyi nus pa rtsal rdzogs te/ /gang ltar bsam pa de ltar snang / /dper na nor bu gcig nyid la/ /mchod gsol rkyen gyis bye brag tu/ /ji ltar 'dod pa so sor skong / /zhes sogs gsang rdzogs rang shar gnyis ka las gsungs pa bzhin no//rtsa ba'i sngags su 'jog tshul la/ /spyir gsang ba sgyu 'phrul las/rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags zhes gsungs pa lta bu gzhan yang yod kyang / 'dir drag sngags gzhan thams cad kyi mthu dang byed las sngags 'di la 'dus shing / 'di gzhir bzung ste/ de'i byed las kyi cha shas re rtsal du bton nas so sor nus pa 'byin pa la gzhan 542

mgon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ pod/ 3rnams gyes pas/ 'di la bzlas pa ma 'khyol bar gzhan bzlas kyang dngos grub kyi las mi byed la/ 'di legs par grub pa nyid kyis 'dir bstan drag sngags lhag ma thams cad kyang 'bad med du 'a grub pas bzhag par mngon no/ /gsum pa mjug don gtad rgya la/ dngos dang / zhar byung ngo / /dang po ni slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu'i rgya bod paṇa grub gnam gyi skar tshogs ltar mang ba zhal dngos su bzhugs pas bsil ljongs skal bar ldan pa'i dus su sngags pa rnga rdung phreng thogs kyi rgyal por yongs su grags pa sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis snyan brgyud las dpe la ma bkod par mdzod sbugs kyi gces nor bzhin du snying la 'chang ba'i man ngag yin pas phyi rabs kyi skal ldan rnams kyis yal bar ma 'dor bar srid zhi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas gcig pu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba'i don gyi slad du nyams su longs shig ces gdams pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/le'u gsam pa ste/ legs par bshad zin to/ /sprul pa'i gter ༄ston las rab gling pas bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ra sa 'phrul snang gi nye 'khor pho brang chen po po ta lar/ sngon gu ru rin po che'i spyan sngar smon lam gtad rgya thun mong ma yin pa thob pa'i rgyu 543

pod/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang / 'dir nges don ma hā kā la dngos su mjal zhing / rang byung 'phags pa lo ki shwa ri'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i rkyen la brten nas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter du byung ba ltar lhag chad 'khrul pa'i nyes pas ma sbags par bris pa dge legs kyi 'byor pa tshad med pa 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig ces pa'o /rjod byed bong thung brjod bya sbom la rgyags/ /drag po sngags kyi lag stobs shin tu brling / /byin rlabs gzi chen 'bar ba'i man ngag gi/ /gyad 'dis thub bstan rgyal khab srung bar nus/ /tshul 'dir bdag gis ji bzhin min bshad pa'i/ /dri mas sbags rnams 'phags mchog spyan sngar 'chags/ /bsod nams gang thob stobs bcu mnga' ba yi/ /chos tshul 'dzin dang srang ba'i rgyu ru 1(tho/chen 1(1hāX/ ra༄mi:de//rje/ shā)(bsngo/ /nag —na man ngag snyan brgyud lung (nga po don cung zad bshad pa bdud dpung byer 'thag rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'phrul 'khor zhes bya ba/ gter chen bla ma nyid kyi bkas gnang ba thob pa la brten te/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas chu glang dbo zla'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa dmag dpon g.yul las/ rgyal ba'i 'phrod sbyor bzang po'i snga dro la rdzogs par byas pa mchog tu dge bar gyur cig /maṅga lo// //544

pod 3bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/de yang mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad las/ rma rol dang /smar rol/ rdo rol/ zla rol sogs su gtso bor chags pa'i lcags mo mgo log pa 'di dag yongs grags ltar na phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i mjug ste bod rab byung bdun pa tshugs ma thag tsam la khams 'gu kho lung nas gnas spo byas te/ da lta'i mgo log pad+ma rdzong gi sa cha gtso bor gyar ba'i rdo 'dzi smar gsam gyi nodang rig meyul gru bdag gir byas nas ring du ma song ba na/ mgo log phag thar gyi sras su kaḥthog bla ma byang chub seng ge'i thugs zin gyi slob bu mkhas shing grub pa'i bdag nyid chen po mgo log bla ma chos 'bum bya ba 'khrungs pas dbu bzung / rim bzhin kar rnying bstan pa'i sgron me karma yongs 'dzin chen po dang / zhwa nag sku phreng bcu ba mchog sprul chos dbyings rdo rje/ bcu gcig pa chen po ye shes rdo rje/ zhwa dmar bdun pa ye shes snying po/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i yang sprul de ma thag pa mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje/ zhe chen rab 'byams lnga ba kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs gangs 1

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/can bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag chen por gyar ba dag dang / gzhan yang ༄mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho/ grub pa'i dbang po gtsang ba byams pa chos 'dzin/ smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi nyin byed phyag mdzod byams pa gsung rab/ sman rgyal g.yu thog gnyis pa lha rje stag bla nor bu/lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po gyi lung sras po sku mched/ rtsod rigs smra ba'i seng chen 'gya ba a lags mdo sngags/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po khra dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas/ yongs 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros/ bstan pa'i nyin byed a rig dge bshes chen mo/ gsang chen bka' babs shar wod grags pa bzang po/ mdo rgyud smra ba gyang sprul don yod rdo rje/ nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta sku phyogs shing bza' sku phreng / rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa/ rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba'i mkhan chen a skong blo bzang rdo rje/ theg mchog smra ba'i bka' babs kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo sogs mkhas dbang nor bu'i phreng ba zam ma chad par yul 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'am dus yun ring por bzhugs te mdzad phrin rgya cher bskyangs pa dang /dgon gnas dang dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde dag smra ma dgos/ khyim pa sbra nag pa dag gi khrod du'ang yig tshang lo rgyus gleng ba'i dge 2

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 3thon cing / dpe gtam sgrung rgyud 'chad la mnga' brnyes pa/ dkar nag rtsis kyi 'phrul la thogs pa med cing / gso byed sman gyi lugs la dbang 'byor ba/ ri mo dang yi ge'i bzo rtsal la mdzes byang gi cha khyad du thon pa sogs mang du byung 'dug par brten de dag gis mdzod pa'i bstan bcos rig gnas kyi shul bzhag tu gyur ba par ma dang bris ma'i glegs bam du byas pa'ang da lta'i bar mi nyung ba zhig bzhugs yod pa la/ spyir grub mtha'i dbang du byas na yul 'dir snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge ldan pa/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba sogs bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha' che rigs phal cher zhig mnyam gnas su bzhugs shing / sa bab kyi dbang du byas tshe'ang mdo khams lho byang 'brel mtshams su chags yod pa sogs kyi dbang gis yul 'di'i rig gnas spyi dang dmangs khrod kyi rig gnas tshun chad la mdo khams rig gnas ma lag gnyis ka 'dres pa las byung ba'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod par brten/ myur skyob dang zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi'i rin thang 'gangs che ba zhig yod par gdon mi za/de'i phyir spyir bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bya bzhag la rang ngos kyi nus shugs 'bul ba dang / sgos thun min — 3

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rang khyad thon pa'i sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag myur skyob dang dar spel byed pa'i kun slong gis bskul te/ nged las khungs nas 'tshol bsdu sgrig gsum gyi bya ba yun ring spel mthar dpe rnying mi nyung ba zhig lag son byung ba las bdams pa brgyud/ 〈mgo log sa khul mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉zhes pa zhig bsgrigs nas rim par dpe deb skor zhig par du skrun par rgya che'i klog pa po dag gi gdeng 'jog legs po dang 'brel yod sde khag gi gzengs bstod thob/ rting skul de dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rig gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun te nga tshos rim pa sngar las spags te/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉kyi par skrun jus gzhi gsar ba zhig bzos nas khul srid gzhung dang 'brel yod mgo khrid la yar zhu byas pas rgyab skyor dang khas len legs par thob par brten da lta jus gzhi dngos su lag star byed pa'i skal ba legs po thob/de la 'dir〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig rtsom sgrig par skrun bcas kyi skor gsal bshad du 'os pa 'ga' zhig zhu ba 'di lta ste/1 nga tshos bya ba 'di spel ba la mgo log khul u dang / khul 4

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 3dmangs chen/ khul srid gzhung / khul srid gros bcas 'go khrid tshan skor che bzhi dang 'brel yod sde khag gi 'gan 'khur ba las grub pa'i ched don 'go khrid tshan chung btsugs thog 'brel yod don bya gang ci'i thad bka' skor snyan seng zhus pa'i dgongs don ltar bsgrubs pa yin la/ ched dmigs bya ba'i jus gzhi yig thog nas khul mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan thob cing brgyud spel gnang ba dang bstun pa sha stag yin/ dus mtshungs su ma phyi'i yig rnying yod tshad so so'i 'brel yod gnyer bdag dang chos bdag dgon bdag sogs brgyud de tshul ldan lugs mthun sgos 'tshol sdud byas shing / khong tshor gros zhu byas te par skrun byed par thugs mthun yid 'thad byung ba yin la/ rgyun srol lam gsang ba sngags dang 'brel ba sogs kyi dbang gis bka' dog dgos min dag kyang khong tsho'i dgongs 'dod bka' 'khrol dang bstun pa ma gtogs nged cag gi lag tu gang son ltar gzu lum sger gcod byas pa gcig kyang med/2 mthun rkyen 'byor ba'i gnas bab 'og gsung 'bum gcig la'ang bris ma dang par ma'i ma phyi ci rnyed cig nye bar bsdus te phan tshun bsdur gshib sgos gang rgyas shos kyi rmang gzhi'i steng gzhan las kha bskangs shing / dmangs khrod du kha 'thor du 5

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhugs pa'i thor bu dag kyang lag tu ci 'ong gis gsab snon byas yod pas/ so so'i gsung 'bum gang la mtshon na'ang mig snga ltar na da lta'i〈dpe tshogs〉'dir 'khod pa kho na kha tshang shos dang rgyas shos su brtsi chog snyam/3 gsung chos go rim sgrig stangs skor la sngon gyi ma phyi gang legs shos su snang ba de'i sgrig stangs gzhir bzhag gi rmang gzhi'i steng gcig 'gyur dang dgos dbang sogs la gzhigs te rtsom sgrig pa nas las babs kyi 'gan dbang spyad de 'os 'tsham gyi skyar sgrig dang slar sdeb kyang byas yod/4 ma phyi phal cher la dpe chod yang yang bgyis la tshad ldan gyi par gzhi med pa sogs kyi dbang gis yi ge mi dag cing / chad lhag shor ba/ go rim 'chol ba/ ma yig mi gsal ba sogs cung mang ba la rang blos lcigs pa 'khrul med du snyam pa dag legs par bcos shing dag par bsgrigs la/ dogs gzhir mthong ba du ma zhig gzigs pa yangs shing de phyogs su nang rgyus che ba'i mkhas pa du mar drung bcar bka' 'dri yang yang byas te dogs pa chod pa dag de bzhin du bcos/ re zhig khungs lung mi gsal zhing dpog par dka' ba re zung 'dug pa phyis kyi dpyad gzhir zin bris su bgyis thog 'ol tshod kyis ma bcos shing dpyad yams la ma 6

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 3/jiX/ /rdogre/ //bye/ //bye/ /༷༷/ /bye/shā'ajus par ma sor 'a ga byas nga / 'ga' ga la na shas bar 'dod pa'i yi ge de zur gyi zla khyim du bkod yod/ 5 klog bde bar gzhigs te gsung chos bye brag pa phal mo cher mdzad byang sogs las dras te kha byang bkod cing / sa bcad blangs la/ ldeb byang yang bye brag tu bkod yod/6 ba zur 'dogs min lta bu sogs yi ge skor zhig gi bkol stangs da lta'i dag yig 'ga' zhig dang gcig tu mthun min yod kyang mkhas pa tshad ldan gyi phyag rgyun la thar chags su yod phyin khungs lung re yod srid la phyis su dag yig zhib dpyod pa dag gi dpyad gzhir nye bar mkho yang srid snyam nas ji bzhin sor 'jog byas/ gzhan yang ma yig tu skabs 'gar mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung thung ngu tsam re yongs su drangs 'dug pa zhib par dpyad tshe gong 'og gi gsung gang rung re de'i zur rgyan nam gsal 'don ci rigs su song ba sogs 'brel shin tu che bas dgos dbang la gzhigs nas 'dir yang ma yig ltar bkod pa lags/bye brag rdo grub chen rin po che 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung 'bum la gsal bshad du zhu dgos pa zhig ni khong la da reb kyi deb bdun po 'dir 'khod pa las gzhan da dung gsung chos mang tsam yod par nges la de ltar du'ang thos mod dus dbang 7

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du gyur bas yid phangs la/ nga tshos rtsad gcod byas pa ltar na'ang khong gis mdzad pa'i rus mdzod deb gcig da dung yod nges su 'dug kyang da reb lag son ma byung la/ dpal ldan bla ma la rdol thabs kyi ca cos bstod pa ces pa'i rtsom de'ang cung zad kha mi tshang bar 'dug pas slad char don gnyer can dag la thugs 'dog do gzigs kyi las su zhu'o/ /mtshams 'dir slebs tshe nga tshos cis kyang dran yul du bslang bar 'os pa ni〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid la thog mtha' gang rung du thugs khur rgyab skyor khyad du gnang zhing 'di nyid kyi ched du sku tshegs 'o brgyal mdzad pa'i 'brel yod 'go khrid dang mkhas dbang blo mthun gyi tshogs dag yin te/ khong cag rnam pa'i rgyab skyor rogs ram dang bral phyin〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid klog pa po dag gi spyan lam du gzigs mor spro ba'i de ring gi skal ba bzang po 'di nyid nyams par 'gyur bas/ nga tshos khong rnam par lhag bsam dag pas bka' drin zhu ba lags/ lhag par du〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun sogs gang ci'i thad thugs khur dang phyag ston bla lhag gnang zhing / gnad don du ma'i 'gag mdor gyur ba par skrun ma dngul gyi mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i cha nas bka' drin khyad du thon cing mdzad rjes kun las lhag 8

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 3pa ni khul u'i hru'u ci gzhon pa khul gna' rtsom dpe tshogs 'tshol sdud dag sgrig par skrun 'go khrid tshan chung gi tshan gtso sku zhabs pad ma rnam rgyal lags yin pas rang re 'brel yod mi rabs snga phyi kun nas khong gi bka' drin yid la 'chang zhing rjes su dran par 'os zhes 'di gar ched du gsal 'debs zhus pa lags/ de bzhin rdzong gtso smug lo lags nas kyang sa gnas mi rigs rig gnas phyogs dgongs klong yangs la spyod pa mdzangs pa'i bka' drin bstsal ba mdzad pa dge ba'i phyag rjes su che/gzhan yang zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang bod yig rtsom sgrig khang nas nga tshor phyogs gang ci'i thad bla na med pa'i mthun rkyen bskrun cing mi rigs rig gnas la gcig tu brtse ba'i lhag bsam dkar pos phyogs du ma nas dmigs bsal chen po'i mdzad pa bskyangs pas dngos gnas bka' drin che zhu/ lnga rig mkhas pa'i dbang po bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang bde legs rab rgyas dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po 'ju bkra shis bzang po nas kyang〈dpe tshoṭa〉'di la thugs khur sku tshegs kyi mdzad pa bzhes shing / gsung chos sam mdzad pa po so so la 'brel yod kyi dgon sde bla sprul rnam pas rang ngos kyi mthun rkyen sbyar ba'ang rang re klog pa po dang bcas pas yid la bsrel bar 'os pa nyid do//9

pod 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum//rten /)she rtse:tsho re/nya she:( /rje/mjug mthar da du zhu bya / nga ra gna' ma ma ga par skrun gyi nyams myong zhan cing / dag sgrig par zhu byed pa'i chu tshad dma' la/ dus tshod kyis gtug cing las brel che ba sogs kyi rkyen gyis dpe tshogs la nor 'gal gyi cha yod nges yin pas/ rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnam par thugs dkrugs dwangs zhu dang 'brel phyi phyir sman pa'i yo bcos dgongs 'char la'ang bsri ba med par 'tshal//zhes mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang nas/2003lo'i zla10tshes8la/10

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ bkra shis/mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ karma tshe ring /rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pod gsum pa/mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gzhung las khang gis bsdu sgrig byas/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun nas bkram/khreng tu'u hru'u thung par 'debs 'gan 'khri tshad yod kun sis dpar/2003lo'i zla10par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2006lo'i zla6par par thengs gnyis pa dpar/par grangs/ 1301khe2300dpe rtags/ rwa52smo7—5409—2739—9dzeku 44deb bdun po la rin sgor/ 180 00

〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dag sgris/ dpe skrun bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gi ming tho/tshan gtso/ pad ma rnam rgyal/tshan gtso gzhon pa/byis tshe ring / rdo rje bkra shis/bstan chos/ 'jigs med/ rdo rje/gces ma/ klu skyabs/ nor sde/khongs mi(ming rim bod yig ka mad ltar bsgrigs pa)klu skyabs/ dge legs/ mgon lha/cin nor bu/ gces ma/ 'ju skal bzang /'jigs med/ bstan chos/ thub bzang /dung gces/ rdo rje/ rdo rje bkra shis/nor sde/ nor bu/ pad ma rnam rgyal/byis tshe ring / tshul khrims/ tshe ring skyabs/
8skyi:3trī
